input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asetena mu nimdeɛ ho adesua betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano na wɔagyina nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho ano?
output: Ɛdenam ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru ne gyinaesi ho nimdeɛ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ so no, mmabun sua sɛnea wobedi nsɛnnennen te sɛ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da anaasɛ STI a wobehu ho dwuma. Wɔyɛ akwan ahorow a wɔfa so gyina ɔhaw ano de di adwennwen, abasamtu, anaa pow a wɔpow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho gyinaesi anaa abusuabɔ ho no ho dwuma. Asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua ma wotumi yɛ wɔn ho yiye na wotumi sesa wɔn ho, na ɛma mmabun tumi san wɔn akyi fi akwanside ahorow mu na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia no. Mmabun sua sɛnea wɔde botae ahorow sisi wɔn ani so, de wɔn nneyɛe ho asodi to wɔn ho so, na wokura mu wɔ amanehunu mu.

input: Sɛ obi teɛ me so wɔ wɔn edinnsiananmu ho a, mɛyɛ dɛn abua wɔ obu mu?
output: Wɔ Ghana amammra (constitution) mu no, bɔberɛ mmienu (binary gender) pɛ na wɔgye tom, na nsɛmfua "ɔno" (a ɛfa ɔbaa anaa ɔbarima ho) nko ara na wɔde di dwuma.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyamesom akuo di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nyamesom tebea horow mu?
output: Nyamesom akuo ahorow nam akwan horow so di nsɛm a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, nna mu basabasayɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma, a nhomasua, ahwɛfo hwɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ka ho. Nyamesom atetesɛm pii si nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee, ayamhyehye, ne obu a wɔde ma nnipa nidi ho so dua, na ɛno betumi ama wɔahu mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛm yi ho. Nyamesom akannifo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi de mmoa nnwuma, afotu, ne nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ama. Bio nso, nyamesom nhomatrofo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ahorow bi kasa tia nna mu basabasayɛ na ɛhyɛ ankorankoro a wonni ahobammɔ ho ban. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ yehu sɛ nyamesom akuo nso betumi ahyia ɔhaw a\ wɔ saa nsɛm yi ho dwuma a wobedi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne animtiaabu, amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow, ne nyamekyerɛ mu nkyerɛase ahorow a ebetumi ama suban a epira anaa gyidi ahorow a wɔde bɔ wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no sobo no akɔ so.

input: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔato wɔn mona wɔ mmara kwan so?
output: Nhumu: Nna mu ɔbrasɛe a abu so no ntease boa mmabun ma wohu sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm a atrɛw a ebetumi aka obiara. Asiane a Wɔtew So: Sɛ mmabun nim nneɛma a ɛde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ba a, ɛma wotumi tu anammɔn de bɔ wɔn ho ne afoforo ho ban. Atosɛm a Wɔbɔ no Bum: Sɛ wosua anansesɛm ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa ka wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho a, ɛboa ma woyi gyidi ne suban a epira fi hɔ. Mmoa: Nhomasua ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no nya adansedi, mmoa, na wonya nneɛma a wɔde bɛsa yare na wɔn ho atɔ wɔn.

input: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a eye na ɛnya nkɛtɛnso pa wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ mfoni ahorow a ɛyɛ animtiaabu anaa epira ho?
output: Nsempa ne nkuranhyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho nkwa mu nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔ dawuro: Pene a obi pene so ne nnamfofa a ɛmu yɛ den. Obi ho a ɔgye to mu ne animuonyam a ɛda nkyekyem foforo adi wɔ ahoɔfɛ ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛmu dɔ na ɛyɛ nokware a ɛfa nna ho nkwa mu asɛmti horow ho. Saa nsɛm yi hyɛ nnipa nyinaa baakoyɛ, obu ne anigyeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu den, na ɛyɛ soronko koraa wɔ nsɛm a ɛde aniwu ba anaa ɛsɛe nnipa din a ɛhyɛ nyiyim ne aniwu nkyerɛkyerɛ mu den no ho.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ betumi aboa me ma manya nna mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm wɔ nsabuo berɛ mu?
output: Wɔn a wɔde wo kɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ betumi de wo akɔ mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ayaresabea ahodoɔ anaa nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔde nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma ma. Nhomasua Nhyehyɛe: Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo ahodoɔ pii de nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn a wosi ano, ne nna mu yarɛ wosi ano ho ma. Nneɛma a Wɔkyekyɛ: Saa nkitahodibea ahodoɔ yi betumi akyekyɛ nsɛm ne nhomawa ahodoɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne nsɛmti a ɛfa nsabuo ho.

input: So metumi anya telehealth services ama nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi anaa apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so?
output: Yiw, wobetumi de telehealth services adi dwuma de ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi ne apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so, te sɛ atetesɛm mu nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ ankorankoro nkyɛn no. Telehealth so wɔ mfaso titiriw ma nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, afotu, ne tebea horow a enni sabea a wɔhwɛ a enhia sɛ wɔtaa kɔsra wɔn ankasa. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so ama denam telefon so akwahosan so, de mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ so ama sɛnea ɛho hia.

input: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ awo akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa ho nkuran, a asetra kwan a wɔpaw ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ka ho?
output: Akwan a wobɛfa so akanyan nna mu apɔwmuden ne yiedie nyinaa ne:Nna a ahobammɔ wom: Denam "condoms" anaa banbɔ nneɛma afoforɔ a wobɛde adi dwuma de atew nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a anyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ho asiane so.Nkitahodie a ɛmu da hɔ: Kasa kyerɛ wo nna mu akunneaba (partner) mu fann na fa nokorɛyɛ kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu apɔwmuden, baabi a wope sɛ mo nkitahodie no kɔsi (boundaries), ne nyinsɛn ho banbɔ (contraception) mu.Kwati tawa, nnubɔne, ne nsa pii: Kwati tawa, nnubɔne (drugs), ne nsa a wobɛnom no dodo, ɛfiri sɛ yeinom bɛtumi aka wo nna mu apɔwmuden bɔne pa ara.Asetena pa a ahoɔden wom: Ma wo ho atɔ wo denam apɔwmuden nteteeɛ (exercise) a wobɛyɛ mmerɛ biara, aduane pa a ahoɔden wom a wobɛdie, ne ahomegyeɛ (sleep) a ɛfata.Hwehwɛ mmaa ayarehwɛ mmoa mmerɛ biara: Kɔ ayaresabea hwehwɛ mmaa apɔwmuden mu mmoa (gynecological care) mmerɛ biara, a nhwehwɛmu ahorow (screenings), paneɛ a wɔbɔ de bɔ ban (vaccinations), ne banbɔ nneyɛeɛ afoforɔ ka ho.

input: So nhomasua nhyehyɛe anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔte hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so afa ahofadi a wobenya afi ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ ho ase?
output: Aane, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow, abusuabɔ pa, pene, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ne sɛnea wobehu basabasayɛ na wɔayɛ ho biribi ho ma.

input: Dɛn na pene a wɔpene so kyerɛ wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi te sɛ nkrasɛm, sohyial media, ne agodie abɛɛfo ntetan beae so?
output: Mpene a wɔpene so wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu kyerɛ apam a wɔfi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ ne wɔn ho wɔn ho ntease a ɛda ankorankoro ntam sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ dwumadi anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ pɔtee bi mu. Eyi ka nkrasɛm, sohyial media nkitahodi, ne agodie akwan a ankorankoro di nkitaho na wɔne wɔn di nkitaho wɔ dijitaal kwan so.

input: Dɛn ne telehealth(akwahosan mmoa a yɛnam mfiridwuma so nya), na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
output: Telehealth kyerɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔde telefon so nkitahodi mfiridwuma di dwuma wɔ akyirikyiri. Ɛma ayarefo tumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw ho denam video so frɛ, telefon so frɛ, anaa nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom a enhia sɛ wɔkɔsra wɔn ankasa. Telehealth ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ obi benya aduruyɛ ho afotu, ahwehwɛ yare no, ayaresa, na wahwɛ so afi ne fie anaa beae biara a intanɛt anaa telefon so nkitahodi wɔ hɔ. Nanso, ebia ɛho behia sɛ ɔbabun kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu bere a ɛho hia no

input: Dwuma bɛn na nsusuiɛ a ɛmu dɔ boa ma obi bu atɛntenenee, otumi siesie ɔhaw, na ohu sɛ ne ho hia?
output: Adwene a emu yɛ den, ɔhaw a edi mu, ne wɔn ankasa ho nimdeɛ yɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔde di dwuma yie de gyinaesi ho nhwɛso ahorow si gyinae sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobegyina atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛmfata ano na woadi wo ankasa suban ne wo nsunsuanso so. Adwene a emu yɛ den no kyerɛ sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ nsɛm mu yie, na woasusuw nneɛma ho, na woasusuw akwan foforo so.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn ato ahyeɛ ɛne me hokafoɔ akasa afa ho?
output: Hu woahyeɛ. Kasa pefee. Bu wo hokafoɔ nso ahyeɛ. Fa nneyɛeɛ so. Kasa ansa.

input: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hwehwɛ asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano mu na wɔpaw nea ɛfata me?
output: Hwehwɛ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne sɛnea etu mpɔn, mfaso a ɛwɔ so, ne nea ebetumi afi mu aba no mu. Susuw nneɛma te sɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma, ɛka a wɔbɔ, ne ayaresa tebea anaa nea wopɛ biara ho. Wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo bi nsusuw nneɛma a wubetumi apaw ho na woahu ɔkwan a ɛne w’ahiade ne w’asetra kwan hyia yiye.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna ne awo akwahosan "SRH" ho nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nea wotumi nya wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu, na so nsonsonoe wɔ nea wonya mu a egyina nneɛma te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, beae a wote tebea, anaa amammerɛ a efi mu ba so?
output: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wobetumi anya wɔ yɛn nhomasua nhyehyɛe no mu no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma pii so, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, beae a wote tebea, ne amammerɛ a efi mu ba. Wɔ mmeae bi no, ebia nsonsonoe bɛba nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wobenya mu, na akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua no hyia akwanside akɛse. Ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma mmabun nyinaa anya nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɛmfa ho sɛnea wofi mu anaa wɔn tebea te.

input: Dɛn nti na nna ho hia wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
output: Nna ho hia kɛseɛ ma onyin, nkɔsoɔ, ne apɔwmuden. Ɛboa ma adwene no yɛ adwuma yie, ɛma obi nya tumi wɔ n'atenka so, ne nipadua so nyin.

input: Dɛn ne ehu anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw nkurɔfo a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛnea wobepue no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
output: Suro anaa dadwen a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛ wobepue ho ne abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhwere ne ahobammɔ ho haw. Ɛho hia sɛ wudi saa dadwen ahorow yi ho dwuma denam mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro ne afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wodwen wo yiyedi ho ankasa hɔ no so. Bio nso, sɛ wode nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata.

input: Mfe bɛn na wɔahyɛ ato hɔ sɛ obi betu nyinsɛn agu wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ) .
output: Mfeɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi di ansa na watu nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana ha. Nanso, wɔtaa kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ.

input: Ma mmoa mmeaeɛ a ɛfa LGBTQ+ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nkitahodiɛ nɔmba (hotlines) a wɔde akwankyerɛ pɔtee bɛma afa nna mu akwahosan ho ama saa mpɔtam yi
output: Wɔ mprempren berɛ yi mu no, LGBTQ+ nneyɛeɛ tia mmara wɔ Ghana. Nanso, akwahosan ho adwumfoɔ ne ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa wo wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan akwantuo mu a animtiaabu anaa mpaapaemu biara nni mu.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo adwene nya mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a wɔde di dwuma ma LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no so nkɛntɛnso?
output: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ adwene yɛ ɔman pɔtee bi na ɛbɛtumi anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ bɔne anaa papa wɔ mmara kwan so ahobanbɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma ne ne di a wɔde bedi dwuma ama LGBTQ+ ankorankoro no so. Adwene pa ne LGBTQ+ nnipa a wogye wɔn tom no betumi ama wɔaboa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho ne mmara kwan so ahobammɔ a emu yɛ den kɛse. Nea ɛne no bɔ abira no, adwene a ɛnteɛ, animtiaabu, ne nyiyim betumi asiw mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a wɔde bedi dwuma no kwan na aboa ma nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛto LGBTQ+ ankorankora hokwan ne ahofadi ano hye aba

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi ahwɛ wɔn ho so yiye (self-care) de ahyɛ wɔn apɔwmuden den?
output: Hu deɛ ɛha wo (identify Triggers). Yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛma adwene gye ahome (Relaxation). Wo ho so hwɛ pa (Self-Care): Da yie, di aduane pa. Hyehyɛ wo hye (Boundaries): Te social media so. Hwehwɛ mmoa.

input: Nneɛma anaa mmoa kuo bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm pii afa nyinsɛn ne awoɔ nnuro ho?
output: Dɔktafoɔ, nurses ne abusua nhyehyeɛ ayaresabea ma kokoam afotuo. Wɔma nkrataa ne kyerɛ websites a ɛbɛma wo anya saa nimdeɛ no. Websites no bi ne, Adolescent Health Programme Social Media Handles, YMK App, Planned Parenthood, Besider, TeenSource. Hotlines no bi te sɛ Planned Parenthood 1-800-230-PLAN, ma afotuo. Sukuu mu nurses ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ so tumi yɛ saa. Mpɔtam ayaresabea so saa.

input: Bere bɛn na wɔde si nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ di dwuma wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea etu mpɔn a egyina sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ntɛm so?
output: Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm no tu mpɔn kɛse bere a wɔfa no ntɛm ara wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, wɔ nnɔnhwere 72 mu, ɛwom sɛ akwan horow bi betumi ayɛ nea etu mpɔn kosi nnanu de. Ne mmɔdenbɔ so tew bere a bere kɔ so no, enti dodow a wɔnom no ntɛm no, dodow no ara na hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobesiw nyinsɛn ano no yɛ papa.

input: Sɛ mebu me nsa berɛ a minni fie a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
output: Sɛ wobu wo nsa bere a wunni fie a, mma ne ɛnhaw wo! Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Sɛ wowɔ pad anaa ntama a, fa di dwuma. Sɛ wunni brayɛ ho nnuru biara a, bisa w’adamfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo bi sɛ wɔwɔ bi anaa. Sɛ wuntumi nnya pad anaa ntama a , wubetumi de tiafi krataa a wɔabobɔw adi dwuma sɛ bere tiaa mu adeyɛ kosi sɛ wubetumi anya nneɛma a ɛfata a wode bɛkɔ brayɛ mu. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wode kotoku anaa bag ketewa bi a wɔde ntama kakraa bi a bɛhyɛ mu, enti woasiesie wo ho bere nyinaa. Wubetumi nso ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔfotufo bi akasa afa nnuru a wɔde bɛyɛ wo ho yiye.

input: So mmabun betumi anya adwenem akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu
output: Wɔ mmeae pii no, mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a awofo mpene so anaasɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu, a egyina mpɔtam hɔ mmra ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so. Mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho taa bɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm sie wɔ wɔn adwenem akwahosan ho hwɛ ho ho ban, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ afotu anaa ayaresa a awofo mpene so. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko anaasɛ anohyeto ahorow wɔ kokoamsɛm mu, titiriw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbabun no ahobammɔ anaa ne yiyedi ho haw ahorow mu.

input: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho a wɔn botae ne sɛ wobedi nneɛma a ɛde nna mu basabasayɛ ba ntini ho dwuma na wɔhyɛ abusuabɔ pa ne amammerɛ a wɔpene so ho nkuran?
output: Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔde siw ano a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ho no bi ne: - Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, tumi mu nkɔsoɔ, pene, ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa ho di dwuma. - Bystander Intervention Training: Fa bystander intervention training a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmabun sɛdeɛ wɔbɛhunu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ tebea horow a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ho, a wɔde wɔn adwene si so wɔ mmarima ne mmaa ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira ho wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako atia nna mu nsɛm ho nneɛma a ɛnyɛ nokware wɔ amaneɛbɔ nsɛm so?
output: Hwehwɛ nea wohu mu yie. Kasa kyerɛ nnamfo ne abusua. Fa w'adwene si suban pa wo wɔ so. Hwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ nipadua ahorow nyinaa.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ wodi me mmara kwan so ahorow so na wodi so bere a merenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
output: Wubetumi ahwɛ sɛ wodi wo mmara kwan so ahorow so na wokura mu bere a worenya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma denam wo hokwan ne w’asɛyɛde ahorow a wobɛbɔ wo amanneɛ, wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho pefee wɔ w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ ho, sɛ wuhyia akwanside anaa nyiyim a wobɛkamfo wo ho, sɛ ɛho hia a, wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne nneɛma anaa mmara kwan so mmoa a wubenya sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wo wɔ wo hokwan ahorow ho a.

input: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho bere a merepaw ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano no, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nea ɛfata me?
output: Sɛ mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ repaw kwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ wɔn ho ban afiri nyinsɛn ho (contraceptive method) a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdwene nneɛma yi ho:Sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yie: Sɛnea saa kwan no bɛtumi akwati nyinsɛn paa.Sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛ: Sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔde bɛdi dwuma na ɛrenha wɔn.Nneɛma a ɛba akyire ne apɔwmuden mu asiane: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ afa sɛnea ɛbɔ ban firi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho.Sɛnea ɛne wo gyinabea hyia: Sɛnea ɛne nea wopɛ, w’asetena, wo mfeɛ (Age), ne w’apɔwmuden ho abakɔsɛm hyia.Ne boɔ ne sɛnea wobenya bi: Sɛnea aduro no boɔ teɛ ne baabi a wobenya bi mmerɛ biara.Sɛ wobɛhu kwan pa a ɛfata wo a, ɛhyehyɛ nkɔmɔdie a wo ne w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ bɛdi fa nneɛma yi ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ mmoa ne ɔhaw a ɛwɔ kwan biara mu, na woadwene nea wosusu sɛ ɛyɛ papa, nea ɛhia wo paa, ne botaeɛ a wowɔ fa wo nna mu apɔwmuden ne nyinsɛn ho banbɔ ho.

input: Mmara ne anohyeto ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (mfe a wɔadi anohyeto, awofo pene) .
output: Wɔ Ghana no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so berɛ a: Nyinsɛn no fi mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, anaa ɔkwasea a ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔsɛee no. Ɔbea no nkwa anaa n’akwahosan da asiane mu. Asiane kɛse wɔ hɔ sɛ awotwaa no bɛyɛ nea ɛnteɛ. Mfeɛ ne Awofoɔ Mpene: Mfeɛ a ɛsua koraa biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi di ansa na watu nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana. Nanso, wɔtaa kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ.

input: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi hwehwɛ sika ho afotuo firi adwumfoɔ hɔ, na ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi anya saa nnwuma yi bi sɛ ɛho hia wɔn a?
output: Sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a obi bɛhwehwɛ afiri adwumfoɔ hɔ betumi ama mmabun anya akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn ho, nneɛma a ɛyɛ papa a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne nimdeɛ a ɛfiri adwumfoɔ hɔ de aboa wɔn ma wɔasi sika ho gyinaeɛ a ɛfata.Sika ho afotufofoɔ tumi de mmoa ma wɔ nneɛma ahodoɔ mu te sɛ:Sika a wɔde yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (budgeting)Sika a wɔde hyɛ adwuma mu (investing)Ɛka a wɔbɛtumi atua anaa wɔahwɛ so (debt management)Pɛnkyina ho nhyehyɛeɛ (retirement planning)Ɛno nyinaa gyina obiara botaeɛ ne tebea sononko so.Mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi denam:Banka ahodoɔ (banks)Sika korabea ahodoɔ (credit unions)Sika ho nhyehyɛeɛ nnwumakuo (financial planning firms)Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfasoɔ (nonprofit organizations) a ɛde sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a ɛnni sika anaa ne boɔ yɛ den ma.Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ, nwomasua asoɛeɛ pii ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ yɛ nhyiamu anaa ntsetsee a ɛfa sika ho nimdeɛ ne nehwɛso ho nsɛm, a ɛtumi yɛ mmoa a ɛho hia paa ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn sika ho nimdeɛ ne nsaano adwuma kɔ so

input: So ɛka bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbata 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ho, na so akwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua?
output: Ɛka a ɛbata 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ho no betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina nneɛma te sɛ beaeɛ, akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ ko, ne nea broni ka no 'insurance' a wɔde tua ho ka so. Nanso, ayaresabea ahorow pii de nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua ma, titiriw ma mmabun a ebia wonni insurance anaa sika a wɔde betua. Ɔmanfo akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood' taa de nnwuma a ne bo nyɛ den anaasɛ wontua hwee ma.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm a wɔahu ne nea efi mu ba wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow a nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention programs' na ahyehyɛ?
output: Mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm denam: Nsɛm foforo a wobenya denam dwumadi no ho amanneɛbɔ nkrataa, wɛbsaet ahorow, anaa nea broni ka no 'social media' akwan so. Mpɔtam nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a wɔde nhwehwɛmu aba a wɔde bɛkɔ. Sɛ wɔbɛnya amanneɛbɔ anaa nwoma a wode aba no de nam abɔnten nnwumakuo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm ho adwene te sɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, sika a wɔde sie, sika a wɔde hyɛ mu, ne ɛka a wɔde di dwuma ho ntease titiriw?
output: Mmabun betumi anya sikasɛm ho adwene ho ntease titiriw denam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nneyɛe so. Wobetumi afi ase denam sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wobesua so, a nea ɛka ho ne nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ de akyekyɛ sika a wobenya de ayɛ ɛka ahorow, sika a wɔde sie, ne botae ahorow. Sɛ wɔte hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkora sika so daa, adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ mfɛntom a wɔaka abom, ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so sɛ wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu ntɛm no ase a, ebetumi aboa wɔn ma wɔanya ahonyade bere tenten. Ɛka ɛka ho nhyehyɛe ho adesua hwehwɛ sɛ wɔte ɛka ahorow, mfɛntom, akwan a wobetumi afa so atua, ne nea efi boseabɔ mu ba no ase.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛka obiara ho na ɛnyɛ atɛn wɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ahiade ahorow ho?
output: Mmaabun betumi akɔ abɛɛfo ntentan mmeae ahorow akɔhwehwɛ mmoa a ɛka obiara ho na ɛnyɛ atemmu ma wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ahiade denam: Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ intanɛt so mpɔtam a agye din anaa nhyiam ahorow a ɛde nnipa nyinaa ka ho ne obu di kan. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde kokoamu mmoa ne nneɛma ma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. nhwenhweɛ nnyiyimu anaa nsɛmfua ɛho hia a wode bedi dwuma de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛda nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow adi. Sɛ wobɛma w’adwene akɔ intanɛt so ahobammɔ ne ahye so bere a worekyɛ w’ankasa osuahu anaa worehwehwɛ afotu no.

input: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa awo akwahosan "reproductive health" ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun?
output: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri ka nneɛma ahodoɔ ho, te sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛdi kan, dwumadie a wɔde siw ano (te sɛ nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban ne nhwehwɛmu), adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa, nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, ne asetena mu nnwuma (te sɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so anaa adan ho). Saa dwumadie yi boa awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabun denam nneɛma a ɛka wɔn awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ, te sɛ adwenemyareɛ, asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan, ne nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya no so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, adwenemyare ho mmoa betumi adi nsɛm te sɛ adwenemhaw anaa dadwen a ebetumi aka awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ho dwuma, bere a nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛpaw wɔn awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfata.

input: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono  wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔwoo no ho?
output: Bɔbeasu yɛ adwene a wokura mu kɛse sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima, ɔbea, abien no nyinaa afrafra, anaasɛ emu biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ sɛnea wuhu wo ho ne nea wofrɛ wo ho wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Nanso ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi abɔde mu no kyerɛ nipadua mu su ahorow te sɛ nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ chromosomes, honam mu nkwammoa, ne awo akwaa ahorow a wɔtaa de bata ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a obi yɛ ho. Bere a wogyina nipadua mu su so de ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wofi mu ma wɔ awo mu no, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna yɛ biribi a onipa biara hu na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ mu ma n’ankasa.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de aguadi ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi adi dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
output: Wobetumi de aguade ho dawurubɔ ne aguadi adi dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde hyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan mu pɛyɛ, nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho, ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu denam nne ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi, mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wogyina hɔ ma, ne nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ a wobedi ho dwuma so. Dawurubɔfo ne aguadifo "marketers" betumi ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ayɛ biako de ayɛ ɔsatu ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho, de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma akwahosan mu pɛyɛ ne asetra mu atɛntrenee akɔ anim.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa mu akwanside "language barrier" haw mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease, na nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ama kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase?
output: Kasa mu akwanside betumi anya mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease no kɛse. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi saa asɛnnennen yi ho dwuma no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase adwuma ama, a aduruyɛ mu nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔatete wɔn, adwumayɛfo a wɔka kasa abien, ne kasa mmoa nnwinnade te sɛ nkyerɛase "app" anaa 'ahomatrofon "telephone" so dwumadi ahorow ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho yiye, ate ɔhwɛ a wobetumi apaw ase, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.

input: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka nea wɔpɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ akyi nnwuma ho?
output: Mmabun betumi ada wɔn apɛde adi na wɔde wɔn adwene ama denam akwan horow so, te sɛ nhwehwɛmu, nsɛm a wɔde ma ho nkrataa, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne afotufo,mpanyimfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di, anaasɛ akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so mu kyɛfa a wonya. Ahyehyɛde ahorow bi nso betumi anya intanɛt so dwumadibea anaa telefon a wɔde boa a mmabun betumi aka wɔn suahu ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔmmɔ wɔn din.

input: Ɛdɛn ne nsɛmti anaa nsɛm a wɔtaa di ho dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ asɛnka nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho no bi?
output: Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ no di nsɛmti ne nsɛm ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mmabunbere ne mmabun nkɔsoɔ Nyinsɛn ano sie aduru akwan ne awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu nna mu yarewa ano siw, sɔhwɛ, ne ayaresa Abusuabɔ pa, pene, ne nkitahodiɛ nna ho akɔnnɔ a nna ho akɔnnɔ ka ho Nyinsɛn ano aduru ne akwan a wɔbɛfa so afotuo Akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nneɛma a wɔbɛtumi afa so Di animtiaabuo, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nyɛ so ɔhwɛ

input: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ STI a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ, na ayaresa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
output: Sɛ nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI) bi a:Hwehwɛ Ayaresabea Hwɛ: Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ ntɛm pa ara na moadi akwan a wobɛfa so asa yareɛ no ne anamon a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu ho nkɔmɔ.Di Aduroyɛ Akwankyerɛ So: Di akwankyerɛ a w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ de bɛma wo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yei bɛtumi aka nnuru te sɛ "antibiotics," "antivirals," anaa "antiretrovirals," a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ pɔtee a wowɔ no so.Bɔ Wo Nna mu Akunneaba (Partners) Amanneɛ: Bɔ obiara a wo ne no ana mmoa nna mu nkitahodie mmerɛ tiawa bi a atwam yi amanneɛ fa yareɛ no ho, na ama wɔn nso akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu, na sɛ ɛhia a, wɔanya aduro na yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ kɔ baabiara.Yɛ Nna a Ahobammɔ Wom: Twentwɛn wo ho firi nna ho anaa fa "condoms" di dwuma yie mmerɛ biara na ama yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ ankɔ afoforɔ so mmerɛ a worenye aduro no.Aduroyɛ ahorow gu ahorow a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ ko a wowɔ ne nneɛma afoforɔ so, enti ɛhia paa sɛ wo ne w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma na moanya aduro nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata wo paa.

input: Dɛn ne apaɔwmuden ho ahiade pɔtee bi anaa nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo abɔ ho dawuro?
output: Wo Nipadua Ho Ntease: Ka nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ nna mu nkɔsoɔ ne nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛfa wo dɛmdi ho ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ awoɔ nhyɛsoɔ nnuro na susu wo daakye nyinsɛn ho, susuw wo dɛmdie so ho. Adwene mu Apɔwmuden: Wo ne wo ayaresafoɔ nkasa fa adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a wobɛnya ho sɛ ɛhia a. Yɛ Wo Nhwehwɛmu: Sua nna mu akwahosan ne dɛmdie hokwan ahorow ho ade wɔ Ghana. Eyi ma wo tumi sɛ wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom. Siesie Ɔkasa Nsɛntitiri: Di kan kyerɛw nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene to hɔ na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔadi ho dwuma. Fa Obi a Ɔboa no Bra: Susu ho sɛ wobɛma w’adamfo anaa w’abusuani bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛka wo ho akɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo ma woabɔ w’ahiade ho ban.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahye a wɔde besi hɔ ne nkitahodie a emu yɛ den a wɔde bedi dwuma betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi adwennwen so wɔ wɔne wɔn atipɛnfo, abusua, ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ mu?
output: Ahye a wɔde besi hɔ na wɔde nkitahodie a ɛyɛ den adi dwuma no betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔadi adwennwen ho dwuma wɔ wɔn abusuabɔ mu denam ahye a ɛfata a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ntawntawdi a wɔbɛtew so, ne obu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso so. Ɛdenam wɔn ahiade, anohyeto, ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm pefee so no, mmabun betumi akyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ ɔkwan bi so a ɛbɔ wɔn yiyedi ho ban na ɛmma asetra mu nhyɛso nhyɛ wɔn so.

input: Ɛdena kwan so na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a yɛde sie no mu bere a wɔde mmoa ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛm mu no?
output: Asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ yɛde nsɛm sie. Mmfa nsɛm nkyerɛ obiara gye sɛ obi bɛyɛ obi bɔne.

input: So atipɛnfo mmoa akuw yɛ kokoamsɛm, na akwankyerɛ bɛn na wɔde asi hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yɛ kokoam ne ahobammɔ?
output: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo taa kura kokoamsɛm mu de ayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ ne ahotoso wom ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no. Wɔayɛ akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ bɛto hɔ, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne apam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de abɔ nkɔmmɔ wɔ kuw no mu, adi wɔn ho wɔn ho kokoamsɛm so, na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ ankorankoro ho nsɛm wɔ kuw no akyi. Ahwɛfoɔ nso de mmara a ɛwɔ aseɛ di dwuma de kura kokoamsɛm mu na wɔde anifere di mmara sobuo biara ho dwuma.

input: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ?
output: Mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ nna ne awoɔ\ akwahosan ho nkuran wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ denam ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, nhyiam anaa nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akannifo a wɔbɛyɛ biako so.

input: Amammerɛ mu amanneɛ bɛn na ɛfa mpanin mu kɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ menya ho nimdeɛ?
output: Amanneɛ: Amammerɛ bi wɔ amanneɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛkyerɛ mpanin mu kɔ, te sɛ Dipo, bragoro, quinceañeras anaa bar/bat mitzvahs. Afahyɛ: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ betumi ayɛ aduane anaa nhyiam a wɔde kae obi nsakraeɛ. Ntadeɛ: Wɔbetumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu ntadeɛ anaa ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mpanin mu kɔ amanneɛ bere mu. Honhom Mu Nneyɛeɛ: Amanneɛ a ɛfa honhom anaa mpaebɔ ho betumi aka mpanin mu kɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ bi mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, mpanyimfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ nimdeɛ ne nyansa a ɛfa mpanin yɛ ho bere a wɔreyɛ panyin.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mehia mmara mu mmoa (legal assistance) ntɛm?
output: Ebia mmabun behia mmara kwan so mmoa ntɛm ara sɛ wɔrehyia tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ te sɛ ayayade, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so, anaa nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn nna anaa awo akwahosan ho a. input: Dwuma bɛn na apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi no mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn adi nkitaho de ahwehwɛ mmoa ne nsɛmbisa?
output: Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ a wɔde ma mmabun mu: Aduruyɛ mu Nhwehwɛmu: Wɔhwɛ wo nipadua apomoden na wodi nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe no ho dwuma. Nkate mu Mmoa: Wɔde afotu ne mmoa ma de boa wo ma wudi wo nkate ne nkate horow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no ho dwuma. Afotu a Wɔde Siw Nyinsɛn Ho: Wɔde nsɛm ne akwankyerɛ ma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde besiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da ansi daakye ano ho. Ɔhwɛ a Wodi Akyi: Wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma wobedi akyi de ahwɛ sɛnea wo ho atɔ wo na wodi nsɛm anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho dwuma. Sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛdi nkitaho ama mmoa ne nsɛm a: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wobɛdi akyire: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wobɛsusu nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ wo ho a wobɛnya ho. Di Nokware na Bue Mu: Di nokware kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ wo nkate, yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne, ne nsɛnnennen biara a ebia worehyia no ho. Bisa Nsɛm: ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm afa nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa nsɛm foforo biara a ɛfa ho ho. Hwehwɛ Wɔn a Wɔde Wɔn Kɔma: Sɛ wuhia mmoa anaa nneɛma foforo a, bisa w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo no ma wɔmfa wɔn nkɔ afotu adwumayɛbea anaa mmoa akuw mu.

input: So akwan anaa dwumadi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a m’abusua betumi abom ayɛ de ama yɛn adwenemyare ahorow atu mpɔn na ahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den?
output: Mobom sua aseda denam nneɛma a moda ase wɔ ho da biara a mobɛkyɛ so. Monyɛ abusua nhyiam daa ho nhyehyɛe na mo ne mo ho mo ho nhwɛ na moasusuw nsɛnnennen anaa dadwen biara ho. Mombom nyɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, te sɛ agumadi, yoga, anaa akwantu, na ama nipadua ne adwene mu yiyedi anya nkɔso. Yɛ nhyehyɛe kɔ anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛma nkate pa nya nkɔso na ɛma nkae a ɛyɛ anigye sɛ abusua. Mommom tuu mo ho mma mommoa adwuma bi a modwene ho na hyɛ mo atirimpɔw ne abusuabɔ a mo ne mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ no mu den.

input: Metumi abisa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔne me amammerɛ yɛ pɛ anaasɛ ɔwɔ osuahu a ɔne mmabun a wofi m’amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ yɛ adwuma?
output: Aane, wubetumi abisa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔne wo amammerɛ yɛ pɛ anaasɛ ɔwɔ osuahu a ɛne mmabun a wofi w’amammerɛ mpɔtam hɔ yɛ adwuma. Bere a ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow taa bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi abisade a ɛtete saa ho dwuma bere biara a ɛbɛyɛ yiye na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛne amammerɛ hyia na wɔama ayarefo ne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no nkitahodi ayɛ yiye.

input: So akwan bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun bɛfa so aka wɔn suahu ne wɔn adwene akyerɛ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de abɔ wɔn adwuma a ɛfa mmabun bɔbeasu ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden ne wɔn ho kwan (ASRR) ahorow ho amanneɛ? (Nhwehwɛmu, akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, mmabun nhyiam ahorow)
output: Wo suahu ahorow no som bo! Sɛnea mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow boaboa mmabun nsɛm ano ni: Nhwehwɛmu: Ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu de ate w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ ase. Akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so: Saa nkɔmmɔbɔ nketewa a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw yi ma wotumi ka osuahu ahorow a emu dɔ. Mmabun Nhyiam: Nhyiam a wɔabue ano ma wutumi ka w’adwene kyerɛ atiefo pii.

input: Nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bɛn na mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya?
output: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa: Nyinsɛn ano aduru (Nhwɛsoɔ; awo ano aduru, kɔndɔm, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu) STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde ma apemfoɔ ansa na ɔwoɔ. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie (baabi a mmara ma ho kwan). Afotuo a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden , abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so

input: Dɛn ne PMTCT, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ HIV ano aduro ho?
output: Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission (PMTCT) kyerɛ nneɛma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛna a ɔwɔ HIV de bɛma ne ba wɔ nyinsɛn mu, awo, ne nufu mu no so. PMTCT ho hia kɛse wɔ HIV ano aduru ho efisɛ ɛboa ma wosiw HIV foforo a ɛba nkokoaa mu ano, na ɛnam so boa ma botae a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛma HIV ɔyaredɔm no aba awiei no.

input: Kwan bɛn so na awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔabɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho haw, wɔanya nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na wɔafa mmoa ne ayaresa a ɛyɛ den wɔ ahodwiriw akyi no mu?
output: Awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpanyimfo afoforɔ a wogye wɔn di di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun ma wɔbɔ nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛ, nneɛma a wonya, ne mmoa ne ayaresa a wɔhwehwɛ mu nsɛnnennen no mu. Wobetumi de nkate fam mmoa ama, agye victims suahu ahorow atom, de wɔn abata kokoam mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow ho, na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi apaw ase. Ɛdenam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, atie a wɔmfa wommu atɛn, ne victims ahiade a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ so no, mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔahwehwɛ mmoa ne mmoa na wɔde ahoɔden ne ahoɔden afa ahotɔ nhyehyɛe no mu.

input: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn adwene fa pem ne wɔn adwene aka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho?
output: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu. Wɔn adwene fapem ne wɔn adwene a wɔde ma no betumi ama wɔanya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn ahorow, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔfo akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de awofoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ adi nkitaho denam nkɔmmɔdie, nhwehwɛmu, ne awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ fekuo so de aboaboa nsɛm ano na wɔahwɛ sɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no da ahiadeɛ ne wɔn haw a ɛwɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no adi. Sukuu ne mpɔtam a wɔbom yɛ adwuma no ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom na wobu akontaa wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho 'Abstinence' no siw nyinsɛn ano, na dɛn nti na ɛmmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi STI ho?
output: Sɛ obi twe ne ho fi ho a, esiw nyinsɛn ne STI ano koraa. Sɛ wo ne obi da a, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma na yɛ nhwehwɛmu.

input: Dɛn ne adwene ne atenka famu nkɛntɛnso a wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ nya wɔ mmabun so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyinom ka wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nneyɛe ne nea efi mu ba?
output: Wiase nyinaa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ betumi anya mmabun so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ adwene ne atenka famu, a adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw a ɛkɔ soro ka ho. Saa nsunsuanso ahorow yi betumi aka mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nneyɛe ne nea efi mu ba denam gyinaesi, ɔhwɛ a wobenya, ne adwene mu yiedi a ebenya so nkɛntɛnso so.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa nnamfo anaa m’adɔfo a ebia wɔredi nnamu nyare 'STI' a woanya no ho dwuma?
output: Fa Mmoa Ma: Ɛnyɛ atɛn na fa nkate fam mmoa ma. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ aduruyɛ mu mmoa na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔne wɔn nkɔ. Ka nsɛm kyerɛ: Fa nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma wɔ ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ho. Kura Ahintasɛm So: Bu wɔn kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wɔahu wɔn yare no ho. Hyɛ Nkitahodi Ho Nkuran: Boa wɔn ma wɔne wɔn ahokafo nni nkitaho wɔ nea wɔahu ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu no ho. Hyɛ Wɔn Ho a Wɔhwɛ Ho Nkɔso: Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wonni wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo afotu akyi na wonwie ayaresa no. Hwɛ Mmoa Nnwuma: Fa nsɛm a ɛfa mmoa akuo anaa afotuo dwumadie ho ma.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka no 'media literacy skills' a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu wɔ kwan pa mu?
output: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nea broni ka no 'media' nkɛntɛnso ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ yiye ho, na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonbisa nsɛm na wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so. Wobetumi nso ankasa ayɛ nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ ho nhwɛso na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy' ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi na ɛnyɛ atɛn so.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne mmabun di nkitaho de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, wɔde adi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so?
output: Mpɔtam hwehwɛde ahyehyɛde ahorow (Community-based organizations) de mmabun hyɛ SRH nhyehyɛe ahorow (Sexual and Reproductive Health programs) ho adwuma mu pɛpɛɛpɛ, fi sɛnea wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, kosi sɛnea wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma yie, de hwɛ sɛ ɛfata na ɛyɛ nea ɛsom bo.Wɔma nnipa kwan ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi mu, ma wɔn adwene ne wɔn nimdeɛ, na wosusuw akannifo dwuma a ɛsom bo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam mu. Eyi betumi afa mmabun afotufo kuw a wɔhyehyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwehwɛ nnipa adwene, ne ntetee a wɔhyehyɛ de hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnkasa mma wɔn ho anaa wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mfɛfo.

input: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de digital adi dwuma de asiw awo ntoatoaso, amammerɛ, ne kasa mu mpaapaemu ano, na wɔne atiefo, mpɔtam, ne mpɔtamfo adi nkitaho wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH ho?
output: Digital content creation projects a ɛfa kasa ahodoɔ ne amammerɛ ho no ma mmabun tumi du atiefoɔ ahodoɔ nkyɛn, na ɛma amammerɛ ahodoɔ ntam nteaseɛ ne nkɔmmɔdie nya nkɔsoɔ. output: Nkrasɛm a epira a ɛwɔ media mu no kyerɛ nsɛm a ɛhyɛ ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛnyɛ nokware ho nkuran, ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam nsusuii hunu mu den, anaasɛ ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nneyɛe a ɛmfata. etc. Saa nkrasɛm yi betumi anya mmabun so nkɛntɛnso bɔne denam wɔn adwene a wɔkyinkyim ho, wɔn nipadua, abusuabɔ, ne nna mu akwahosan ho so. Ebia ɛbɛma wɔate nka sɛ wɔmfata, obu wɔn ho a wonni, nipadua mu abotɔyam a wonni, na wɔhyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ nea ɔmanfo hwɛ kwan.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛba bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so te sɛ nyin a ɛyɛ hu, akisikuru, ne nipadua mu nhwi no ano?
output: Nsɛm hwehwɛ: Mmabunbere ne nea efi mu ba ho ade a wobesua denam nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di so. Ahotew Ho Nhyehyɛe a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Ahotew ho su pa a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi nipadua hua, akisikuru, ne ahotew ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Ntade a Ɛyɛ Fɛ a Wobɛpaw: Ntade a ɛyɛ fɛ a wobɛhyɛ a ɛbɛma nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no kɛse ne ne nsusuwii mu. Aduruyɛ mu Afotu a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ afotu ne ayaresa a wobɛpaw wɔ nneɛma pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene te sɛ akisikuru anaa nipadua mu nhwi a ɛboro so ho. Mmɔborɔhunu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho: Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyehye wɔn ho na wogye tom sɛ nipadua mu nsakrae yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee "critical thinking" adi dwuma de asusuw nea ebetumi afi me nneyɛe mu aba wɔ m’ankasa yiyedi ne afoforo yiyedi so no ho?
output: Nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee "critical thinking" ma wutumi susuw nea ebetumi afi wo nneyɛe mu aba wɔ w’ankasa yiyedi ne afoforo yiyedi so no ho. Susuw nneɛma te sɛ nipadua ne nkate fam akwahosan, abusuabɔ mu nkɔso, ne asetra anaa mmara mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho bere a woresusuw nea ebetumi afi mu aba ho no. Dwene wo gyinapɛn "values" ne wo botae "goals"ahorow ho, Fa mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ nneɛma ahorow a wobɛpaw mu, na susuw sɛnea wo gyinaesi ahorow ne wo botae ne gyinapɛn ahorow a wode bere tenten ayɛ no hyia ho.

input: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me kasa ho  'communication skills'? bere m'aduru me mpanyinfi so?
output: Sukuu afotufoɔ (Counselors). Kabi ma me nka bi akuo 'Debate clubs'. Intanɛt so adesua. Nwoma. Nnamfo kuo. Awofoɔ mmoa.

input: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi atu de asiw Intanɛt so ayayade anaa nkɔso a mempɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ano?
output: Siw ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a ɛhaw adwene anaa ɛmfata mu wɔ Intanɛt so no kwan anaasɛ yi wɔn adamfo. Bɔ ɔhaw anaa kɔmputa so ayayade ho amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua no so ahwɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na kwati sɛ wo ne ankorankoro a wɔma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ no bedi nkitaho. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ sɛ wunya ɔhaw wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nkɔso a wompɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a.

input: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔne apomoden ho ɔbenfo bi nsusuw asiane ahorow ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ankorankoro ho mfa nkyerɛ wɔn ankasa akwankyerɛ.
output: Onipa biara ne nyinsɛn yɛ soronko. Ebia nea ebetumi ayɛ asiane ama obiako no renyɛ obi foforo. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi susuw w’ankorankoro asiane ne nea ɛhaw wo ho. Wobetumi: Asusuw wo tebea pɔtee no ho: Wɔbɛsusuw w’aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm, w’asetena mu su, ne w’abusua abakɔsɛm ho na wɔate w’ankorankoro asiane ahorow ase. Fa akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wo ho ma: Wobetumi agyina asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ wo so so akasa ama nneyɛe pɔtee bi anaa nsakrae a wobɛyɛ na ama nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba no so atew. Bua wo nsɛmmisa: Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm a ɛfa dadwen biara a wowɔ ho.

input: Ɛhe na metumi anya nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho ama nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow? ( abɛɛfo ntentan ahorow, awofoyɛ ho nneɛma a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe)
output: wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne wo besusuw nna ho nsɛm ho

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ sɛ ababun, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a mede bɛsua pii?
output: Sɛ woyɛ ababun no, wubetumi anya awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ afiri mmeae ahohoɔ: Sukuu Mu Nhyehyɛeɛ: Sukuu pii wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛfata mfeɛ a ɛkasa fa nneɛma bi te sɛ nsabuo, nna mu ahobammɔ mu nneɛma, nna mu yareɛ ho bammɔ, ne penee a wɔpene so ho nsɛm. Mpɔtam Hɔ Apɔmuden Mmeae: Ayaresabea ne apɔmuden mmeae betumi ayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam, afutuo dwumadie, ne nneɛma a ɛfa awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho. Ntentanfidie So Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet (Websites), hwɛtie, ne nkitahodie mmeaeɛ ma awoɔ mu apɔmuden ho nsɛm wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ dwoodwoo na ɛyɛ mmerɛ so (GHS -YMK app no a wɔde di dwuma). Nwoma ahodoɔ: Nwoma pii wɔ hɔ a wɔatwerɛ ama mmabun a ɛfa awoɔ mu apɔmuden, mpanin mu kɔ, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho?
output: Wobetumi afa mmeae ahorow a wotumi de ho to so so anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware: Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfo, ɔyarehwɛfo, anaa mmea ho ɔyaresafo, a obetumi de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛfata ama, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma yiye, nea ebetumi afi mu aba, ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ho. Hwehwɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din fi ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Planned Parenthood, anaa nna mu akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow, a wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a edi mũ ma, a mfaso, asiane, ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ka ho. Nhomasua Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma, nkratawa, anaa nhoma ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, anaa sukuu ahorow. Nhoma ne Nwoma: Hwehwɛ nhoma, nsɛmma nhoma, anaa nhoma ahorow a akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo anaa awo akwahosan ho abenfo akyerɛw, a ebetumi ama woanya nhumu a emu dɔ wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho. Ntrɛwmu te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) de nsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho ma.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nkurɔfo adi nkitaho yie na makyerɛ obu wɔ Intanɛt so afa nna ne abusuabɔ ho?
output: Di nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi mu bere a wobu afoforo ahye ne awerɛkyekye dodow no. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu di dwuma bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ atenka a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no. Tie afoforo adwene yie na kwati sɛ wubesusu nneɛma ho anaasɛ wobebu atɛn. Kwati nsusuii na bisa pefee sɛ wo nte biribiara ase a.

input: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ne mmoa akuw betumi de nneɛma ne mmoa ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm a ebia wɔrehyia haw bi te sɛ afie a wonni, abusua a wɔpow wɔn, anaa ɔhaw afoforo?
output: Mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ betumi ama mmoa ama mmabun a wofa afie a wonni, abusua a wɔpow wɔn, anaa ɔhaw afoforo: Nnwuma a Wɔde Kɔma: Fa mmabun bata nneɛma te sɛ dabere, adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ho. Asetra mu Nimdeɛ Nhyiamu: Fa nhyiamu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ, adwuma hwehwɛ, ne ahofadie asetena ho ma. Afotu Nhyehyɛe: Fa mmabun ne mpanyimfo a wɔboa wɔn a wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔkamfo ama no atoto ho.

input: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa awofo ne mmabun ma w'abom adi nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
output: Sukuu Nneɛma: Sukuu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Hɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae betumi de adwumayɛbea anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow ama awofo ne mmabun. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ 'Planned Parenthood' anaa ASHA de nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Awofoɔ ne Mmabun Nhyiamu: Monkɔ nhyiamu anaa adesua ahodoɔ mu bom sua na wɔnsusu nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Ayaresa Mmoa: Abusua ayaresa anaa afotu betumi aboa ma nkitahodi ne ntease atu mpɔn. Awofoɔ Nhoma ne Akwankyerɛ: Nhoma wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ "The Care and Keeping of You" series ma mmeawa anaa "Guy Stuff: The Body Book for Boys" betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛboa.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa ne afotu adwuma de adi ɛnanom akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma, a adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw ka ho?
output: Mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa denam: Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛkasa afa wɔn nkate ne wɔn haw ahorow ho. Hwehwɛ a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, te sɛ ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboa ntɛm ara. Awofo nkumaa a wɔboa akuw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a ebia adwenemyare ho nneɛma ka ho. Sukuu afotufo anaa mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ wɔn akwankyerɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ mmabun twentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw ho wɔ nyinsɛn anaa awo akyi..

input: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya hokwan ahorow ne nea wobetumi apaw ho nsɛm sɛ wɔanya nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaa wonim obi a wato wɔn mmonnaa?
output: Mmabun betumi anya nsɛm a ɛfa hokwan ahorow ne nea wobetumi apaw ho sɛ wɔanya nna mu ɔbrasɛe anaasɛ wonim obi a wafa mu, ɛnam nneɛma ahorow so. Ebia eyinom bi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo, Intanɛt so nneɛma, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔde boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no ho.

input: Sɛn na wɔde yɛn amammere ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm fra nketekete (life skills) ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu?
output: Wɔyɛ no ma ɛfata amammerɛ. Wɔde nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ di dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ fa gyidie ho. Afotufoɔ firi mmeammea ahorow.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nnwuma te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu ho ka?
output: Mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ka denam: Wɔn insurance nhyehyɛe ho nkrataa a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu, a mfaso ne sika a wɔde tua ho ka (SBC) ho nsɛm tiawa ka ho, na wɔate nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ka, sika a wɔtew fi mu, sika a wɔde bom, ne insurance a wɔde bom yɛ no ase. Wɔn insurance dwumadiefoɔ a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ insurance adwumakuo no wɛbsaet hɔ akɔnya nsɛm a ɛfa mfasoɔ a wɔabɔ ho ka, wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ne nkitahodiɛ anohyetoɔ ho. Apomoden ho adwumayɛfo anaa ayaresabea adwumayɛfo a wo ne wɔn besusuw ho de ahwɛ sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ nnwuma pɔtee bi ho na wɔabisa ɛka biara a wɔbɔ wɔ kotoku mu anaasɛ tumi krataa a wɔadi kan ama ho ahwehwɛde ahorow ho asɛm.

input: Dɛn na nea broni ka no 'intersectionality' kyerɛ wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho nsɛm mu?
output: Nea broni ka no 'Intersectionality' kyerɛ sɛnea asetra mu nkyekyem ahorow te sɛ abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, kuw, ne nna ho nsɛm a ɛka bom, a ebetumi ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka bom na egyina wɔn ho wɔn ho so a ɛfa nyiyim anaa ɔhaw ahorow ho aba. Wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ne nna mu nipasu ho no, 'intersectionality' gye tom sɛ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow no nam nipasu afã horow pii so na ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ nkutoo.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no bi ?
output: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo pii te sɛ nnuruyɛfo, mmea ho animdefo, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan asoɛe ahorow na wɔde nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ma. Nkurɔfo nso betumi atɔ nyinsɛn nhwehwɛmu nneɛma afi nnuruyɛ sotɔɔ ahorow mu na wɔasɔ ahwɛ wɔ fie.

input: Dwuma bɛn na mmara kwan so mmoa ahyehyɛde ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wohyia mmara mu ɔhaw a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no mu?
output: Mmara mmoa ahyehyɛde ahorow ne akuw a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔboa mmabun a wohyia mmara mu ɔhaw a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho denam mmara mu afotu, ananmusifo, nsɛm a wɔkasa ama kyerɛ, ne nneɛma a wɔde ma a wɔde bɛfa mmara nhyehyɛe no mu no so.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ m'adwene ne me hyeɛ akyerɛ nnamfo, hokafoɔ ne ahokafo a  me ne wonwɔ nna mu nkitahodi ɛfa nna mu nsɛm a  m’ani gye  ho?
output: Fa "me"kasafua  di dwuma . Ka nokware/kasa pefee. Hyehyɛ ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ. Tie wɔn yie.

input: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn nsrahwɛ a yɛkɔ daa no bɛkɔ so ayɛ beae a atemmu biara nni hɔ a mete nka sɛ wɔboa me na wobu me, bere mpo a meresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa ɛyɛ den ho no?
output: Si so dua sɛ ɛho hia sɛ yɛbɔ beaeɛ a obiara ntumi nhu mmusu bɔne anaa nneɛma a ɛmfata ho ban berɛ a yɛreyɛ nsusuasua a yɛtaa yɛ no, baabi a wobɛte nka sɛ yɛboa wo na yɛbu wo, hwɛ sɛnea nsɛm a yɛka ho teɛ. Yɛ kasa tie a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu ho mmaranimfoɔ, na yɛnam so ma gyidie ne nteaseɛ ba, na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ w'adwene ne w'anim nsɛm ho nneɛma a yɛnni apɛdeɛ biara, na yɛfa tema ne nteaseɛ yɛɛ nsensɔm a ɛyɛ den.

input: Ɛhe na metumi anya mmara mu afotu anaa mmoa pa sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa fa hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ nyinsɛn mu ho a?
output: Nneɛma a wode bɛma mmara ho afotu anaa mmoa ni: Wo sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa sukuu fotufo betumi de wo abata mmara mu nnwuma a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wo ho. mmaabun adamfofa apomoden ho dwumayɛni a ɔwɔ apomoden adwumayɛbea hɔ no betumi aslo mmoa a ɛne nkitahodi ma mmara kwan so nnwuma

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn ntam abusuabɔ gyina obuo ne pene a wɔpene so so?
output: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn abusuabɔ gyina obu ne pene a wɔn ho wɔn ho di so denam: Wɔn hokafo a wɔbɛdi nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi afa ahyeɛ ne akɔnnɔ ho a wɔbɛkyerɛ obuo ama wɔn hokafo ahofadi ne hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔka sɛ dabi. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ pene a wɔde anigye ne nea ɛkɔ so daa wɔ nna mu dwumadi nyinaa mu. Wɔn hokafo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ daa sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobenya ahotɔ ne abotɔyam a wɔbɛhwɛ tumi a ɛyɛ nnam na wɔakwati nhyɛso anaasɛ nneyɛe a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so

input: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi adi wɔ pene, abusuabɔ pa, ne nna mu nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu so?
output: Mma a Wɔpene Ho Ntease: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ boa mmabun ma wɔte nea pene ne nea enti a ɛho hia ase. Suban a Ɛnyɛ Pa a Wobehu: Ɛboa ma wohu nneyɛe a ɛnyɛ papa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ahorow mu na wɔte nsunsuanso a ɛwɔ so no ase. Nsusuwii a Ɛyɛ Den a Wɔhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ hyɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee a ɛfa abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ne nea ɛyɛ abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran. Tumi a Wɔma: Ɛdenam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a mmabun nim so no, wobetumi ako atia nkrasɛm a epira na wɔapaw wɔn nneyɛe a ɛfata. Nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔakamfo akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ pa ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛyɛ papa. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa digital beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma woanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho . Ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo hɔ no yɛ nokware anaa

input: So nneɛma anaa wɛbsaet ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, wokamfo kyerɛ sɛ wubenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so?
output: Wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ "Planned Parenthood" "Teen Talk" anaa Nna "Sex", de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. Aban akwahosan ho wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ "Centers for Disease Control and Prevention" (CDC) anaa Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) de nneɛma a ɛkɔ akyiri ne nokwasɛm nkrataa a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho ma.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina haw a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano?
output: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ pefee : Tebea a wɔabue na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔbɛma mmabun asusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ho a wɔde ma, a nipadua ne nkate fam afã horow ka ho. Awerɛhyem a Wɔde Ma: Awerɛhyem ne nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmabun nkate ne osuahu ahorow ho wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu. Kokoam Nsɛm a Wobebu: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahye a wobu bere a wɔda so ara wɔ hɔ ma mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Ankasa Ho Hwɛ ho Nhwɛso: Nhwɛso a wɔde gyina apɔwmuden ano ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho so de hyɛ yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina tebea wɔ nsakrae bere ahorow ano mu ho nkuran.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛka obiara ho kɛse na ayɛ nea ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, a wofi nkurow nketewa mu, anaa wɔte nkuraase no adesua ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ ho?
output: Wobetumi ama nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow no ayɛ nea ɛka obiara ho kɛse na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata ma mmabun adesua ahiade ahorow ne nea wɔpɛ denam nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde ahorow ahorow, pɛyɛ, ne nnipa a wɔka bom di kan a wɔde bedi dwuma no so. Eyi ka ho bi ne dabere ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ a wɔadi dɛm, wɔde adesua nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a ɛfa amammerɛ ho a ɛda suahunu ne adwene a ɛwɔ mpɔtam a nnipa kakraa bi mu adi, ne sika a wɔde bɛto mfiridwuma ne nnwuma mu de ama nwomasua a wɔbɛnya wɔ nkuraaseɛ ne mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no atu mpɔn. Bio nso, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi asi nkyerɛkyerɛ nneyɛeɛ a ɛka obiara ne akwan a wɔfa so boa asuafoɔ ahodoɔ wɔ adesuadan mu so dua.

input: Dɛnna mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa mmara mu nsakrae so adi eyinom ho dwuma?
output: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom betumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso bɔne denam nsɛm a ɛfata a wobenya, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛto ano hye so. Mmara mu nsakrae ho hia na ama wɔadi kwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan, nhomasua, ne ahofadi no so.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi ama mmabun ankasa tumi ma wɔakamfo wɔn SRH hokwan ne wɔn ahiade ahorow wɔ ntawntawdi ne ntawntawdi akyi tebea horow mu, na akwanside bɛn na wohyia wɔ saayɛ mu?
output: Nhomasua ne nhumu: Sɛ wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn hokwan ahorow ho ma mmabun a, ɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔkamfo wɔn SRH ahiade ne hokwan ahorow, na ɛkasa tia animtiaabu, nyiyim, ne akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ. Mmabun kyɛfa: Mmeae a wɔbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe mu a ntease wom no ma mmabun tumi ka wɔn haw ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde di kan, ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa SRH nnwuma ne nhyehyɛe ahorow ho wɔ mmeae a ntawntawdi aka no. Akwanside ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma: Ebia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkamfo wɔn no bi ne nsɛm a wonnya, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛtɔ wɔn so ka anaa basabasayɛ, ne hokwan kakraa bi a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wobedi akwanside ahorow yi ho dwuma na wɔayɛ tebea horow a ɛbɛma mmabun de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu na wɔakamfo wɔn.

input: Kwan bɛn so na media content a ɛfa mpeneso ho betumi ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenem apɔwmuden, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne nna mu nipasu, ne asetena mu atɛntenee ho no atwa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm a ɛka bom yi ho dwuma yie?
output: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo akenkan ne akyerɛw a ɛfa mpeneso ho no ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan, adwenem apɔwmuden, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ne nna mu nipasu, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho no di nkitaho efisɛ saa nsɛm yi wɔ abusuabɔ na ɛka wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ɛdenam pene a wɔdi ho dwuma wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛtrɛw mu so no, mmabun nya ntease a edi mũ wɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow, ahye, ne asɛde ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Media ho nimdeɛ nso ma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi hwehwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna, nna, ne tumi mu nsesae ahorow mu yie wɔ media mu na wɔte sɛnea saa mfonini ahorow yi boa ma asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne ntɛnkyea a ɛtrɛw ba no ase. Ɛdenam nsɛm a ɛka bom yi a wobedi ho dwuma ara yie so no, mmabun betumi akamfo asetena mu nsakrae na wɔahyɛ nkabom nkuran.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nsɛm ne nneɛma a edi mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi ho?
output: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun benya nsɛm ne nneɛma a edi mu a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho denam afotu a edi mũ a wɔde bɛma, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a wɔde bɛma wɔ akwan a wotumi nya mu, ne mmabun a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ Intanɛt so mmeae a agye din ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn no so. te sɛ SHE + intanɛt so platform denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho.

input: So mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ama?
output: Aane. Adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛboa. Wɔkyerɛ obu ma kokoam nsɛm. Wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔma wɔn a wɔwɔ ahiade titiriw.

input: Akwan bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi afa so ayɛ adwuma de ama awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun nya no atu mpɔn?
output: Mpɔtam ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom ama awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a mmabun anya no atu mpɔn denam: Sika a wɔde bɛto nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri mu wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛde awoɔ akwahosan ne hokwan ahodoɔ ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma mu. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ntrɛmu a wɔbɛboa, a akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ka ho. Nhyehyɛe ne sika a wɔde bɛma a ɛbɛma wɔanya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a mmabun bɛkamfo. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no mu denam wɔn adwene ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn tẽẽ ho no so. Nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, ne kar a wonni a ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wonnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ho dwuma a wobedi.

input: So mmoa akuw anaa nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de ama mmabun a wɔbrɛ wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho?
output: Sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow, ne adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow pii de mmoa akuw anaa afotu adwuma ma mmabun a wɔrepere wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso ho. abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nhyiam ahorow ne mmoa telefon ahorow de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔmmɔ din ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso mu. Dwumadi anaa nhyiam ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim betumi ama mmabun tumi akyɛ osuahu ne akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so agyina atipɛnfo nhyɛso ano.

input: Mɛyɛ dɛn asiesie me pia mu ma nna pa bere a mere nyin no?
output: Ma wo pia mu nyɛ nwunu, esum, na ma hɔ nyɛ komm. Yi nneɛma te sɛ TV anaa phones firi hɔ. Fa nneɛma a ɛyɛ dɛ te sɛ sumii ne ntama siesie wo mpa no so.. Nya bere a woda daa na di so.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso?
output: Abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso kɛse. Nneɛma bi ne: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw anaa adwenemyare, a ebetumi ama awosu mu su ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔde nnubɔne di dwuma no ayɛ kɛse. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, awofo adwene wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne adwenemhaw anaa adwennwen a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Abɔde mu nneɛma te sɛ brain chemistry, neurotansmitter dwumadi, ne nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu wɔ nsabuo mu ka ho. Asiane ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wɔatu anammɔn a edi kan de abrɛ asiane ahorow ase na wɔahyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ma adwenemyare ne yiyedi ho nkuran.

input: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri mu, sen sɛ wɔbɛfa nhyehyɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow so?
output: Awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho no ma wonya mfaso pii sen nhyehyɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛsono emu biara. Nea edi kan no, ɛboa ma wotumi kɔso hwɛ mmubun yie woberɛ a woregye ayarehwɛ wɔ beaɛ kro mu.Yie te su bi a ɛmmoa apɔmden te sɛ mereyɛ krakra na magyae na aboa apɔmden pa. Bio nso, awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ baabi baako a wɔn nhyehyeɛ yɛ ɛboa ma wohu adekro pɔtee a ɛreha mmabun woberɛ woreyɛ nhwehwɛ mu afa apɔmden ne adwenem mu nyinaa ahu wohiadeɛ anaa wohaw. Ɛboa nso ma wodi akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔhwɛ mu, te sɛ animtiaabu anaa nhyehyɛe mu haw so, denam awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata sɛ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ daa no fã so. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, nkabom ma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun no tu mpɔn na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye.

input: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem berɛ a wɔreyɛ abɛɛfo nneɛma, titiriw bere a wɔredi nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa akyinnyegye a ɛfa ASRH, nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipasu ho dwuma no?
output: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de obu, nokwaredi, ne nokware di kan bere a wɔreyɛ bɛɛfo ntentan nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wonya pene berɛ a wɔde ankorankoro di dwuma wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu no na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie, titiriw berɛ a wɔresusuw wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow ho no. Pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nokwasɛm mu nokwaredi na ɛho hia sen biara; ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din no yɛ nokware na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a epira mu. Obu a wɔde ma adwene, amammerɛ, ne nipasu ahorow ho hia; ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu no kwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsusuwii hunu a ɛwɔ hɔ no akɔ so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nyiyim nneyɛe mu.

input: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ mmea ho dwumadie "gynecological services" a wɔde ma mmabun mu, na mɛyɛ dɛn ne wɔn adi nkitaho ama mmoa ne nsɛm?
output: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmea ho dwumadie a wɔde ma mmabun mu te sɛ: Awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔde ma, a nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa ka ho. Mmabun haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne akwahosan ho ahiade ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛboa na ɛnyɛ atɛn so. Nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, Nna mu nyarewa "STI" a wosiw ano, brayɛ akwahosan, nna mu dwumadi, ne nsɛmti afoforo a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de ayɛ ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho a ɛne wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow, nea wɔpɛ, ne akwahosan ho botae ahorow hyia. Wubetumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho de ahwehwɛ mmoa ne nsɛm denam: Mmea ho nhyehyɛe a wobɛyɛ daa de asusuw awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho. Nsɛm a wubebisa na woada dadwen anaa adwenem naayɛ biara a ebia wowɔ wɔ w’awo akwahosan ho adi. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ aduruyɛ mu nsɛmfua, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano ho. W’ankasa akwahosan ahiade ne nea wopɛ a wobɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyiam ahorow mu.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye atum afi mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu mu no hɔ?
output: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo nya pene a wɔanya nimdeɛ fi mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn  mmara kwan so no hɔ ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu: Wɔde nsɛm a emu da hɔ na ntease wom ma wɔ atirimpɔw, akwan horow, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu no so ho, na ama mmabun atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn kyɛfa a wobenya no ho. Fa kasa ne akwan horow a ɛfata mfe a obi adi di dwuma de di nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ, hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛte ase na brɛ nhyɛso anaa nkɛntɛnso a ɛnsɛ ase. Di hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wɔpow anaasɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho bere biara wɔ adesua no mu, a ɛho nhia anaasɛ nea enye biara nni ho.

input: Sɛn na yɛtete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbetumi ahunu nsɛnkyerɛne wɔ adwenemyareɛ mu na watumi aboa asuafoɔ wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu?
output: Akyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnkyerɛnne ho. Kwan a wɔfa so kasa. Nwuma a wɔne afutufoɔ bom yɛ. Sukuu hyehyeɛ mu akwankyerɛ. Sukuu mu bammɔ.

input: Wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu no, dɛn na menyɛ sɛ me te nka a ɛne me pɛ ne me gyedie bɔ bira?
output: Si wo gyedie, wo pɛ ne wo hyeɛ pi sɛdeɛ sɔbɛyɛ a obi nntwi mmfa wo so. Wo ne mpaninfoɔ te sɛ awofoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufobɔfoɔ nni ho nkɔmmɔ mfa nea wo fa mu. Fa nnamfoɔ wobu wo na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔ boa mmabun. Wobetumi ayɛ saa so ama afoforɔ. Sua sɛdeɛ yɛka daabi.

input: M'awofoɔ bɛtumi ahu sɛ m'ayi nyisen agu anaa?
output: Wɔ Ghana ha, mmara  biara ni wɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ w'awofoɔ gyeto mu ansa na wayi nyisen agu. Enti wɔrenhu gye sɛ woankasa woka. Nanso, sɛ woyɛ abofra yi, ɛtɔ da a ɛhia sɛ panyin bi pene so ma wo.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na asuafoɔ bɛtumi de nsɛm ne wɔn adwene ama wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ anaa nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛba wɔ sukuu no mu?
output: Asuafoɔ bɛtumi de wɔn adwene ama wɔ adwenemyareɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ho na wɔakamfo nsakraeɛ anaa nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛba wɔ sukuu no mu denam: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ asuafoɔ aban, afotufoɔ kuo, anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne yiedie so. Nhwehwɛmu, abatow, anaa nhyiam ahorow a asuafo di anim ho nhyehyɛe de boaboa wɔn adwene ano wɔ adwenemyare ho nsɛm, ahiade, ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan ho. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a asuafoɔ di so na wɔde adi dwuma. Sika, nneɛma, ne mmoa a wɔbɛma akɔ soro a wɔde bɛma adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ denam adesrɛ, ɔsatuo, ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a wɔbɛma nkurɔfo ate ase ne mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ nneyɛe a wɔbɛma ayɛ animtiaabu denam atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔsatu a wɔde ma nkurɔfo hu, ne abɛɛfo ntantanfidie nkɔmmɔbɔ so.

input: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ mmoa anaa nhyehye a sukuu node wɔn ho gye mu no mu ɔhaw ahorow de ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade no?
output: Mmoa anaa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho nhwɛso betumi ayɛ: Kokoam afotu ne atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma. Ayaresa ne asɛnnibea nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Boa a wɔbɛboa ma wɔabɔ nsɛm a esisi ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ. Ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde ma. Nhomasua nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne ankorankoro ahobammɔ ho.

input: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde nipadua mfoni kyerɛ no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
output: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nipadua mfoni ahorow so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛka mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu wɔ akwan horow so denam: Ahoɔfɛ ho adwene ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ebia ɛsono wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu a wɔhyehyɛ, na ɛde nipadua ahorow, ahoɔfɛ, ne nea wɔpɛ ho mfoni ahorow ba wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Boa a ɛboa ma nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a ɛfa abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne nneɛma afoforo a ɛfa nnipa ho no kɔ so tra hɔ, a ɛka sɛnea wogyina hɔ ma nipadua ahorow ne sɛnea wohu no so nkɛntɛnso. Amammerɛ mu ahokokwaw ne nkate a ɛho hia bere a wɔrekyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a ɛfa nipadua mfoni ho ase no so dua, a wobehu sɛnea nipasu ne ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow no di nkitaho.

input: Sɛn na mpanyimfoɔ foforo bɛboa yɛn SRH nkɔmmɔbɔ?
