Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukwata abantu ssekinnoomu ab’ebika by’omubiri byonna, obunene, n’embeera zonna. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka akasinga okukosa abaserikale b’omubiri, ne kanafuya obusobozi bwagwo okulwanyisa obuwuka obugulumba. Kasiigibwa okuyita makubo ag’enjawulo, gamba ng’okwegatta n’omuntu alina akawuka nga teweetangidde, okugabana empiso oba ebbomba z'empiso n’omuntu alina akawuka, oba okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana ng’azaala oba ng’ayonsa. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasosola okusinziira ku bunene bw’omubiri oba endabika. Omuntu yenna, awatali kufaayo ku buzito bw’omubiri gwe, asobola okubeera mu katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa yeenyigira mu nneeyisa oba ebikolwa ebisobola okusaasaanya akawuka kano. Kikulu eri buli muntu okutegeera engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kasaasaanamu n’okukola okwegendereza okutuufu okutangira okukwatibwa akawuka kano, gamba ng’okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, okukozesa empiso ennyonjo okwejjanjaba, n’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu buli kiseera singa baba mu katyabaga. Engeri yokka gy’oyinza okuzuula embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri emu ku zikozesebwa. Bw’oba olina ebikweraliikiriza ku mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba okwenyigira mu nneeyisa eziyinza okukuteeka mu katyabaga, lowooza ku ky’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okwebuuza ku musawo oba omubuziibuzi wo akuwe okulambikibwa ku ngeri y’okwetangira n’okuddukanya embeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okuddukanyizibwa n’obujjanjabi obutuufu, era okuzuula amangu n’okujjanjabibwa bikulu nnyo mu kukuuma obulamu obulungi.

input: Bizibu ki ebiva mu Musujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B?
output: Singa Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B tegujjanjabwa, gusobola okunyiinyiitira era ne guleeta ebizibu bingi ku bulamu. Akawuka kaalula buli kiseera mu mubiri ne koonoona mpola mpola obutoffaali bw'ekibumba. Mu mutendera ogusooka oba omuntu nga yaakakafuna ayinza obutalaga bubonero, wabula ekibumba kasita kikosebwa ennyo, obubonero butandika okweyoleka, omuli ekibumba okujjako amabwa n'obutakolera ddala, Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B ogw'olukonvuba, ekibumba okujjako enkovu ne kookolo w’ekibumba.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okufuna obuyambi ku nsonga z’okukozesa ebiragalalagala?
output: Okwaŋŋanga okukozesa ebiragalalagala kusoomooza nnyo naye waliwo emitendera gy'osobola okuyitamu okukuyamba: kkiriza ekizibu, noonya obuyambi obw'ekikugu, okubeera n'abantu abakuyambako, genda bakubudeebude, weemanyiize empisa eziyamba okukuuma obulamu bwo nga bulungi era ensonga yo gibuulire ku mikwano gyo n'abooluganda lwo. Okubuulira ku b'emikwano n'enganda kyandiba ekizibu olw'okutya okukulamula naye kikulu kubanga bw'okola ekyo tojja kubeera wekka mu mbeera eno.

input: Bwe ngenda okwekebeza oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekitono nga wiiki 2, kiba kikyamu?
output: Si kikyamu okugenda okwekebeza oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekitono, gamba nga wiiki 2, bw’oba olina ensonga ey'essimba ekweraliikiriza ku busobozi bw'akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka, omuli akaleeta Siriimu oba Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala k'oyinza okuba nga obaddemu. Wabula ebiseera by’okukeberebwa biyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku nsonga eziwerako, omuli ekika ky’Akawuka akakweraliikiriza, embeera ezeetooloolera ku katyabaga k'obaddemu n’ekika ky’okukeberebwa ky’okozesa. Kikulu okugoberera obuwabuzi bw'abasawo abakugu bwe kituuka ku biseera by’okukeberebwa.

input: Kibinja kya musaayi ki ekikwatibwa amangu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okulwaza abantu ssekinnoomu ab’ebibinja by’omusaayi byonna, era tewali kibinja kya musaayi kitongole kyanguyirwa kukwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu okusinga birala. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kakwata obutoffaali obulwanyisa endwadde ez’enjawulo mu mubiri obuyitibwa CD4+ T, era tekalina kibinja kya njawulo kye kasinga kwagala kukwata kusinga ku biralala. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasaasaana okuyita mu kukwatagana n’amazzi g’omubiri agamu, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g’ekikyala, amazzi agava ewava obubi, n’amabeere, agalimu akawuka kano nga kangi. Kikulu okumanya nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakwatagana butereevu oba tekagenderera kirungo kisangibwa kungulu kwa butaffaali obukola omusaayi, nga kino kye kisalawo ekibinja ky'omusaayi gw'omuntu (okugeza, A, B, AB, O). Ekirungo ky'omusaayi ekisalawo ekibinja ky'omusaayi omuntu ky'aba nakyo tekisika kukwatibwa kwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kagenderera abaserikale b’omubiri naddala obutoffaali bwa CD4+ T, era ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo, kasobola okunafuya abaserikale b’omubiri, ekivaako obuzibu obw’enjawulo ku bulamu singa tebujjanjabibwa. Akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu keekuusa ku nneeyisa n’enkola eziteeka abantu ssekinnoomu mu mbeera y'okukwatibwa akawuka kano, okusinga ekibinja ky’omusaayi gwabwe.

input: Nnina kumala bbanga ki ndyoke mbuulireko omuntu ku bwe nnyimiridde ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba waakamanya embeera yo, funa obudde okulowooza ku mawulire ago nga tonnasalawo kugagabana na muntu.

input: Kisoboka okuddamu okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’omulundi ogwasooka?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu vvayiraasi esobola okuvaamu Siriimu singa tejjanjabwa. Omuntu bw’amala okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, abeera n'akawuka kano obulamu bwe bwonna. Mu kiseera kino tewali ddagala liwonyeza ddala Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu, era akawuka kano tekasobola kuggyibwa ddala mu mubiri. Wabula, singa wabaawo okulabirirwa n'okujjanjabibwa okutuufu, kasobola okufugibwa, era n’okusuumuka kwako okufuuka Siriimu ne kuziyizibwa. Kikulu okutegeera nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakukwata mirundi gya muddiringanwa nti kasobola "okukukwata" emirundi egiwera. Bw’omala okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, osigala ng’okalina okuggyako ng’ofunye obujjanjabi obusaanidde okufufuggaza akawuka kano. Ekigendererwa ky’obujjanjabi bwa bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obumanyiddwa nga antiretroviral therapy, bukozesebwa okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka (obungi bw’akawuka mu musaayi) okutuuka ku mutendera gw'obutazuulibwa. Akawuka kano bwe kaba tekakyazuulibwa mu musaayi, tekatera kusiigibwa balala, era omuntu ssekinnoomu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okubeera n’obulamu obulungi. Okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, abantu ssekinnoomu basobola okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu bwabwe mu katyabaga, okukozesa obupiira buli mulundi era mu butuufu, okwekebeza entakera okulaba oba alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala, n’okulowooza ku ngeri y’okuwetangira nga PrEP singa baba mu katyabaga ak’amaanyi  ak’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Omuntu asobola okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu okuyita mu kunywegeragana?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasaasaanyizibwa nga kayita mu mazzi ag'omu mubiri agalimu akawuka ka vvayiraasi akangi ennyo. Amazzi gano mulimu omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g'ekikazi, agava awava obubi, n'amabeere. Amalusu agali mu kamwa gabeeramu omuwendo gw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mutono ddala, naye ng'obungi bw'akawuka ako buba butono nnyo okuba nga kasobola okusaasaana okuyita mu kunywergeragana.

input: Magezi ki ge nsobola okuwa omulenzi eyakwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuyita mu kufumitibwa empiso gye yagabana n'omuntu omulala era n'agobwa awaka oluvannyuma lw'okuzuulibwamu akawuka?
output: Kya nnaku okuwulira embeera enzibu omulenzi ono gy'ayitamu. Kikulu okumuyamba n'okumulambika mu kiseera kino ekizibu. Gano ge gamu ku magezi g’osobola okumuwa: Okunoonya obujjanjabi, akwatagana n'abantu abasobola okuyambako, okunoonya abantu abayinza okumusembeza, okufuna obuwabuzi mu mateeka, okufuna okuyambibwa mu bwongo, okutabagana n'abenganda, okwekuumira mu kumanya, era n'okunoonya obuyambi obw’amangu.

input: Kiki kye nnina okukola singa nteebereza nti nnina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Genda mu ddwaliro weekebeze amangu ddala kubanga bw'otandika okufuna obujjanjabi amangu, kikuyamba.

input: Lwaki kya mugaso okukebeza omwana wange omuwere Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga nkalina?
output: Okukebera omwana wo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu y’engeri yokka enkakafu ey’okumanya oba omwana wo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nedda. Okumanya kino kikulu mu ngeri nti kye kifuga ekirina okuddako okukolebwa. Omwana wo bw’aba alina akawuka, kikuyamba okutandika obujjanjabi nga bukyali ate bw’aba nga takalina, kikuyamba okugoberera enkola ez'okumukuuma ng'ali bw’atyo.

input: Nnina kukwata ntya obukyawe oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta?
output: Weewe obudde okuwona, yogerako n’emikwano gy’olina okufuna obuyambi, era essira lisse ku bulamu bwo.

input: Kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa okutangira akawuka ka siriimu okukula n’afuuka mukenenya?
output: Okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti ogenda kufa. Olw’enkulaakulana mu bujjanjabi naddala enkola eweweeza ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kifuuse embeera ya lukonvuba naye nga esobola okukkakkanyizibwa eri abantu bangi. Kikulu okumanya nti si buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti ajja kugenda mu maaso n’okufuna Siriimu naddala ng’azuuliddwa mangu n’okufuna obujjanjabi.

input: Nnandiwulidde ntya singa mba ne Kiramidiya?
output: "Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa ng'Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo tekatera kwoleka bubonero, naye nga kasobola okuleeta obuzibu obw'amaanyi ku bulamu, wadde nga tekalaze bubonero. Singa obubonero bweyoleka, kiyinza okutwala ssabbiiti eziwera oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta n'omuntu akalina.                                                                                                                                                               1. Mu bakyala, obubonero bw'akawuka obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu eby'ekayama mulimu enkyukakyuka mu langi y'amazzi agava mu bukyala (enjeru, kyenvu, oba kitosi agayinza okuba nga gawunya), okuddingana mu nsonga oba okuvaamu omusaayi oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta, obulumi mu ndira, n'okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa.2. Mu baami, obubonero obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu by'ekyama oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka kano mulimu okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa, okuvaamu amazzi agalinga eminyira mu busajja n'obulumi mu nsigo.3. Okukwatibwa akawuka kano ewafulumira obubi mu baami n'abakyala kiyinza okuleeta obulumi, amazzi agalinga eminyira n'okuvaamu omusaayi. Singa omulwadde aba n'obulwadde bw'ensanjabavu, obubonero obusooka okweyoleka mulimu amabwa mu bitundu by’ekyama, oluvannyuma okuzimba n'okulumizibwa kw'ensanjabavu mu bitundu by’ekyama ebiruma.

input: Mirundi emeka mu lunaku omuvubuka gy'alina okunaaba mu maaso?
output: Okukola ku nkyukakyuka ezijja ku lususu nga embalabe oba olususu okubaako ekirungo ekiseerera bituukawo nnyo mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka. Kozesa ebizigo by'enviiri ebitaliimu kirungo kiseerera, bikuume olususu nga lulimu amazzi ag'ekigero, era okozese ekirungo ekitangira okususu okukosebwa omusana. Weewale okukwata mu bwenyi n'okusuna embalabe okusobola okwewala olususu okufuukuuka n'okujjako enkovu. Okulya ebibala ebirungi, enva endiirwa n’emmere ey’empeke, okukyusakyusa engoye z'oku ppiro buli kiseera, n’okukuuma obuyonjo nabyo bisobola okuyamba. Singa embalabe ziba za maanyi oba nga teziwona, okwogera n’omusawo w’ensusu kiyinza okukuwa bujjanjabi obulungi.

input: Lwaki abantu bafumiitiriza ku mukwano n'obwesigwa bwabwe oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta?
output: Embeera gy’onnyonnyolako, abantu ssekinnoomu mwe bayinza okubeerera n’emboozi ezikwata ku birowoozo byabwe eby'ebuziba oba ezikwata ku nkolagana zaabwe oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta, ya bulijjo, era ng'esobola okufugibwa ensonga ez'enjawulo. Zino ze zimu ku nsonga lwaki emboozi ekika ekyo ziyinza okubaawo: Okusemberegana kw'ebirowoozo by'abaagalana n'okunafuyizibwa, okuggyawo, okuwuliziganya wakati w'abaagalana, okwagala okuddamu okukakasa, okweraliikirira ku bwesigwa, okwefumiitiriza, empisa z'obuwangwa n'embeerabantu.

input: Kisoboka obutakwatibwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta n'omuntu akalina?
output: Okwenyigira mu kwegatta n'omuntu awangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekukuteeka mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu, naye akatyabaga kasobola okukendeerera ddala okuyita mu nkola z'okwetangira ez'enjawulo n'enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga. Eddaala ly'akatyabaga lisinziira ku nsonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ekika ky'okwegatta, obungi bw'akawuka akali mu musaayi gw'omubeezi akalina, n'okulaba oba ng'enkola z'okwetangira zikozeseddwa.

input: Kiki kye nsobola okukola singa nkizuula nti nneegasse n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba weenyigidde mu kwegatta n’omuntu gw’oteebereza oba gw’omanyi nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kyetaagisa okubaako by'okola amangu ddala okukuuma obulamu bwo n’embeera yo eya bulijjo nga nnungi. Bino by’osaanidde okulowoozaako okukola: Weekebeze, weenyigre mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, funa amagezi g’abasawo, era bw’okeberebwa n'ozuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kyetaagisa okunoonya obujjanjabi n’okuyambibwa amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Bino by’osaanidde okukola: Weebuuze ku musawo omukugu mu by’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tandika eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tegeeza ababeezi bo, noonya obuyambi, era ogoberere amagezi g’abasawo. Jjukira nti okuzuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti ye nkomerero y'obulamu obumatiza. Singa abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuna obujjanjabi obutuufu, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, n’okuyambibwa, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala era nga balamu bulungi. Kikulu okufuna obujjanjabi n'obuyambi mu bwanguu ddala nga bwe kisoboka okusobola okutambuza obulamu bwo mu ngeri entuufu.

input: Nsobola okufuna Kiramidiya okuva mu mazina agayinza okuyimya omuntu?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo akasaasaana okuva mu kwegatta ng'amazzi g'ekikyala oba ag'ekisajja agalimu akawuka kano katambula okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Osobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa weegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba awava obubi, okugabana ebintu ebikozesebwa mu kwegatta n'omuntu alina akawuka kano. Okukwatagana kw'ensusu z'ebitundu by'ekyama y'enkola esinga okumanyibwa mu kusaasaana kwa Kiramidiya, n'amazzi g'ekisajja oba ag'ekikyala agalimu akawuka kano singa gagenda mu maaso g'omuntu. Omukyala ow'olubutu alina Kiramidaya asobola okumusiiga omwana we mu kiseera ky'okuzaalibwa, era ekyo kisobola okuviirako omwana okukwatibwa Kiramidiya akwata amaaso ekisobola okukosa endaba ye. Bw'oba walina Kiramidiya n'ojjanjabibwa osobola okuddamu n'omufuna singa weegatta n'omuntu amulina nga teweetangidde.

input: Osobola okuwa obubaka obukwata ku katyabaga bw’okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’obeera wamu n’omuntu akalina?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasiigirwa mu makubo ag’enjawulo, era akabi k’okusiigibwa okuva ku muntu omu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okudda ku muntu omulala kasobola okuba okutono ennyo nga waliwo okwegendereza okutuufu okukoleddwa. Kikulu okutegeera engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kasaasaanyizibwamu n’engeri gy’ekatasobola kusaasaanyizibwamu okusobola okwekenneenya akatyabaga akaliwo mu butuufu bwako. Akatyabaga k'okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeera y'awaka katera okuba akatono singa enkola z'okukuuma obuyonjo eza bulijjo zigobererwa. Kikulu abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okutegeezebwa n'okugoberera enkola ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga okusobola okutangira okusiiga abalala akawuka. Mu bufunze, okubeera ewabeera omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu mu butonde tekirina bulabe bwa maanyi bwa kukasaasaanya kasita wabaawo okwegendereza okw’omutindo okutangira okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era ng’omuntu ssekinnoomu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu aba agoberera okulabirirwa n’obujjanjabi bw'ekisawo. Era kyetaagisa okuba n'empuliziganya ey'olwatu era ey'amazima n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukola ku buli kimu ekimweraliikiriza n'okukakasa nti enkola ezitali za bulabe ziteekebwawo.

input: Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama ayinza kubinjawazibwa atya?
output: Obulwadde buno obwa Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama oba Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi, era obumanyiddwa nga Kisipi buva ku bika bibiri eby'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi. Kisipi akwata ebitundu by'ekyama aleetebwa ebika bino ebibiri eby'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi afaanagana. Ekika kya 1 (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1) kisinga kusaasaana kuyita mu kukwatagana kw'akamwa k'omuntu omu n'ak'omulala era nga kareeta obuwuka obuleeta Kisipi mu kamwa oba okukeetooloola. Era kayinza okuleeta Kisipi akwata mu bitundu by’ekyama. Abantu abakulu abasinga obungi balina Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1. Ekika 2 (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2) kisaasaana okuyita mu kwegatta ne kireeta Kisipi akwata mu bitundu by’ekyama. Wabula era kisoboka Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2 okuleeta Kisipi w'akamwa. Oluusi, Kisipi (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1 ne Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2) asobola okusiigibwa okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana mu kisera ky'okuzaala, ekivaako Kisipi akwata abaakazaalibwa (omwana omuwere).

input: Obungi bw'akawuka mu musaayi n'omuwendo gw'obutaffaali obulwanyisa akawuka mu musaayi bikolagana bitya okulaga embeera y’obulamu bw’omuntu?
output: Obungi bw'akawuka ka vvayiraasi akali mu musaayi n'omuwendo gw'obutaffaali obulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu musaayi nkebera za mu kkeberero ebbiri ez'omugaso ezikozesebwa okulondoola okweyongera kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'engeri obujjanjabi bw'akawuka kano gye bukolamu. Enkebera zino ziwa obubaka obw'enjawulo obukwata ku kawuka ka vvayiraasi n'obwerinzi bw'omubiri.

input: Ebitundu oba abantu bayinza batya okuyamba omutiini ali olubuto okudda mu ssomero nga bazadde be bakiwakanya?
output: Okuyamba omuntu ow'olubuto awanduse mu ssomero era asanga okuwakanyizikwa okuva mu bazadde be kiyinza okuba ekizibu.  Kikulu nnyo okumubudaabuda mu bwongo n'okumuyamba okuyita mu bizibu bino n'okukola okusalawo okutuufu biseera bye eby'omu maaso.

input: Waliwo obubonero bwonna obulaga nti nfunye Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulaga nti nnina okulaba omusawo mu bwangu?

input: Nsobola okwegatta nga sseetangidde nga ndi ku PEP?
output: Nedda, si kirungi kwegatta nga teweetangidde ng’oli ku ddagala lya PEP. PEP ddagala eriziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga erikubirizibwa okumiribwa abantu abayinza okuba nga babaddeko mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kigendereddwamu okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma kubeera mu mbeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka kano. Wabula PEP si nkola ya nkomeredde obutakwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era okwetaba mu kwegatta nga teweetangidde ng'oli ku PEP kikyayinza okwongera okukuteeka mu katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Mu bufunze, wadde nga PEP esobola okukendeeza ku katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’okubeera mu mbeera eyinza okukuviirako okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tesikira nkola za kwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga omuli n'okukozesa obupiira. Kikulu nnyo okwegendereza ebiragiro ng'oli ku nkola ya PEP ne bw'oba ogivuddeko okwetangira ggwe n'abo be weegatta nabo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo n'obweraliikirivu ku bulamu bw’okwegatta n’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, weebuuze ku musawo oba omukugu mu kubudaabuda mu by’okwegatta okufuna obuwabuzi obutuukana n'embeera mw'oli.

input: Nsobola ntya okukwatamu embeera y’okubeera n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kiyinza okuleeta okusoomoozebwa okw'enjawulo n'emikisa gy'okwongera okutegeera ebikwata ku Kawuka n'engeri y'okuyambamu abakalina. Kikulu okukwata embeera eno mu ngeri ey'ekisa n'obusaasizi n'okumanya okusoomoozebwa abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe basanga n'abaagwalwa baabwe. Bino bye bimu ku bisoomooza ebiyinza okujjawo ng'obeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng'oyamba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: okusosolwa n'okusosolebwa, okukosebwa mu birowoozo, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, okugoberera obulungi eddagala, obulamu bw'okwegatta n'enkolagana, okubikkula n'okukuuma ebyama, ensonga z'ebyensimbi n'amateeka, okukoowa kw'omulabirizi, endowooza enkyamu n'obutaba na kumanya, n'ebyetaago ebyekuusa ku bwongo. Kikulu okukwata ebisoomooza bino n'obusaasizi, empuliziganya ennungi, n'obumalirivu okuyamba obulungi bw'omubiri n'enneewulira y'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okunoonya obuyambi mu bibinja, obuweereza bw'okubudaabudibwa, n'abasawo abalina obumanyirivu mu bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kiyinza okuba eky'omugaso eri omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'abo abamuyamba. Okukendeeza ku kusosolwa n'okwongera okumanyisa n'okutegeera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mitendera mikulu mu kukola ku bisoomooza abo abalina akawuka kano.

input: Okubeera bbanga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu lye kamala okubeera nga kasobola okuzuulibwa mu musaayi kitegeeza ki?
output: Kino kitegeeza ekiseera okuva lwe wakwatibwa akawuka okutuuka lwe kasobola okuzuulibwa mu mubiri gwo. Omutendera gw’obutazuulika bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gusinziira ku kika ky’okukebera okukolebwa.

input: Akatyabaga k'abantu abeegattira awava obubi kasingako kw'ako ak'abo abeegattira mu bukyala mu kukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasingako nga weegattidde awava obubi n'omuntu akalina okusinga nga weegattidde mu bukyala nga temukozesezza kapiira.

input: Lwaki mpulira nga nneekyaye n'okukyuka mbeera zange mu myaka gyange egy'obuvubuka?
output: Obusannyalaze bw'omubiri naddala estrogen (abawala) ne testosterone (abalenzi) bukola kinene ku birowoozo byo ng’oli mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Obusannyalaze bw'omubiri buno busobola okukosa ebirungo eriri mu bwongo bwo ebifuga embeera zo. Oyinza okwesanga ng’owulira essanyu akaseera akamu ate oluvannyuma n’ofuna ennaku ey’amangu, n'onyiiga oba okufuna amangu entondo. Bino byonna kitundu ku nkyukakyuka ezigenda mu maaso mu mubiri gwo, era kya bulijjo ddala. Enkola ezimu ez’okugumira embeera z’osobola okukozesaa mulimu okwenyigira mu kukola emirimu egy'amaanyi, okulima, okuyimba, okusoma, okuwummula n’otulo ebimala, n’okufumba n’okulya emmere ewa omubiri obulamu.

input: Nnyinyonnyola ku buwuka obuleeta obulwadde bw’ekikaba.
output: Okukwatibwa kw'obuwuka obufunibwa okuyita ku mu kwegatta. Era busobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu biseera by’okufuna olubuto, okuzaala, okuyonsa, n’okuyita mu musaayi ogulimu obuwuka.

input: Waliwo ebituukiddwako mu kukola eddagala eriwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okukola eddagala eriwangaala eriwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kibadde kigendererwa kinene eky’okunoonyereza kwa ssaayansi okumala emyaka mingi, era abanoonyereza okwetoloola ensi yonna banyiikivu mu kugoberera ekigendererwa kino. Wabula waliwo okusoomoozebwa okuwerako okw’amaanyi okufuula okuzuula eddagala eriwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuzibu okusinga okukola obujjanjabi nga eddagala eriweeweeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Wadde nga ekigenderererwa ky'okuwonyeza ddala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikyali kizibu, abanoonyereza banoonyereza ku makubo ag’enjawulo okutuuka ku ddagala eriwonyeza ddala Akawuka kano. Kikulu okuggumiza nti enkulaakulana ekolebwa mu kunoonyereza ku kuwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, naye okuzuula eddagala eritali lya bulabe era erikola obulungi kukyali kufuba okuzibu naye nga kugenda mu maaso.

input: Nneetaaga okukeberebwa ne bwe mba neewulira bulungi?
output: Obwetaavu bwo obw'okwekebeza okwekuusa ku by'okwegatta buzinziira ku katyabaga k'olina ak'okufuna Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Olina okwekebeza buli lwe weegatta n'omubeezi omuggya nga teweetangidde, okwegatta n'ababeezi abangi oba okwegatta n'omubeezi alina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Era olina okwekebeza singa obeera n'obubonero oba ng’oli lubuto. Abantu bangi abalina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba tebalaga bubonero. Okukeberebwa okw’enjawulo kukolebwa ku buwuka obw'enjawulo obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Okukeberebwa kuno kutera okuzingiramu okuggya ku muntu sampolo y'omusaayi, omusulo oba amazzi okuva mu mumiro, mu bukyala oba mu busajja. Sampolo zino olwo ne zikolebwako mu kkeberero okusobola okuzuula oba waliwo Obulwadde obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba ng'era obujjanjabi bwetaagisa. Ebivudde mu kkeberero bikakasibwa okusobola okuwa ebivaamu eby'enkomeredde.

input: Nsobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa nnaaba ne sooda wa Coca-Cola oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta nga sikozesezza kapiira?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo akasaasaana okuva mu kwegatta ng'amazzi g'ekikyala oba ag'ekisajja agalimu akawuka kano katambula okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Osobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa weegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba awava obubi, okugabana ebintu ebikozesebwa mu kwegatta n'omuntu alina akawuka kano. Okukwatagana kw'ensusu z'ebitundu by'ekyama y'enkola esinga okumanyibwa mu kusaasaana kwa Kiramidiya, n'amazzi g'ekisajja oba ag'ekikyala agalimu akawuka kano singa gagenda mu maaso g'omuntu. Omukyala ow'olubutu alina Kiramidaya asobola okumusiiga omwana we mu kiseera ky'okuzaalibwa, era ekyo kisobola okuviirako omwana okukwatibwa Kiramidiya akwata amaaso ekisobola okukosa endaba ye. Bw'oba walina Kiramidiya n'ojjanjabibwa osobola okuddamu n'omufuna singa weegatta n'omuntu amulina nga teweetangidde.

input: Kiki ekikuleetera okuwulira obw'omu oba nga nneeyawudde ku bantu mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okuwulira nga oli wekka oba nga weeyawudde ku balala mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka kusobola okubaawo olw’ensonga ezitali zimu: Enkyukakyuka mu mikwano: Emikwano gisobola okukyuka kubanga buli muntu ayita mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka ku misinde egy’enjawulo. Kino oluusi kisobola okukuleetera okuwulira ng’oli wekka singa owulira ng’osuuliddwa ebbali. Okupikirizibwa  embeerabantu: Okupikirizibwa banno n’okwagala okutuukagana n’abantu oluusi bisobola okukuleetera okuwulira nga weeyawudde ku balala singa oba togoberera mpisa ezimu. Okwezuula: Bw’ogenda ozuula ky'oli ng'muntu, osobola okuwulira ng’abalala tebakutegeera, ekikuleetera okuwulira ng’olina okubeeyawulako. Obukodyo buno wammanga busobola okukuyamba okukola ku mbeera y'okuwuubaala: Empuliziganya: Empuliziganya ey'olwatu ne mikwano n'ab'omu maka gaabwe esobola okuyamba okuzimba olutindo lw'okumalawo enneewulira z'okuwuubaala. Gabanako ebirowoozo byo n’enneewulira zo n’omuntu gwe weesiga. Weegatte ku mirimu: Okwegatta ku kiraabu, ttiimu z’emizannyo, oba ebibinja ebirina ebintu by'ofaanaganya nabyo kusobola okukuyamba okukwatagana n’abalala abakufaako. Obuyambi obw’ekikugu: Singa enneewulira y'okuba  ng’oli wekka eremerako era n'etandika okukosa obulamu bwo, lowooza ku ky’okwogera n’omubuziibuzi oba omusawo ajjanjaba. Basobola okukuwa obuyambi n'obukodyo okutumbula enkolagana y'abantu. Jjukira nti si kibi okuwulira enneewulira ezitali zimu ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, era si ggwe wekka afuna enneewulira zino. Okunoonya obuyambi okuva mu bantu abakulu abeesigika, mikwano gyabwe, oba abakugu kusobola okuleetawo enjawulo ennene mu kuyita mu mbeera y'ebirowoozo ebijja n'omutendera guno ogw'obulamu.

input: Kiki kye nnina okukola singa mbeera nneeraliikiridde nti nnyinza okuba nga ndi lubuto?
output: Weekebeze olubuto era oyogereko n'omuntu omukulu oba ow'ebyobulamu okufuna obuyambi n'amagezi.

input: Waliwo engeri endala zonna ez'okuwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuggyako okukozesa eddagala lya ARVs?
output: Tewali ddagala liwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko eddagala erikaweweezaako. Enkola y'okuweweeza ku kawuka bwe bujjanjabi obw’omutindo obusinga okukola ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Eyamba okukkakkanya vvayiraasi, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka mu mubiri, okuzzaamu abaserikale b’omu mubiri, n’okukendeeza ku kukula kw’obulwadde. Kyokka tekiwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde enkola zino ziwa essuubi, tewali n’emu ku zo ekakasiddwa nti ddagala erijjuvu era erituukiridde okuwonyeza ddala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku bye nnakasembayo okumanya. Enkola enkulu era esinga okusembebwa okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esigala nga ya kukaweweezaako, ekiyamba abantu abalina akawuka okuwangaalira mu balamu obweyagaza ate nga bwe bakendeeza ku bungi bw'akawuka mu musaayi okutuuka ku ssa ly'obutazuulibwa n'okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukasaasaanya. Okunoonyereza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kukyagenda mu maaso, noolwekyo kirungi okubeera ng’omanyi ebigenda mu maaso nga weebuuza ku nsonda ezeesigika ez'abakugu mu byobulamu.

input: Osobola otya okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okwegatta nga teweetangidde?
output: Okwegatta nga tolina nkola ekiziyiza, gamba nga akapiira, kitera okuyitibwa "okwegatta kw'obuteetangira." Wadde ng’abaagalana abamu bayinza okusalawo okwegatta nga tebeetangidde kikulu okutegeera akatyabaga akakirimu era n’okukola emitendera okulaba ng’olina obukuumi naddala ng’olina omubeezi, omubeezi omu akebeddwa era nga talina Bulwadde bwa Kikaba. Zino ze ngeri z’okuyamba okukakasa nga weegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga: Abaagalana bombi balina okwekebeza, okubeera n'omubeezi omu yekka, okuziyiza okuzaala, okwekebeza entakera, okwogera mu bwerufu, okulowooza ku PrEP, okwerinda akatyabaga n'okwetegerekera olubuto. Kikulu okujjukira nti engeri yokka ey’okumalawo akatyabaga k'Obulwadde bw'Ekiakaba nga weegasse n'omubeezi kwe kukozesa enkola z'okwetangira nga obupiira buli mulundi era mu butuufu. Bw’oba olina okubuusabuusa oba okweraliikirira kwonna ku bulamu bwo obw’okwegatta, kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo akulungamye era akukebera.

input: Ani atera okuweebwa eddagala erigema erya Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) mu nsi ezirimu ennyo Akafuba?
output: Yee, eddagala erigema erya bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) lisobola okukuuma omuntu okuva eri endwadde ez’amaanyi ng'Akafuba. Likola ebitundu nga 80% mu kujjanjaba ebika by'Akafuba ebisinga okuba eby’amaanyi. Mu nsi omuli Akafuba, BCG eweebwa abaana abawere n’abaana abato ng’emu ku nteekateeka y’eggwanga ey’okugema abaana.

input: Omuntu asobola atya okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kyetaagisa okutegeera, okuyamba, n'okubeera omwegendereza okulaba ng'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naawe kennyini mubeera bulungi. Eno y'emu ku nnambika egobererwa ku ngeri y'okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: weesomese, wiliziganya naye mu bwesimbu, kuuma ebyama bye, kozesa enkola ez'okwegatta ezitaleeta za bulabe ku bulamu, muyambe afune obujjanjabi, kolerera okubeera mu bulamu obulungi, mutegeere, weewale olulimi olusosola oba oluboola, weekebezenga, funa obuyambi ku nsonga z'obwongo, yiga eby'obujjanjabi ebisookerwako, era tambulira mu kumanya. Jjukira nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa mu nkolagana eya bulijjo nga okugwangana mu bifuba, okukwata mu ngalo oba okugabana ebikozesebwa mu kulya.

input: Okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kirina akakwate ku mbeera oba ku nneeyisa?
output: Yee, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu bisobola okuleeta enkyukakyuka mu mbeera nga ekimu ku bikosa omuyungo gw'empuliziganya y'omubiri n'obulamu bw'omuntu okutwaliza awamu. Enkyukakyuka zino mu bwongo ne mu mubiri zisobola okutwalibwa nga zeekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Siriimu. Kikulu nnyo okukimanya nti enkyukakyuka mu bwongo mu bantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu zisobola okwawukana nnyo okusinziira ku muntu. Abantu abamu bayinza okufuna enkyukakyuka entonotono mu bwongo, ate abalala bayinza okufunira ddala obuzibu obw'amaanyi ku bwongo.

input: Nsonga ki eziyinza okuviirako omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuba nga akyakwatibwa endwadde zinnakigwanyizi?
output: Obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi bwe bulwadde obusinga okubalukawo era nga businga kuba bwa bulabe mu bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kino kiri bwe kityo kubanga emibiri gyabwe giba ginafuye. Leero, endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka bunnakigwanyizi tezikyali nnyo mu bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu olw’okuba waliwo eddagala erikola obulungi ku kawuka ka kano. Naye abantu abamu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bakyafuna endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka bunnakigwanyizi  kubanga basobola okuba nga tebamanyi nti balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, bayinza okuba nga tebali ku ddagala lya Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, oba eddagala lyabwe eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu liyinza okuba nga terikola bulungi.

input: Kimiimo ki ekirala ekikozesebwa okutegeeza obubonero obusooka obw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okulumwa omutwe emirundi egiwerako ekiro n’okutuuyana byokka si bubonero bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obubonero bw'Akawuka akaleeta Sriimu busobola okwawukana nnyo mu bantu ssekinnoomu, era butera okweyoleka nga wayise wiiki okutuuka ku myezi oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa. Obubonero obusooka obw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obutera okuyitibwa obw'oku mutendera ogusooka ogw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng'omubiri gutandise okwerwanako oluvannyuma lw'okulumbibwa, muyinza okubaamu obwefaanaanyiriza obwa ssennyiga. Bw'oba olina obweraliikirivu ku Kawuka  akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu nnyo okwekebeza Akawuka kano. Okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu y’engeri yokka ey’okuzuula obulungi bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okukebera kutera okukolebwa nga bakozesa omusaayi oba amazzi g’omu kamwa.

input: Kibi okubeera n’abantu be weegatta nabo abawera?
output: Yee, gy'okoma okubeera n'ababeezi abangi, gy'okoma okubeera n'emikisa mingi egy'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, nga noolwekyo kyalibadde kirungi okubeera n'omubeezi omu, kakasa nti buli omu yeekebezza, era weenyigira mu nkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu bwo mu katyabaga.

input: Bifo ki oba mikutu ki egiwa amagezi ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne Siriimu?
output: Waliwo ebikozesebwa bingi ebisobola okukozesebwa okufuna obuyambi n'okuyiga ebisingawo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne Siriimu. Ne bwe kiba nga onoonya bubaka buyambi, oba buweereza bwa kisawo, bino bye bimu ku bifo w'osobola okutandikira: abasawo, ebifo ewakebererwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ebitongole by'ebitundu ebituusa obuweereza bwa Siriimu ku bantu, ennamba z'olukale ezikubwako ku nsonga z'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n'ennamba okusabirwa obuyambi.

input: Mitendera ki egiyinza okuyitibwamu okukakasa nti Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu beetaayiza mu kitundu?
output: Okugyisa abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeerabantu kyetaagisa okusobola okukendeeza ku kuboolebwa, okutumbula embeera egasa abantu bonna, n’okuwagira obulamu bwabwe bwonna okutwalira awamu. Ensonga eno ya buntu era ng'erina kwesigama ku ggwe ng'omuntu era nga tolina kugyesigamya ku ngeri bantu balala gye bagirabamu oba gye bagirowoozaako.

input: Buzibu ki obuva ku Kiramidiya w'omu kamwa?
output: Kiramidiya, era amanyiddwa Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo, Kawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ak'olulango mu baami n’abakyala. Kasobola okuvaako obukosefu obw'olubeerera ku bitundu by'omukyala ebizaala, ekikifuula ekizibu oba ekitasoboka kufuna lubuto oluvannyuma. Kiramidiya era asobola okuleeta olubuto okukulira mu nseke (wabweru wa nnabaana) ekiyinza okuteeka omukyala mu katyabaga k'okufa. Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa avaako obuzibu ku bulamu, omuli okuzimba kw'amagumba g'omu kiwato mu bakyala n'okuzimba kw'olububi lw'oku kibumba. Mu baami, asobola okuvaako enseke z'oku nsigo okukwatibwa akawuka, ekivaako obutazaala. Kiramidiya era asobola okuleeta ekyenda ekinene n'amaaso okukwatibwa akawuka n'okuzimba mu nnyingo. Obukosefu obusooka Kiramidiya bw'aleeta tebutera kweyoleka.  Wabula, Kiramidiya asobola okuleeta obuzibu obwamaanyi ku bulamu.Mu bakyala Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa asobola okuvaako okuzimba kw'amagumba g'omu kiwato. Obumu ku buzibu bw'amagumba g'omu kiwato okuzimba bwe buno:• Okutondebwawo kw'ekifundikwa ky'enkovu ekinene ekizibikira enseke.• Olubuto okukulira mu nseke (okukulira wabweru wa nnabaana).• Obutazaala (obutasobola kufuna lubuto).• Obulumi bw'amagumba g'omu kiwato/olubuto obw'olukonvuba. Abaami tebatera kufuna buzibu buva ku Kiramidiya. Okukwatibwa Kiramidiya kuyinza okuleeta omusujja n'obulumi mu nseke z'oku nsigo. Kino emirundi egy'ebbalirirwe kisobola okuvaako obutazaala.Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa era asobola okwongera ku mikisa gy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusiigibwa mu mitendera egisooka oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa Akawuka?
output: Ekiseera omuntu omulwadde mw’asobolera okusiiga abalala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kiyitibwa ekiseera eky’okusiiga oba eky’okuwereba akawuka. Okutwaliza awamu, kisoboka omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukasiiga abalala, naye nga waliwo ensonga endala ez’okulowoozaako, gamba ng’omuwendo gwa vvayiraasi oguli mu musaayi gw'omuntu, ekika ky'eddagala lya ART ekikozesebwa, n'enneeyisa z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Bino byonna birina kye bikola mu kusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Nsobola okufuna Kiramidiya okuva mu kusemberera abulina?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo akasaasaana okuva mu kwegatta ng'amazzi g'ekikyala oba ag'ekisajja agalimu akawuka kano katambula okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Osobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa weegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba awava obubi, okugabana ebintu ebikozesebwa mu kwegatta n'omuntu alina akawuka kano. Okukwatagana kw'ensusu z'ebitundu by'ekyama y'enkola esinga okumanyibwa mu kusaasaana kwa Kiramidiya, n'amazzi g'ekisajja oba ag'ekikyala agalimu akawuka kano singa gagenda mu maaso g'omuntu. Omukyala ow'olubutu alina Kiramidaya asobola okumusiiga omwana we mu kiseera ky'okuzaalibwa, era ekyo kisobola okuviirako omwana okukwatibwa Kiramidiya akwata amaaso ekisobola okukosa endaba ye. Bw'oba walina Kiramidiya n'ojjanjabibwa osobola okuddamu n'omufuna singa weegatta n'omuntu amulina nga teweetangidde.

input: Biki ebikwata ku ngeri abantu gye balabamu akaboozi ennaku zino?
output: Endowooza y'okuba nti okwegatta kuli mu kufuuka ekintu ensonga enkukunavu ennyo mu ngeri abantu b'omulembe guno gye batambuzaamu obulamu bwabwe esobola okuteekebwa ku okukolagana kw'ebintu ebiwererao ddala omuli embeerabantu, ebyobuwangwa, tekinologiya, n'ensonga z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Wadde nga kikulu okwewala obwattwalirawamu obususse, zino ze zimu ku nsonga enkulu ezivaako endowooza egamba nti okwegatta kucaase nnyo mu mbeerabantu y'olwaleero: okwongera kw'ebirabibwa, enkyukakyuka mu mpisa z'obuwangwa, ebyenjigiriza n'okumanyisibwa, tekinologiya ne appu z'abanoonya ababeezi, okukendeera kw'okusosolebwa olw'obulwadde, enkola z'okulungamya abaagalana ezimeruseewo, okulanga n'okutunda ebintu, okupikirizibwa n'ensi yonna okufuuka ng'ekyalo ekimu ekinene.

input: Enkola z'Abantu ez'okuziyiza si za buseere?
output: Enkola z'embeerabantu ez'okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ziraze nti zikola bulungi ddala mu kutangira okukwatibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bantu ababadde tebakalina. Enkola ng'ezo zisobola okukendeeza ku nsimbi ezisaasaanyizibwa kubanga zisobola okutuuka ku bantu bangi abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka ku bisale ebitono ddala. Ezimu ku nkola embeerabantu z'ekozesa okutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mulimu; okwagazisa abantu okukozesa obupiira, n'enteekateeka z'okukyusa empiso ezijjanjaba.

input: Magezi ki agayinza okuweebwa abavubuka abatya okwogera ne baganzi baabwe ku kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okumanya oba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nedda nga tamanyi oba nga takkirizza kikyamu era kimenya mateeka mu bitundu bingi. Okussa ekitiibwa mu bikwata ku muntu ebyekyama n'okwefuga kwe kikulu nnyo. Bw'oba olina okweraliikirira ku mbeera y'obulamu bw'omubeezi wo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, enkola entuufu era ey'obuvunaanyizibwa kwe kwogera naye mu lwatu era mu mazima ku bikwata ku bulamu bw'okwegatta, okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n'okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga. Jjukira nti okumanya embeera y'omubeezi wo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwetaagisa ku lw'obulungi bwammwe mwembi, naye nga kulina kwesigama ku kukkaanya okutali kukake.

input: Nnyinza ntya okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga nneegatta n'omuntu akalina?
output: Okutangira okusiigibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga weegatta n’omuntu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kyetaagisa okubeera omwegendereza n’okukozesa enkola z'okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusiigibwa Akawuka. Gino gye gimu ku mitendera emikulu egy'okufaako: okuwuliziganya obulungi, okwekebeza buli kiseera, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, okukozesa PrEP, okukozesa enkola z’okwegatta ennungi, okukendeeza ku ngeri z'okwegatta ez'obulabe, obujjanjabi obwa bulijjo, okumanya obungi bw'Akawuka muganzi wo bw'alina mu musaayi, okukozesa PEP, okukkiriziganya, n’okubaawo n'entegeeragana.

input: Biki ebyaviirako maama okunsiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'nzaala?
output: Kya nnaku okuwulira embeera mw'oyita. Kikulu okukinogaanya nti bamaama tebakigenderera kusiiga baana baabwe Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Ensaasaana y'Akawuka okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana eyinza okubaawo ng'ali lubuto, mu kumuzaala oba mu kuyonsa naye si kikolwa kigenderere.

input: Ntegeera ntya nti ndi mwetegefu okuganza?
output: Bw’oba owulira obutebenkevu n'essanyu, oyinza okuba ng'oli mwetegefu, noolwekyo weesige empulira yo.

input: Otegeera otya nti omuntu ali lubuto?
output: Okubeera olubuto kitera okuwerekerwako obubonero obw'enjawulo wadde nga buno butera okukyuka okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Singa oteebereza nti oli lubuto oba ng'oteekateeka okulufuna, buno bwe bumu ku bubonero bw'olina okwetegereza: obutagenda mu nsonga, obukoowu, enkyukakyuka mu mabeere, okusinduukirirwa emmeeme n'omusujja gw'okumakya.  Obubonero buno tebufunibwa buli mukyala ali lubuto, era nga businziira ku muntu.

input: Okumira eddagala lya ARV erya bulijjo kya nkizo mu kuwangaala kw’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Enkola eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe bujjanjabi obw’omutindo eri abantu ssekinnoomu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Omuntu ssekinnoomu bw’atandika enkola eno, okutwaliza awamu kirungi okugenda mu maaso ng'amira eddagala lye nga bw'alagiddwa omusawo obulamu bwe bwonna. Okuva ku bujjanjabi obuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kuyinza okuviirako akawuka kano okuddamu okwalula, ne keeyongera mu musaayi, n’okukendeera kw’abaserikale b’omubiri.

input: Ng’omusajja, nnyinza ntya okwekuuma obutafuna bulwadde bwa Genital Herpes?

input: Biki abantu bye balina okulowoozaako nga tebannagabana buwale bwa munda oba engoye?
output: Okugabana n'omuntu engoye ka kibeere obuwale ezoomunda oba eza bulijjo, kiyinza okukosa obulamu okusinziira ku mbeera ebeetoolodde n'embeera y’obulamu bw’abantu abakwatibwako. Zino ze zimu ku nsonga ez'okulowoozaako: Engoye, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde, embeera mwe mwambalira n'obuyonjo bw'omuntu. Okutwalira awamu, okugabana engoye n’omuntu kiyinza okuba ekya bulijjo mu mbeera ezimu, gamba nga b’omu maka oba mu mikwano egy’oku lusegere. Wabula kikulu okusoosowaza obuyonjo n’obulamu bw’omuntu okukendeeza ku bulabe bw’okukwatibwa endwadde nga bwe kisoboka. Bw’oba olina okweraliikirira ku biva mu kugabana engoye n’omuntu, kirungi okwebuuza ku mukugu mu byobulamu oba omusawo asobola okukuwa amagezi agasingawo okusinziira ku mbeera yo n’embeera y’ebyobulamu.

input: Abantu bakisanga nga kyangu okwogera ku bwe bayimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okwasanguza embeera y'omuntu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusalawo kwa buntu nnyo, era ng'eddaala ly'obutebenkevu bw'okwasanguza embeera y'omuntu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu lyawukanira ddala. Abantu abamu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebakirinaako buzibu mbeera yaabwe kwasanguzibwa, so ng'ate abalala bayinza okugikuuma nga ya kyama.

input: Ki ekibaawo singa Kisipi alekebwa nga tajjanjabiddwa ng'oli lubuto?
output: Okufuna obulwadde bwa Kisipi ow’ebitundu by’ekyama mu kiseera ng’oli lubuto kikwanyiziddwa n'okuvaamu olubuto embagirawo, okulemererwa kw’omwana ali mu lubuto okukula, okuzaala omwana ng'ebbanga ettuufu terinnatuuka, n’omwana eyaakazaalibwa okukwatibwa akawuka akaleeta Kisipi. Ebiseera ebisinga, Kisipi akuba ku lususu kwokka. Kisipi asobola okuvaamu ebizibu bingi ebikosa ebitundu by'omubiri ebirala, naye kino tekitera kusangika. Okutwaliza awamu, ebizibu bino bisinga kubaawo mu mbeera za mirundi ebbiri: Omwana bw’abeera ne Kisipi eyamusiigibwa mu kuzaalibwa ne mu mbeera ng'omubiri gw'omuntu tegulina maanyi galwanyisa buwuka buleeta ndwadde (era nga bwe kiri ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu).

input: Singa nfuna obujjanjabi bwa Kiramidiya ne mpona, waliwo emikisa gy’okuddamu okumufuna?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo ajjanjabibwa era awonyezebwa mu nnaku oba wiiki entonotono. Abantu balina okulindako okwegatta okumala ennaku 7 oluvannyuma lw'okumira eddagala lya Kiramidiya oba bwe kiba nga tekisoboka bakozese obupiira mu ngeri entuufu. Balina okutegeeza be beegatta nabo okukeberebwa n'okujjanjabibwa, bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

input: Kyetaagisa okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe mba ndi mu mukwano?
output: Kikulu okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’omukwano gutandika kubanga mu ngeri eyo ojja kumanya embeera yo n’ey’omwagalwa wo. Wabula kya bulijjo mwembi obutaba na mbeera ya Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu efaanagana.

input: Abantu abamu bagejja oluvannyuma lw’okutandika obujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Yee, eddagala erijjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu erimu naddala eryo eriweweeza lisobola okugezza omuntu alikozesa. Mu kwongerezaako, okugejja kuyinza okufugibwa ensonga eziwerako omuli ekika ky'eddagala erikozeseddwa, obutoffaali bw'omuntu obw'omu mubiri, enneeysa ye n’endya ye.

input: Waliwo enzikiriza nti abasajja babeera n'emikisa mitonoko okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu; kino kituufu?
output: Enzikiriza nti abasajja bali ku kigero kya wansi eky’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu si ntuufu kikumi ku kikumi. Emisinde Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kakwatira abantu gisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku nsonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ekifo, enneeyisa, n'omuwendo gw'abantu. Kikulu okutegeera nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasosola mu bantu kusinziira ku kikula kyabwe, era omuntu yenna, awatali kufaayo ku kikula kyabwe, basobola okukwatibwa akawuka kano.

input: Waliwo enteekateeka y'okugabira abawala ppamba w'ekikyala ow'ebbeeyi ensaamusaamu okuva bwe kiri nti bangi beewaayo okwegatta nga tebeetangidde okusobola okumufuna?
output: Enteekateeka ez'okuwa abawala ppamba w'ekikyala ziyinza okuba n'emiganyulo egiwerako mu kumalawo ebizibu ebiwerako omuli enkuuma y'obuyonjo nga bali mu nnaku zaabwe, okufuna okusomesebwa n'okukendeeza ku bikolwa ebiteeka obulamu bwabwe mu katyabaga nga okwegatta nga tebeetangidde okusobola okumufuna.

input: Okuyumunguza obukyala ne sooda wa Coca-Cola kitangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’embeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okukakwatibwa?
output: Nedda, okunaaba mu bukyala ne sooda wa Coca-Cola oba ekyokunywa oba ekintu ekirala kyonna tekujja kutta Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu keeko aka vvayiraasi erumbagana obusirikale bw'omubiri ng'era okusinga kasaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu mazzi g'omubiri okugeza omusaayi, amazzi agava mu busajja, agava mu bukyala, agava awava obubi, n'amabeere.

input: Lwaki mpulira okweraliikirira oba okutya ku kutandika okuvubuka?
output: Okuwulira okweraliikirira oba okutya olw’okutandika okuvubuka kya bulijjo ddala. Kiseera kya nkyukakyuka ez’amaanyi, mu mubiri ne mu birowoozo, era kya butonde okuwulira nga tolina bukakafu ku kiki ky’olina kusuubira. Oyinza okweraliikirira engeri abalala gye banaakutunuuliramu, engeri omubiri gwo gye gunaakyukamu, oba engeri gy’onooyitamu mu mbeera z'obulamu empya. Jjukira nti buli muntu ayita mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, era kitundu kya bulijjo mu kukula. Okwogera n’abantu abakulu oba emikwano gye weesiga ku nneewulira zo kusobola okukuyamba okukendeeza ku kukulungutana.

input: Ddi lwe nsobola okuddamu okwekebeza okukakasa bwe nnyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okugera ekiseera ky'okuddamu okwekebeza okuva ku kukeberebwa okwasooka kwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera eziriwo n'ekika ky'okukeberbwa kwe wakozesa omulundi ogwasooka. Kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo oba eddwaliro erikebera okufuna okulambikibwa ku ddi lw’olina okwekebeza omulundi ogwokubiri nga beesigama ku mbeera zo ng'omuntu. Basobola okukuwa amagezi agakutuukirako ng'omuntu n’okukuyamba okutegeera engera y'ekiseera ekituufu eky’okuddamu okwekebeza. Jjukira nti okuzuula amangu n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okuyambako okwongera ku mutindo gw'obulamu, noolwekyo okwekebeza entakera kitundu kikulu nnyo mu kuziyiza n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ddi lwe nnina okubuulira ku muntu yenna ku bwe nnyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba waakamanya embeera yo, funa obudde okulowooza ku mawulire ago nga tonnasalawo kugagabana na muntu.

input: Kiki omuntu ky’alina okulowoozaako ng’abeera n’omuntu alina akawuka ka siriimu?
output: Okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kyetaagisa okutegeera, okuyamba, n'okubeera omwegendereza okulaba ng'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naawe kennyini mubeera bulungi. Eno y'emu ku nnambika egobererwa ku ngeri y'okubeera n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: weesomese, wiliziganya naye mu bwesimbu, kuuma ebyama bye, kozesa enkola ez'okwegatta ezitaleeta za bulabe ku bulamu, muyambe afune obujjanjabi, kolerera okubeera mu bulamu obulungi, mutegeere, weewale olulimi olusosola oba oluboola, weekebezenga, funa obuyambi ku nsonga z'obwongo, yiga eby'obujjanjabi ebisookerwako, era tambulira mu kumanya. Jjukira nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa mu nkolagana eya bulijjo nga okugwangana mu bifuba, okukwata mu ngalo oba okugabana ebikozesebwa mu kulya.

input: Kikukakatako okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu si kya buwaze mu bifo n’embeera ezisinga obungi, naye kirungi nnyo olw’ensonga eziwerako. Kikulu okujjukira nti okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwa kyama, era ebiva mu kukukebera tebiteekeddwa kugabanibwa na balala nga tokkirizza. Ebifo by’ebyobulamu bingi n’ebibiina by’omu kitundu biwa obuweereza bw’okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era mu mbeera ezimu, osobola n’okukebererwa awaka ng’olina ekikozesebwa okwekebera. Okusalawo okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kya muntu ku bubwe, naye kirungi nnyo naddala nga weenyigira mu nneeyisa eziyinza okukuteeka mu katyabaga k’okukwatibwa akawuka. Okwekebeza buli kiseera kwetaagisa nnyo mu bulamu bw’okwegatta, era kiwa abantu ssekinnoomu amaanyi okusalawo mu ngeri entuufu ku bulamu bwabwe n’embeera yaabwe ennungi.

input: Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B gugemebwa gutya?

input: Nsobola ntya okugumira okulumwa olubuto nga kubaddewo mu kiseera nga ndi mu nsonga?

input: Omanyi oba okubudaabudibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwa bwereere mu bulwaliro oba mu bitongole?

input: Abavubuka basobola okukozesa batya ebintu nga ebizigo ebiziyiza omusana n'ebiziyiza olususu okukala mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?

input: Nsobola okuwuga oba okukola dduyiro nga ndi mu nsonga?

input: Obukodyo bw'okweggyako okweraliikirira busobola butya okuyambako ku mbeera ekulembera okugenda mu nsonga?

input: Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okwanguyirwa okufuna eddagala lya ARVs?
output: ARV ezijjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okutwalira awamu zisangibwa mu bitundu bingi okwetoloola ensi yonna, naddala mu nsi ezirina enkola z’ebyobulamu enteeketeeke obulungi. input: Nnyinza kunnyonnyola ntya omuntu omugaso gw'okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Nnyonnyola omuntu atalowooza nti yaakwatiddwa akawuka nti kikyetaagisa okukeberebwa kubanga y’engeri yokka gy’anaamafunamu obukakafu ku mbeera ye ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Bubonero ki obulaga nti omuntu ayinza okuba n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Obubonero obulaga Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busobola okubaamu okuvaamu amazzi agatali ga bulijjo, okusiiyibwa, okubabuukirirwa mu kufuuyisa, obulumi mu kwegatta, oba amabwa, naye ebiseera ebimu tewabaawo bubonero, noolwekyo singa obaako ky'olaba kyonna ekitali kya bulijjo, kikulu okwejjanjabisa.

input: Nnina kuzzaako ki singa omuntu ampikiriza okwegatta?
output: Olina okugamba nti nedda era n’otambula n'ovaawo, ng’ojjukira nti kuba kusalawo kwoera nga tewali muntu yenna akubanja kintu kyonna.

input: Nteekeddwa kukola bintu ki singa mbeera lubuto ate ne nzuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Singa ozuulwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, osobola okuzaala abaana abatakalina! Osobola okufuna obujjanjabi bw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oli lubuto, mu kuzaala omwana, ne mu kumuyonsa mu kutangira okukamusiga. Oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala, omwana wo ajja kwetaaga okufuna obujjanjabi bw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okumala wiiki 4–6. Kino tekitegeeza nti aba n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; kiyamba kutangira kusiigibwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Omuntu alina kweyisa atya oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba weenyigidde mu kwegatta n’omuntu gw’oteebereza oba gw’omanyi nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kyetaagisa okubaako by'okola amangu ddala okukuuma obulamu bwo n’embeera yo eya bulijjo nga nnungi. Bino by’osaanidde okulowoozaako okukola: Weekebeze, weenyigre mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, funa amagezi g’abasawo, era bw’okeberebwa n'ozuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kyetaagisa okunoonya obujjanjabi n’okuyambibwa amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Bino by’osaanidde okukola: Weebuuze ku musawo omukugu mu by’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tandika eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tegeeza ababeezi bo, noonya obuyambi, era ogoberere amagezi g’abasawo. Jjukira nti okuzuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti ye nkomerero y'obulamu obumatiza. Singa abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuna obujjanjabi obutuufu, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, n’okuyambibwa, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala era nga balamu bulungi. Kikulu okufuna obujjanjabi n'obuyambi mu bwanguu ddala nga bwe kisoboka okusobola okutambuza obulamu bwo mu ngeri entuufu.

input: Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okutandika amaka?
output: Yee, okumira obulungi eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kiseera ky'okuba olubuto kitegeeza nti abakyala abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okufuna ekiseera ky'okuba embuto ekirungi n’okuzaala abaana abalamu, abatalina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu.

input: Waliyo engeri ezisobola okukozesebwa okulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Endwadde z'Ekikaba?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kasobola okulwanyisibwa era n'okukolebwako okuyita mu mugatte gw'enkola z'okutangira n'okujjanjaba akawuka kano. Kino kyetaagisa ennenganga ennambulukufu etwaliramu empenda z'okutangira akawuka Akaleeta Siriimu, okwekebeza entakera, okweebejjebwa mu bwangu, n'okugondera ebiragiro ebiweebwa ku bujjanjabi. Kikulu okukolagana obulungi n'abasawo n'abakugu mu by'obulamu bw'okwegatta okufuna okulambikibwa n'okulabirira okutuufu.

input: Weekebeza otya Akafuba?
output: Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okukeberebwa akafuba buli kaseera. Waliwo engeri nnyingi ez'okukebera akafuba:Okukebera omusaayi kye kikozesebwa ennyo, nga bakebera sampolo y'olukusense (omukka ogukolondolwa) oba ekintu ekirala eky'omubiri. Okugatta ku ekyo, akatundu katono ak'obutaffaali bw'akafuba kasobola okukubibwa wansi w'olususu okulaba oba waliwo ekikyuse. Okukuba ekifaananyi kya X-ray nakyo kikozesebwa okukebera oba akafuba kasse amawuggwe go.

input: Nnina okutegeeza omubeezi wange singa mba nnina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Yee, kikulu okubeera omwesimbu eri omubeezi wo ku byobulamu byo okusobola okukuumagana n'okulaga nti ofaayo.

input: Biki ebiva mu kukozesa empeke y’oku makya (P2) ku mwana omulenzi?
output: "P2" kitera okutegeeza enkola y'okuziyiza okufuna olubuto ey'amangu, okutera okumanyibwa nga "empeke ey'oku makya." Enkola y'okuziyiza okufuna olubuto ey'amangu ddagala oba omuteeko gw'obuweke oguyinza okumiribwa oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta okutaliimu kwetangira oba oluvannyuma lw'okulemererwa kw'eddagala eriziyiza okufuna olubuto okusobola okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okufuna olubuto. Kikulu okunnyonnyola nti okuziyiza okuzaala okw’amangu si ngeri ya bulijjo ya kizaalaggumba era terina kukozesebwa nnyo. Egenderererwa kukozesebwa mu mbeera ey’amangu yokka. Okugatta ku ekyo, ekigambo "omwana omulenzi" kitera okukozesebwa mu njogera mu buwangwa n'ebitundu ebimu okutegeeza abavubuka oba abalenzi. Singa oba olina ebibuuzo oba obweraliikirivu obwekuusa ku kuziyiza embuto okwamangu ebyekuusa ku nkola y'ekizaalaggumba eri abalenzi, kirungi okunoonya okumanyisibwa oba obuwabuzi okuva mu basawo abakugu abasobola okukuwa obuwabuzi obutuufu n'obuyambi.

input: Obuweke obuziyiza okuzaala bukola bulungi kwenkana wa?
output: Bwe bukozesebwa mu butuufu bwabwo, bukola ebitundu nga 99% mu kuziyiza embuto.

input: Si kya bulijjo okutandika emboozi ekwata ku bulamu bw’okwegatta n’omusawo w’ebyobulamu?
output: Si bwe kiri n'akatono, abasawo basuubira ebibuuzo nga bino era nga baliwo kukuyamba awatali kukusalira musango.

input: Okukula kye ki, era lwaki kubaawo?
output: Okugimuka bye biseera omubiri gwo we gukulira amangu mu bbanga ettono. Kino kiva ku busannyalaze bw'omubiri obw’okukula omubiri gwo bwe gukola. Obusannyalaze bw’okukula bugamba amagumba go, ebinywa n’ebitundu byo okukula. Mu kiseera ky’okukula, oyinza okukiraba nti ogenda owanvuwa mu bwangu. Okukula kutera okubaawo ku myaka 10-14 ku bawala ate 12-16 ku balenzi, naye kyawukana ku buli muntu.

input: Waliwo eddagala erigema Kramidiya?

input: Ddi omwana wange omuwere lw'alina okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Omwana wo alina okukeberebwa amangu ddala okumanya ekiddako okukolebwa. Okugeza nga yaakazaalibwa oba mu nnaku 2 oluvannyuma lw’okuzaalibwa.

input: Lwaki abantu abamu bafuna obwagazi obw'amaanyi obw'okwegatta oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta omulundi ogusooka?
output: Obagazi bw'okwegatta n’engeri omuntu gy’akwatamu enneewulira z’afuna mu by’okwegatta bisobola okwawukanira ddala mu bantu ssekinnoomu, era tewali nsonga n’emu ennyonnyola lwaki abantu abamu, omuli n’abawala, bayinza okwagala ennyo oba okunyumirwa okwegatta oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Obwagazi bw’okwegatta, okusikirizibwa, n’okumatizibwa bintu bizibu era bifugibwa omugatte gw'ensonga ez’obutonde, ez’eby’obwongo, n’ez’embeerabantu. Bino bye bimu ku bintu ebirina okulowoozebwako: Ensonga za ssaayansi w'obulamu, enkwatagana mu birowoozo, eby’obwongo, ensonga z’embeerabantu n’obuwangwa, omuntu by'ayiseemu, okukkiriza n’okukola okusalawo. Kikulu okutegeera nti buli muntu by'ayitamu mu kwegatta bya njawulo, era tewali nnyinyonnyola "emu ekola ku buli omu" lwaki okwagala kw'omuntu okw'okwegatta kweyongera oluvannyuma lw'omulundi gwe ogusooka mu kwegatta. Okugatta ku ekyo, abantu abamu bayinza obutafuna nkyukakyuka za maanyi mu bwagazi bwabwe oba mu ndowooza zaabwe oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Empuliziganya ey'olwatu era ey'amazima n’abantu be weegatta nabo, okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, n’okusalawo mu ngeri ey’amagezi ku bulamu bw’omuntu mu by’okwegatta bintu bikulu nnyo mu kwegatta okw’obuvunaanyizibwa. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo oba ebikweraliikiriza ku bwagazi bwo oba obw'omubeezi wo mu kwegatta oba by’ayitamu, lowooza ku ky’okubiteesaako n’omusawo w’ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu by’obulamu bw’obwongo asobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuwagizi.

input: Nnina emikisa emeka egy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa nneenyigira mu bikolwa by'okwegatta n'ababeezi abangi?
output: Emikisa gy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gigenda gyeyongera buli omuwendo gw’abantu be weegatta nabo gye gweyongera okulinnya wamu n'eddaala ly'akatyabaga akava ku ngeri omuntu gye yeeyisaamu mu by'okwegatta. Okwenyigira mu kwegatta n’ababeezi abawera naddala nga tokozesa kapiira buli mulundi oba enkola endala ez’okwetangira, kusobola okwongera ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala. Kikulu okukimanya nti emikisa gy’okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tegisalibwawo muwendo gwa baagalana bokka wabula omugatte gw'ensonga zino. Okugatta ku ekyo, embeera z’omuntu kinnoomu n’ebintu ebiyinza okuvaako akatyabaga bisobola okwawukana ennyo.

input: Kituufu nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kafa ng'onaabye ne sooda wa Coca-Cola?
output: Nedda, okunaaba mu bukyala ne sooda wa Coca-Cola oba ekyokunywa oba ekintu ekirala kyonna tekujja kutta Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu keeko aka vvayiraasi erumbagana obusirikale bw'omubiri ng'era okusinga kasaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu mazzi g'omubiri okugeza omusaayi, amazzi agava mu busajja, agava mu bukyala, agava awava obubi, n'amabeere.

input: Tuliici Kawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Tuliici, Bulwadde bwa Kikaba obuleetebwa akawuka ka pulotozowa/akanyuunyunsi akayitibwa Trichomonas Vaginalis.
