input: Lwaki kikulu okwogerako ne mikwano gyo ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Okwogera kuyamba okuggyawo okusosolebwa n'okumanyisa buli omu embeera, era musobola okugabana  ku magezi g'okwekuumira mu mbeera etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga.

input: Engeri ki esinga obulungi ey’okukwangangamu engambo ezikwata ku Ndwadde z’Ekikaba?
output: Sigala ng’oli mukkakkamu era jjukira nti obulamu bwo bwa kyama, noolwekyo fuba okulaba ng’oli bulungi era weewale ebikwogerwako.

input: Obujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwa buseere; nsobola kuggya wa obuyambi bw'ensimbi ez'obujjanjabi n'okulya?
output: Ssente ezisaasaanyizibwa mu bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu zisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku nsonga nga ekika ky’eddagala erikulagiddwa  abasawo, ekitundu mw'obeera, n'ekika ky'obujjanjabi ekikuweebwa. Wabula, obuyambi bw’ensimbi n’ebyetaagisa ebirala weebiri okuyambako abantu okufuna obujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'obuweereza obulala obwekuusa ku kawuka.

input: Kituufu nti Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba bungi mu bavubuka?
output: Yee, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba bweyolekera nnyo mu baana abali wansi w'emyaka okuva ku kkumi n'esatu okutuuka ku kkumi na munaana, era ng'abavubuka bangi bayinza n'obutamanya nti babulina.

input: Nsobola okwetangira okufuna Enziku nga nfunye omubeezi omuggya?
output: Abantu abalina Enziku balina okubuulira ku babeezi baabwe kiyambe okutangira okusaasaana kw'endwadde.

input: Kiki ekibaawo singa weegatta n’omuntu alina Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama?
output: Kisipi bulwadde bwa kikaba obuleetebwa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi. Okwegatta n’omuntu alina Kisipi ow’ebitundu by’ekyama kwongera ku mikisa gy’okukwatibwa akawuka okuva ku muntu oyo.

input: Kisoboka omuntu okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye nga talina Siriimu?
output: Yee, kisoboka omuntu okuba na Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye ne katasuumuka kufuuka Siriimu okumallira ddala ekiseera ekiwanvu. Okusuumuka kw'Akawuka akaleeta SIriimu kwawukana okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala, era si tteeka nti buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akawuka ke kajja kusuumuka okufuuka Siriimu.

input: Biki ebikolebwa okuddukanya embeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu bikkakkanyizibwa okuyita mu kugatta enkola ezigendererwamu okuziyiza okukwatibwa abalala okukwatibwa, okuwa abo abawangaala nako obujjanjabi,  n'okukendeeza ku bizibu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bye kaleetera abo abakalina n'ekitundu. Okulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu, kaweefube ow’enjawulo eyeetaaga okugatta enkola ez'ekisawo, enneeyisa, n’enkwatagana wakati w'ebitongole ebirwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu. Tekizingiramu bya bulamu byokka wabula n’enkola za gavumenti, ebyenjigiriza, okwenyigira mu bantu, n’okubunyisa amawulire okutuukiriza ekigendererwa eky’okumalawo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Wadde nga waliwo ebituukiddwako eby’amaanyi mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kaweefube agenda mu maaso yeetaaga okukendeeza ku bantu abalala abakwatibwa n'okwongera ku mutindo gw'obulamu bw’abo abakoseddwa Akawuka kano.

input: Osobola okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa weegatta n’omuntu akalina ng’okozesa akapiira?
output: Okunoonyereza kulaga nti singa akapiira kabeera nga kakozesebwa mu ngeri entuufu, kawa obukuumi obw'amaanyi okuva eri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, wamu n’okuba n’omugaso ogwongezeddwako ogw’okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obulala obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Okusobola okwekuuma obulungi okuva eri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obupiira busobola okukozesebwa nga bugattiddwako enkola endala okugeza PrEP oba okubeera n'obungi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obutasobola kulabibwa mu musaayi.

input: Ekitundu kisobola kitya okuziyiza okuboola abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okukendeeza ku kuboolebwa okwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikulu okulumirirwa, okwenyigiramu kw'abantu bonna, n'ebiva mu bulamu obulungi eri abo ababa bakoseddwa. Zino ze zimu ku nkola ez'okuyambamu ekitundu okw'ongera okutegeera ebikwata ku Kawuka n'okuyambagana: Somesa banno era obunyise amawulire, tumbula obusaasizi n'okulumirirwa, yogerako n'abakulembeze b'ebitundu, lwanirira enkola enkola z’okulwanyisa obusosoze, yamba ku mirimu gy'ebibiina, wakanya ebigereesebwa ku kikula ky'abantu , tumbula enkuuma y'ebyama, sosowaza ensoga y'abantu okukolera awamu, tendeka abasawo era somesa ab'amawulire.

input: Okwegatta kufuuse kya bulijjo mu bavubuka leero?
output: Endowooza y'okuba nti okwegatta kuli mu kufuuka ekintu ensonga enkukunavu ennyo mu ngeri abantu b'omulembe guno gye batambuzaamu obulamu bwabwe esobola okuteekebwa ku okukolagana kw'ebintu ebiwererao ddala omuli embeerabantu, ebyobuwangwa, tekinologiya, n'ensonga z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Wadde nga kikulu okwewala obwattwalirawamu obususse, zino ze zimu ku nsonga enkulu ezivaako endowooza egamba nti okwegatta kucaase nnyo mu mbeerabantu y'olwaleero: okwongera kw'ebirabibwa, enkyukakyuka mu mpisa z'obuwangwa, ebyenjigiriza n'okumanyisibwa, tekinologiya ne appu z'abanoonya ababeezi, okukendeera kw'okusosolebwa olw'obulwadde, enkola z'okulungamya abaagalana ezimeruseewo, okulanga n'okutunda ebintu, okupikirizibwa n'ensi yonna okufuuka ng'ekyalo ekimu ekinene.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okukwata ebizibu mu mukwano?
output: Okuzimba n'okukuuma enkolagana ennungi kintu kikulu nnyo mu kubeera n'obulamu obumatiza. Bulijjo manya nti buli nkolagana ya njawulo era tewali kintu kifaanagana kisobola kukola mu nkolagana z'abantu zonna. Ekikolera abaagalana abamu kisobola obutakolera balala.

input: Jjajja wange omusajja yangamba nti abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kati basobola okuwangaala ng’omuntu omulala yenna; kituufu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa obulamu bw’omuntu singa takajjanjabwa oba singa kakwatibwa bubi. Wabula, singa kazuulibwa mu bwangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi omuli n'enkola ey'okukaweweezaako, abantu bangi abakalina basobola okuwangaala era ne babeera mu bulamu obweyagaza. Mu bufunze, wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kizibu kya maanyi eyinza okukosa obulamu singa tekajjanjabwa, si ndwadde etiisa kutuusa kutwala bulamu nga bwe gwali ekyali edda, okusiima okw'enjawulo kugende eri eby'obujjanjabi ebikuze. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obweyagaza singa kazuulibwa mangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi. Kikulu okunoonya obujjanjabi, okubunywererako, n'okusoosowaza obulamu obulungi okutwaliza awamu okusobola ekisinga obulungi. Okulondoolwa kw'obulamu entakera n'okwogera n'abasawo mu bwesimbu bikulu nnyo mu kujjanjaba obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Kyetaagisa maama alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukebeza omwana we Akawuka kano?
output: Okukebera omwana wo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu y’engeri yokka enkakafu ey’okumanya oba omwana wo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nedda. Okumanya kino kikulu mu ngeri nti kye kifuga ekirina okuddako okukolebwa. Omwana wo bw’aba alina akawuka, kikuyamba okutandika obujjanjabi nga bukyali ate bw’aba nga takalina, kikuyamba okugoberera enkola ez'okumukuuma ng'ali bw’atyo.

input: Tuyinza tutya okukendeeza ku Kabootongo?
output: Kabootongo yeewalika. Engeri esinga ey'okuziyiza Kabootongo kwe kulekera awo okwegatta. Okukozesa obulungi obupiira buli lwe weegatta kitangira Kabootongo n'obuwuka obulala bungi obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Kabootongo era asobola okusaasaana okuyita mu nkwatagana y’ebitundu by’omubiri ebirala ebitabikkiddwako kapiira omuli ebitundu by’ekyama, awava obubi n’akamwa. Abantu abali mu katyabaga ak’amaanyi ak'okukwatibwa Kabootongo balina okukeberebwa waakiri omulundi gumu mu mwaka. Abakyala abali embuto balina okukeberebwa Kabootongo ku lunaku lwabwe olusookera ddala olw'okunywa eddagala mu ddwaliro era bajjanjabibwe mu bunnambiro singa ebiva mu kukebera biraga nti balina Kabootongo. Kabootoongo asiigibwa omwana ng'akyali mu lubuto asobola okutangirwa nga maama akeberebwa era n'ajjanjabibwa. Abantu abazuuliddwamu Kabootongo balina okutegeeza abantu be beegatta nabo okusobola okwewala okuddamu okukwatibwa akawuka.

input: Abaana abali wansi w'emyaka 12 basobola okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukwata abantu ssekinnoomu ab’emyaka gyonna omuli n’abaana abali wansi w’emyaka 12. Tewali muntu yenna "mulongoofu" oba atakwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku myaka gye gyokka. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasiigibwa okuyita mu nneeyisa oba embeera ez'akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, so si kuyita mu ngeri za buzaaliranwa oba obutaba na musango. Kikulu nnyo okukiggumiza nti abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebalina musango ku bulwadde bwabwe, era basaana obujjanjabi obusaanidde, obuwagizi, n’obukuumi. Enkola z'okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omuli okusomesa ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufuna okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okujjanjaba abakyala ab’embuto, n’okwegendereza okwa bulijjo mu bifo eby’ebyobulamu, bikulu nnyo mu kukendeeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu baana. Okusomesa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okumanyisa abantu, n'okufuna empeereza z'ebyobulamu bikola kinene mu kutangira okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bibinja by'emyaka gyonna, omuli n'abaana. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera esobola okuziyizibwa era esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era okuzuulibwa amangu n’okujjanjabibwa kisobola okuyamba abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okubeera n’obulamu obulungi.

input: Singa mukwano gwange alina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba, alina okwegendereza ennyo ku mbeera emuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okubeera n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba kisobola okwongera ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa oba okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okukiggumiza nti okubeera n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba tekikakasa kukwatibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era si buli muntu alina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba nti ajja kukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Wabula, kiggumiza obukulu bw’okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, okukozesa obupiira obutayosa era mu butuufu, n'okunoonya obujjanjabo obw'amangu obw'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe kiba kyetaagisizza.

input: Olowooza nti okwegatta kikulu mu mulembe gwaffe okusinga edda?
output: Endowooza y'okuba nti okwegatta kuli mu kufuuka ekintu ensonga enkukunavu ennyo mu ngeri abantu b'omulembe guno gye batambuzaamu obulamu bwabwe esobola okuteekebwa ku okukolagana kw'ebintu ebiwererao ddala omuli embeerabantu, ebyobuwangwa, tekinologiya, n'ensonga z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Wadde nga kikulu okwewala obwattwalirawamu obususse, zino ze zimu ku nsonga enkulu ezivaako endowooza egamba nti okwegatta kucaase nnyo mu mbeerabantu y'olwaleero: okwongera kw'ebirabibwa, enkyukakyuka mu mpisa z'obuwangwa, ebyenjigiriza n'okumanyisibwa, tekinologiya ne appu z'abanoonya ababeezi, okukendeera kw'okusosolebwa olw'obulwadde, enkola z'okulungamya abaagalana ezimeruseewo, okulanga n'okutunda ebintu, okupikirizibwa n'ensi yonna okufuuka ng'ekyalo ekimu ekinene.

input: Bantu ba ngeri ki b’osaanidde okutegeeza ku bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okuboolebwa okwetooloolera ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu nsonga ya nsi yonna. Ebyembi tetulina buyinza ku ngeri abantu gye banaakutunuuliramu ng’ozuuliddwa n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ekintu kyokka ky’osobola okufuga be bantu abajja okumanya embeera yo. Kakasa nti obuulirako abantu abanaakuyamba, abataakweyisizeeko bubi.

input: Ngeri ki obubonero bw'Embeera ekulembera okugenda mu nsonga busobola kukolebwako butya?
output: Embeera ekulembera okugenda mu nsonga etegeeza omugatte gw'obubonero obw'omubiri n'ebirowoozo abantu bangi bwe bayitamu nga tebannagenda mu nsonga zaabwe ez'ekikyala. Obubonero buno buyinza okutwaliramu okukyukakyuka mu mbeera, okunyiiganyiiga, obukoowu, okuzimba olubuto, amabeere okulumirira, okuyoya ebyokulya n’okulumwa omutwe. Zino ze ngeri z’okukola ku bubonero bw'Embeera ekulembera okugenda mu nsonga: Endya ennungi: Okulya emmere ennungi omuli ebibala ebingi, enva endiirwa n’emmere ey’empeke ennyingi kusobola okuyamba. Dduyiro: Dduyiro buli kiseera asobola okulongoosa embeera y’omuntu n’okukendeeza ku bubonero ng’okuzimba olubuto n’okukoowa. Okweggyako obweraliikirivu: Okwenyigira mu obukodyo bw’okukkakkana ng’okussa ennyo oba okufumiitiriza kiyinza okuyamba okukendeeza ku kweraliikirira n’okulongoosa embeera z’omuntu. Eddagala eritundibwa ma matundiro g'eddagala: Eddagala eriweweeza ku bulumi nga ibuprofen oba naproxen lisobola okuyamba ku kulumwa olubuto n’okulumwa omutwe. Bulijjo goberera ebiragiro ebikulagiddwa abasawo. Singa obubonero bwo obw'embeera ekulembera okugenda mu nsonga bubeera nga bwa maanyi era nga bukosa obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo, yogerako n’omusawo. Asobola okukuwa amagezi n’engeri z’obujjanjabi.

input: Okweraliikirira kusobola okukosa obulamu bwange obw'okwegatta?
output: Obweraliikirivu busobola okucankalanya obusannyalaze bw'omubiri gwo n'obwagazi bw'okwegatta, nga kino kiyinza okukosa obulamu bwo obw'okwegatta.

input: Bbanga ki "empeke y'oku makya,"(P2) mw'ayinza okukolezebwa okukola kwe ne kusigala nga tekukendedde?
output: Ppulaani B oba P2, era emanyiddwa nga "empeke y'oku makya," egendererwamu okukozesebwa obw'olumu ne mu mbeera ey'obwangu oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta nga teweetangidde oba ng'enkola za kizaalaggumba endala ziremereddwa.  Teyakolebwa kukozesebwa ntakera oba emirundi emingi ng’enkola enkulu ey’okuziyiza okuzaala. Emirundi gy’okukozesa P2 girina okukendeezebwa, era erina kukozesebwa mu kaseera ka bwangu kokka.  Okukozesa ennyo P2 kuyinza okuvaako okukendeeza ku nkola yaayo, okwongera ku bulabe bw’ebizibu ebiva mu kugikozesa, n’okwongera ku kukaluubirirwa n’okusaasaanya ssente. Kikulu okutegeera nti wadde nga P2 nkola ya muwendo nnyo mu kuziyiza embuto z'oteetegekedde mu mbeera ez’amangu, tekola bulungi oba teyeesigika kwenkana nkola za kizaalaggumba endala ezimanyiddwa, obuweke obuziyiza okufuna olubuto, obupiira, n'obuti bw'omu mukono obuziyiza okufuna olubuto.

input: Okuzuula Tuliici?
output: Waliyo enkebera za Tuliici ez'enjawulo era nga mulimu:                                                                                                                       1. Okukebera kw'obuwuka bwa Tuliici mu kitangaazo (sampolo y'amazzi agava mu bukyala oba mu lupiira oluleeta omusulo gateekebwa ku kalabirwamu ne gakeberebwa mu kitangaazo okuzuula oba nga mulimu obuwuka obutambula. 2. Okukebera okw'okwaluza obuwuka, nga wano sampolo eyaluzibwa mu kifo ekiteeketeeke. 3. Okukebera kw'okuzuula  okutumbuka kw'obutaffaali oba vvayiraasi mu ndagaluse y'omuntu: Enkebera eno ya kuzuula ntambuza ya Tuliici okuva ku mugigi ogumu okudda ku mulala nga bakozesa amazzi agava mu bukyala oba mu lupiira oluleeta omusulo. 4. Okukebera okw'amangu, okulaba oba ng'omuntu alina Tuliici, n'aweebwa ebivudde mu kukebra embagirawo. 5. Enkebera ey'okukubisa mu butaffaali bw'endagaluse, nakwo kukubisa mu bungi bw'obutaffaali buno ne kiyamba okuzuula obwo obutambuliramu Tuliici.

input: Omuntu abaddeko mu mbeera emuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu yeetaaga kumanya ki ku nkozesa ya PEP?
output: PEP kye kigambo ekitegeeza "Post-Exposure Prophylaxis." Eno y'enkola y'ekisawo etangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'omuntu okwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okukafuna. PEP etera kukozesebwa mu mbeera nga waliwo akatyabaga ak'amaanyi akamanyiddwa akayinza okuleeta omuntu okufuna Akawuka. Kikulu okumanya nti PEP tesobola kusikira nkola za kutangira Kawuka akaleeta Siriimusi ezimanyiddwa, okugeza, okukozesa obupiira ne PrEP eri abantu abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP ddagala eritangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'omuntu tanneetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okumufuna, sso nga ate PEP ekozesebwa oluvannyuma lw'akatyabaga ak'amaanyi. Bw'oba olowooza nti obadde mu katyabaga k'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, noonya omusawo amangu ddala mwogeremu ozuule oba PEP y'enkola esaana embeera gy'olimu.

input: Biki ebiyinza okuva mu butakozesa ARVs ku bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obutakozesa nkola eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'owangaala nako kiyinza okuvaamu ebizibu eby’amaanyi era ebiyinza okuvaako okufa. ARVs kitundu kya nkizo ku bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kijja kukuviirako Akawuka okweyongera mu musaayi ekiyinza okutegeeza nti kijja kuba kyangu okuwatibwa endwadde ezisobola okukutta.

input: Nafuna ntya Kiramidiya nga siyenze?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo akasaasaana okuva mu kwegatta ng'amazzi g'ekikyala oba ag'ekisajja agalimu akawuka kano katambula okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Osobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa weegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba awava obubi, okugabana ebintu ebikozesebwa mu kwegatta n'omuntu alina akawuka kano. Okukwatagana kw'ensusu z'ebitundu by'ekyama y'enkola esinga okumanyibwa mu kusaasaana kwa Kiramidiya, n'amazzi g'ekisajja oba ag'ekikyala agalimu akawuka kano singa gagenda mu maaso g'omuntu. Omukyala ow'olubutu alina Kiramidaya asobola okumusiiga omwana we mu kiseera ky'okuzaalibwa, era ekyo kisobola okuviirako omwana okukwatibwa Kiramidiya akwata amaaso ekisobola okukosa endaba ye. Bw'oba walina Kiramidiya n'ojjanjabibwa osobola okuddamu n'omufuna singa weegatta n'omuntu amulina nga teweetangidde.

input: Okukomolebwa kukukuuma obutafuna bulwadde bwa Trichomoniasis?
output: Nedda, kisoboka okufuna Tuliici ne bw’oba ng’oli mukomole; okukomolebwa tekukuwa bukuumi bwa nkomeredde kuva eri Buwuka buleeta Bulwadde bwa Kikaba.

input: Nsobola ntya okukolagana n'abantu abalina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba nga sibasosodde?
output: Okukolagana n'abalwadde b'Endwadde z'Ekikaba awatali kubasosola kyetaagisa nnyo okutumbula okusaasira, okutegeera, na buli muntu okwenyigiramu. Eno y'emu ku nnambika ku ngeri y'okuzimba enkolagana eyamba era etasosola balwadde ba Ndwadde za Kikaba: Weesomese, beera okusaasira, ssa ekitiibwa mu by'ekyama byama bya banno, weewale olulimi oluboola, beera muyambi, era wuliriza nnyo.

input: Kiki omuntu ky’alina okulowoozaako bw'aba amaze emyaka egiwerako nga teyeekebeza Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba omaze emyaka ena nga teweekebeza Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu ng'ate weenyigidde mu bikolwa by’okwegatta oba enneeyisa eziyinza okukuteeka mu Katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka mu kiseera ekyo, kiba kirungi okuddamu okwekebeza. Kirungi okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu buli kiseera naddala ng’olina emikisa mingi egy’okukwatibwa. Kikulu okujjukira nti okuzuula Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu amangu kikulu nnyo mu kukkakkanya obulungi Akawuka kano. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera esobola okukkakkanyizibwa nga kazuuliddwa mu budde n'okufuna obujjanjabi.

input: Okwogerako n’emikwano oba n'abenganda kusobola kutya okukuyambako singa owulira obw'omu mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okuwulira nga oli wekka oba nga weeyawudde ku balala mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka kusobola okubaawo olw’ensonga ezitali zimu: Enkyukakyuka mu mikwano: Emikwano gisobola okukyuka kubanga buli muntu ayita mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka ku misinde egy’enjawulo. Kino oluusi kisobola okukuleetera okuwulira ng’oli wekka singa owulira ng’osuuliddwa ebbali. Okupikirizibwa  embeerabantu: Okupikirizibwa banno n’okwagala okutuukagana n’abantu oluusi bisobola okukuleetera okuwulira nga weeyawudde ku balala singa oba togoberera mpisa ezimu. Okwezuula: Bw’ogenda ozuula ky'oli ng'muntu, osobola okuwulira ng’abalala tebakutegeera, ekikuleetera okuwulira ng’olina okubeeyawulako. Obukodyo buno wammanga busobola okukuyamba okukola ku mbeera y'okuwuubaala: Empuliziganya: Empuliziganya ey'olwatu ne mikwano n'ab'omu maka gaabwe esobola okuyamba okuzimba olutindo lw'okumalawo enneewulira z'okuwuubaala. Gabanako ebirowoozo byo n’enneewulira zo n’omuntu gwe weesiga. Weegatte ku mirimu: Okwegatta ku kiraabu, ttiimu z’emizannyo, oba ebibinja ebirina ebintu by'ofaanaganya nabyo kusobola okukuyamba okukwatagana n’abalala abakufaako. Obuyambi obw’ekikugu: Singa enneewulira y'okuba  ng’oli wekka eremerako era n'etandika okukosa obulamu bwo, lowooza ku ky’okwogera n’omubuziibuzi oba omusawo ajjanjaba. Basobola okukuwa obuyambi n'obukodyo okutumbula enkolagana y'abantu. Jjukira nti si kibi okuwulira enneewulira ezitali zimu ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, era si ggwe wekka afuna enneewulira zino. Okunoonya obuyambi okuva mu bantu abakulu abeesigika, mikwano gyabwe, oba abakugu kusobola okuleetawo enjawulo ennene mu kuyita mu mbeera y'ebirowoozo ebijja n'omutendera guno ogw'obulamu.

input: Abantu abakulu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala n'okutuukiriza ebyetaagisa mu mukwano?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukwata abantu ab’emyaka gyonna, omuli n’abakadde. Wadde emisinde Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kasaasaanira mu bakadde giri wansiko bw’ogeraageranya ku bato, abakadde bakyasobola okufuna Akawuka kano, era abo abawangadde n'akawuka emyaka emingi bayinza okufuna ebizibu ebyekuusa ku kukaddiwa n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti abakadde abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okubeera mu bulamu obweyagaza nga balina obujjanjabi obutuufu, obuyambi bw'abantu, n'okufuna obujjanjabi.

input: Bifo ki ebirala eby’okukebererwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko ekifo awabudaabudibwa n'okukeberebwa n'amalwaliro?
output: Okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikulu nnyo mu kumanya embeera yo n’okuyita mu emitendera egisaanidde okukuuma obulamu bwo. Bw’oba nga toyagala kugenda mu kifo kya bwannakyewa awabudaabudirwa n'okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba mu ddwaliro okukeberebwa, waliwo ebyokulondako ebirala eby'enjawulo: okwekeberera awaka ng'okozesa obukebera, awatundirwa eddagala oba mu ssemaduuka w'eddagala, okugenda ku nsiisira z'omu kitundu mwe bakeberera abantu endwadde, ebitongole ebikebera abantu ebitambula nju ku nju, okwebeza ng'okozesa enkebera z'oku masimu, appu z'ebyobulamu n'obuweereza bw'oku mutimbagano, obulwaliro bw'oku byalo, ebitongole by'obwa nnakyekwa eby'oku byalo, amalwaliro ga yunivasite oba amatendekero. Ye ggwe musawo wo owa bulijjo. Singa obeera ng'olina omusawo akujjanjaba oba omusawo wa ffamire, osobola okwebuuza ku kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku nkyala zo ez'eddwaliro eza bulijjo.

input: Okukozesa obupiira kutwalibwa ng'engeri esinga obulungi ey'okuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okukozesa akapiira obutayosa era mu butuufu y’emu ku nkola ezisinga okukola obulungi mu kukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okusaasaanya n’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala okuyita mu kwegatta. Obupiira bukola ng’omuziziko ogutangira okukwatagana obutereevu wakati w'amazzi g'ebitundu by'ekyama n'obububi ow'omubiri obuseerera, ekikendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya akawuka. Wadde ng'obupiira nkola nnungi nnyo ey’okwetangira, kikulu okukkiriza nti tewali nkola yonna yeesigika 100%. Obupiira busobola okwabika oba okuseerera singa tebukozesebwa bulungi, era bulijjo wabaawo akatyabaga akajja n'okwegatta. Okwekebeza entakera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala, wamu n'empuliziganya ey'olwatu n'abo be weegatta nabo n'enkola z'okwetangira, bintu bikulu mu nneeyisa y'okwegatta ey'obuvunaanyizibwa.

input: Nneewala ntya okwegatta nga sinnabeera mufumbo?
output: Okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa kikusalawo wa muntu ssekinnoomu okusinziira ku by'oyagala, by'okkiririzaamu n’ebiruubirirwa byo. Bw’oba nga weewaddeyo okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa, zino ze zimu ku nkola eziyinza okukuyambako okutuukiriza okusalawo kwo: Teekawo ekkomo ku bintu by'otalina kukola, funa ababeezi bwe mufaananya endowooza, era oteekewo empuliziganya ennungi.

input: Okuzuulibwamu Kiramidiya kitegeeza ki?
output: Singa ebiva mu kukebera biraga nti olina Kiramidiya, kitegeeza nti ekkeberero lyazudde bbakitiiriya ereeta Kiramidiya. Kino kitegeeza nti olina Kiramidiya era ojja kwetaaga obujjanjabi (eddagala eritta bbakitiiriya). Era ojja kwetaaga okutegeeza be weegatta nabo, basobole okukeberebwa.

input: Nkola ki eziriwo ez'okwanganga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka nga 20 egy'okunoonyereza ku nkola ez'okwanganga n'okutangira Akawuka akaleeta siriimu, waliwo ebiwe ebikungaanyiziddwa bingi ku ntangira y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Enkola ezisinga kw'ezo eziziyiza mwe muli ezikwata ku nneeyisa, enzijanjaba, ebintu ebituukirawo mu kaseera akamu, ebyekuusa ku by'ekisawo ne tekinologiya, n'ebyekuusa ku bwebulungulule bw'abantu.

input: Ngeri ki omuntu z'asobola okukwatamu obusimu obuleeta okunyumirwa mu kwegatta?
output: Obusannyalaze bw'omubiri bukola kinene nnyo mu kuleeta obwagazi n'okunyumisa okwegatta. Kikulu nnyo okutegeera nti obwagazi n'okunyumirwa mu kwegatta bintu bizibu nnyo era bifugibwa ensonga nnyingi omuli ez'amasannyalaze g'omubiri, ez'ebirowoozo, ez'obwongo, n'ez'omubiri.

input: Nsobola ntya okuleetera munnange okuwulira obutebenkevu singa mba njagala okugezaako akakodyo ak’enjawulo mu by’okwegatta?
output: Beera wa mazima era omubuulire mu lwatu ng'omubuulira bw'owulira nga naawe bw'owuliriza ebirowoozo bye.

input: Ali lubuto lwa myezi ebiri era alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; omwana we asobola okuzaalibwa nga talina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu?
output: Yee, omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okuzaala omwana atalina kawuka singa aba alina obujjanjabi obutuufu. Kino kimanyiddwa nga okutangira okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana. Enkola nnyingi zikozesebwa okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana mu kiseera kya maama ng'ali lubuto, okuzaala, n'okuyonsa. Kikulu okussa essira ku kuba nti emikisa gya maama ali olubuto okusiiga omwana we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gisobola okukendeezebwa okutuuka ku kitundu 1% singa afuna obujjanjabi obutuufu era n'anywerera ku nkola eziragirwa. Abantu abali embuto abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okukolagana n'abasawo baabwe okuteekawo enteekateeka y'obujjanjabi etuukana n'embeera mwe bali n'okugoberera ebiragiro byonna ebiweebwa okukuuma obulamu bw'omukyala n'omwana.

input: Kabootongo asobola okuleetawo ebizibu ng’oli lubuto?
output: Yee, abakyala abalina Kabootongo atajjanjabiddwa basobola okumusiiga abaana baabwe abali mu mbuto. Kabootongo aleeta ebizibu eby'amaanyi ku mwana ali mu lubuto. Kabootongo aggyamu embuto, aviirako omwana okufiira mu lubuto, okuzaala omwana atannatuuka, okuzaala omwana alina obulemu bw'amagumba, okuggwamu omusaayi, okukyuka kw'olususu n'amaaso, obuzibu ku bwongo, okusannyalala kw'obwongo n'okufa kw'omwana eyaakazaalibwa.

input: Kisoboka Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu okusiigibwa okuyita mu ndagaluse ya bajjajja bo?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa kuyita mu ndagaluse ya muntu okuva ku bajjajja oba abazadde be. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasaasaanira mu makubo ag'enjawulo. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa kuyita mu ndagaluse oba kukasikira okufaananako n'embeera oba endwadde ezimu ezisikirwa okuva ku bajjajja oba abazadde okudda ku baana. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bulwadde obukwata omuntu oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka akabuleeta, ebiseera ebisinga mu bikolebwa eby'enjawulo oba enneeyisa ezisobozesa okusaasaana kw’akawuka. Kikulu okutegeera engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kasaasaanamu n’okugoberera emitendera emituufu egiyitibwamu okutangira okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naddala nga tuyita mu nkola z’okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, okwewala okugabana empiso, n’okufuna okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’obujjanjabi. Okutegeezebwa ku kusaasaana n’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kyetaagisa nnyo mu kukola ku nnawookeera w'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu nsi yonna.

input: Mitendera ki egisobola okuyitibwamu abo abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okugunjaawo amaka amayambi era aganaabawanirira mu biseera by'omu maaso?
output: Okubeera n’amaka amalungi n’okwezimbira ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebirungi kisoboka ne bw’oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Embeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era bw’ofuna obujjanjabi obutuufu n’okukola okusalawo okulungi eri obulamu bwo, osobola okubeera n’obulamu obulungi era obumatiza. Jjukira nti okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekikugaana kubeera na maka agalimu okwagalana era amayambi mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Bw’ofuna obujjanjabi obulungi, n'osoma, n’obuwagizi, osobola okubeera n’obulamu obumatiza n’okuzimba enkolagana ez’amakulu. Weetooloolwe abantu ssekinnoomu abategeera embeera yo era abakusaasira abasobola okukuwanirira.

input: Singa omuntu yeerabira okukozesa kondomu, okunaaba mu mazzi agannyogoga kinaamukuuma obutakwatibwa yinfekisoni?
output: Okunaaba oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta tekitangira Ndwadde za Kikaba, naye okukozesa obupiira n'obupiira obw'omunda bitangira. Emu ku ngeri ezisinga obulungi ez'okutangira Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ye y'okukozesa obupiira buli mulundi gwe weegattira mu kamwa, ewava obubi ne mu bukyala. Enkola zino zisobola okukutangira ggwe n'omubeezi wo okukutangira amazzi agajjawo n'okwegatta n'ensusu okusisinkana obutereevu ebisobola okusaasaanya Endwadde z’Ekikaba.

input: Lufumo ki olusinga okuba olw'ekiralu lwe wali owulidde ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Abantu abamu bakkiriza nti osobola okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba okuva ku kaabuyonjo ezituulwako oba nti ebika by'abantu ebirondobemu be basobola okubufuna, naye bombi bano bakyamu kubanga Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busobola okukosa omuntu yenna nga tekiri ku myaka gye oba engeri gy'atambuzaamu obulamu bwe.

input: Kya bulijjo okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu enfunda eziwera okusobola okuba omukakafu?
output: Omuwendo gw’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kw’osaanidde okuba okukola okukakasa embeera yo ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu guyinza okusinziira ku bintu eby’enjawulo omuli ebiyinza okukuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka, ekika ky’okukeberebwa kw’okola, n’ekiseera ky’okukeberebwa. Mu nkomerero, omuwendo n’ekiseera eby’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebyetaagisa okukakasa embeera yo bisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku muntu. Ekikulu kwe kufaayo ku ky’okukeberebwa naddala ng’obadde weetabye mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi ak'okukwatibwa akawuka oba nga teweekakasa mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Abasawo basobola okukuwa amagezi agakutuukira ku mbeera yo nga basinziira ku nsonga ezaakuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'embeera ezisobola okukuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka. Okugatta ku ekyo, okwenyigira mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga n'enkola ezikendeeza ku kukosebwa bisobola okuyamba okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Kkiraapu mu buwuka obuleeta obulwadde bw'ekikaba yajjawo etya?
output: Enziku esangibwa mu biwandiiko ebyasookera ddala ebyogera ku luse lw'omuntu. Abaluumi, Abayudaaya n’Abawalabu bonna balina ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku bulwadde bwa Nziku era buli kibinja ky'abantu kyalina ennyinyonnyola yaakyo ku bubonero n'enzijanjaba. Ensibuko y'Enziku esangibwa mu Ndagaano Enkadde mu kitabo eky'Abaleevi n’eky'Olubereberye nga ennyonnyolwa nga okusiigibwa, okuvaamu amazzi g'ekisajja agatakalira n'okuyima okw'obulumi. Munnassaayansi Omulooma ayitibwa Galen mu mwaka gwa 130 AD endwadde eno aginnyonnyola nga okutoloka kw'amazzi g'ekisajja. Hippocrates (460–375 BC) yabuyita okulumizibwa mu kufuuyisa. Obulwadde era bwamanyibwanga nga "Kkiraapu,” ekitegeeza okulumizibwa okubaawo ng'omuntu alina obulwadde buno afuuyisa. Mu biseera ebyo, abaami baatwalibwanga ate ng'abakyala bo basiiga busiizi. Akawuka akaleeta obulwadde buno kaasooka kuzuulwa mu mwaka 1879 mu Albert Neisser, noolwekyo akawuka ne katuumibwa Neisseria Gonorrhoea. Ekigambo Enziku kiva mu Luyonaani, ekitegeeza "okukulukuta kw'ensigo."

input: Bujjanjabi ki obuliwo ku bulumi bw'ensonga z'ekikyala obw'amaanyi oba okuvaamu omusaayi omungi ennyo?
output: Bw’oba ng'ovaamu omusaayi mungi ng'oli mu nsonga oba ng'okufuna obulumi, kikulu okwogera n’omusawo. Asobola okuyamba okuzuula oba waliwo ensonga enkulu era n'akuwa obujjanjabi. Gano ge gamu ku magezi g'osobola okusala: Weebuuze ku Musawo: Singa obeera ng'ovaamu omusaayi mungi ng'oli mu nsonga zo ez'ekikyala (okujjuza omusaayi ne guyita mu ppaadi oba kappamba akasonsekebwa mu bukyala buli luvannyuma lwa ssaawa 1) oba bw’oba olina obulumi obw’amaanyi, laba omusawo. Eddagala: Omusawo ayinza okukuwa eddagala eriyamba okukendeeza ku bungi bw'omusaayi oba okukkakkanya obulumi. Kizaalaggumba afugibwa obusannyalaze bw'omubiri: Empeke eziziyiza okuzaala, ebipande oba obuweta obufugibwa obusannyalaze bw'omubiri busobola okuyamba okutereeza ennaku zo ez'okugenda mu nsonga, okukendeeza ku kuvaamu omusaayi omungi n’okukendeeza ku kulumwa olubuto. Ebirungo ebizzaamu omusaayi: Bw’oba ovaamu omusaayi mungi ng'oli mu nsonga, oyinza okuba mu bulabe bw’okuggwaamu omusaayi olw’obutaba na kirungo ekizzaamu omusaayi. Omusawo asobola okukuwa amagezi ku by’okukozesa ekirungo ekizzaamu omusaayi kiba kyetaagisa. Jjukira nti kikulu okufaayo ku bulamu bwo ng'oli mu nsonga, era waliwo ebikozesebwa n’abakugu abasobola okukuyamba okwanganga ebikweraliikiriza oba ensonga zonna ezibaawo.

input: Lwaki eddoboozi ly'omuntu oluusi "likutuka" oba liwulikika nga liwuuma mu kiseera ky'obuvubuka?
output: Eddoboozi lyo likyuka olw’obusannyalaze bw'omubiri obuba bulikolako ng’oli mu myaka gy’obuvubuka naddala ekirungo ekiyitibwa testosterone eri abalenzi ne estrogen eri abawala. Obusimu buno buleetera amalaka go (ebitundu ebiri mu mumiro ebikankana n’okukola eddoboozi ng’oyogera) okukula n'okuguma. Kino kifuula eddoboozi lyo okubeera eddene era ekkulu. Liyinza okukyukakyuka mu bunene oba okuwulikika nga ssaakaavu ebiseera ebimu, naye kino kya bulijjo era ebiseera ebisinga litereerera ne lyeyongeramu ku bunene gy'ogenda weeyongera mu myaka egy’obuvubuka.

input: Buli muntu amera obwoya mu bwenyi oba ku mubiri ng'avubuka?
output: Yee, abavubuka bangi batandika okukula enviiri mu ffeesi ne ku mubiri nga bali mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Naye kino kiva ku busannyalaze bw'omubiri naddala  obuyitibwa testosterone eri abalenzi ne estrogen eri abawala. Testosterone asobola okuleetera enviiri okukula mu bifo nga ffeesi yo (nga ebirevu oba ekirevu), mu nkwawa zo, ne mu bitundu by'ekyama. Abawala nabo batandika okukula enviiri mu bitundu by’ekyama ne mu nkwawa olw’ekirungo kya estrogen. Kitundu kya bulijjo mu kufuuka omuntu omukulu.

input: Wandinnyonnyodde otya eri mukwano gwo enjawulo wakati w’obungi bw’akawuka mu musaayi n’omuwendo gw'obutaffaali obulwanyisa akawuka mu musaayi?
output: Obungi bw'akawuka ka vvayiraasi akali mu musaayi n'omuwendo gw'obutaffaali obulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu musaayi nkebera za mu kkeberero ebbiri ez'omugaso ezikozesebwa okulondoola okweyongera kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'engeri obujjanjabi bw'akawuka kano gye bukolamu. Enkebera zino ziwa obubaka obw'enjawulo obukwata ku kawuka ka vvayiraasi n'obwerinzi bw'omubiri.

input: Lwaki abantu abamu batwala okwegatta nga enneeyisa oba omusono gw'obulamu?
output: Endowooza y'okuba nti okwegatta kuli mu kufuuka ekintu ensonga enkukunavu ennyo mu ngeri abantu b'omulembe guno gye batambuzaamu obulamu bwabwe esobola okuteekebwa ku okukolagana kw'ebintu ebiwererao ddala omuli embeerabantu, ebyobuwangwa, tekinologiya, n'ensonga z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Wadde nga kikulu okwewala obwattwalirawamu obususse, zino ze zimu ku nsonga enkulu ezivaako endowooza egamba nti okwegatta kucaase nnyo mu mbeerabantu y'olwaleero: okwongera kw'ebirabibwa, enkyukakyuka mu mpisa z'obuwangwa, ebyenjigiriza n'okumanyisibwa, tekinologiya ne appu z'abanoonya ababeezi, okukendeera kw'okusosolebwa olw'obulwadde, enkola z'okulungamya abaagalana ezimeruseewo, okulanga n'okutunda ebintu, okupikirizibwa n'ensi yonna okufuuka ng'ekyalo ekimu ekinene.

input: Nkola ki ze nnyinza okukozesa okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omuli n'endya, ne nsigala nga nkola emirimu gyange egya bulijjo?
output: Okuddukanya embeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kuzingiramu enkola ennambulukufu omuli obujjanjabi, obulamu obulungi, n'okubeera obulungi mu nneewulira y'ebirowoozo. Kikulu nnyo okukolagana obulungi n'abakugu mu by'obulamu, omuli abakugu mu ndwadde ezisiigibwa n'abakugu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okukola enteekateeka y'obujjanjabi n'engeri y'okuddukanyaamu embeera y'akawuka kano ekwata obutereevu ku muntu ssekinnoomu. Jjukira nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera ya lubeerera esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era singa omuntu abeera afuna obujjanjabi obutuufu n’okutambuza obulamu bwe obulungi, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala ebbanga eddene era nga bali bulungi. Bulijjo weebuuze ku musawo wo okufuna okulambikibwa n'okumanya by'oteekeddwa okukola okusinziira ku mbeera y'obulamu bwo ssekinnoomu n'ebyetaago byo.

input: Lwaki okufuuweeta sigala kya bulabe nnyo eri abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okunywa sigala kulina ebizibu bingi ebikosa obulamu. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu abanywa sigala batera okusinga ku bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu abatanywa ssigala okulwala kookolo w’amawuggwe, kookolo w’omutwe n’ensingo, kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana, akwata ewava obubi, ne kookolo omulala. Okufuna lubyamira ava mu bakitiriya, ekika kya lubyamira ekya Pneumocystis jiroveciipneumonia, okuzubikira kw'amawuggwe okw'olukonvuba, n’endwadde z’omutima. Okuvaako embeera ezikosa akamwa, gamba nga kandida ow’omu kamwa n'ebipaapi by'olwoya ebikuba mu ku lulimi. Kuvaako n’obutakola bulungi obw'eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okufuna obulwadde obuteeka obulamu mu katyabaga obuvaako n'okuzuulibwamu Siriimu. Omuntu awangaala kitono.

input: Ddala PrEP ewa obukuumi, oba okukkiririza mu nkola ye ennungi kutwalibwa ng’okugereesa?
output: PrEP si kugereesa; nkola ya kwetangira eya ddala era ennungamu ey’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP alimu okumira eddagala buli lunaku okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bantu ssekinnoomu abali mu bulabe obw’amaanyi obw’okukwatibwa akawuka kano. Kizuuliddwa nti akola nnyo singa akozesebwa mu ngeri ey'obutayosa era mu butuufu. Kikulu okumanya nti PrEP tatangira kukwatibwa buwuka buleeta bulwadde bulala obusiigibwa okuyita mu kwegatta oba obuwuka obutambuzibwa mu musaayi, noolwekyo abantu ssekinnoomu balina okugenda mu maaso n’okukozesa obupiira n’okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga okusobola okukendeeza ku bulabe bw’okukwatibwa endwadde endala. PrEP kye kimu ku bikozesebwa mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naddala eri abantu ssekinnoomu abali mu bulabe obw’amaanyi. Bw’oba olowooza nti oli mu bulabe bw’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng’olina ekibuuzo ku PrEP, kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo asobola okwekenneenya embeera ezikuteeka mu katyabaga n’okukuwa okulambikibwa oba nga PrEP y’enkola gy'osaanidde okukozesa.

input: Omusajja alina Kiramidiya asobola okufunyisa omukyala olubuto?
output: Abaami abasinga abalina Kiramidiya basobola okufunyisa omukyala olubuto, wabula, singa tajjanjabibwa, Kiramidiya asobola okukosa obusobozi bw'omwami okufunyisa omukyala olubuto.

input: Lwaki nnina okutegeeza ku mubeezi wange ku byavudde mu kunkebera Kabootongo ebiraga nti mmulina?
output: Okubuulira omubeezi wo nti olina Kabootongo kikulu nnyo era kibayamba mwembi. Kabootongo Bulwadde bwa Kikaba; bw’okizuula nti obulina, waliwo emikisa mingi nti n'omubeezi wo abulina, naddala singa mubadde mwegatta. Okubuulira omwagalwa wo kimuyamba okufuna obujjanjabi. Naye singa omwagalwa wo tafuna bujjanjabi, oyinza okuddamu okukwatibwa obulwadde oluvannyuma lw’okumala okujjanjabibwa. Naye omubeezi wo singa aba talina kawuka, okumubuulira nti okalina kikuyamba obutakamusiiga nga weewala okwegatta naye okutuusa ng’owonedde ddala.

input: Singa obutulututtu bulabika mu bitundu by'ekyama oluvannyuma lw'ennaku ssatu ng'omuntu yeegasse, kisobola okulaga obusobozi bw'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Okuyiwa obutulututtu oba obubonero bwonna obutali bwa bulijjo mu bitundu by’ekyama oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta biyinza okweraliikiriza, naye si bulijjo nti bulaga nti omuntu alina Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba. Waliwo ebintu eby’enjawulo ebiyinza okuvaako okuyiwa obutuluttu mu bitundu by'Ekyama oba obutawulira bulungi era kikulu okulowooza ku nsonga eziwerako, omuli obubonero obw’enjawulo, ebyafaayo by'omuntu eby’okwegatta, gy'abadde akola gye buvuddeko.

input: Kituufu nti singa weenyigira mu kwegatta nga tonnabeera mufumbo, ojja kufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa, ku bwakyo, tekitegeeza nti ojja kukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu oba Obuwuka bwonna obulala obuleeta obulwadde bw’Ekikaba. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu bisinga kusaasaanyizibwa mu makubo nga okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teweetangidde, okugabana empiso oba ebiyiso n’omuntu alina Akawuka, oba maama okukasiiga mwana mu kumuzaala oba mu kumuyonsa. Okukwatibwa oba obutakwatibwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kisinziira ku nsonga ez'enjawulo omuli enneeyisa yo mu by'okwegatta, ebyafaayo byo mu kwegatta n’embeera y'omubeeziwo oba ababeezi bo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'amakubo g'okwata okwetangira Akawuka. Kikulu okuggumiza nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu tekasoso mufumbo n'atali.  Abantu ab’embeera zonna ez’omukwano basobola okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa beenyigira mu mbeera eziteeka obulamu bwabwe mu katyabaga oba okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okwawukana ku ekyo, abantu abeenyigira mu nkola z’okwegatta okutateeka bulamu bwabwe mu katyabaga era nga bamanyi embeera yaabwe eya Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okwekuuma obutakwatibwa Kawuka. Ekikulu kwe kwekuumira mu kumanya, okubeera omwegendereza, n’okukola okusalawo okw'obuvunaanyizibwa ku bikwata ku kwegatta. Okwekebeza entakera, empuliziganya mu bwerufu, n'okukozesa enkola ez'okwetangira nga obupiira mitendera mikulu mu kukendeeza ku katyabaga k'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu n'Obuwuka obulala obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, si nsonga oli mufumbo oba nedda.

input: Ani ayinza okunnyamba okukola mu nsonga eziviirako obuseegu n'okunnungamya okusobola okukyuka?
output: Bw’oba oyagala okukyusa enneeyisa yo n’okwewala okwenyigira mu by’otwala ng’ebikolwa eby’obugwenyufu, kikulu okukitegeera nti okukola enkyukakyuka ennungi mu nneeyisa yo ey’okwegatta nkola ya muntu ku bubwe ate oluusi erimu okusoomoozebwa. Kikulu okujjukira nti okukola enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa kusobola okubeera okuzibu, era kiyinza okukutwalira ekiseera. Bw’oba osanga obuzibu okukola enkyukakyuka zino ku bubwo, tolwawo kutuukirira bakugu singa oba weetaaze obuyambi n’obuwagizi. Omusawo oba omubuziibuzi asobola okukolagana naawe okukola ku bivaako enneeyisa yo n'okukuwa obukodyo bw'okuyitamu okukyusa. Mu nkomerero, ekigendererwa kwe kukwataganya ebikolwa byo n’empisa zo n’okubeera n’obulamu obumatiza era obw'obuvunaanyizibwa.

input: Lwaki nfuna okusiiyibwa ku busajja bwange?
output: Okwetakula (okusiiyibwa) mu bitundu by'ekyama oba ebitundu ebirala by'omubiri kayinza okuba akabonero akaleetebwa ensonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ensonga z'olususu, endwadde, alagye, oba embeera endala ez'obulamu. Kikulu okuzuula ekivaako okusiiyibwa okusobola okukwata emitendera emituufu okwanganga ekizibu. Zino ze nsonga ez'enjawulo eziviira okusiiyibwa mu bitundu by'ekyama: Alagye oba olususu okwekanga, obuwuka obukwata ensusu, olususu olukalu oba olususumbuka, okusiiyibwa, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’embeera endala ez’ebyobulamu. Singa ofuna okusiiyibwa okutawona oba ne kusajjuka mu bitundu by’ekyama, kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo oba omukugu mu byobulamu. input: Waliwo omukisa gwonna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuwona awatali ddagala?

input: Ani asinga okusaanira okwogera naye ku nsonga z'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Waliwo abakugu n'abantu  abawerako b'osobola okukubaganya ebirowoozo n'obweraliikirivu bwo ku bikwata ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okusinziira ku byetaago byo n'embeera mw'oli. input: Omulenzi omuto okwegatta n'omukazi omukulu kumukosa kutya mu mubiri ne mu birowoozo?
output: Ebiva mu kwegatta wakati w’omulenzi ebiseera ebisinga n'omukyala omukulu bisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera, abantu abakwatibwako, n’embeera yaabwe mu birowoozo ne mu bwongo. Zino ze zimu ku nsonga enkulu ez'okulowoozaako: Okulowooza ku by'amateeka, okukosebwa ku bwongo, nnyini buyinza ku bantu bombi, ebyobulamu, okwenyigiramu kw'abazadde oba abakuza, okuyamba n'okubudaabudibwa, okuwuliziganya n'okukkiriza. Kikulu okujjukira nti buli mbeera ya njawulo, era ebiva mu mukwano bwe gutyo bisobola okwawukana nnyo. Okulowooza ku mateeka n’empisa, awamu n’obulamu obulungi n’okukkiriza kw’abantu bonna abakwatibwako, bulijjo birina okuba eby’okusoosowaza. Singa ggwe oba omuntu gw’omanyi ali mu mbeera erimu okwegatta ereeta okweraliikirira oba ebibuuzo, kirungi okunoonya obuwabuzi okuva eri omuntu omukulu eyeesigika, omubuziibuzi, omusawo oba ekitongole ekiyambi eky'omu kitundu ekiyinza okukuwa obuyambi n’ebyetaagisa ebituukira ku mbeera mw'oli.

input: Kiki ekyetaagisa okubeera obulungi n'okuyamba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?

input: Abatiini bakosebwa batya okwegatta n’abantu abakulu?

input: Emyaka gy'okuvubuka mu basajja kye ki?
output: Obuvubuka mu basajja: Obuvubuka kye kiseera ky’okukula ng’omubiri gw’omulenzi gukyuka ne gufuuka omubiri gw’omusajja omukulu ogusobola okuzaala. Enkyukakyuka zino ziva ku nkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri naddala akasannyalaze akayitibwa testosterone akavunaanyizibwa ku kukula kw’ebitundu by’omusajja eby’okuzaala n’enkyukakyuka mu mubiri olw'okuvubuka.

input: Bubonero ki obw'Akafuna akakwata amawuggwe obutera okweyoleka?

input: Kisoboka okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu nga mbadde mu mbeera eyinza okunviirako okumufuna omulundi gumu?
output: Kisoboka okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’ofunye akawuka kano omulundi gumu gwokka gw'obeereddemu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, naye obusobozi bw'okusiiga akawuka kano bwesigama ku nsonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ekika ky'embeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga, obungi bw'obuwuka obuli mu musaayi gw'omuntu omulwadde wa Siriimu, n'okubeerawo kw'ensonga endala eziyinza okwongera oba okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka. input: Nnina amabwa mu bitundu by’ekyama, kitegeeza nti nnina Kabootongo?
output: Kabootongo w’omutendera ogusooka n’ogwokubiri alina akakwate n’ebiwundu n’olususu okuyiwa era nga bwe bubonero obusinga okweyoleka. Buno ebiseera ebimu tebuluma ate era tebusiiwa ne bwe buba nga tebujjanjabiddwa mu ssabbiiti ntono ng'obufunye. Busobola okweyolekera ku kitundu kyonna eky’omubiri, naye ebifo ebisinga okukwatibwa mulimu ebitundu by’ekyama, obusajja, obukyala, awava obubi, ekitundu ky'awava obubi ekya waggulu, akamwa, ebibatu ne mu ntobo z'ebigere. Ebiwundu bya Kabootoongo oluusi biba bikalu era nga tebiruma era oluusi birabika nga enjatika. Bw’oba ng’olina ebiwundu ku mubiri gwo naddala mu bitundu byo eby'ekyama, laba omusawo wo akwekebejje.

input: Waliyo enkebera z'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu endala eziriwo, kubanga nnoonya okwewala okumanyibwa abantu abangi abali ku ddwaliro lino?
output: Singa oba mweraliikirivu ku ngeri y'okukuumamu ebyama byo, era nga oyagala okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku kalwaliro gye batakumanyi, waliwo ensonga ez'okulondako eziwerako. Osobola okulyalira akalwaliro ak'enjawulo akabudaabuda n'okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Noonya bulwaliro bwa gavumenti, obulwaliro obuli mu bifo awakungaanira abantu oba obulwaliro obw'obwannannyini w'osobola okwekebereza mu kyama. Ebifo ebimu bikebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teweetaaga kuwaayo bikukwatano. Ebifo bino bikozesa obubonero obw'enjawulo mu okuzibira ebyama byo. Waliwo n'enkola eyakakasibwa ey'okwekeberera awaka esangibwa mu matundiro g'eddagala n'emitimbagano.

input: Mitendera gya kisawo ki egikubirizibwa okuyitibwamu ku mwana azaaliddwa omukyala alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Yee, oluvannyuma lw’okuzaalibwa, abaana bonna abazaalibwa bamaama abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bajja kwetaaga okumira eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okumala wiiki 4–6.

input: Okuzuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kitegeeza ki?
output: Kitegeeza nti okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe wakola kwazuula akawuka mu mubiri gwo. Kino tekitegeeza nti obulamu bwo buweddewo, kitegeeza nti olina okutandika obujjanjabi nga bukyali.

input: Nsobola ntya okubuuza bazadde bange oba abakuza bange ebibuuzo ebikwata ku nsonga z’ekikyala bwe mba nga ntidde?
output: Okwogera n’abazadde oba abakuza ku nsonga z’okugenda mu nsonga kusobola okukutiisa, naye jjukira nti bafaayo ku bulamu bwo era baagala okukuyamba. Gano ge magezi g'osobola okutandika emboozi: Londa ekiseera ekituufu; funa akaseera akasirifu, ak’ekyama mw’oyogerera nga buli omu awummudde era nga talina kimupapya.Kozesa ebikozesebwa: Bw’oba tokakasa ngeri ya kutandikamu, osobola okukozesa ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa oba okusoma emiko osobole okumanya engeri y'okutandikamu.Oyinza okugamba nti, "Nnasomako ku bikwata ku nsonga z'ekikyala, era nnina ebibuuzo."Beera mwesimbu: Si kibi okukkiriza nti owulira nga tolina mirembe. Oyinza okugamba nti, "Mpulira nga nfunyeemu obuzibu okwogera ku nsonga eno, naye njagala okumanya ebisingawo."Saba okuweebwamu akaseera ak'ekyama: Bw’oba oyagala, osobola okusaba okulekebwamu mu kyama bwe kituuka ku ky'okukolera ensonga zo ez'ekikyala. Oyinza okugamba nti, "Nnandyagadde okukwatira ensonga zange ez'ekikyala ku lwange nga nze, naye nnyinza okwetaaga obuyambi bwo okufuna ebikozesebwa mu nsonga zange ez'ekikyala."

input: Akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ke kamu ku mitendera gyonna egy'okukwatibwa?
output: Omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okukasiiga ku mutendera gwonna ogw'akawuka omuli omu kiseera nga talaga bubonero, ogw'olukonvuba, n'ogw'okusajjuka. Wabula eddaala ly'okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'akatyabaga k'okukasaasaanya bisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku mitendera egy'enjawulo akawuka kwe katuuse. Eno y'ennambika ey'awamu eraga ensiiga y'akawuka gy'egenda ekyukamu buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero gumala akaseera katono oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka, nga wiiki nga ziizo ezisooka. Omutendera gw'olukonvuba: Oluvannyuma lw'omutendera ogutalaga bubonero, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kayingira omutendera gw'olukonvuba.

input: Kisipi asobola okukosa obwagazi bw'okwegatta?
output: Yee, kisoboka obulwadde bwa Kisipi okukosa obwagazi bw'okwegatta.

input: Ngeri ki ezimu ku ziyinza okuyamba ekitundu okwongera okutegeera n'okuyamba ku kukendeeza okuboola abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okukendeeza ku kuboolebwa okwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikulu okulumirirwa, okwenyigiramu kw'abantu bonna, n'ebiva mu bulamu obulungi eri abo ababa bakoseddwa. Zino ze zimu ku nkola ez'okuyambamu ekitundu okw'ongera okutegeera ebikwata ku Kawuka n'okuyambagana: Somesa banno era obunyise amawulire, tumbula obusaasizi n'okulumirirwa, yogerako n'abakulembeze b'ebitundu, lwanirira enkola enkola z’okulwanyisa obusosoze, yamba ku mirimu gy'ebibiina, wakanya ebigereesebwa ku kikula ky'abantu , tumbula enkuuma y'ebyama, sosowaza ensoga y'abantu okukolera awamu, tendeka abasawo era somesa ab'amawulire.

input: Nsobola okukwatibwa Kisipi nga ngabana ebyokunywa?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Kisipi kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa okuva ku bifo ebiba biriko akawuka. Okubeera n’omuntu alina akawuka akaleeta Kisipi akoolese obubonero kuleetera okusiiga akawuka mu bifo eby'enjawulo okugeza ebikozosebwa mu kulya, engoye, n’emmeeza by’okozesa ebiyinza okukuviirako okukwatibwa akawuka.

input: Kyewuunyisa okwogerako ne mukwano gwange ku bulamu bwange obw’okwegatta?
output: Si bwe kiri, okwogera ku nsonga z'okwegatta kikulu nnyo era kiyinza okubayamba mwembi okubeera mu bulamu obweyagaza.

input: Pulogulaamu ya kompyuta gy'otondawo ejja kuwa obubaka ku ddagala omuntu ly'asaanidde okumira singa akwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Sirina busobozi bwa kukola pulogulaamu za kompyuta, naye nsobola okuwa amawulire n’okuteesa ku ngeri pulogulaamu oba enkola ng’ezo gye ziyinza okukolebwamu okusobola okukola ku byetaago by’ebyobulamu, omuli n’ebyo ebikwata ku Ndwadde z’Ekikaba. Pulogulaamu za kompyuta oba ez'oku ssimu ziyinza okuba ez'omuwendo mu kuwa obujjanjabi, omuli okuwa obubaka n’okujjukiza okumira eddagala mu mbeera y’Endwadde z’Ekikaba oba embeera endala.

input: Eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu lirina okumiribwa obulamu bwonna?
output: Obujjanjabi obuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obuzingiramu eddagala erijjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwa lubeerera kasita omuntu abutandika. Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'obujjanjabi buno kwe kusobola okukkakkanya okwekubisaamu kw'akawuka kano mu mubiri okusobozesa obwerinzi bw'omubiri okuddamu okukola obulungi nga bwe gwali. Obujjanjabi buno tebuwonya Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu naye busobola bulungi okukaweweeza n'okukaziyiza okuleeta endwadde kw'ossa okuwa omuntu obulamu obulungi.

input: Kiki kye nnina okukola singa ntandika okugenda mu nsonga zange ez'ekikyala nga siri waka?
output: Bw’otandika okugenda mu nsonga nga toli waka, teweeraliikiriranga! Bino by’osobola okukola: Bw’oba olina paadi oba akawero akayonjo, bikozese. Bw’oba tolina bikozesebwa mu nsonga za kikyala, saba ku mukwano gwo, omusomesa oba omusawo w’essomero oba balinawo ez'okwekuumisa. Bw’oba tosobola kufuna paadi oba kawero akayonjo, osobola okukozesa ebikozebwa okwerongoosa mu kaabuyonjo ng'obizinze bulungi ng'amagezi agaamangu okutuusa w’onoofuna ebikozesebwa mu nsonga z'ekikyala ebituufu. Kirungi okwekuumirako akasawo oba ensawo entono nga mulimu paadi entono oba obuwero obuyonjo, kale bulijjo beera mwetegefu. Osobola n’okwogera n'omusawo w’essomero oba omukugu mu kubudaabuda abantu ku ky’okubeera n’ebikozesebwa mu nsonga z'ekikyala ku ssomero singa wabaawo embeera ey’amangu.

input: Abantu bategeeza ki bwe boogera ku kaweke k'okumakya (P2)?
output: P2, era emanyiddwa nga "Ppulaani B" oba "empeke y'oku makya," kika kya nkola ya kuziyiza kuzaala ekozesebwa okutangira okufuna olubuto oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta ng'omuntu teyeetangidde oba oluvannyuma lw'enkola ya kizaalggumba gy'abadde akozesa okulemererwa. Si nkola ya bulijjo ey’okuziyiza okufuna olubuto era erina okukozesebwa mu mbeera ez’amangu zokka. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde nga P2 esobola okuba eky'okulondako ekisinga obulungi mu kuziyiza embuto ezitali za nneetegekere, tesaana kusikira nkola eza bulijjo eza kizaalaggumba mu kwetangira okuddirira. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo ku ngeri y’okuziyiza okuzaala ey'obwangu bwangu oba ng’olowooza ku ky’okukozesa P2, kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo oba omutunzi w'eddgala ly'ekisawo okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku by'okulondako ebiriwo n'okufuna okulungamizibwa ku nkozesa yaayo entuufu.

input: Kisoboka omuntu okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa omubeezi we abadde ku ddagala lya ARVs okumala emyaka ebiri?
output: Emikisa gy'omuntu abadde ku nkola eweweeza Akawuka nga era Akawuka tekakyalabika mu mubiri okusiiga omubeezi we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mitono nnyo. Enkola eno etera okuyitibwa "Obutazuulibwa = Obutasiigibwa" oba U=U.

input: Okunaaba oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta kuyinza okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Okukwatibwa n'obutakwatibwa Bulwadde bwa Kikaba si kabonero kalaga buyonjo bwo era okunaaba oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta tekitangira Bulwadde bwa Kikaba, wabula okukozesa obupiira oba obupiira obw'omunda kye kiziyiza.

input: Nsobola ntya okulabirira ebitundu byange eby'omubiri ebizaala n'okubikuuma nga biramu bulungi?
output: Okwekebeza okwa buli kiseera: Genda ew'omusawo buli kiseera okwekebejjebwa n’okukeberebwa obulamu bw’ebitundu byo ebizaala. Muno mulimu okukeberebwa Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana (okuggya obutaffaali ku mumwa gwa nnabaana ne bukeberebwa), okukebera amabeere, okukebera Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’okukebera obulamu bw’ebitundu ebizaala byonna okutwaliza awamu. Okwewala okwegatta kirungi nnyo okuva bwe kiri nti kutangira embuto ezitali nneeteekereteekere wamu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ebitundu 100%. Kozesa enkola z'okwetangira: Bulijjo kozesa obupiira mu butuufu oba engeri endala ez’okuziyiza okuzaala okutangira embuto z’otayagala n’okukendeeza ku katayabaga k'okwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Weenyigire mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga: Empuliziganya ey'olwatu n’abo be weegatta nabo ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n’okuziyiza okuzaala. Weekebeze Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba buli kiseera naddala ng’olina ababeezi abawera. Entambuza y'obulamu ennungi: Lya emmere ennamu, kola dduyiro buli kiseera, weekuumire ku bunene obw'ekigero, era weewale okunywa sigala n’okunywa omwenge omungi. Enneeyisa zino zitumbula obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu, omuli n’obulamu bw’okuzaala. Manya omubiri gwo: Weetegereze nnyo ennaku z'ogenderako mu nsonga zo ez'ekikyala, enkyukakyuka mu mubiri gwo, n’obubonero bwonna obutali bwa bulijjo. Kino kiyamba mu kuzuula obuzibu obuyinza okubaawo nga bukyali. Wesomese: Yiga ebikwata ku bulamu bw’okuzaala, enkola z’okuziyiza okuzaala, n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Okumanya kukuwa amaanyi okusalawo mu ngeri ey’amagezi ku bulamu bwo. Okulabirira obulamu bwo obw’okuzaala kuzingiramu omugatte gw'enkola z’okwetangira, okwekebejjebwa buli kiseera, n’okufaayo ku bubonero bw’omubiri gwo. Bw’oba olina ekibuuzo oba ekikweraliikiriza, tolwawo kwogera na musawo. Emitendera gino gisobola okukuyamba okukuuma enkola y’okuzaala ennungi n’obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu.

input: Ani atuukiriza ebisaanyizo by’okumira PEP?
output: PEP ow'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akubirizibwa nnyo okukozasebwa abantu ssekinnoomu abadde mu mbeera ebateeka mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi ak'okwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okugwanira ku kukozesa PEP kusinziira ku nsonga z'enjawulo, omuli ekika ky'embeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka, ebbanga eriyiseewo okuva lw'obadde mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka, n'embeera z'omuntu ssekinnoomu ezimuteeka mu katayabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka. Kikulu nnyo okuggumiza nti PEP tagendereddwamu kukozesebwa bulijjo ng’enkola enkulu ey’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PEP nkola ya kuziyiza Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bantu ababeera mu mbeera ez'enjawulo ezibateeka mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Bw'oba ng'okkiriza nti obaddeko mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng'olowooza ku kukozesa PEP, kya mugaso okulaba omusawo mu bunnambiro. Tuukirira omusawo, ekisenge omuweebwa obujjanjabi obw'amangu, oba eddwaliro awajjanjabibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku mbeera yo n'okuzuula oba PEP akusaanira okusinziira ku mbeera ey'enjawulo mwe kayinza okuba nga kaakukwatidde. Okukola ku nsonga eno mu bwangu kikulu nnyo mu kuleetera PEP okukola obulungi.

input: Enkola z'okutangira okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu zireetera omwana eyaakazaalibwa okuba ow'enjawulo ku baana abalala?
output: Enkola eziteekeddwawo okutangira bamaama abali embuto abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukasinga abaana baabwe okusinga zigendereddwamu okulaba ng’abaana abazaalibwa nga tebalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era nga babeera mu bulamu obweyagaza. Enkola zino tezifuula mwana wa njawulo nnyo ku baana abalala abazaalibwa bamaama abatalina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu mu bulamu bwabwe oba enkula yaabwe.

input: Waliwo we kiyambira okunaaba ng’omaze okwegatta?
output: Okukwatibwa n'obutakwatibwa Bulwadde bwa Kikaba si kabonero kalaga buyonjo bwo era okunaaba oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta tekitangira Bulwadde bwa Kikaba, wabula okukozesa obupiira oba obupiira obw'omunda kye kiziyiza.

input: Kirungi okwogerako ne mikwano gyange ku bulamu bwange obw’okwegatta?
output: Yee, okwogera n’emikwano kusobola okuyamba, naye kakasa nti nabo bamanyi eky'okukola!

input: Oyinza kukwata otya ebizibu ebyekuusa ku kukozesa ebiragalalagala?
output: Okwaŋŋanga okukozesa ebiragalalagala kusoomooza nnyo naye waliwo emitendera gy'osobola okuyitamu okukuyamba: kkiriza ekizibu, noonya obuyambi obw'ekikugu, okubeera n'abantu abakuyambako, genda bakubudeebude, weemanyiize empisa eziyamba okukuuma obulamu bwo nga bulungi era ensonga yo gibuulire ku mikwano gyo n'abooluganda lwo. Okubuulira ku b'emikwano n'enganda kyandiba ekizibu olw'okutya okukulamula naye kikulu kubanga bw'okola ekyo tojja kubeera wekka mu mbeera eno.

input: Kituufu okulumizibwa mu kwegatta kabonero ka Buwuka obukwata Omuyitiro gw'omusulo oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Obuwuka obukwata Omuyitiro gw'Omusulo tebutera kuleetawo bulumi mu kwegatta. Obulumi mu kwegatta butera kuba kabonero ka bumu ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba embeera endala ng'obusannyalaze bw'omubiri, obuvune, okutawankana mu birowoozo n'ebirala. Okukwatibwa akawuka ka Kiramidiya oba Enziku kuyinza okuleetawo okukuluusanyizibwa ekivaako obulumi. Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba obuvaako  amabwa mu bitundu by’ekyama nabwo buyinza okuvaako obulumi olw’okukuluusanyizibwa kw’ebiwundu mu kwegatta. Bw’oba oteebereza nti oyinza okuba n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba, oba bw’oba olumizibwa mu kwegatta, weebuuze ku musawo.

input: Okukula kutera kubaawo ku myaka emeka mu balenzi n'abawala?
output: Okugimuka bye biseera omubiri gwo we gukulira amangu mu bbanga ettono. Kino kiva ku busannyalaze bw'omubiri obw’okukula omubiri gwo bwe gukola. Obusannyalaze bw’okukula bugamba amagumba go, ebinywa n’ebitundu byo okukula. Mu kiseera ky’okukula, oyinza okukiraba nti ogenda owanvuwa mu bwangu. Okukula kutera okubaawo ku myaka 10-14 ku bawala ate 12-16 ku balenzi, naye kyawukana ku buli muntu.

input: Nnaakwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa ndiira ku ssowaani n’omuntu akalina?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasobola kusaasaanyizibwa kuyita mu kugabana bikozesebwa mu kulya mmere n'omuntu akalina. Okugabana ebikozesebwa mu kulya oba okulya emmere n'omuntu tekireetawo katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kafunibwa okuyita mu nkwatagana n'ebintu ebirimu omusaayi ogulimu akawuka oba amazzi g'ebitundu ebizaala.

input: Ki kye nnina okukola singa nfuna okulumizibwa mu lubuto okutawona nga ndi mu nsonga zange ez'ekikyala?
output: Okwegatta ng’oli mu nsonga kibeera kya kusalawo kya muntu ssekinnoomu era kusobola obutaba kya bulabe kasita abaagalana bombi babeera bakiwuliriramu emirembe era nga beegendereza mu ngeri esaanidde. Wabula kyetaagisa okutangaaza nti okwegatta ng’oli mu nsonga si bujjanjabi bwa kisawo buwonya bulumi bwa lubuto oba embeera endala yonna ey’obulamu. Endowooza nti okwegatta ng’oli mu nsonga kusobola okuwonya obulumi bw’olubuto kugereesa era tekiwagirwa bujulizi bwa ssaayansi. Obulumi bw’olubuto buyinza okuba n’ensonga ez’enjawulo, gamba ng’ensonga z’omu lubuto n'ebyenda, okugulumba kw'olubuto okuva kugenda mu nsonga, ekyenda okulemererwa okumulungula emmere, oba embeera endala ez’obujjanjabi eziteeyoleka. Wadde ng’okwegatta kuyinza okuba n’emigaso egimu mu mubiri ne mu bwongo, tekusikira bujjanjabi bwa kisawo oba okukola ku kivaako okulumwa olubuto. Bw’oba ggwe oba omuntu gw’omanyi ng’alumizibwa olubuto olutalekera awo oba olw’amaanyi, kirungi okunoonya amagezi g’omusawo okuva ew’omukugu mu by’obulamu. Basobola okwekenneenya obubonero, okuzuula ensonga enkulu, n'okuteesa ku bujjanjabi oba okuyingira mu nsonga ezisaanidde okukendeeza ku butabeera bulungi n'okutumbula obulamu n'embeera ennungii okutwalira awamu.

input: Nnyinza ntya okukendeeza ku katyabaga kange ak’okufuna Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi?
output: Kisipi asobola kuzuulibwa mu ddwaaliro mwokka. Tosobola kumukeberera waka oba ng’okozesa enkola yonna ey’okukuba ebifaananyi (enkola z'okutangaaza). Omusawo wo ayinza okuzuula Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by’ekyama ng’atunuulira erimu ku mabwa g'olina. Abasawo era basobola n’okuggya sampolo okuva ku bbwa (amabwa) ne bagikebera. Singa amabwa tegabaawo, okukebera omusaayi kuyinza okukozesebwa okunoonya obutoffaali bw'omubiri obulwanyisa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi. Yogerako mu bwesimbu era mu lwatu n’omusawo wo ku kukebera Kisipi n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Weetegereze: Okukebera Kisipi okuyita mu musaayi kuyinza okuyamba okuzuula oba olina Kisipi. input: Njawulo ki eri wakati w'obuwoowo n'ekirungo ekikendeeza okutuuyana mu nkwawa era nnina kukozesa ki mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Eddagala lyombi eryesiigibwa mu nkwawa obutawunya n’okuziyiza entuuyo osobola okulikozesa ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka okumalawo entuuyo n’okuwunya. Eno ye ngeri gy’oyinza okulondamu: Akeesiigibwa mu nkwawa: Akeesigibwa mu nkwawa kabikka akasu n’akawoowo ne katta obuwuka obuleeta okuwunya. Tezikendeeza ku ntuuyo. Londa akeesiibibwa mu nkwawa akalina akawoowo k'oyagala. Akeesiigibwa akaziyiza okutuuyana: Eddagala eriziyiza entuuyo lirimu ebirungo ebikolebwa mu aluminiyamu ebiziyiza endwadde z’entuuyo, ekikendeeza entuuyo. Era zirimu ebirungo by'akeesiigibwa mu nkwawa obutawunya. Londa eddagala eriweweeza ku ntuuyo bw’oba otuuyana nnyo. Okugatta: Ebintu byombi ebitangira okuwunya n’okuziyiza entuuyo, biyamba okufuga okuwunya n’okukendeeza entuuyo. Noonyereza era okozese ebyesiigibwa ebirwanyisa okuwunya ebisangibwa mu kitundu kyo ng’okusiiga omubisi gw'enniimu oba evvu okuva mu miti ng’ebula eddakiika 10-15 okunaaba. Obuwunya bw'olususu: Bw'oba olina olususu oluzibu, londa eddagala eritangira okuwunya oba eriziyiza entuuyo eriwandiikiddwako "abafuukuuka ennyo" oba "lya lususu olw'entondo." Siiga Bulungi: Siiga eddagala eritangira okuwunya oba eriziyiza entuuyo ku lususu oluyonjo era olukalu. Lindako eddakiika ntono nga tonnayambala okulusobozesa okukala.

input: Omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okuyonsa n'atasaasaanya Kawuka?
output: Okuyonsa ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nsonga nzibu esinziira ku bintu ebiwerako, omuli obujjanjabi bwo obw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obungi bw’akawuka akali mu musaayi, n’okubeerawo kw’engeri endala ezitali za bulabe eri abaana abawere. Mu nkomerero, okusalawo okuyonsa ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kulina okukolebwa nga weebuuza ku bajjanjabi abasobola okufuna okulambikibwa okutuukana n’embeera yo ssekinnoomu n’ebikozesebwa ebiriwo mu kitundu kyo. Ekigendererwa kwe kukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okusiigibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu eri omwana omuwere nga bwe bakakasa nti bakakasa obulamu bw’omwana omuwere okutwalira awamu n’embeera ye ennungi nga bayita mu kukakasa nti endiisa y'omwana terina bulabe era ntuufu.

input: Omukyala yagamba nti okusalawo okukozesa ebyokuzannyisa eby’okwegatta okusinga okwegatta n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kikendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka; kituufu?
output: Okukozesa eby’okuzannyisa eby’okwegatta ng’engeri y’okumatiza obwagazi n’okwewala okwegatta n’abantu abalwadde kuyinza okuba eky’obukuumi era eky’obuvunaanyizibwa, kasita kiba nga kikolebwa nga bakkiriziganyizza, mu buyonjo, era mu ngeri essa ekitiibwa mu nsalo z’omuntu ye kennyini n’ensalo z’abalala. Kikulu okumanya nti okukozesa eby’okuzannyisa eby’okwegatta kusalawo kwa muntu era ekituufu eri omuntu omu kiyinza obutaba kituufu eri omulala.

input: Kiki kye nsobola okukola okukuuma ebitundu byange eby'omubiri ebizaala nga biramu bulungi?
output: Okwekebeza okwa buli kiseera: Genda ew'omusawo buli kiseera okwekebejjebwa n’okukeberebwa obulamu bw’ebitundu byo ebizaala. Muno mulimu okukeberebwa Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana (okuggya obutaffaali ku mumwa gwa nnabaana ne bukeberebwa), okukebera amabeere, okukebera Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’okukebera obulamu bw’ebitundu ebizaala byonna okutwaliza awamu. Okwewala okwegatta kirungi nnyo okuva bwe kiri nti kutangira embuto ezitali nneeteekereteekere wamu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ebitundu 100%. Kozesa enkola z'okwetangira: Bulijjo kozesa obupiira mu butuufu oba engeri endala ez’okuziyiza okuzaala okutangira embuto z’otayagala n’okukendeeza ku katayabaga k'okwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Weenyigire mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga: Empuliziganya ey'olwatu n’abo be weegatta nabo ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n’okuziyiza okuzaala. Weekebeze Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba buli kiseera naddala ng’olina ababeezi abawera. Entambuza y'obulamu ennungi: Lya emmere ennamu, kola dduyiro buli kiseera, weekuumire ku bunene obw'ekigero, era weewale okunywa sigala n’okunywa omwenge omungi. Enneeyisa zino zitumbula obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu, omuli n’obulamu bw’okuzaala. Manya omubiri gwo: Weetegereze nnyo ennaku z'ogenderako mu nsonga zo ez'ekikyala, enkyukakyuka mu mubiri gwo, n’obubonero bwonna obutali bwa bulijjo. Kino kiyamba mu kuzuula obuzibu obuyinza okubaawo nga bukyali. Wesomese: Yiga ebikwata ku bulamu bw’okuzaala, enkola z’okuziyiza okuzaala, n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Okumanya kukuwa amaanyi okusalawo mu ngeri ey’amagezi ku bulamu bwo. Okulabirira obulamu bwo obw’okuzaala kuzingiramu omugatte gw'enkola z’okwetangira, okwekebejjebwa buli kiseera, n’okufaayo ku bubonero bw’omubiri gwo. Bw’oba olina ekibuuzo oba ekikweraliikiriza, tolwawo kwogera na musawo. Emitendera gino gisobola okukuyamba okukuuma enkola y’okuzaala ennungi n’obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu.

input: Emirundi emeka mu lunaku omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mw'alina okumirira eddagala lya HIV RX?
output: Buli ddagala lirina ebiragiro (amateeka) ku ngeri y’okulimira. Soma ebiragiro era obigoberere bulungi. Okugeza: “Mira emirundi ebiri olunaku” kitegeeza nti omira ddoozi esooka kumakya ne ddoozi eyookubiri oluvannyuma lw’essaawa nga 12.
