input: Waliyo engeri y’okufunamu empeke z'AKawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga tosasudde?
output: Okubeerawo kw’eddagala lya Siriimu ery’obwereere, eritera okuyitibwa eddagala eriziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu (ART), kuyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku nsonga eziwerako, omuli ensi oba ekitundu mw’obeera n’enkola y’ebyobulamu eriwo. Kikulu okumanya nti okufuna eddagala lya Siriimu ery’obwereere n’emisingi egy’enjawulo egy’okubeera n’ebisaanyizo bisobola okwawukana nnyo okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala. N’olwekyo, abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okwebuuza ku nteekateeka n’obuweereza obuyambi obuliwo mu kitundu kyabwe. Abakola ku by‟obulamu, eddwaaliro lya Siriimu, oba ebibiina by‟Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kitundu bitera okuwa amawulire n‟obuyambi mu kufuna eddagala lya Siriimu ery‟obwereere oba eriweebwa ensimbi. Okufuna amawulire amatuufu era ag’omulembe ku kubeerawo kw’eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu ery’obwereere mu kitundu kyo, nkuwa amagezi okutuukirira abakulira ebyobulamu mu kitundu oba ebibiina ebikola ku mpeereza z'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebisobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuyambi obutuufu okusinziira ku mbeera zo ng'omuntu.

input: Nsonga ki ezirina okulowoozebwako ng'oli mu mukwano n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okusalawo oba okukuuma oba okugenda mu maaso n’enkolagana n’omwagalwa alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate nga ggwe tokalina si kya kusalawo kikyo ng'omuntu era kyesigamizibwa ku nsonga ezy’enjawulo, omuli eddaala ly’okutegeera kwo, empuliziganya, n’okwewaayo kwo eri omukwano n’obulamu bwo. Kikulu okumanya nti enkolagana n'abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esobola okuba ennungi, ey'okwagala, era ematiza.

input: Okubeera n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kutegeeza nti sisobola kuzaala baana oluvannyuma?
output: Obuwuka obumu obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busobola okukosa obusobozi bw'okuzaala, naye singa bujjanjabwa nga bukyali, obusinga obungi tebuleetawo bizibu bimalawo bbanga ddene, nga ye nsonga lwaki okwekebeza n'okujjanjabibwa amangu kikulu.

input: Lwaki nnina okufaayo ennyo ku kusenya amannyo nga nvubuka?
output: Yee, kikulu okukuuma akamwa nga kayonjo kiseera ky'okuvubuka, kubanga enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri eyinza okukosa ebibuno n’amannyo. Kikolebwa bwe kiti: Senya emirundi ebiri buli lunaku: Senya amannyo n’eddagala eririmu ekirungo kya fluoride waakiri emirundi ebiri olunaku (kumakya n’akawungeezi) naddala ng’omaze okulya. Enkola entuufu: Kozesa akasenya akagonvu era osenye n'obwegendereza nga weetoolooza. Longoosa amannyo n'akawuzi buli lunaku: Okukozesa akawuzi mu kulongoosa amannyo kiyamba okugaggyamu obupapajjo bw'emmere n'obuwuka wakati w'amannyo akasenya bye katasobola kutuuka. Kendeeza ku biwoomerera: Emmere n’ebyokunywa biwoomerera bisobola okukola eky'amaanyi mu kuviirako okwonooneka kw'amannyo. Bikendeeze era oyumunguzenga mu kamwa n'amazzi buli luvannyuma lw'okulya obumpwankimpwanki obuwoomerera. Okukebera amannyo buli kiseera: Laba omusawo w’amannyo yeekebejjenga amannyo go n'okugayonja, buli luvannyuma lwa myezi mukaaga. Kozesa eddagala eritta omuwuka mu kamwa: Eddagala ly'okuyumunguza mu kamwa eritaliimu kirungo kya mwenge lisobola okuyamba okuttaka bbakitiiriya n'okuvaamu akawoowo akalungi naye teririna kusikizibwa kusenya na kukozesa akawuzi okulongoosa amannyo. Weewale okunywa taaba: Okunywa oba okukozesa ebintu ebikolebwa mu taaba kiyinza kukosa akamwa ko ne kikuviirako okuvaamu omukka omubi kko n'okulwaza ebibuno. Lya emmere erimu ebiriisa ebimala kikuyambe okubeera n'akamwa akalamu obulungi. Jjukira nti ebbula ly'ebiriisa ebimu kiyinza okuvaako endwadde z’omu kamwa.

input: Lwaki kikulu abatiini okwambala obuwale obwomunda ebibatuuka obulungi era obukkiriza emibiri gyabwe okussa obulungi mu kiseera ky’okuvubuka?
output: Obuleega (obw’abawala) n'obuwale bw'omunda (bw’abalenzi) buwa obuwagizi buyamba n'okutenkeza omubiri mu kiseera ng'omubiri guyita ng’oli mu myaka egy’obuvubuka. Ku bawala amabeere gakula, era okwambala akaleega kusobola okugawa obuwanirizi n’okuziyiza obutali butebenkevu. Obuleega era buyamba okukuuma ekinyusi ky'amabeere ng’okola emirimu egy'amaanyi. Ku balenzi, obuwale bw'omunda bubawa obuwanirizi mu bitundu by’ekyama gye beeyongera okukula n'okutandika okukola emirimu egy'amaanyi. Era ziyamba okuziyiza okubabuka n’okuwa ebitundu by'ekyama obukuumi. Londa obuleega n'obuwale bw'omunda ebikoleddwa mu ppamba. Okulonda obuleega n'obuwale bw'omunda obukutuuka obulungi obulungi n’okukuwa emirembe kikulu. Olina okugezaako emisono n'obunene obw’enjawulo ozuule ekisinga okukukolera.

input: Okutaataaganya mu bujjanjabi kukubirizibwa ng’enkola eya bulijjo ey’okulabirira abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ennaku zino?
output: Okuwummuzaamu okumira eddagala era ekimanyiddwa nga okutaataaganyizibwa kw'obujjanjabi kuzingiramu okuwummulamu mu nkozesa y'enkola eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu okw'akaseera. Wadde ng'enkola eno yagezesebwako emabegako, tekyakubirizibwa kweyambisibwa bantu bawangaala na Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Enkola entongole eriwo ey'obujjanjabi bw'abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kubeera ku bujjanjabi obuweweeza ku kawuka kano olubeerera.

input: Lwaki abantu bagamba nti tosobola kumanya oba ng'omuntu alina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ng'omutunuulidde butunuulizi?
output: Obuwuka bungi obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busbola obutalaga bubonero, ekitegeeza nti omuntu asobola okubeera nabwo n'atalaga kabonero konna.

input: Makubo ki omuntu g'asobola okuyitamu okuddamu okufuuka embeerera oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta?
output: Ekigambo okuddamu okufuuka embeerera si kya kisawo oba si kya ssaayansi wabula kya kinywi oba kya buntu. Kitegeeza okusalawo kw'omuntu okwewala okwegatta nga yali yeegasseeko. Abantu bayinza okusalawo okuva ku kwegatta olw'ensonga ez'enjawulo omuli eddiini, okwegomba kw’omubiri.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kakendeeza ku myaka omuntu gy’asobola okuwangaala?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa obulamu bw’omuntu singa takajjanjabwa oba singa kakwatibwa bubi. Wabula, singa kazuulibwa mu bwangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi omuli n'enkola ey'okukaweweezaako, abantu bangi abakalina basobola okuwangaala era ne babeera mu bulamu obweyagaza. Mu bufunze, wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kizibu kya maanyi eyinza okukosa obulamu singa tekajjanjabwa, si ndwadde etiisa kutuusa kutwala bulamu nga bwe gwali ekyali edda, okusiima okw'enjawulo kugende eri eby'obujjanjabi ebikuze. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obweyagaza singa kazuulibwa mangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi. Kikulu okunoonya obujjanjabi, okubunywererako, n'okusoosowaza obulamu obulungi okutwaliza awamu okusobola ekisinga obulungi. Okulondoolwa kw'obulamu entakera n'okwogera n'abasawo mu bwesimbu bikulu nnyo mu kujjanjaba obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ddi enkyukakyuka mu mbeera ezikwatagana n’ekiseera ekikulebera okugenda mu nsonga lwe zibaawo?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo okufuna enkyukakyuka mu mbeera zo oba okukyuka mu birowoozo mu kiseera ky'okubeera mu nsonga z'ekikyala. Kino kitera okuyitibwa "PMS" oba Obubonero Obukulembera ensonga z'Ekikyala. Enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri mu kiseera ky'okubeera mu nsonga z'ekikyala zisobola okukosa embeera zo, ne kikuleetera okuwulira obusunguwavu, ennaku, oba okukulungutana. Enkyukakyuka zino zitera kubaawo mu nnaku ezisembayo ng'onaatera okugenda mu nsonga zo ez'ekikyala era zisobola okutereera ng'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala zitandise. Kijjukire nti enkyukakyuka zino mu mbeera zo za bulijjo, naye bwe ziba nga zikusukkiriddeko era nga zikosa obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo, kiba kirungi okwogerako n'omusawo.

input: Mu kiseera kino tulina eddagala erikakasiddwa okuwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Eddagala eriwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu terinnazuulibwa. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kabadde kakyali kawuka ka Vvayiraasi akazibu, akayingira mu ndagamuntu y'obutoffaali obukwatiddwa, ekikifuula ekizibu ennyo okukamala mu mubiri.

input: Tulubawaza akawuka akaleeta Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B.
output: Akawuka akaleeta Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B kalimu ebika bisatu nga bino mulimu acute, ak'olukonvuba ne fulminant Hepatitis. Akawuka ka acute keeko akalwaza okumala akabanga akatono emyezi nga mukaaga ng'omaze okukafuna. Abantu abamu tebalaga kabonero konna oba balwalamu katono. Abalala bayinza okulwala ennyo ne beetaaga okugenda mu ddwaliro. Akawuka ak'olukonvuba: Akawuka aka acute kasobola okufuukamu obulwadde obw’olukonvuba. Singa kaba tekajjanjabiddwa, kasobola okuviirako obuzibu obw’amaanyi ku bulamu, omuli okukosebwa ekibumba, okuleeta enkovu ku kibumba, kookolo w’ekibumba, sinakindi okufa. Akawuka ka Fulminant tekatera kusangika wabula ka bulabe nnyo akakosa ekibumba amangu ddala n'okukitoniya mu nnaku oba mu ssabbiiti  mbale.  Abantu abawangaala n'Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B tebalaga bubonero bwa bulwadde bwa lukonvuba wabula basobola okusiiga abalala akawuka.

input: Okugeza, singa nzijanjabibwa Enziku ne siwona, bujjanjabi ki bwe nteekeddwa okukozesa okusobola okuwona?
output: Obubonero bulina okubula mu ssabbiiti bbiri ng'oli ku bujjanjabi. Singa obubonero bw’omuntu bugaana okubula, singa okuddamu okukeberebwa kukizuula nti akyalina Enziku oluvannyuma lw'okujjanjabibwa, yeetaaga addeyo alabe omusawo. Omusawo ajja kugezaako okwekenneenya oba omuntu azzeemu n'akwatibwa akawuka akaleeta obulwadde oluvannyuma lw'okujjanjabibwa oba obujjanjabi tebwakola. Omusawo ayinza okuddamu obujjanjabi. Singa aba azzeemu okukwatibwa akawuka, omusawo ayinza okuddamu okumujjanjaba. Singa eddagala liba teryakola, omusawo ayinza  okusalawo okumujjanjabisa eddagala eddala eritta obuwuka bwa bbakitiitiya.

input: Omuntu nga nze nsobola kukola ki okuwangaala n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga ndi mugumu?
output: Okuwangaala n'okuweeweeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kisobokera ddala n'obujjanjabi obutuufu, obujjanjabi n'engeri gy'osalawo okweyisa. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala nako mu bulamu obweyagaza nga balina obujjanjabi obutuufu n'okunywererako. Kikulu okukolagana obulungi n’abakugu mu byobulamu abakuguse mu kulabirira abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okugoberera enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi eziragiddwa, n’okusoosowaza obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu.

input: Nteekateeka ki esinga obulungi ey'okunaaba mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Emirundi gy’okweyonja oba okunaaba ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka gisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku byayagalibwa abantu ssekinnoomu n’ebintu bye bakola. Bino bye biragiro eby’awamu: Buli lunaku: Abantu bangi bakisanga nga kya muganyulo okweyonja oba okunaaba waakiri emirundi ebiri buli lunaku (okuli ku makya n’akawungeezi), naddala ng’okola emirimu egituuyanya omubiri, ng’otuuyana nnyo oba ng’obeera mu mbeera ey’ebbugumu. Faayo ku nfunyiro z'olususu n’ebitundu entuuyo ne obuwuka we bikuŋŋaanira, gamba ng'enkwawa, mu bisambi n’ebigere, ng’onaaba. Oluvannyuma lw’okukola dduyiro: Bw’oba weetaba mu mizannyo oba okukola emirimu egituuyanya omubiri, kirungi okunaaba oluvannyuma lw’okukola dduyiro okweggyako entuuyo n'obuwuka. Nga tonnagenda kwebaka: Okunaaba nga tonnagenda kwebaka kusobola okukuyamba okweggyako obucaafu, butto n’entuuyo ezikuŋŋaanyiziddwa emisana. Okunaaba enviiri: Okusinziira ku kika ky’enviiri zo (eza butto, enkalu n’ebirala), oyinza okusalawo okunaaba enviiri zo buli lunaku oba buli luvannyuma lwa nnaku entono.

input: Lwaki okwatula ky'owulira kikulu ng’oyita mu mbeera y'okukyukakyuka kw'obusannyalaze bw'omubiri?
output: Buno bwe bukodyo bw’okuddukanya ebiva mu nkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri: Entambuza y'obulamu ennungi: Okulya emmere ennungi, okusigala ng’omubiri okukozesa emirimu egy'amaanyi, n’okwebaka ekimala bisobola okuyamba okutereeza obungi bw'obusannyalaze bw'omubiri n’okutumbula obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu. Okulabirira olususu: Bw’oba olwanyisa embalabe oba olususu olumeremeenya, enkola ey’okulabirira olususu mu ngeri ennyangu esobola okukuyamba. Kozesa eddagala erirongoosa olususu erikkakkamu ku lususu ebikubirizibwa abakugu mu by'ensusu. Obuteeraliikirira: Enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri zisobola okuvaako okweraliikirira, noolwekyo okunoonya engeri ennungi ez’okuddukanyaamu embeera y'okweraliikirira kikulu. Kino kiyinza okuzingiramu okukola dduyiro w’okussa ennyo, yoga, okwogera n’omuntu omukulu oba mukwano gwo gwe weesiga, oba okwenyigira mu bintu by’oyagala ennyo. Dduyiro wa buli kiseera: Dduyiro asobola okuyamba okulongoosa embeera y’omuntu, okukendeeza ku okweraliikirira, n’okutumbula obulamu okutwalira awamu. Funa ebintu by’onyumirwa ng'obikola, ka bibeere bya mizannyo, mazina, kutambula oba yoga. Yogera: Tolwawo kwogera bw'owulira n’ebirowoozo byo. Ka kibeere ng'oyita mu kuwandiika, kusiiga bifaananyi, okuyimba oba okwogera n’omuntu gwe weesiga, okwogera ku birowoozo kiyinza okukujjanjaba ennyo. Noonya obuwagizi: Bw’oba olwanagana n’ebiva mu nkyukakyuka z'obusannyalaze bw'omubiri, tolwawo kunoonya buyambi okuva eri omuntu omukulu gwe weesiga, omubuziibuzi w’essomero oba omusawo. Basobola okukuwa okulambikibwa, obuyambi, n'ebikozesebwa okukuyamba okuyita ku mutendera guno.

input: Nsobola ntya okwogera ne munnange ku ky’okugezesa akakodyo akapya mu buliri mu mbeera etakireetera kuwulikika nga kya kiralu?
output: Beera wa mazima era omubuulire mu lwatu ng'omubuulira bw'owulira nga naawe bw'owuliriza ebirowoozo bye.

input: Ngeri ki ze nnyinza okufumamu eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu nga abooluganda lwange tebakizudde?
output: Bw’oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’oyagala okufuna eddagala ng’abooluganda lwo tebamanyi, waliwo emitendera egiwerako gy’osobola okuyitamu okukuuma eby’ekyama byo nga bw’ofuna n'obujjanjabi obwetaagisa: Obujjanjabi obw’ekyama, okukozesa yinsuwa ey’obwannannyini oba okwesasulira, okusaba embeera yo okukuumibwa nga ya kyama, okwetuukira ku bifo ewafunirwa eddagala, empeereza y’eddagala eriweerezebwa ku mmeyiro, enteekateeka z’okuyambibwko ku by'eddagala, ebibiina n'obuweeereza obw'oku mutimbagano ebiyamba ku bantu balina akawuka, n’obukuumi mu mateeka. Jjukira nti kyetaagisa okugenda mu maaso n’okumira eddagala lyo ery'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bwe likulagiddwa okusobola okuddukanya obulungi akawuka. Obujjanjabi obw'obutayosaamu n’okulabirirwa okw'eskisawo bikulu nnyo mu bulamu bwo n’embeera yo ennungi. Ng'okolaganira wamu n'abasawo abakulembeza okukusika ebikukwatakao n'okugoberera emitendera egimenyeddwa waggulu, osobola okufuna obujjanjabi n’eddagala eryetaagisa ate nga bw'okuuma ebikukwatako nga bya kyama.

input: Obulabe ki obuli mu kwegatta n’omuwala omuto oba omuntu omulala yenna awatali kufaayo ku myaka gye nga teweetangidde?
output: Okwegatta n’omuwala omuto oba omuntu omulala yenna, awatali kufaayo ku myaka, nga teweetangidde n’okwegendereza okutuufu kiyinza okwongera ku bulabe bw’okusiigibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa omu aba akalina. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu kwegatta n’omuntu akalina nga teweetangidde singa wabaawo enkwatagana ey'obutereevu n'amazzi g'omubiri, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g’ekikyala, agava awava obubi n'amabeere n’amabeere. Kikulu okutegeera nti emyaka si gye kisalawo akatyabaga k'okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; ensonga enkulu kwe kuba nti omu oba bombi abeegatta balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okumanya oba enkola ez’okwekuuma zikozeseddwa. Okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu weegatta: Kozesa obupiira, manya munno bw'ayimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okwekebeza entakera, lowooza ku PrEP, era funa amagezi g’abasawo. Kikulu okusoosowaza enkola z’okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga era ez'obuvunaanyizibwa mu kwegatta okwetangira ne bwe weegatta nabo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba.

input: Omuntu yandiba ng’abeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne katafuuka Siriimu?
output: Yee, kisoboka omuntu okuba na Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye ne katasuumuka kufuuka Siriimu okumallira ddala ekiseera ekiwanvu. Okusuumuka kw'Akawuka akaleeta SIriimu kwawukana okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala, era si tteeka nti buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akawuka ke kajja kusuumuka okufuuka Siriimu.

input: Buzibu ki obutuuka ku bulamu nga buva ku Kabootongo?
output: Kabootongo, singa aba tajjanjabiddwa, ayita mu mitendera okutuuka mu mutendera ogusembayo ekiyinza okuvaako okukosebwa kw'ebitundu by'omubiri bingi n'obuzibu obw'amaanyi obusobola n'okuvaako okufa. Wadde nga Kabootongo ow'omutendera ogusembayo ajja wayise emyaka mingi asobola okukosa kyenkana buli kitundu kya mubiri. Asobola okuleeta ebizibu ku mutima, ekibumba n'ensigo, era asobola okuzingiramu obwongo n'empulizo y'omubiri, eky'obulabe ennyo. Kabootongo ono asobola okuvaako okusannyalala, omusujja kw'obwongo, okuzibuwalirwa mu kutambula, obuzibu ku maaso n'amatu ebireeta obwamuzibe n'obwakiggala.

input: Kisoboka Kookolo okusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu kwegatta?
output: Kookolo nga ye si Bulwadde bwa Kikaba. Wabula waliwo Endwadde z'Ekikaba ezongera ku mikisa gy'omuntu okulwala Kookolo. Kookolo asinga okujja mu mbeera nga zino mwe muli ow'Omumwa gwa Nnabaana aleetebwa okukwatibwa kw'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Ensundo okw'olutatadde. Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Ensundo ke k'Endwadde y'Ekikaba esaasaanyizibwa mu kwegatta.

input: Kiki ekintuukako singa nkwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw'ozuulibwa nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ebintu ebikulu ebiwerako bibaawo, era kikulu nnyo okugoberera emitendera egy'enjawulo okuddukanya obulamu bwo n'entambuza y'obulamu bwo ennungi: Okukeberwa n'okulabirirwa kw'abasawo, okutandika obujjanjabi, okulondoolwa abasawo buli kiseera, okwetangira n'okwegatta nga weetangidde, okuziyiza okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde olw'omubiri okunafuyizibwa akawuka, okuyambibwa ku nkola y'obwongo, n'okusomesa, n'entambuza y'obulamu n'okwefaako. Kikulu okujjukira nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera ya lubeerera esobola okuddukanyizibwa ng’olina okulabirirwa okutuufu n’okunywerera ku bujjanjabi. Abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala emyaka emingi era ne babeera mu bulamu obumatiza, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, n’okuwuliziganya mu lwatu n’omusawo wo bye bikulu mu kuddukanya obulungi akawuka n’okukuuma obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu n’embeera yo ennungi.

input: Kituufu okupikiriza omuntu okwetaba mu kwegatta?
output: Kikulu okunywerera ku ky’okkiririzaamu nti kye kituufu, era singa wabaawo akupikiriza, ako kabeera kabonero akooleka obulabe; weesige endowooza yo, kubanga si kirungi kusindiikiriza muntu yenna kwenyigira mu bikolwa bya kwegatta.

input: Lwaki abantu bagamba nti okwewala okwegatta kwe kusinga obulungi mu kwewala okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Kubanga bw'oteegatta tosobola kukwatibwa Buwuka buleeta Bulwadde bwa Kikaba.

input: Ki ekisinziirwako okutunda eddagala ly'omu matundiro g'eddagala, omuli n'eriziyiza okufuna olubuto ery'amangu, eri abavubuka?
output: Okutundira eddagala mu matundiro gaalyo, omuli ery'okuziyiza embuto okw'amangu (EC) eri abavubuka kusinziira ku mateeka n’ebiragiro ebiteekeddwawo mu eggwanga eryo oba ekitundu. Kikulu okumanya nti eddagala eriziyiza okufuna olubuto bwe liba limiriddwa mu kiseera ekigere oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta nga teweetangidde oba okulemererwa kw'enkola eziyiza okufuna olubuto. Okubeerawo kw'eddagala eriziyiza embuto ery'amangu (EC) awatali biragiro bya kisawo byawukana okusinziira ku kifo n'amateeka agayinza okufugibwa ensonga ez'enjawulo, omuli enkola z’ebyobulamu, okulowooza ku by’obulamu bw’abantu bonna, n’ebiragiro by’obujjanjabi. Zino ze ensonga enkulu z’olina okulowoozaako: Okufuna obujjanjabi obukwata ku by'okuzaala, okufa ku budde, okusalawo okwesigamiziddwa ku bujulizi, okwekuuma n’okwetengerera, okusomesa n’okubudaabudibwa, n’okukugirwa olw'emyaka. Kikulu okujjukira nti okubeerawo kw'eddagala eritangira okufuna olubuto okw'amangu awatali biragiro bya kisawo tekitumbula kwegatta kuteeka bulamu mu katyabaga, kiwa abantu omukisa okuziyiza embuto ze bateetegekedde mu kaseera ak'akazigizigi.

input: Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba buwonyezebwa?
output: Yee, Endwadde ez’Ekikaba nnyingi, ng’oggyeeko Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, zirina eddagala eriziwonya oba zisobola okujjanjabibwa obulungi n’obujjanjabi obutuufu. Okubaawo n’obulungi bw’obujjanjabi buyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku Ndwadde z'Ekikaba ez'enjawulo. Kikulu okumanya nti okuzuula amangu n’okujjanjaba Endwadde z'Ekikaba kikulu nnyo mu kuzikkakkanya n'okuziwonya. Endwadde z'Ekikaba ezimu singa tezijjanjabwa, zisobola okuvaako ebizibu eby'amaanyi ku bulamu n'okwongera ku katyabaga k'okuzisiiga abalala. Okuziyiza nayo nsonga nkulu mu kukkakkanya Endwadde z'Ekikaba.

input: Waliyo eddagala erigema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Nedda, teri ddagala lyakakasibwa kugema kawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Oyinza kusonjola otya akawuka ka Neisseria akaleeta Enziku?
output: Enziku kawuka akaleeta obulwadde bw'ekikaba ak'ekika kya bbakitiiriya ekeeyoleka ennyo era nga kaziyizika n'okuwonyezeka nga kasinga kukwata mumwa gwa nnabaana mu bakyala wamu n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo mu basajja. input: Kiki ekiremesa abantu okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Abantu abamu balowooza nti tebali mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa kawuka ate abalala batya okumanya ebivudde mu kukeberebwa.

input: Mukwano gwange ennyo alwana okufuga eddoowo lye ery’okwegatta; magezi ki ge nnyinza okumuwa okuvvuunuka eddoowo lino?
output: Bw'oba okkiriza nti olwanagana n'ekizibu ky'eddoowo ly'okwegatta era ng'oyagala okukivvuunuka, kikulu nnyo okukkiriza nti okunoonya obuyambi n'obuwanirizi mutendera mukulu mu kuwona. Eddoowo ly'okwegatta era nga eddoowo ery'ebintu ebirala, lisobola okukosa obulamu bwo. Gino gye mitendera gy'olina okuyitamu okuwona eddoowo ly'okwegatta, okwekubamu ttooci n'okukkiriza nti olina ekizibu, weesomese, noonya obuyambi obw'ekikgu, noonya obuyambi okuva mu bantu abasobola okukuyamba, okubudaabudibwa, manya ebikuviirako okutuuka mu mbeera eyo, kulaakulanya obulamu

input: Kisoboka Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okumalibwawo ddala mu mubiri?
output: Tewali ddagala liwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko eddagala erikaweweezaako. Enkola y'okuweweeza ku kawuka bwe bujjanjabi obw’omutindo obusinga okukola ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Eyamba okukkakkanya vvayiraasi, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka mu mubiri, okuzzaamu abaserikale b’omu mubiri, n’okukendeeza ku kukula kw’obulwadde. Kyokka tekiwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde enkola zino ziwa essuubi, tewali n’emu ku zo ekakasiddwa nti ddagala erijjuvu era erituukiridde okuwonyeza ddala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku bye nnakasembayo okumanya. Enkola enkulu era esinga okusembebwa okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esigala nga ya kukaweweezaako, ekiyamba abantu abalina akawuka okuwangaalira mu balamu obweyagaza ate nga bwe bakendeeza ku bungi bw'akawuka mu musaayi okutuuka ku ssa ly'obutazuulibwa n'okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukasaasaanya. Okunoonyereza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kukyagenda mu maaso, noolwekyo kirungi okubeera ng’omanyi ebigenda mu maaso nga weebuuza ku nsonda ezeesigika ez'abakugu mu byobulamu.

input: Kikakasiddwa ddala nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu takalina ddagala?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekatwalibwa kuba nti nga kawona mu ngeri nti akawuka kano kasobola okumalibwawo mu mubiri. Wabula enkulaakulana ez’amaanyi ezikoleddwa mu by'enzijanjaba n'okuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu zikikyusizza ebizibu ebiyinza okuleetebwa Akawuka kano. Kikulu okubeera ng’omanyi ebigenda mu maaso mu kunoonyereza n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kubanga ekisaawe kino kyeyongera okukulaakulana.

input: Ng’oggyeeko okukozesa obupiira, waliwo engeri endala ez'okuziyizamu Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Yee, okwongereza ku kukozesa obupiira, waliwo engeri endala nnyingi ez'okuziyiza okusaasaana kw'obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba n'akaleeta siriimu: okwewala okwegatta, okubeera n'omubeezi omu, okukozesa enkola z'okwegatta ennungi, okwekebeza entakera, okukozesa eddagala lya PrEP ne PEP, okugemebwa, okwekebeza omubiri, okukendeeza ku bikolwa ebikuteeka mu katyabaga n'okusomesebwa era n'okumanyisibwa.

input: Lwaki kirungi okulabula omuntu ku ky’okubeera n’omukwano n’abantu abayinza okuba nga balina akawuka ka siriimu oba endwadde endala ez’ekikaba nga tomulumya nneewulira?
output: Okulabula omuntu ku katyabaga k'okwegatta n’abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba abalina Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba endala nsonga eyinza okwetaaga okukwata obulungi.  Ekiruubirirwa kya kuwa amawulire n’okutumbula enkola z’okwegatta ennungi awatali kukosa muntu yenna. Jjukira nti ekiruubirirwa kya kukuuma bungi bulamu sso si kufuga oba okusalira omuntu omusango olw'ebikolwa bye.

input: Waliwo ekika ky'emmere eky'enjawulo ekiyinza okukendeeza ku mikisa gy'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba?
output: Tewali mmere ntongole esobola kuwonya oba okujjanjaba obutereevu Endwadde z’Ekikaba oba okukubisa mu baserikale b’omubiri abasobola okumalamu obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde. Wabula, okwekuumira mu mmere ennamu n'okwekuumira ku ndya ennungi okutwaliza awamu kyetaagisa nnyo mu kuyamba okuwa obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwo amaanyi wamu n'okusitula omutindo gw'embeera y'obulamu bwo, ekiyinza okubeera eky'omugaso mu kujjanjaba Endwadde z'Ekikaba.

input: Okukolagana n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kuvaako okukwatibwa akawuka kano?
output: Nedda, okukwatagana obukwataganyi n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekusobola kuvaako kusiigibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa kuyita mu kukwatagana n’abantu mu ngeri eya bulijjo oba okukwatagana n'abantu abalala mu mbeerabantu oba mu kukola emirimu egya bulijjo. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusaasaanira mu mikutu egimanyiddwa nwe kasaasaanira. Enkolagana eya bulijjo n'abantu abalala ng'okwegwa mu bifuba, okukwatagana mu ngalo, okugabana emmere, okugabana ebikozesebwa mu kinaabiro oba mu ffumbiro, n'okubeera oba okukola n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebiteekawo katyabaga konna ka kusaasaanya Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasiigibwa kuyita mu malusu, entuuyo, amaziga, omusulo, oba okukwatagana n’olususu mu ngeri eya bulijjo. Kikulu okulwanyisa okuboolebwa n’okusosolwa ebiva ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okumanya engeri akawuka kano gye kasobola okusaasaanamu ne gye katasobola kusaasaanamu. Okutegeera amazima agakwata ku ngeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kasaasaanamu kusobola okuyambako mu kuzimba ebitundu ebiwagira n'okugyisa abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu byo.

input: Osobola okuwandiika emitendera emikulu egy’okuzaala kw’omuntu?
output: Okukola enkwaso: Enkwaso zikolebwa mu nsigo z'abasajja nga ziyita mu nkola eyitibwa okukula kw'enkwaso. Enkola eno etandikira mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka n’egenda mu maaso mu bulamu bw’omusajja bwonna. Okukula: oluvannyuma lw'okukolebwa, enkwaso zigenda mu kitundu ekiyitibwa oluseke olutereka enkwaso, gye zikulira ne zifuna obusobozi bw’okuwuga. Okutereka: Enkwaso ezikuze ziterekebwa mu kitundu ekiyitibwa oluseke olutereka enkwaso okutuusa omusajja lw'amala. Okumala: Mu kiseera ky’okuzuukusa kw'omubiri okw'okwegatta n’okutuuka ku ntikko, enkwaso zifuluma okuva mu luseke mwe ziterekebwa ne ziyita muluseke oluzisaabaza. Oluseke okusaabaza enkwaso lwegatta ku luseke olufulumya wabweru, nga luno lwe luseke olutwala omusulo n'enkwaso okuva mu mubiri. Okusammula: Enkwaso zifulumizibwa okuva mu mubiri wamu n’amazzi agava mu nsawo y'amazzi g'ekisajja n'ensulo z'amazzi g'ekisajja, byonna wamu ne bikola amazzi g'ekisajja. Ekikolwa kino kimanyiddwa nga okusammula. Enkwaso zisobola okuwakisa eggi ly’omukyala singa zilituukako mu kiseera ky'okwegatta. Enkola zino zeetaagisa nnyo mu kuzaala kw’omuntu n’okweyongerayo kw'obulamu.

input: Mitendera ki gy'olina okuyitamu bw'okizuula nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba ozuuliddwa nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu okukola emitendera egiwerako egy’amangu okukakasa nti oli bulungi n’okukkakkanya vvayiraasi. Zino ze zimu ku nkola z'olina okukola oluvannyuma lw’okukimanya nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: Noonya obujjanjabi, yiga ebikwata ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, Yogera ku bika by’obujjanjabi, gendanga ku ddwaliro, noonya okuyambibwa mu birowoozo, tegeezaako ababeezi, kozesa enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, ziyiza endwadde zinnakigwanyizi, kukola ku nsonga z’ebyobulamu endala ezijja olw'obulwadde, wettanire obulamu obulungi, weekwate ku mpeereza eziyinza okukuyamba, kuuma eby’ekyama byo, era oteekereteekere ebiseera eby'omu maaso. Jjukira nti abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe banywereera ku bujjanjabi obutuufu n’obulamu obulungi, basobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obwesiimisa. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera ya lukonvuba esobola okukkakkanyizibwa, era waliwo obuyambi n’ebikozesebwa bingi ebisobola okukuyamba mu lugendo lwo. Empuliziganya ey'obwerufu era ey'amazima n’omusawo wo kye kisumuluzo ky’okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Omanyi engeri PEP gy'ekola oba ya ki?
output: PEP kye kigambo ekitegeeza "Post-Exposure Prophylaxis." Eno y'enkola y'ekisawo etangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'omuntu okwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okukafuna. PEP etera kukozesebwa mu mbeera nga waliwo akatyabaga ak'amaanyi akamanyiddwa akayinza okuleeta omuntu okufuna Akawuka. Kikulu okumanya nti PEP tesobola kusikira nkola za kutangira Kawuka akaleeta Siriimusi ezimanyiddwa, okugeza, okukozesa obupiira ne PrEP eri abantu abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP ddagala eritangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'omuntu tanneetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okumufuna, sso nga ate PEP ekozesebwa oluvannyuma lw'akatyabaga ak'amaanyi. Bw'oba olowooza nti obadde mu katyabaga k'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, noonya omusawo amangu ddala mwogeremu ozuule oba PEP y'enkola esaana embeera gy'olimu.

input: Bubonero ki bwe nnina okunoonya obuyinza okutegeeza nti nnina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Faayo ku kuvaamu amazzi agatali ga bulijjo, okusiiyibwa, okubabuukirirwa ng'ofuuyisa, amabwa, era nga singa olaba akamu ku bubonero buno, genda weekebeze.

input: Maama wange yafa ekirwadde ekiteeberezebwa okuba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; nnina kukola ki?
output: Kya nnaku okuwulira nti maama wo yafa. Singa weekengera nti maama wo ayinza okuba nga yafa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba singa waba waliwo obweraliikirivu ku mbeera ye ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, gino gye mitendera gy'olina okulowoozaako; Bwe kiba kisoboka gezaako okufuna ebikwata ku mbeera ya maama wo ey'ebyobulamu oba ssatifikeeti y'okufa kwe, ebiyinza okukuwa amawulire ku mbeera y'obulamu bwe, omuli oba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ke kaaviirako okufa kwe. Yogerako n'abasawo abakugu, weekebeze, budaabudibwa era onoonye obuyambi, yogerako n'abenganda zo, okwetangira n'okukeberebwa entakera. Bw'oba olina ebibuuzo oba obweraliikirivu ku bulamu bwo oba obwa maama wo, abasawo abakugu bayinza okukuwabula okukuwa egeri z'okukebera ez'enjawulo n'amawulire agakwata ku kutangira Akawuka n'obujjanjabi.

input: Kiki ekirungamya okusalawo kw'ekika ky'eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ery'omuntu awangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kaweweezebwa ne ARVs ng'oluusi zigattibwa wamu n'eddagala eddala erijjanjaba oba eritangira endwadde zinnakigwanyizi. Eddagala ery'enjawulo erikozesebwa liyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera y’obulamu bw’omuntu, omuwendo gw’akawuka mu musaayi, omuwendo gw'obutoffaali bwa CD4, n’ensonga endala.

input: Mugaso ki oguli mu kukebeza omwana wange omuwere Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa mbeera nga nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okukebera omwana wo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu y’engeri yokka enkakafu ey’okumanya oba omwana wo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nedda. Okumanya kino kikulu mu ngeri nti kye kifuga ekirina okuddako okukolebwa. Omwana wo bw’aba alina akawuka, kikuyamba okutandika obujjanjabi nga bukyali ate bw’aba nga takalina, kikuyamba okugoberera enkola ez'okumukuuma ng'ali bw’atyo.

input: Singa omuntu akwatibwa akawuka akaleeta obulwadde bw’ekikaba, kyongera ku mikisa gy’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z’Ekikaba tebuviirako Siriimu oba Akawuka akamuleeta bwo kennyini. Wabula enkolagana ey'amaanyi wakati w'Obuwuka obumu obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba n'akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okubeera n'obuwuka obumu obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba kisobola okwongera ku mikisa gy'okufuna akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa omuntu aba yeetabye mu bikolwa ebiviirako okukwatibwa akawuka ako.

input: Akafuba akatasiigibwa era akatalaga bubonero kaawukana katya ku kafuba akasiigibwa era akalaga obubonero?
output: Okukolola okujjirako ekikolondolwa (eminyira) oba omusaayi okumala wiiki ezisukka mu 3, okulumwa mu kifuba, okukoowa ennyo, omusujja, okutuuyana ekiro, obutayagala kulya, n’okukogga.Obubonero bw'Akafuba akasusse amawuggwe akalaga obubonero butera okubeeramu okuzimba ensanjabavu oba obulumi mu kitundu ekikoseddwa.Akafuba akakusike (oba akatalaga bubonero) tekalina bubonero oba buzibu ku bulamu, naye Akafuba akakusike kasobola okusuumuka okufuuka akalaga obubonero, era oyinza okufuna obubonero singa kino kibaawo.

input: Nnaawulira obulumi bwonna nga nkeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Si bwe kiri yadde n'akatono; sampolo ekuŋŋaanyizibwa okuyita mu kukufumitako ku kasongezo k'olugalo lwo, era kino tekirina bulumi buli awo bwe kinaakuleetera.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kayinza kutabula katya endowooza y'omuntu?
output: Yee, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa obwongo bw'omuntu mu ngeri ez’enjawulo. Enkosa y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku bwongo eyinza okuba ey'amaanyi, era eyinza okweyoleka mu ngeri eziwerako: Okukabirirwa n'okweraliikirira, okwennyamira, okuboolebwa, n'okusosolebwa, embeera eva mu kukosebwa ennyo ku bwongo, enkyukakyuka mu bwongo, ebizibu ebiva mu kumira eddagala, okukozesa ebiragalalagala n'okwekutula ku bantu.

input: Omuntu asobola okufuna obuyambi singa yeegatta nga teyeetangidde n'omuntu gw'atamanyi obulamu bwe bwe buyimiridde oluvannyuma n'atandika okufuna obubonero bw'Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Singa omuntu yeenyigidde mu kwegatta okutaliimu kwetangira era nga tamanyi mbeera ya bulamu bwa mubeezi we, n’atandika okufuna obubonero bw’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, kikulu nnyo okubaako ekikolebwa mu bwangu okukola eky’amangu okunoonya obujjanjabi n’okutangira okusiiga abalala akawuka. Gino gye mitendera gy’osobola okukola: Weekebeze Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, weenyingire mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu bwo mu katyabaga, buulira omubeezi wo, goberera ebiragiro by’omusawo, era weenyigire mu kwetangira mu biseera ebijja. Jjukira nti Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busobola okuba n’ebizibu eby’amaanyi ku bulamu bwo singa tebujjanjabibwa nga bukyali, era busobola n’okusiigibwa abalala. Kikulu okugenda mu basawo n’okugoberera okulambikibwa kw’abakugu okulaba ng’ofuna obujjanjabi obutuufu n’okutangira okusaasaana kw’obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde.

input: Lwaki oluusi mpulira ensonyi oba obuswavu ku miramwa egyekuusa ku kuvubuka?
output: Okuwulira ensonyi oba okuswala ku nsonga ezikwata ku myaka gy’obuvubuka kya bulijjo olw’emizizo gy'embeerabantu, obutaba na mboozi za lwatu, n’engeri emiramwa gino gye giragibwamu mu mawulire. Zino ze nsonga lwaki oyinza okuwulira bw’otyo: Obutaba na bubaka: Bw’oba tofunye kusomesebwa kwa maanyi mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, oyinza okukwatibwa ensonyi olw’obutategeera. Okuboolwa mu mbeerabantu: Enkyukakyuka ezeekuusa ku myaka gy’obuvubuka zitera okuvaako okuboolebwa oba okulagibwa ng’ez'omuzizo mu buwangwa oba ebitundu ebimu. Okutya okusalirwa omusango: Wayinza okubaawo okutya mikwano gyo okusalirwa omusango oba okuwulira ng'oli wa njawulo ku balala. Obunafu: Obuvubuka buleeta enkyukakyuka mu mubiri ne mu birowoozo ezisobola okukuleetera okuwulira ng’oli mu katyabaga era ng’oyanjaddwa mu lwatu. Kikulu okujjukira nti okuvubuka kitundu kya butonde era kya bulijjo mu bulamu. Okunoonya amawulire amatuufu n’okwogera mu lwatu ku nsonga zino ne banno abakuwagira, abazadde, oba abantu abakulu be weesiga kusobola okukuyamba okukendeeza ku kuwulira ensonyi oba okuswala.

input: Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n'Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba?
output: Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kitegeeza “obulwadde obusiigibwa nga buyita mu kwegatta,” ate Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kitegeeza “obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde obuyita mu kwegatta.” Wabula engeri yonna abantu gye baba bakiyise, basigala boogera ku kintu kye kimu: obuwuka obuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala mu kiseera ky'okwegatta.

input: Kiki omuntu ky’ayinza okukola okukendeeza ku kwennyika n’okweraliikirira mu bulamu bwe?
output: Okwaŋŋanga okwennyamira n'okweraliikirira kiyinza okuba ekizibu naye wasobola okubaawo enkola ennungamu ez'okukuyambako okuyita mu mbeera zino. Singa oba ng'oyita mu kwennyamira okw'amaanyi oba okweraliikirira kya mugaso nnyo okunoonya obuyambi obw'ekikugu okuva eri omusawo w'obwongo omutendeke. Enkola endala ezimalawo embeera eno mulimu okufuna abantu abakubudaabuda, okwefaako, obutakkiririza mu ndowooza enkyamu, n'okweteerawo enkola z'okwemalako okweraliikirira.

input: Nsobola ntya okuyamba mukwano gwange ayita mu kaseera akazibu oluvannyuma lw'okwawukana n'omwagalwa we?
output: Babeererewo bubeerezi era obamanyise nti ofaayo.

input: Ani gwe wandisembye mbuulireko ku bwe nnyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Eky’okuddamu kya kino kisinziira ku ggwe ng'omuntu. Olina okulonda abantu be weesigira ddala n’abantu abatajja kukusalira musango olw'okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kitegeeza nti obuwangaazi bw’omuntu bukendedde?
output: Nedda, okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti tekyewalika kuba nti ojja kufa akawuka kano. Okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera ya lubeerera esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era singa wabaawo okufiibwako kw'ekisawo n’obujjanjabi obutuufu, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaalira ddala era nga bali mu balamu obweyagaza. Obuwangaazi bw'omuntu awangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bweyongedde nnyo emyaka bwe gigenze giyitawo olw’enkulaakulana mu bujjanjabi n’okulabirira eby'ekisawo. Kikulu okukitegeera nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakyali kibonerezo kya kufa, era abantu bangi abakalina babeera mu bulamu obumatiza. Naye, okuddukanya obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kyetaagisa obujjanjabi obutasalako, okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, n’okwewaayo okukuuma obulamu okutwalira awamu. Bw’oba ozuuliddwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nga weeraliikirira ku mbeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu nnyo okunoonya obujjanjabi n’obuyambi okuva mu bakugu mu by’obulamu abakugu mu nzijanjaba n'endabirira y'abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Bw’oba n’okulambikibwa wamu n’obuwagizi bw’abasawo obutuufu, osobola okuddukanya obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okubeera n’obulamu obuwanvu era obulungi. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era abantu bangi ssekinnoomu abakalina bagenda mu maaso n’okutuukiriza ebiruubirirwa byabwe eby’obulamu ne babeera n’obulamu obumatiza.

input: Amawulire agakwata ku miwendo gy’abakwatibwa akawuka ka siriimu gakwatibwa gatya mu ngeri y’okukuuma ebyama?
output: Nsonyiwa, naye sirina busobozi bwa kutuuka ku biwe eby'enjawulo ebiraga omuwendo gw'abayizi abaakwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu yunivaite yo oba mu ttendekero eddala lyonna. Ebiwe ebikwata ku ddaala ly'okukwatibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga bikungaanyizibwa era ne biterekebwa ebitongole by'ebyobulamu, amatabi ga gavumenti, n'ebitongole ebikola ku by'obulamu by'abantu bonna, naye obubaka ekika ekyo okusinga bukuumibwa nga bwa kyama era nga tebwasanguzibwa mu lwatu ku mutendera gwa muntu ssekinnoomu oba ogw'ettendekero.

input: Omubeezi wange ayinza atya okuba ng'asigala yeekyawa kyokka nga nze nneezzaamu essuubi?
output: Embeera ng’omu ku baagalana alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ate ng'omulala takalina ya bulijjo. Waliwo ensonga eziwerako eziyinza okunnyonnyola embeera eno; Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kalina ekiseera ky’okufumbirirwa nga mu kiseera kino akawuka kayinza obutazuulibwa mu kukeberebwa okutongole nga waakayitawo akaseera katono nga kaakakwata omuntu. Singa ombueezi atalina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu abeera nga tannaba kwekebeza kawuka kano gye buvuddeko oba nga teyeenyigidde mu bikolwa bimuteeka mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa kawuka, ayinza okuba ng'akawuka tekannamukwata. Abaagalana bano bayinza okuba nga babadde beenyigira mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu bwabwe mu katyabaga obutayosa, okugeza ng'okukozesa obupiira oba PrEP, nga kino kisobola okukendeeza ku mikisa gy'okusaasaanya akawuka Akaleeta Siriimu. Singa omubeezi alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu abeera ku nkola entuufu ey'okuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng'amaze okukakkakkanya ng'obulumi bwako bukendedde ng'era tekakyalabika mu musaayi, emikisa gy'okukasiiga munne atakalina gikendeerera ddala. Wabula teggweerawo ddala, noolwekyo enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulabe ku bulamu nkulu. Abantu abamu mu butonde balina obwerinzi bw'omubiri obw'amaanyi oba ensonga ez'obuzaale ezikendeeza ku mikisa gyabwe okukwatibwa Akawuka. Okusaasaana kw'Akawuka  akaleeta Siriimu kusinziira ku nsonga nnyingi omuli, ebikolwa eby'okwegatta obuwuka abaagalana bye beenyigiramu, okubaawo kw'obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala n'enkozesa y'ebiragalalagala oba omwenge ebiyinza okwongera ku ku kweyongera kw'akatyabaga k'okusaasaana.

input: Kimiimo ki ekikozesebwa singa omuntu afuna ebika by'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebisukka mu kimu?
output: Okukwatibwa ebika by'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebisukka ku kimu kiyitibwa "okulwalannakabirye". Embeera eno nzibu nnyo era nga tetera kulabikalabika ng'evaako ebizibu ebitali bimu. Eyongera ku bungi bwa vvayiraasi mu musaayi era eyinza n'okuvaako eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu erya ART obutakola ku muntu alina akawuka kano.

input: Abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola batya okugyisibwa mu mbeerabantu?
output: Okugyisa abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeerabantu kyetaagisa okusobola okukendeeza ku kuboolebwa, okutumbula embeera egasa abantu bonna, n’okuwagira obulamu bwabwe bwonna okutwalira awamu. Abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okuba n’emikisa n’eddembe ery'ekyenkanyi ng’omuntu omulala yenna. Zino ze zimu ku negri z'okwanguya mu kugyisa abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeerabantu: Okutumbula okusomesa n’okumanyisa abantu, amateeka agalwanyisa obusosoze, obuyambi mu kitundu, obujjanjabi obusobola okutuukirirwako buli muntu, obuweereza ku byobulamu bw’obwongo, okufuna obyenjigiriza, okwegatta n’okwetangira ebitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, obuwagizi okuva mu bakulembeze b’eddiini n’abantu b’omukitundu, enteekateeka z’okusoma n’okuwandiika ku by’obulamu, okusomesa abavubuka, emikisa gy’emirimu, kakuyege mu by'amawulire, okusomesa PrEP ne PEP, ensiisira z’okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, emikwano emiyambi n'abooluganda, okwetaba mu mirimu gy'obwa nnakyewa, okutumbula ku kufunika kw'obujjanjabi, okujaguza ennaku z’okumanyisa abantu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Tuyinza tutya okukendeeza ku mikisa gy’okukwatibwa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi?
output: Kisipi asobola kuzuulibwa mu ddwaaliro mwokka. Tosobola kumukeberera waka oba ng’okozesa enkola yonna ey’okukuba ebifaananyi (enkola z'okutangaaza). Omusawo wo ayinza okuzuula Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by’ekyama ng’atunuulira erimu ku mabwa g'olina. Abasawo era basobola n’okuggya sampolo okuva ku bbwa (amabwa) ne bagikebera. Singa amabwa tegabaawo, okukebera omusaayi kuyinza okukozesebwa okunoonya obutoffaali bw'omubiri obulwanyisa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi. Yogerako mu bwesimbu era mu lwatu n’omusawo wo ku kukebera Kisipi n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Weetegereze: Okukebera Kisipi okuyita mu musaayi kuyinza okuyamba okuzuula oba olina Kisipi. Tekisobola kukubuulira ani yakusiiga kawuka kaleeta Kisipi oba ddi lwe wakafuna

input: Taata bw’aba ng’alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate nga maama talina, abaana baabwe babeera mu mikisi emeka egy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Emikisa gy'okubaana abooluaganda abazaalibwa taata alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne maama atakalina okuba nga nabo banaakafuna gisinziira ku nsonga nnyingi omuli oba maama n'omwana baayita mu mitendera egitangira maama okusiiga omwana we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'ali lubuto, mu kumuzaala ne mu kumuyonsa. Enkola ezitangira okusaasaana kw'akawuka okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana zisobola okukendeereza ddala ku katyabaga ka maama okusiiga omwana we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Singa maama afuna obujjanjabi obutuufu era n’agoberera enkola ezitangira okusaasaana kw'akawuka okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana eziragiddwa, akatyabaga k’okusiiga omwana we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukendeezebwa ennyo.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kakyali kizibu kya ensi yonna, oba kifuuse kizibu kya wano, okusinziira ku kitongole ky'Ebyobulamu eky'ensi yonna (WHO)?
output: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna kikola omulimu munene mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu mu nsi yonna ng'ewa abantu okulambikibwa, okubagawo ebigobererwa ebiri ku mutindo, okutumbula kaweefube w'okumanyisa abantu mu nsi yonna ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okukeetangira. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu tekatwalibwa nga "bulwadde bwa ggwanga erimu" wabula wabula nnawookeera w'ensi yonna akosezza ebitundu n'abantu okwetoloola ensi yonna. Noolwekyo, kyetaagisa okuteekawo kaweefube omulungamu ku mutendera gw'ensi yonna wamu n'ogw'eggwanga. input: Ebbanga akawuka akaleeta Siriimu lye kamala mu mubiri nga tekannatuuka kuzuulwa byuma bikebera kitegeeza ki?

input: Bukodyo ki obusobola okunnyamba okwanganga ennyiike mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?

input: Bintu ki ebisalawo oba kiba kya bulamu eri abavubuka okwenyigira mu bikolwa eby’okwegatta?

Eddagala: Omusawo ayinza okukuwa eddagala eriyamba okukendeeza ku bungi bw'omusaayi oba okukkakkanya obulumi. Kizaalaggumba afugibwa obusannyalaze bw'omubiri: Empeke eziziyiza okuzaala, ebipande oba obuweta obufugibwa obusannyalaze bw'omubiri busobola okuyamba okutereeza ennaku zo ez'okugenda mu nsonga, okukendeeza ku kuvaamu omusaayi omungi n’okukendeeza ku kulumwa olubuto. Ebirungo ebizzaamu omusaayi: Bw’oba ovaamu omusaayi mungi ng'oli mu nsonga, oyinza okuba mu bulabe bw’okuggwaamu omusaayi olw’obutaba na kirungo ekizzaamu omusaayi. Omusawo asobola okukuwa amagezi ku by’okukozesa ekirungo ekizzaamu omusaayi kiba kyetaagisa. Jjukira nti kikulu okufaayo ku bulamu bwo ng'oli mu nsonga, era waliwo ebikozesebwa n’abakugu abasobola okukuyamba okwanganga ebikweraliikiriza oba ensonga zonna ezibaawo.

input: Singa omuntu akizuula nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu leero, abeera akyasuubira okuwangaala n'okulaba ku bazzukulu be?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa obulamu bw’omuntu singa takajjanjabwa oba singa kakwatibwa bubi. Wabula, singa kazuulibwa mu bwangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi omuli n'enkola ey'okukaweweezaako, abantu bangi abakalina basobola okuwangaala era ne babeera mu bulamu obweyagaza. Mu bufunze, wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kizibu kya maanyi eyinza okukosa obulamu singa tekajjanjabwa, si ndwadde etiisa kutuusa kutwala bulamu nga bwe gwali ekyali edda, okusiima okw'enjawulo kugende eri eby'obujjanjabi ebikuze. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obweyagaza singa kazuulibwa mangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi. Kikulu okunoonya obujjanjabi, okubunywererako, n'okusoosowaza obulamu obulungi okutwaliza awamu okusobola ekisinga obulungi. Okulondoolwa kw'obulamu entakera n'okwogera n'abasawo mu bwesimbu bikulu nnyo mu kujjanjaba obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Oluvannyuma lw'okwetaba mu bikolwa ebinteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kinaatwala ssaawa mmeka nga okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.
output: Okusinziira ku kitongole kya Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, obubonero bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obusookera ddala buyinza okweyoleka mu wiiki 2 ku 4 oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa Akawuka. Oluvannyuma lw'ennaku 10 ku 33, omuwendo gw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu musaayi guba gusobolera ddala okulaga nti omuntu akalina. Omuntu akubirizibwa okumira eddagala lya PEP mu ssaawa 24 naye nga tezisukka ssaawa 72.

input: Mbuulira ebisingawo ku Buwuka bwa Kiramidiya obulwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo.
output: Kiramidiya oba Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo Kawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba akamanyiddwa era nga kakosa abaami n'abakyala era nga kawuka ka bbakitiiriya akayitibwa Chlamydia trachomatis. Akawuka ka Kiramidiya kasobola okujjanjabwa era n'okuwonyezebwa. Wabula, obubonero bwako tebutera kweyoleka. Kikulu nnyo okufuna obujjanjabi bw'akawuka kano amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Bw’otafuna bujjanjabi, Kiramidiya asobola okuleeta obuzibu obw'amaanyi era n'okuteeka obuvune obw'ebitundu by'omuntu ebizaala olubeerera, gamba nga obutazaala.

input: Okufufuggaza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kitegeeza ki?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bulwadde bwa bulamu bwonna, naye singa omuntu afuna okulabirirwa n’obujjanjabi bw'ekisawo obutuufu, busobola okuddukanyizibwa obulungi. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okufugibwa okutuuka ku mutendera nga tekasobola kuzuulibwa mu musaayi, embeera etera okuyitibwa "okufufuggazibwa kw'akawuka." Akawuka kano bwe kafufuggazibwa, abaserikale b’omubiri basobola okusigala nga balamu bulungi, era akatyabaga k’okukasiiga balala ne kakendeerera ddala. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu katera okuddukanyizibwa n’enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omugatte gw'eddagala eriziyiza akawuka kano okwekubisaamu. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu baweebwa amagezi okumira eddagala lino obutayosa era nga bwe libalagirwa abasawo baabwe. Kikulu okumanya nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga ko bulwadde bwa bulamu bwonna, era mu kiseera kino tewali ddagala lisobola kumalirawo ddala mu mubiri. Naye singa kajjanjabibwa mu ngeri entuufu n’okunywerera ku bujjanjabi, abantu bangi ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okubeera n’obulamu obulungi era obugasa okumala emyaka mingi.

input: PEP eyamba etya omuntu abaddeko mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: PEP kye kigambo ekitegeeza "Post-Exposure Prophylaxis." Eno y'enkola y'ekisawo etangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'omuntu okwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okukafuna. PEP etera kukozesebwa mu mbeera nga waliwo akatyabaga ak'amaanyi akamanyiddwa akayinza okuleeta omuntu okufuna Akawuka. Kikulu okumanya nti PEP tesobola kusikira nkola za kutangira Kawuka akaleeta Siriimusi ezimanyiddwa, okugeza, okukozesa obupiira ne PrEP eri abantu abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP ddagala eritangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'omuntu tanneetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okumufuna, sso nga ate PEP ekozesebwa oluvannyuma lw'akatyabaga ak'amaanyi. Bw'oba olowooza nti obadde mu katyabaga k'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, noonya omusawo amangu ddala mwogeremu ozuule oba PEP y'enkola esaana embeera gy'olimu.

input: Omuntu asobola okulowooza nti okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kukwatagana n’okubeera omutono?
output: Nedda, okubeera omukovvu oba okuba n’ekika ky’omubiri ekimu tekirina kakwate butereevu na mbeera ya kuba nga Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukwata abantu ssekinnoomu ab’ebika by’omubiri byonna, obunene, n’embeera zonna. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka akasinga okukosa abaserikale b’omubiri, ne kanafuya obusobozi bwagwo okulwanyisa obuwuka obugulumba. Kasiigibwa okuyita makubo ag’enjawulo, gamba ng’okwegatta n’omuntu alina akawuka nga teweetangidde, okugabana empiso oba ebbomba z'empiso n’omuntu alina akawuka, oba okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana ng’azaala oba ng’ayonsa. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasosola okusinziira ku bunene bw’omubiri oba endabika. Omuntu yenna, awatali kufaayo ku buzito bw’omubiri gwe, asobola okubeera mu katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa yeenyigira mu nneeyisa oba ebikolwa ebisobola okusaasaanya akawuka kano. Kikulu eri buli muntu okutegeera engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kasaasaanamu n’okukola okwegendereza okutuufu okutangira okukwatibwa akawuka kano, gamba ng’okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, okukozesa empiso ennyonjo okwejjanjaba, n’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu buli kiseera singa baba mu katyabaga. Engeri yokka gy’oyinza okuzuula embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri emu ku zikozesebwa. Bw’oba olina ebikweraliikiriza ku mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba okwenyigira mu nneeyisa eziyinza okukuteeka mu katyabaga, lowooza ku ky’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okwebuuza ku musawo oba omubuziibuzi wo akuwe okulambikibwa ku ngeri y’okwetangira n’okuddukanya embeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okuddukanyizibwa n’obujjanjabi obutuufu, era okuzuula amangu n’okujjanjabibwa bikulu nnyo mu kukuuma obulamu obulungi.

input: Singa ntandise PEP, nkomya ddi okumukozesa?
output: Ekiseera ky'okumira eddagala eriziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'okwetaba mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga kitera kuba nnaku 28 (ssabbiiti 4). PEP kika kya bujjanjabi obuziyiza okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obuweebwa abantu ababa bamaze okwetaba mu mbeera eyinza okubateeka mu Katyabaga k'okukwatibwa nga bayita mu bikolwa nga okwegatta n'omuntu atamanyiddwa oba alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufuna ebisago eby'empiso, oba embeera endala ez'akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ddi lw’osaanidde okutegeeza maama wo nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okusalawo ddi n’engeri y’okutegeeza maama wo oba omuntu yenna ow’omu maka nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kusalawo kwa muntu ku bubwe nnyo era emirundi mingi kusoomooza. Tewali kya kuddamu kimu, kubanga kisinziira ku mbeera yo ssekinnoomu, enkolagana yo ne maama wo, n’obwetegefu bwo mu birowoozo. Bino bye bintu by’olina okulowoozaako ng’osalawo ddi lw’olina okubuulira maama wo: obutebenkevu bwo n’okwetegeka kwo, enkola y’okukuwagira, obudde, obwetegefu bwe mu birowoozo, ebikozeesebwa, okulambikibwa kw’ekikugu, okulowooza ku byetaago bye, emmizi n’ebyama, okulowooza ku mateeka n’empisa, n’okwenoonyeza obuyambi ku ggwe kennyini. Mu nkomerero, okusalawo okutegeeza maama wo embeera yo ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kya buntu nnyo, era olina okukikola ng’owulira ng’ekiseera kituufu era nti kikwatagana n’ebyetaago byo n’okwetegeka mu birowoozo. Kisobola okukuyamba okwegezaamu by’oyagala okwogera n’okusuubira ebibuuzo bye, naye kikulu okujjukira nti tosobola kufuga ngeri gy’anaakitwalamu, era kiyinza okumutwalira ekiseera obwongo bwe okumulungula amawulire ago. Beera mugumiikiriza era omusaasizi gy'ali n'eri ggwe kennyini nga mugezaako okuyita mu mboozi eno esoomooza mwembi.

input: Nneeyisa ntya singa ndaba omuntu ng’atulugunyizibwa mu by’okwegatta?
output: Yingira mu nsonga bw’oba osobola okukikola nga tekireese buzibu, oba funa obuyambi okuva eri omuntu omukulu oba omuntu ow’obuyinza eyeesigika, kubanga kikulu okuwagira oyo atulugunyizibwa.

input: Butaffaali ki obw'omubiri obusinga okuluubirirwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kakosa abaserikale b’omubiri, nga kagenderera okwonoona obutoffaali bw'omubiri obuyitibwa CD4 T. Bino bye bitundu by’omubiri n’enkola z'omubiri ezisinga okukosebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: obutoffaali bwa CD4 T, ensanjabavu, olubuto n'ebyenda, obwongo, olususu n'obububi obuseerera mu mubiri, omuyitiro gw'okussa, enkola y’omutima. Kikulu okumanya nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa enkola y'ebitundu by'omubiri gwonna, kubanga anafuya abaserikale b’omubiri n’okufuula abantu ssekinnoomu okuba nga bali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde olw'okunafuyizibwa akawuka n'ebika kya kookolo ebimu. Singa omuntu afuna okulabirirwa n’obujjanjabi obutuufu obuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okusuumuka kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okulwisibwawo oba n’okuyimirizibwa, ne kisobozesa abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okubeera n’obulamu obulungi. Okuzuula amangu akawuka n’okujjanjaba kikulu nnyo mu kulwanyisa akawuka kano n’engeri gye kakosa omubiri.

input: Okugejja mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka kirungi?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo nnyo okugejja ng’oli mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Omubiri gwo guyita mu nkyukakyuka nnyingi omuli okugimuka, okukula kw’ebinywa, n’okugejja mu bitundu by'omubiri ebimu. Kino kiyinza okukuleetera okugejja naddala okwetooloola akabina, ebisambi n’olubuto. Jjukira nti omubiri gwa buli muntu gwa njawulo, era okugejja ng’akyali mu myaka gy’obuvubuka kitundu kya bulamu era kya bulijjo mu kukula. Okulya emmere ennungi n’okusigala ng’okola emirimu egy'enjawulo bisobola okukuyamba okubeera omulamu obulungi.

input: Bubonero ki obulina okuwaliriza omuntu okugenda mu ddwaliro singa abeera akwatiddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola obutalagirawo bubonero mu ngeri nnyingi. Obubonero bwe bweyoleka bwawukana okusinziira ku bantu ab'enjawulo, era buyinza okufaanana obw'endwadde endala eza bulijjo. Kikulu okumanya nti obuteeyoleka bw'obubonero tebutegeeza nti Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekaliimu.

input: Ngeri ki esinga obulungi ey'okubuulira muganzi wange nti nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga simutiisizza?
output: Emboozi y'okwogera ku embeera ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu eri omubeezi wo esobola okuba nga ya kwegendereza era nga esoomooza, naye yeetaagisa nnyo ku lw'obulamu n’obulungi bwamwwe mwembi, ggwe n'omubeezi wo. Gano ge gamu ku magezi agaasobola okukuyamba okwasanguza embeera yo ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri ey’okulowooza era ekendeeza ku kyekango: Londa ekiseera ekituufu n’ekifo ekituufu, teekateeka by’oyagala okwogera, kozesa olulimi olutegeerekeka obulungi era olwangu, yogera engeri gye weewuliramu mu birowoozo byo, muwe obubaka obukwata ku mbeera eyo, laga okwewaayo kwo eri okussaawo obukuumi, beera mugumiikiriza era owulirize, omubeezi wo ddamu omugumye, okussa ekitiibwa mu kusalawo kwe, era omuwagire. Weetegekere ekivaamu kyonna; noonya okulambikibwa kw’abakugu. Jjukira nti buli mukwano gwa njawulo ku mirala, era tewali nkola emu ttwalirawamu ey’okwasanguzaamu embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekikulu kwe kuba ow'amazima, omusaasizi, era assa ekitiibwa mu nneewulira y'omubeezi wo n’ebyetaago bye. Okwasanguza embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri ey’okulowooza, obeera otuuse ku ddaala ery’amaanyi mu kuzimba obwesigwa n’okukuuma enkolagana ennungi, erimu obuwagizi.

input: Kiki kye nnina okukola singa nfuna obubonero obutali bwa bulijjo nga ndi mu nsonga z'ekikyala?
output: Bw’ofuna obubonero obutali bwa bulijjo ng'oli mu nsonga z'ekikyala, kikulu okufaayo ku mubiri gwo n’okubaako ky'okola ensonga eno bwe kiba kyetaagisizza. Bino by’osobola okukola: Londoola: Weetegereze obubonero bwonna obutali bwa bulijjo, gamba ng’okuvaamu omusaayi omungi ennyo, obulumi obw’amaanyi, okumala mu nsonga ebbanga eddene oba okuvaamu amazzi agatali ga bulijjo. Weebuuze ku musawo: Bw’oba weeraliikirira ku bubonero bwo, yogerako n’omusawo. Asobola okukuyamba okuzuula oba waliwo ensonga enkulu era n'ateesa obujjanjabi obutuufu bw'olina okukozesa. Embeera ez’amangu: Mu mbeera z’obulumi obw’amaanyi, kammunguluze, okuzirika oba okuvaamu omusaayi omungi ogutakoma, genda mu ddwaliro mu bwangu.

input: Kiramidiya asobola okuleeta obutazaala?
output: Kiramidiya, era amanyiddwa Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo, Kawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ak'olulango mu baami n’abakyala. Kasobola okuvaako obukosefu obw'olubeerera ku bitundu by'omukyala ebizaala, ekikifuula ekizibu oba ekitasoboka kufuna lubuto oluvannyuma. Kiramidiya era asobola okuleeta olubuto okukulira mu nseke (wabweru wa nnabaana) ekiyinza okuteeka omukyala mu katyabaga k'okufa. Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa avaako obuzibu ku bulamu, omuli okuzimba kw'amagumba g'omu kiwato mu bakyala n'okuzimba kw'olububi lw'oku kibumba. Mu baami, asobola okuvaako enseke z'oku nsigo okukwatibwa akawuka, ekivaako obutazaala. Kiramidiya era asobola okuleeta ekyenda ekinene n'amaaso okukwatibwa akawuka n'okuzimba mu nnyingo. Obukosefu obusooka Kiramidiya bw'aleeta tebutera kweyoleka.  Wabula, Kiramidiya asobola okuleeta obuzibu obwamaanyi ku bulamu.Mu bakyala Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa asobola okuvaako okuzimba kw'amagumba g'omu kiwato. Obumu ku buzibu bw'amagumba g'omu kiwato okuzimba bwe buno:• Okutondebwawo kw'ekifundikwa ky'enkovu ekinene ekizibikira enseke.• Olubuto okukulira mu nseke (okukulira wabweru wa nnabaana).• Obutazaala (obutasobola kufuna lubuto).• Obulumi bw'amagumba g'omu kiwato/olubuto obw'olukonvuba. Abaami tebatera kufuna buzibu buva ku Kiramidiya. Okukwatibwa Kiramidiya kuyinza okuleeta omusujja n'obulumi mu nseke z'oku nsigo. Kino emirundi egy'ebbalirirwe kisobola okuvaako obutazaala.Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa era asobola okwongera ku mikisa gy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Lwaki abantu abamu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebalwala Siriimu?
output: Okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti ogenda kufa. Olw’enkulaakulana mu bujjanjabi naddala enkola eweweeza ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kifuuse embeera ya lukonvuba naye nga esobola okukkakkanyizibwa eri abantu bangi. Kikulu okumanya nti si buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti ajja kugenda mu maaso n’okufuna Siriimu naddala ng’azuuliddwa mangu n’okufuna obujjanjabi.

input: Nkola ki ze nsobola okukozesa okukakasa nti nzaala omwana atalina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu singa mba nkalina?
output: Bw'oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'oli lubuto, waliwo enkola ez'enjawulo ezikozesebwa okukakasa nti tosiiga mwana wo ali mu lubuto akawuka. Mu zino mulimu okumira eddagala eryetaagisa okumala ebbanga ly'omala ng'oli lubuto n'okugoberera ebiragiro ebitangira maama okusiiga omwana ali mu lubuto akawuka.

input: Okunaaba ng’omaze okwegatta kiziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba endwadde endala?
output: Okukwatibwa n'obutakwatibwa Bulwadde bwa Kikaba si kabonero kalaga buyonjo bwo era okunaaba oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta tekitangira Bulwadde bwa Kikaba, wabula okukozesa obupiira oba obupiira obw'omunda kye kiziyiza.

input: Nsonga ki ezisalawo ekika ky'obuyambi bw'emmere obuweebwa abantu abakoseddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okuwa obuyambi bw’emmere, omuli n’obuwunga bw’obuugi, eri abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu oba abo abalina Akawuka kano nkola eyinza okuba ekitundu ku nteekateeka nnamutaayiika ey'okuyambako abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekigendererwa ky’okuwa obuyambi bw’emmere obw’engeri eno kirimu emiganyulo mingi. Kikulu okumanya nti ekika ky'obuyambi bw’emmere obw'enjawulo obuweebwayo, gamba ng’obuwunga obw’obuugi, buyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku kitundu, ebintu ebiriwo, n’obwetaavu bw’abantu ssekinnoomu oba ebitundu ebiweebwa obuyambi.

input: Enzijanjaba y'Enziku mu baami eyawukana ku y'abakyala?
output: Abantu bakulu bonna abalina Enziku bajjanjabwa na ddagala eritta obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya. Eddagala eritta obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya erya Ceftriaxone lye lisinga okukubirizibwa olw'engeri obuwuka obuleeta Enziku gye bugenda bumanyiiramu eddagala. Eddagala eritta obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya liba lya mpiso. Oluvannyuma lw’okukubwa ddagala lino eritta obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya, okyayinza okusiga ng'osiiga abalala okumala ennaku musanvu. Noolwekyo weewale okwegatta waakiri okumala ennaku musanvu. Okubirizibwa okuddamu okwekebeza Enziku oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu. Kino kikolebwa okukakasa nti abantu tebazzeemu kukwatibwa kawuka ka bbakitiiriya ekiyinza okubaawo singa abantu be weegatta nabo mu nsonga z'omukwano baba tebajjanjabiddwa oba ng'ofunyeeyo ababeezi abaggya abalina akawuka ka bbakitiiriya.

input: Singa mbeera mu mbeera eyinza okunviira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne nkeberebwa amangu ago, vvayiraasi eyinza okuzuulibwa?

input: Bintu ki ebiyinza okuyamba okwenkanyankaya ebirowoozo by'omuntu n'okuyambako ku nkyukakyuka mu mbeera ze mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?

input: Ngeri ki ezimu ez’okugumiramu enkyukakyuka mu nkula y’omubiri mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka?

input: Bwe mba njogera ne bazadde bange oba abandabirira kw'ebyo bye mpulira ku buvubuka, nnina kwogera ki?

input: Abantu balina okuba ne we bakoma ku bantu bye bayitamu mu by'okwegatta?

input: Nnina embalabe mu bwenyi bwange bwonna; nnyinza ntya okulabirira olususu lwange n’okukendeeza embalabe mu mutendera  guno ogw'obuvubuka?

Mu mbeera nga wabaddewo akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, enkola ey’enjawulo emanyiddwa nga PEP eyinza okulowoozebwako. PEP erimu okumira eddagala eriweweeza ku Siriimu okumala ennaku 28 oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa. Bw’oba okkiriza nti oli mu katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’olowooza ku PrEP, kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo asobola okwekenneenya embeera mw'oli okukulungamya ku nkozesa ya PrEP, n’okukakasa nti y’enkola ekusaanira okwetangira.

input: Nkola ki eziriwo mu kutangira Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo?
output: Engeri yokka ey’okwewalira ddala Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo kwe kwewala okwegattira mu bukyala, ewava obubi ne mu kamwa. Singa oba weetaba mu bikolwa eby'okwegatta, bino wammanga bisobola okukendeeza ku mikisa gyo egy'okukwatibwa Kiramidiya: Okubeera n'omubeezi omu okumala ebbanga eddene ng'omaze okumukebeza era nga talina Kiramidiya, okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu era buli lwe weegatta. Singa oba oli lubuto, yogerako n'omusawo wo ku bikwata ku kwekenneenya, okukeberwa n'okujjanjabibwa. Okujjanjaba Kiramidiya amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka kijja kukendeeza ku bizibu ebiyinza okutuuka ku bulamu bw'omwana wo.

input: Kkiraapu kitegeeza ki mu buwuka obuleeta obulwadde bw'ekikaba?
output: Enziku kawuka akaleeta obulwadde bw'ekikaba ak'ekika kya bbakitiiriya ekeeyoleka ennyo era nga kaziyizika n'okuwonyezeka nga kasinga kukwata mumwa gwa nnabaana mu bakyala wamu n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo mu basajja. Ebitundu ebirala ebikosebwa mulimu ekyenda ekinene, ebitundu by'omukyala ebizaala, akamwa, omumiro oba amaaso mu baana nga bazaalibwa. Enziku era eyitibwa "Kkiraapu" oba "Dduliipu."

input: Okukomolebwa kusobola okunkuuma obutakwatibwa Kabootongo?
output: Okukomola abaami kuzzenga kulagibwa nti kukendeeza ku mikisa gy’okusaasaanya Kabootongo mu kunoonyereza okw'enjawulo. Kino kye kimu n'ekyazuulibwa ku Buwuka obulala obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba, nti okukomola abaami kikendeereza ddala emikisa gy'okusaasaanya obuwuka.

input: Ngeri ki Abantu ze basobola okukolaganamu n'abo abalina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba nga tebabasosodde?
output: Okukolagana n'abalwadde b'Endwadde z'Ekikaba awatali kubasosola kyetaagisa nnyo okutumbula okusaasira, okutegeera, na buli muntu okwenyigiramu. Eno y'emu ku nnambika ku ngeri y'okuzimba enkolagana eyamba era etasosola balwadde ba Ndwadde za Kikaba: Weesomese, beera okusaasira, ssa ekitiibwa mu by'ekyama byama bya banno, weewale olulimi oluboola, beera muyambi, era wuliriza nnyo.

input: Ani yavumbula Kabootongo?
output: Embeera eyeetooloolera ku kubalukawo n’okusaasaana ennyo okw’obulwadde bwa Kabootongo mu Bulaaya ey’omulembe gwa Renaissance (wakati w’ekyasa 14 ne 16) ebaddeko okukubaganya birowoozo okwa maanyi. Ennyinyonnyolero ekyasinze okukira ku ndala egamba nti obulwadde bwa Kabootongo bwaleetebwa abalunnyanja abaakulirwa  Christopher Columbus abaali bava ku lugendo eyo mu ssemayanja wa Atalantic. Obulwadde buno ensangi zino bweyoleka nga bwe bwali edda nga mu kiseera kino ensi ya Haiti y'esingamu obulwadde buno. Abalala bakinogaanya nti obulwadde bwa Kabootongo bwalina ensibuko ku Bulaaya edda ennyo ng'olugendo lwa Columbus terunnabaawo, nga waliwo abantu abaazuulibwamu obulwadde buno ng'emyaka gya 1400 giggwaako era ne babuyita ebigenge mu bukyamu, ebyali bikyase ennyo nga biviirako omulwadde okukyuka mu ndabika. Obulwadde buno, obw'ensibuko ekyatankanibwa abanoonyereza bwatuuka mu Africa ng'ekyasa kya 16 kiggwaako. Mu Africa bwasooka kukakasibwa mu 1520.

input: Eddagala erigema erya Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) likola bulungi kwenkana ki okugema ekika ky'Akafuba eky'amaanyi?
output: Yee, eddagala erigema erya bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) lisobola okukuuma omuntu okuva eri endwadde ez’amaanyi ng'Akafuba. Likola ebitundu nga 80% mu kujjanjaba ebika by'Akafuba ebisinga okuba eby’amaanyi. Mu nsi omuli Akafuba, BCG eweebwa abaana abawere n’abaana abato ng’emu ku nteekateeka y’eggwanga ey’okugema abaana.

input: Nsobola okukwata ku muntu ne nfuna Kiramidiya?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo akasaasaana okuva mu kwegatta ng'amazzi g'ekikyala oba ag'ekisajja agalimu akawuka kano katambula okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Osobola okufuna Kiramidiya singa weegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba awava obubi, okugabana ebintu ebikozesebwa mu kwegatta n'omuntu alina akawuka kano. Okukwatagana kw'ensusu z'ebitundu by'ekyama y'enkola esinga okumanyibwa mu kusaasaana kwa Kiramidiya, n'amazzi g'ekisajja oba ag'ekikyala agalimu akawuka kano singa gagenda mu maaso g'omuntu. Omukyala ow'olubutu alina Kiramidaya asobola okumusiiga omwana we mu kiseera ky'okuzaalibwa, era ekyo kisobola okuviirako omwana okukwatibwa Kiramidiya akwata amaaso ekisobola okukosa endaba ye. Bw'oba walina Kiramidiya n'ojjanjabibwa osobola okuddamu n'omufuna singa weegatta n'omuntu amulina nga teweetangidde.

input: Omusawo w’abakyala asobola okuzuula Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama?
output: Obulwadde bwa Kisipi busobola okukeberebwa n’okukakasibwa mu ddwaaliro mwokka. Tosobola kumukeberera waka oba okukozesa okukebera kwonna okwetaagisa okulaba ebitundu by’omubiri ebiri munda (enkola za z'okutangaaza). Omusawo wo ayinza okukebera n’akakasa okubaawo kwa Kisipi w’ebitundu by’ekyama ng’atunuulira ekimu ku biwundu ebiriwo. Abasawo era basobola okuggya sampolo ku kiwundu (ebiwundu) ne bagikebera. Singa ebiwundu tebibaawo, okukebera omusaayi kuyinza okukozesebwa okunoonya obutoffaali bw’omubiri obulwanyisa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi (abasirikale b'omubiri). Yogerako mu bwesimbu era mu lwatu n’omusawo wo ku kukebera Kisipi n’endwadde endala ez’ekikaba. Weetegereze: Okukebera Kisipi okuyita mu musaayi kusobola okuyamba okuzuula oba olina Obuwuka obuleeta Kisipi. Tekusobola kukubuulira ani yakusiiga akawuka akaleeta Kisipi oba ddi lwe wakafuna.

input: B'ani mu nsi yonna abakoseddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna kikola omulimu munene mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu mu nsi yonna ng'ewa abantu okulambikibwa, okubagawo ebigobererwa ebiri ku mutindo, okutumbula kaweefube w'okumanyisa abantu mu nsi yonna ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okukeetangira. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu tekatwalibwa nga "bulwadde bwa ggwanga erimu" wabula wabula nnawookeera w'ensi yonna akosezza ebitundu n'abantu okwetoloola ensi yonna. Noolwekyo, kyetaagisa okuteekawo kaweefube omulungamu ku mutendera gw'ensi yonna wamu n'ogw'eggwanga. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kakyali kizibu kyamaanyi ku by'obulamu by'ensi yonna, era newankubadde nga waliwo ebikoleddwa okukalwanyisa mu bitundu eby'enjawulo, wakyaliwo omulimu gwa maanyi okukyetaagisa okukolebwa okusobola okutuuka ku biruubirirwa bya Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) 90-90-90, ebigendererwamu okubeera n'abantu ebitundu 90% abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bamanyi bwe bayimiridde ku kawuka kano, ebitundu 90% eby'abantu nga bali ku bujjanjabi bw'akawuka kano, era n'ebitundu 90% eby'abantu abali ku bujjanjabi ng'akawuka ke balina tekakyasobola kuzuulibwa mu musaayi gwabwe.

input: Ntegeera ntya oba ndi mwetegefu okwegatta?
output: Okubeera omwetegefu okwegatta kitegeeza okubeera omutebenkevu mu birowoozo ne mu mubiri, okutegeera oky'ogenda okukola, n’obusobozi okwogera n'omubeezi wo mu bwesimbu, n'okukakasa nti mwembi muli batebenkevu, temuli mu bulabe era nga mwetaaga okukikola.

input: Enziku ekwata baami bokka?
output: Nedda, Enziku bulwadde bwa kikaba. Obufuna weegasse na muntu alina akawuka akagireeta. Oyinza okuba nga owuliddeko ku bantu abagiyita Kkiraapu. Abaami n'abakyala bonna basobola okugifuna newankubadde ng'abaami ebakwata nnyo okusinga abakyala.

input: Omwana ow’emyaka 15 alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu yatwalibwa mu kisulo; bizibu ki bye yasanga mu bulamu bwe, mu birowoozo ne mu mbeera ez'obuntu?
output: Abavubuka abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu boolekagana n'okusoomoozebwa okw'enjawulo okuyinza okukosa embeera yaabwe ey'omubiri, mu ebirowoozo, n'enkolagana yaabwe n'abantu abalala mu mbeerabantu. Okusoomoozebwa kuno kuyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera z'omuntu kinnoomu, naye embeera ezimu eza bulijjo abavubuka abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ze boolekagana nazo: Okuboolebwa n'okusosolwa, ensonga z'obulamu bw'obwongo, okweraliikirira mu kwasanguza embeera yo n'okukuuma ebyama, enzirukanya y'eby'ekisawo, Obulamu bw'okwegatta n'okuzaala, enkolagana n'ab'ekinywi, okweraliikirira ku by'enjigiriza n'ebyemirimu, okweyawula ku balala n'okuwuubaala, okukozesa ebiragalalagala, obusobozi bw'okufuna okulabirirwa, okusoomoozebwa mu kwetangira, entambuza y'obuzadde n'amaka, Ebizuuliddwa mu kukeberebwa engeri gye bikosaamu ebirowoozo by'omuntu. Kikulu okumanya nti si buli muvubuka alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti ajja kwolekagana n'okusoomoozebwa kwe kumu, era bangi basobola okubeera n'obulamu obulungi, obumatiza bwe baba nga bafunye obujjanjabi obutuufu, obuwagizi, n'okufuna ebikozesebwa mu mbeera yaabwe. Abasawo b'ebyobulamu abayambako abantu abali mu mbeera eno, abakugu mu by'obulamu bw'omutwe, ebibiina ebiyamba abali mu mbeera eno, n'ebibiina ebikugu mu kulabirira abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bisobola okukola emirimu emikulu mu kuyamba abavubuka abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okumalako n'okusoomoozebwa kuno n'okutwala obulamu mu maaso. Kaweefube w'okusomesa n'okumanyisa abantu ezigendereddwamu okukendeeza ku kuboola abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nazo zeetaagisa nnyo okusobola okutumbula embeera y'abavubuka abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okutwalira awamu.

input: Waliwo obukakafu bwonna obulaga nti eddagala erijjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu likosa engeri eddagala erigema KKOVIDI-19 gye likolamu?
output: Nedda, tewali bujulizi bulaga nti obujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bukwatagana n'eddagala erigema KOVIDI-19 ne litangira eddagala lyombi okukola. Olina okugenda mu maaso n'okufuna obujjanjabi bwo obw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bulijjo singa ofuna eddagala erigema KOVIDI-19."

input: Kiki ekiremesezza bannassaayansi okukola obulungi ku ddagala erigema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye ng'ate baali bakikoze ku ndwadde endala?
output: Okukola eddagala erigema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu erikola obulungi kizuuliddwa nti kizibu nnyo olw’ensonga eziwerako, wadde nga eddagala erigema endwadde endala likoleddwa bulungi. Wadde nga waliwo okusoomoozebwa kuno, okunoonyereza ku ddagala erigema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kukyagenda mu maaso. Wabaddewo enkulaakulana eziwa essuubi mu myaka egiyise, omuli n’okuzuula obutoffaali obuziyiza endwadde obusobola okutunuulira ebika by’Akawuka kano ebingi. bNAbs zino zinoonyezebwa ng’ebitundu ebiyinza okugema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu biseera eby’omu maaso.

input: Lwaki abantu abamu batandika okuvubuka nga bukyali oba okulwawo okusinga abalala?
output: Si kituufu nti; obuvubuka bwa njawulo eri buli muntu, noolwekyo enkyukakyuka mu mubiri gwo ziyinza okubaawo ku misinde ey’enjawulo okusinga eza mikwano gyo. Abantu abamu batandika okuvubuka nga bukyali oba okulwawo okusinga abalala. Kino kya bulijjo era tewali kya kweraliikirira. Omubiri gwo gujja kuyita mu nkyukakyuka zino ku misinde gyagwo, era kyetaagisa okujjukira nti buli muntu akulira ku misinde gya njawulo.

input: Singa nkitegedde nti nsuze n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era nga ntya okwekebeza, nnina kukola ki?
output: Bw’oba weegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’afaayo ku mbeera yo naye ng’otya okwekebeza, kyetaagisa okukulembeza obulamu bwo n’obulungi bwo. Jjukira nti okuzuula amangu nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okujjanjabibwa kiyinza okuyamba ennyo mu kuziyiza ebyandivuddemu eri abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okufuna essanyu wadde ng'awangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu si kibonerezo kya kufa. Osobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obulungi era n'otuukiriza ebirooto byo bw'oba ng'ogoberedde ebiragiro n'amateeka ebifuga enzijanjaba y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.  Okukkiriza embeera yo ey'okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikulu nnyo ku kubeera omutebenkevu mu mubiri ne mu nneewulira.
