input: Nsobola ntya okulaga engeri gye mpulira mu ngeri entuufu mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okuyiga engeri ennungi ez'okwolesaamu ebirowoozo byo n'okukwatamu obutakkaanya kikulu nnyo mu kiseera ky'obuvubuka. Buno bwe bukodyo bw’oyinza okukozesa: Kyogereko: Yogera ku birowoozo byo eri mikwano gyo, ab’omu maka go, oba omubuziibuzi oba omuntu akulabirira. Okuwandiika mu katabo ko ak'ekyama: Wandiika endowooza zo n’empulira zo mu katabo ko ak'ekyama. Kino kiyinza okuba ekifo eky’obwannannyini eky’okukola ku birowoozo byo. Okulowooza n'okukkakkana: Kozesa obukodyo bw'okulowooza, okussa ennyo, oba okufumiitiriza okusobola okweggyako okweraliikirira n'ebirowoozo. Emirimu egikuuma omubiri nga mulamu: Weenyigire mu mirimu gy’okukozesa omubiri gy’onyumirwa. Dduyiro asobola okuba omukutu omunene ogw’okusumulula ebirowoozo ebyetuzze. Okugonjoola ebizibu: Bw’oba oyolekagana n’obutakkaanya, gezaako okuzanganga ng’olina endowooza y’okugonjoola ebizibu. Essira lisse ku ngeri y’okugonjoolamu ekizibu mu kifo ky’okulowooza ku kizibu ekyo. Noonya obuyambi: Singa ebirowoozo bikusukkako oba obutakkaanya ne bweyongera, tolwawo kunoonya buyambi okuva eri akulabirira, nnansi w’essomero, omubuziibuzi, oba omukugu mu by’obulamu bw’obwongo. Jjukira nti si kibi okuwulira enneewulira ez’enjawulo ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, era okunoonya engeri ennungi ez’okugumira embeera kusobola okuleetawo enjawulo ey’amaanyi mu bulamu bwo. Okwanganga ebirowoozo byo n'ebikusoomooza mu kiseera ky'obuvubuka luba lugendo, era si kibi okunoonya obuwagizi okuva mu bantu abakulu oba abakugu abeesigika nga bw'ogenda mu maaso n'obulamu. Obulamu bwo kikulu, era waliwo ebintu ebisobola okukuyamba okuyita mu mutendera guno ogw’obulamu.

input: Mu ngeri ennyangu, PEP akozesebwa etya oluvannyuma lw’embeera ey’akatyabaga?
output: PEP kwe kujjanjaba okukolebwa mu bwangu okukendeeza ku bulabe bw’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’okukwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okuviirako omuntu okukwatibwa Akawuka. Okusobola okukozesa PEP obulungi, goberera emitendera gino: Funa obujjanjabi amangu ddala, yogera n’omusawo ku mbeera eyo, mukkaanye oba osaanidde okufuna PEP, tandika eddagala lya PEP, lwanisa obuzibu obuyinza okujja okuva mu kukozesa PEP, malayo obujjanjabi bwonna, era weeyongere okukeberebwa. Kozesa enkola ey’okwegatta etateeka bulamu bwo mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era weebuuze ku musawo.

input: Biki ebisinga okuviirako okuggyamu olubuto mu ngeri etali nneeteekereteekere?
output: Okuwakula oba okuggyamu olubuto, oba okuggyawo olubuto, kusobola okubaawo olw’ensonga ez’enjawulo, era zigabanyizibwa mu biti bibiri ebikulu: okuggyamu olubuto mu okw'obutonde (okuvaamu olubuto) n’okuggyamu olubuto mu bugenderevu. Wano waliwo ebimu ebitera okuvaako n’ensonga ezikwatagana n’ebika byombi: Okuggyamu olubuto mu ngeri ey’obutonde (okuvaamu olubuto): Ensengeka enkyamu ey'obutaffaali bw'endagabuzaale obusalawo ekikula ky'omwana, embeera z’obulamu bwa maama, obuzibu mu nnabaana, obutakwatagana mu busannyalaze bwa mubiri, ensonga z’obutonde, emyaka gya maama egy’okubukulu, n’engeri gy'atambuzaamu obulamu. Okuggyamu olubuto okugenderere: Okusalawo kw’omuntu, ensonga z’obujjanjabi, okusobya ku mwana oba okusobezebwako mu by’okwegatta, ensonga z’amateeka n’obuwangwa: Kikulu okumanya nti okusalawo okuggyamu olubuto kuba kwa muntu ku bubwe era kukwatibwako ensonga ezitali zimu, omuli embeera z’omuntu kinnoomu, enzikiriza, n’empisa. Mu bifo bingi, okubeerawo n’okufuna empeereza z’okuggyamu embuto ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga era ezikkirizibwa mu mateeka, bikulu nnyo okulowoozaako eri abo aboolekedde okufuna olubuto lwe bateetegekedde. Abakugu mu by’obujjanjabi n’ebyobulamu basobola okuwa obubaka n’obuyambi eri abantu ssekinnoomu abalowooza okuggyamu olubuto, omuli okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri eziriwo, obulabe obuyinza okuvaamu, n’ensonga z’amateeka n’obujjanjabi ezikwata ku nkola eno.

input: Osobola okunnyonnyola emitendera egigobererwa mu kukozesa akantu akakozesebwa mu kwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okukozesa enkola ey'okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kizingiramu emitendera gino wammanga. Nsaba omanye nti enkola ez'enjawulo ez'okwekebera ziyinza okuba n'enjawulo entonotono mu biragiro, noolwekyo kyetaagisa okugoberera ebiragiro ebikuweereddwa ku nkola gy'okozesa. Soma ebiragiro, kukungaanya ebikozesebwa, okunaaba mu ngalo, teekateeka by'ogenda okwekebezesa, kufumita engalo, kukungaanya omusaayi, yiwamu ka buffer solution, linda ebinaavaamu. Soma ebivudde mu kwekebeza, suula by'okozesezza mu ngeri ennungi, era kakasiza ddala ebivuddemu. Kikulu nnyo okugoberera ebiragiro ebiri mu nkola gy'okozesa, kubanga wayinza okubaawo enjawulo mu ngeri enkola ez'enjawulo gye zikozesebwamu. Okugatta ku ekyo, bw’oba olina ebibuuzo oba obweraliikirivu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, weebuuze ku mukugu mu byobulamu oba omubuziibuzi ayinza okukulungamya n'okukuyamba.

input: Nnyinza ntya okwetangira okufuna Kiramidiya ng'omusajja?
output: Engeri yokka ey’okwewalira ddala Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo kwe kwewala okwegattira mu bukyala, ewava obubi ne mu kamwa. Singa oba weetaba mu bikolwa eby'okwegatta, bino wammanga bisobola okukendeeza ku mikisa gyo egy'okukwatibwa Kiramidiya: Okubeera n'omubeezi omu okumala ebbanga eddene ng'omaze okumukebeza era nga talina Kiramidiya, okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu era buli lwe weegatta. input: Obwerinzi bw'omubiri busobola okunafuyizibwa endwadde ezigukwata oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku mutendera ogusooka ogw'okukwatibwa akawuka kano?

input: Okwagazisa abantu okukozesa enkola z'okwegatta ezitali za bulabe kuyamba kutya mu kuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?

input: Nsobola ntya okwanganga okupikirizibwa kwa bannange n'abantu kye bansuubiramu mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okukola ku ky'okupikirizibwa emikwano n'ebikusuubirwamu abantu kusobola okuba eky'okusoomooza, naye waliwo engeri z'okuyita mu kupikirizibwa kuno: Sigala ng'oli wa mazima gy'oli ggwe kennyini: Jjukira nti si kibi okuba ow'enjawulo n'okuba n'ebyo by'oyagala, enzikiriza, n'empisa zo ggwe wekka. Londa emikwano Egiwagira: Weetooloolwe emikwano egikukkiriza nga bw’oli era nga giwagira okusalawo kwo. Empuliziganya: Yogerako n’omuntu omukulu gwe weesiga bw’oba owulira ng’olina okunyigirizibwa oba ng’ozitoowereddwa. Basobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuyambi. Zimba okwekkiririzaamu: Okwekkiririzaamu n’okwessaamu ekitiibwa kiyinza okukuyamba okuziyiza ebintu ebibi n’okukola okusalawo okulungi. Jjukira nti si kibi kubeera ggwe kennyini, era tolina kukwatagana na bikusuubirwamu mu bantu oba okupikirizibwa banno. Oli wa njawulo, era obw'omuntu bwo kinnoomu kintu ky’olina okukkiriza nga ggwe. Bw’oba owulira ng’ozitoowereddwa ebirowoozo oba okusoomoozebwa ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka, tolwawo kunoonya buyambi okuva mu bantu abakulu oba abakugu abeesigika. input: Lwaki abalenzi bakubirizibwa okwambala obuwale bw'omunda mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?

input: Okubeerawo kw'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba bukosa butya embeerabantu?

Okukendeeza ku misinde Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kwe bukwatira n'ebizibu bye buleeta, kyetaaga okukolaganira awamu okw'abasawo, ebitongole by'eggwanga eby'ebyobulamu n'ebitundu. Okutumbula obulamu bw'okwegatta, enkola ezitali za bulabe, n'okumalawo okuboolebwa kw'abalina Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba mitendera gya nkizo mu kukendeeza ebyo ebizibu Obuwuka buno bye buleetera abantu.

input: Nkola ki eziyinza okuyamba mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo okuyinza okuvaamu ebibala ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kibiina?

input: Nsonga ki ezisobola okwongera ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kiseera ky'okunywegeragana?

input: Bw’oba nga tomanyi ne weegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kiki ekiddako ky’osaanidde okukola?

input: Ebyokulabirako by'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi bye biriwa?

input: Nzijanjaba ki esinga obulungi mu kujjanjaba Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B?

input: Tekirina buzibu okubuuza abazadde ku kwegatta okutateeka bulabe ku bulamu?

input: Obusannyalaze bw'omubiri bukola mulimu ki mu nfuga y'ebirowoozo n’enneewulira z’okwegatta mu myaka gy’obuvubuka?

input: Kiki kye nnyinza okukola singa okusiiyibwa mu bitundu byange eby’ekyama tekusalako oba ne kweyongera?
output: Okwetakula (okusiiyibwa) mu bitundu by'ekyama oba ebitundu ebirala by'omubiri kayinza okuba akabonero akaleetebwa ensonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ensonga z'olususu, endwadde, alagye, oba embeera endala ez'obulamu. Kikulu okuzuula ekivaako okusiiyibwa okusobola okukwata emitendera emituufu okwanganga ekizibu. Zino ze nsonga ez'enjawulo eziviira okusiiyibwa mu bitundu by'ekyama: Alagye oba olususu okwekanga, obuwuka obukwata ensusu, olususu olukalu oba olususumbuka, okusiiyibwa, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’embeera endala ez’ebyobulamu. Singa ofuna okusiiyibwa okutawona oba ne kusajjuka mu bitundu by’ekyama, kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo oba omukugu mu byobulamu. Omusawo asobola okukukebera, n'akuwa by'azudde ebituufu, n’akuwa obujjanjabi obusaanira okusinziira ku kivaako okusiiyibwa. Jjukira obuteekebera oba okugezaako okwejjanjaba mu ngeri etali ya kikugu kubanga kino, kubanga kino kiyinza okuviirako ebizibu ebirala.

input: Mitendera ki gye nnina okuyitamu singa mba nfunye embeera endala ey’obulamu ate nga nnina n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bwe kiba bwe kityo oyinza okuba nga olaba abasawo babiri. Kikulu abasawo bombi okumanya eddagala ly’omira basobole okukukuuma ng’oli mulamu bulungi. Kino kiri bwe kityo kubanga, mu mbeera ezimu, eddagala erijjanjaba embeera endala liyinza okucankalanyizibwa obujjanjabi bwo obw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ne erimu ku lyo oba lyombi obutakola bulungi oba okuteeka obulamu bwo mu katyabaga. Kirungi singa abasawo bo basobola okwogereganya obutereevu, naye kino tekisoboka bulijjo.

input: Omulenzi yakeberebwa n'azuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era maama we n'amugobwa awaka; magezi ki ge nsobola okumuwa?
output: Kya nnaku okuwulira embeera enzibu omulenzi ono gy'ayitamu. Kikulu okumuyamba n'okumulambika mu kiseera kino ekizibu. Gano ge gamu ku magezi g’osobola okumuwa: Okunoonya obujjanjabi, akwatagana n'abantu abasobola okuyambako, okunoonya abantu abayinza okumusembeza, okufuna obuwabuzi mu mateeka, okufuna okuyambibwa mu bwongo, okutabagana n'abenganda, okwekuumira mu kumanya, era n'okunoonya obuyambi obw’amangu.

input: Kijja kitya abantu okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu wadde nga bakimanyi nti bakalina?
output: Ensonga lwaki abantu abamu abamanyi embeera yaabwe ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bagenda mu maaso n'okweyisa mu ngeri eyinza okukasiiga abalala nzibuzibu era za njawulo. Kikulu okumanya nti si bantu bonna abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti beenyigira mu nneeyisa eteeka obulamu mu katyabaga, era bangi bayita mu mitendera egy’obuvunaanyizibwa okwewala okukasaasaanya. Wabula, waliwo ensonga eziwerako eziyinza okuvaako okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeera ezimu: Obutamanya, okuboolebwa n'okusosolebwa, obutakkiriza nti okalina, okukosebwa ku bwongo, okukozesa ebiragalalagala, enkyukakyuka mu nkolagana, n'obutafuna bujjanjabi.

input: Ekiseera ky'okugenda mu nsonga z'ekikyala kitera kumala bbanga ki?
output: Ebbanga erimalibwa mu nsonga litera okumala wakati w'ennaku 3 ne 7, naye era, lino lisobola okwawukana okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Mu myaka egisooka ng'otandise okugenda mu nsonga, ekiseera ky'okugenda mu nsonga kiyinza okukyukakyuka mu buwanvu n'obungi bw'omusaayi. Kino kya bulijjo ng'omubiri gwo gukyukakyuka okutuukana n'enkyukakyuka mu mubiri. Okuva ku myaka 16 okutuuka ku 18, ekiseera ky'okugenda mu nsonga kiba tekikyukakyuka. Omusaayi gwo guyinza okuba nga guba mungi ku ntandikwa ate ne gukendeera gy'osembera.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okumanya nti ali lubuto nga takebeddwa?
output: Okubeera olubuto kitera okuwerekerwako obubonero obw'enjawulo wadde nga buno butera okukyuka okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala. Singa oteebereza nti oli lubuto oba ng'oteekateeka okulufuna, buno bwe bumu ku bubonero bw'olina okwetegereza: obutagenda mu nsonga, obukoowu, enkyukakyuka mu mabeere, okusinduukirirwa emmeeme n'omusujja gw'okumakya.  Obubonero buno tebufunibwa buli mukyala ali lubuto, era nga businziira ku muntu.

input: Kiki ekiwonya Enziku?
output: Obujjanjabi obutuufu buwonya Enziku era kikulu okumira eddagala lyonna eriwereddwa abasawo okusobola owonera ddala obuwuka. Togabana ddagala lya Nziku na muntu yenna wadde nga eddagala lijja kukkakkanya ku kawuka ke. Terijja kuleetawo nkyukakyuka yonna ya lubeerera ku bulwadde.

input: Engeri ki esinga obulungi ey'okwewalamu Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Okukozesa obupiira n'okugemebwa Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Ensundo zombi nkola nnungi ez'okutangiramu Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba.

input: Nnyinza ntya okwerabirira mu nsonga z'okulya engeri gye nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna kikulu eri buli muntu, nga mw'otwalidde n'abo abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri, okukendeeza ku bubonero obuyinza okuva mu ddagala lya ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n'okutumbula obulamu obulungi. Jjukira nti endya kintu kikulu nnyo mu bulamu, era emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwo n'okukuyamba okulwanyisa obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obwetaavu bw'emmere obw'enjawulo busobola okwawukana, noolwekyo kikulu okukolagana n'omusawo w'ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu byendya okukola enteekateeka y'endya ey'omuntu ey'enjawulo etunuulira ebiruubirirwa byo ebyobulamu n'ebyetaago byo.

input: Eriyo enzikiriza eya bulijjo eraga nti okunaaba kirungi oluvannyuma lw’okusobezebwako omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Singa omuntu akabassanyizibwa oba okusobezebwako omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu nnyo okusoosowaza obulamu bwe okuba obulungi. Wadde ng’okunaaba oba okunaaba oluvannyuma lw’okukabassanyizibwa kikulu olw'obuyonjo bw’omuntu n’okutebenkera mu birowoozo, si nkola eyeesigika ey’okuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Gino gye mitendera egirina okuyitibwamu oluvannyuma lw’okukabassanyizibwa naddala nga wabaawo obweraliikirivu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba: Noonya obujjanjabi obw’amangu, kozesa PEP, okwekebeza Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n'okuyambibwa okutebenkera mu birowoozo. Kikulu okukwata embeera n’obwegendereza n’okujjukira nti omuntu akabassanyiziddwa si musango gwe okuyisibwa atyo. Okujjanjabibwa mu budde n'okuyambibwa mu birowoozo bintu bikulu nnyo mu kuyamba omuntu abeera akabassanyiziddwa okusobola okwanganga embeera mu mubiri ne mu birowoozo ebijjawo oluvannyuma lw'okukabassanyizibwa.

input: Nsobola ntya okumanya nti nnina Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B?
output: Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B gukakasibwa okuyita mu kebera okw'enjawulo okw'akawuka akaguleeta. Waliwo n'enkebera endala ez'enjawulo ez'Omusujja gw'ekibumba. Enkebera ezimu zeeyambisibwa okuzuula oba omuntu alina akawuka ate endala zeeyambisibwa okuzuula obwangu omuntu bw'ayinza okukozesa okukasiiga omulala.

input: Kitegeeza ki okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye nga tolaga bubonero era nga tolwala?
output: Abantu abatalaga bubonero bwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu abatera okuyitibwa "Bassekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu" oba "abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu," be bantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mibiri gyabwe. Kikulu okukitegeera nti omuntu okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti buli kiseera omuntu abeera asobola asaasaanya akawuka kano oba nti bulijjo abeera akasiiga abantu abalala. Mu bufunze, wadde ng’abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okusiiga ababeezi baabwe akawuka kano, akatyabaga kano kasobola okukendeezebwa ddala era, mu mbeera ezimu ne kaggyibwawo nga bayita mu nkola zino wammanga.

input: Bizibu ki ebiva mu butafuna bujjanjabi bwa bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku bulamu?
output: Obutakozesa nkola eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'owangaala nako kiyinza okuvaamu ebizibu eby’amaanyi era ebiyinza okuvaako okufa. ARVs kitundu kya nkizo ku bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kijja kukuviirako Akawuka okweyongera mu musaayi ekiyinza okutegeeza nti kijja kuba kyangu okuwatibwa endwadde ezisobola okukutta.

input: Nnyinza ntya okwanganga okweraliikirira ku nsonga z’obulamu bw’okwegatta?
output: Yogerako n’omuntu gwe weesiga oba wandiika enneewulira zo, kubanga toli wekka.

input: Kisoboka kitya obutamanya oba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ng'omutunuulidde butunuulizi?
output: Obuwuka bungi obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba busbola obutalaga bubonero, ekitegeeza nti omuntu asobola okubeera nabwo n'atalaga kabonero konna.

input: Abantu abamira eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuna obuzibu bwonna ku bulamu bwabwe?
output: Enkola eweweeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, nga buno bwe bujjanjabi obw’omutindo eri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, busobola okuba n’emigaso mu kukkakkanya Akawuka n’ebiyinza okuva ku Kawuka oba n'eby'okulowooza ku bulamu. Kikulu nnyo abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukolagana obulungi n'abasawo okulondoola n'okuddukanya obujjanjabi bwabwe.

input: Lwaki abavubuka batandiikiriza okumera obwoya mu bwenyi ne ku mubiri nga bavubuka?
output: Yee, abavubuka bangi batandika okukula enviiri mu ffeesi ne ku mubiri nga bali mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Naye kino kiva ku busannyalaze bw'omubiri naddala  obuyitibwa testosterone eri abalenzi ne estrogen eri abawala. Testosterone asobola okuleetera enviiri okukula mu bifo nga ffeesi yo (nga ebirevu oba ekirevu), mu nkwawa zo, ne mu bitundu by'ekyama. Abawala nabo batandika okukula enviiri mu bitundu by’ekyama ne mu nkwawa olw’ekirungo kya estrogen. Kitundu kya bulijjo mu kufuuka omuntu omukulu.

input: Ngeri ki esinga ey'okuwagiramu mukwano gwo ayita mu mbeera y'okuba n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Muwulirize buwuliriza, beerawo, era omuyambe okufuna ebikozesebwa ebituufu oba omusawo.

input: Omuntu ayinza kukola ki nga muganzi we gw'ayagala ennyo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okuzuula nti omubeezi wo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okukusoomooza mu ndowooza, naye kikulu okujjukira nti kisoboka okukuuma enkolagana yammwe ng'erimu okwagalana n'obuwagizi nga bwe mufuba okukuuma obulungi obulamu bwammwe n'embeera y'obulamu bwammwe eya bulijjo ng'abaagalana. Jjukira nti ebizuulibwa mu kukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebisalawo kiki omuntu ky'ali, era abantu ssekinnoomu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuba n’enkolagana n’obulamu obumatiza. Kikulu okussa essira ku kubategeera, okubakkiriza, n’okubawagira nga bwe mutambula  olugendo luno mwembi. Okunoonya okulambikibwa okuva mu basawo abakugu n'ebitongole ebiyamba ku bantu abali mu mbeera eno nakyo kisobola okuba eky’omugaso nga mwembi bwe mukola ku kusoomoozebwa n'emikisa ebijja n'okuzuulibwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu wakati mu baagalana.

input: Nsobola kukakasa ntya nti nfuna ebivudde mu kwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebituufu?
output: Okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okw'okweyambisa obukebera obw'okutonnyezaako omusaayi bwe kuba nga kukoleddwa bulungi era mu kugoberera ebiragiro ebyateekebwawo kusobola okukuweera ddala ebiva mu kukebera ebituufu. Obukebera buno bwakolebwa okusobozesa abantu ssekinnoomu okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kyama nga bali mu maka gaabwe. Wabula, kikulu okutegeera engeri obukebera buno gye bukolamu, obunafu bwabwo, n'okugoberera enkola esinga obulungi okusobola okufuna ebiva mu kukebera ebituufu. Kikulu okumanya nti okwekebera okw'okweyambisa obukebera bw'okutonnyezaako omusaayi kuyinza obutaba kutuufu eri buli muntu, era abantu abamu bayinza okwagala okukebererwa mu ddwaliro gye basobola okufunira okubudaabudibwa n'obuyambi. Okugatta ku ekyo, okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusalawo kwa muntu ssekinnoomu, era kikulu okulowooza ku ngeri ebivaamu gye biyinza okukosaamu omuntu mu birowoozo ne mu bwongo. Bw'oba ng'olina okweraliikirira ku mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng'olowooza ku ky'okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kiba kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo oba okugenda mu kifo ekikebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Basobola okukulungamya ku ngeri esingayo obulungi  ey'okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu etuukana n'embeera era n'okukuyamba okuyita mu kiseera ky'okukebera kyonna.

input: Waliwo ebika by'emmere ebisobola okuyamba omuntu okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna kikulu eri buli muntu, nga mw'otwalidde n'abo abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri, okukendeeza ku bubonero obuyinza okuva mu ddagala lya ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n'okutumbula obulamu obulungi. Jjukira nti endya kintu kikulu nnyo mu bulamu, era emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwo n'okukuyamba okulwanyisa obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obwetaavu bw'emmere obw'enjawulo busobola okwawukana, noolwekyo kikulu okukolagana n'omusawo w'ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu byendya okukola enteekateeka y'endya ey'omuntu ey'enjawulo etunuulira ebiruubirirwa byo ebyobulamu n'ebyetaago byo.

input: Okukomolebwa kukutangira obutakwatibwa Siriimu oba akawuka akamuleeta?
output: Engeri esinga ey'okwetangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kwewala okwegatta. Wabula, bw’oba tosobola kwewala kwegatta, beera mwesigwa eri omubeezi wo era kozesa obupiira. Singa obeera weetabye mu bikolwa eby'okwegatta mu ngeri eyinza okukuteeka mu katyabaga ak'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, laba musawo wo akuwe eddagala eriyinza okukutangira okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu erya pre-exposure prophylaxis. Era waliwo eddagala eddala erya post-exposure prophylaxis, ekika kya ARV omuntu ly'amira okwetangira okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'amaze okwetaba mu mbeera eyinza okumuleetera okukafuna, gamba nga, okwegatta nga takozesezza kapiira oba amazzi g'omubiri ag'omuntu alina akawuka okugenda ku mubiri gwe. Okutangira maama okusiiga omwana we ali mu lubuto akawuka akano nakyo kisoboka maama bw'aba ng'amize bulungi empeke eziweweeza akawuka ng'ali lubuto, okugendanga mu ddwaliro n'afuna obujjanjabi ng'ali lubuto n'okuzaalira mu mikono gy'omusawo, asobola okufuba okula ng'omwana tasiigibwa kawuka kano okuva ku maama. Omwana olumala okuzaalibwa, aweebwa eddagala erimutangira eya ARV era n’alondoolwa okutuuka ku myezi kkuminamunaana okukakasa nti takwatibwa kawuka. Okukomolebwa okw'abasajja okutali kwa bulabe kukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Waliwo okunoonyereza okw'amaanyi okukwata ku ddagala erigema Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kino kigendereddwamu okutangira okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Lwaki kikulu okusaba obuyambi ng’okola ku nsonga z'enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri?
output: Bw’oba ozibuwalirwa okumalako n'enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri, wano waliwo emitendera gy’osobola okuyitamu: Yogerako n’Omuntu: Okubuulirako omuzadde, omukuza, omubuziibuzi ku ssomero, oba omuntu omukulu gwe weesiga bw'owulira kusobola okukuyamba ennyo. Basobola okuwa obuwagizi, okutegeera, n’okulambikibwa. Wesomese: Okuyiga ebisingawo ku myaka gy’obuvubuka, obusannyalaze bw'omubiri, n’enkyukakyuka ezigenda mu maaso mu mubiri gwo kusobola okukuyamba okuwulira nga weetegese era nga tofaayo nnyo. Okulowooza n’okuwummulamu: Enkola nga okulowooza, dduyiro w’okussa ennyo, n’obukodyo bw’okuwummulamu bisobola okuyamba okukkakkanya ebirowoozo byo n’omubiri gwo mu biseera by'obweraliikirivu. Empisa ennungi: Essira lisse ku mpisa ennungi nga okukola dduyiro buli kiseera, okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa n’otulo otumala. Empisa zino zisobola okukyusa embeera yo mu ngeri ennungi n’obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu. Jjukira nti si kibi okusaba obuyambi ng’obwetaaga. Okugumira enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri kitundu kya bulijjo mu kukula, era waliwo ebikozesebwa n’abantu abasobola okukuwagira okuyita mu kiseera kino.

input: Abantu abamu basobola okubeera nga basiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye nga tebalaga bubonero bwako?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu vvayiraasi erwaza wamu n'okwekubisiza mu butaffaali bw'obwerinzi bw'omubiri, okusingira ddala mu butaffaali bwa CD4 T obukenga obulabe obuba bulumbye omubiri. Akawuka kano ko obutafaananako bulwadde obumu obuleetebwa obuwuka obulala tekasobola kusirikira mu mubiri gwa muntu lubeerera. Wabula, abantu ssekinnoomu basobola okubinjawazibwa mu miteeko egy'enjawulo nga basinziira ku mbeera yaabwe ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'obungi bw'obuwuka obuli mu musaayi gwabwe.

input: Ngeri ki ezimu ku muntu z’ayinza okuyitamu okwewala okwegatta nga tannabeera mufumbo?
output: Okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa kikusalawo wa muntu ssekinnoomu okusinziira ku by'oyagala, by'okkiririzaamu n’ebiruubirirwa byo. Bw’oba nga weewaddeyo okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa, zino ze zimu ku nkola eziyinza okukuyambako okutuukiriza okusalawo kwo: Teekawo ekkomo ku bintu by'otalina kukola, funa ababeezi bwe mufaananya endowooza, era oteekewo empuliziganya ennungi.

input: Ki ekireetera omubiri okukula?
output: Okugimuka bye biseera omubiri gwo we gukulira amangu mu bbanga ettono. Kino kiva ku busannyalaze bw'omubiri obw’okukula omubiri gwo bwe gukola. Obusannyalaze bw’okukula bugamba amagumba go, ebinywa n’ebitundu byo okukula. Mu kiseera ky’okukula, oyinza okukiraba nti ogenda owanvuwa mu bwangu. Okukula kutera okubaawo ku myaka 10-14 ku bawala ate 12-16 ku balenzi, naye kyawukana ku buli muntu.

input: Lwaki kikulu okumanya omubiri gwo n’okwerinda enkyukakyuka oba obubonero?
output: Okwekebeza okwa buli kiseera: Genda ew'omusawo buli kiseera okwekebejjebwa n’okukeberebwa obulamu bw’ebitundu byo ebizaala. Muno mulimu okukeberebwa Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana (okuggya obutaffaali ku mumwa gwa nnabaana ne bukeberebwa), okukebera amabeere, okukebera Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’okukebera obulamu bw’ebitundu ebizaala byonna okutwaliza awamu. Okwewala okwegatta kirungi nnyo okuva bwe kiri nti kutangira embuto ezitali nneeteekereteekere wamu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba ebitundu 100%. Kozesa enkola z'okwetangira: Bulijjo kozesa obupiira mu butuufu oba engeri endala ez’okuziyiza okuzaala okutangira embuto z’otayagala n’okukendeeza ku katayabaga k'okwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Weenyigire mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga: Empuliziganya ey'olwatu n’abo be weegatta nabo ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n’okuziyiza okuzaala. Weekebeze Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba buli kiseera naddala ng’olina ababeezi abawera. Enneeyisa zino zitumbula obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu, omuli n’obulamu bw’okuzaala. Kino kiyamba mu kuzuula obuzibu obuyinza okubaawo nga bukyali. Wesomese: Yiga ebikwata ku bulamu bw’okuzaala, enkola z’okuziyiza okuzaala, n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Okulabirira obulamu bwo obw’okuzaala kuzingiramu omugatte gw'enkola z’okwetangira, okwekebejjebwa buli kiseera, n’okufaayo ku bubonero bw’omubiri gwo. Bw’oba olina ekibuuzo oba ekikweraliikiriza, tolwawo kwogera na musawo. Emitendera gino gisobola okukuyamba okukuuma enkola y’okuzaala ennungi n’obulamu obulungi okutwalira awamu.

input: Mazzi ki mu mubiri agayinza okutambuza akawuka ka siriimu kubanga galimu ekirungo ekinene eky’akawuka?

Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kagenderera abaserikale b’omubiri naddala obutoffaali bwa CD4+ T, era ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo, kasobola okunafuya abaserikale b’omubiri, ekivaako obuzibu obw’enjawulo ku bulamu singa tebujjanjabibwa. input: Bubonero ki obusinga okulabika obwa Tuliici?

input: Ki ekinaabaawo singa sifuna bujjanjabi bwa Kisipi?

input: Emirundi emeka gye nnina okukyusa engoye n’obugoye obw’omunda mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okukyusa engoye n’obuwale obwomunda buli kiseera kikulu mu kukuuma obuyonjo. input: Nafuna ntya Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama ga siyendanga ku mwagalwa wange?
output: Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama asinga kusiigibwa ng'omuntu akwataganye n'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akamuleeta, amalusu, n'ebitundu by'omunda w'akamwa oba okwetooloola akamwa. input: Ntegeera ntya nti nnina Kabootongo?

input: Waliwo amazima gonna agali mu nzikiriza nti okwegatta ng’oli mu nsonga kusobola okukendeeza ku bulumi bw’olubuto?

output: Singa omuntu abeera nga yeekakasiza ddala nti talina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu (ekitegeeza nti yakeberebwa era n'azuulibwa nga talina Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu era nga teyeenyigira mu bikolwa byonna ebyandimutadde mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa kawuka kano) era nga beenyigira mu bikolwa by'okwegatta n'omuntu eyeekakasiza ddala nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye ng'obungi bw'akawuka obuli mu musaayi gwe tebusobola kuzuulibwa mu musaayi gwe olw’okukozesa enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kabeera wansi nnyo, bwe kaba nga si katono nnyo.

input: Nsaana okubuulirako muganzi wange nti emabegako nnajjanjabibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba?
output: Yee, okubeera omwesimbu kikulu kubanga kiraga nti naawe ofaayo ku bulamu bwabwe.

input: Nnyinza ntya okubuulira omwana nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'obwegendereza?
output: Emboozi y'okunnyonnyola omwana nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ebeera esoomooza era ng'esaana kukwata na bwegendereza. Kikulu nnyo okwanganga emboozi eno n’obwegendereza, obwesimbu, n’olulimi olutuukagana n’emyaka gy'omwana. Gino gye gimu ku mitendera egisobola okukuyamba okunnyonnyola omwana ebivudde mu kumukebera ebiraga nti alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: weeteeketeeke, londa Obudde n'ekifo ekituufu, kozesa olulimi olugya mu myaka gy'omwana, tandika n'obubaka obusookerwako, kikkaatirize nti si musango gwe, era omunnyonnyole engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kakosaamu omubiri.

input: Ssaayansi akkiriziganya n'endowooza nti ebifaananyi bya X-rays bisobola okuwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Nedda, okukubibwa ekifaananyi kya X-ray tekiwonya oba okutta Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, akalumba obutoffaali bw’omubiri obulwanyisa endwadde, era tekasobola kujjanjabibwa oba kumalibwawo nga kateekeddwa mu kifaananyi kya X-ray. X-rays kika kya kitangaazo ekikozesebwa okufuna ebifaananyi by’omunda mu mubiri.

input: Endwadde zinnakigwanyizi nga Akafuba (TB) oba omusujja gw'ensiri zisajjula zitya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu katwalibwa ng’embeera ey'olukonvuba era eyinza okutta omuntu kubanga kanafuya abaserikale b’omubiri, ekifuula omubiri okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta endwadde ez’enjawulo n'ebika bya kookolo ebimu. Wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ko kennyini tekatta, kasobola okuvaako obuzibu obuyinza okutta omuntu, omuli obuwuka obuleeta endwadde ezirumbagana omubiri olw'okuba nti gunafuyiziddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okutegeera nti Akawuka akaleeata Siriimu/Siriimu kasobola okuyita mu mitendera egyawukana, era nga si buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti ajja kukwatibwa obuwuka buno obuleeta obulwadde olw'okuba nti omubiri gunafuyiziddwa akawuka kano.

input: Okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwetaagisa okufulumya amazzi g’okuzaala, oba kuyinza okubaawo ne we gatali?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasiigibwa okuyita mu kukwatagana n’amazzi ag’omubiri ag’enjawulo agalimu akawuka kano akangi. Wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusiigibwa okuyita mu mazzi gano ag’omubiri, kikulu okumanya nti akawuka kano tekasangibwa mu mazzi gonna ag’omubiri, era okusaasaana kw'akawuka kano kusinga kubaawo mbeera nga kangi mu musaayi. Tekatera kubeera mu malusu, amaziga oba entuuyo okuggyako nga bino byonna byetabudde n'omusaayi. Kigambibwa nti kisoboka okusiigibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okubaawo nga tewali mazzi gazaala gafulumiziddwa singa wabaawo okukwatagana n’omusaayi ogulimu akawuka ogukwataganye n’akasusu akaseerera, amabwa amasajjufu,oba enjatika ku lususu.  Wabula embeera bwe zityo tezitera kubaawo bw’ogeraageranya n’okusiigibwa okuyita mu kwegatta n’amazzi g'ekisajja oba amazzi ag'ekikyala.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okuddukanya akawuka ka siriimu singa aba teyeeyagaza kugabana mbeera ye?
output: Abantu abasinga abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu beetaaga okwetooloolwa enkola esobola okubayamba mu kwanganga Akawuka. Wabula bw’oba toyagala kubuulira ku banno bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka, funa engeri y'okugyangangamu eyinza obutakuteeka mu kukabirirwa. Bw’oba oli ku nkola ART ng’omusawo wo bw'akulungamya, olwo ojja kubeera n’omuwendo gw'Akawuka ogutasobola kuzuulibwa ekitegeeza Akawuka tekajja kufuuka Siriimu ekitegeeza ojja kuba tosobola kusiiga muntu mulala.

input: Singa omuntu abeera yeewulira nga mulamu, ateekeddwa okugenda okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Mazima ddala si kya tteeka kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okusalawo okwekebeza kusalawo kwa buntu era kisinziira eri ggwe, enneeyisa yo ne by'okkiririzaamu. Tewali tteeka likulagira kwekebeza Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Wabula kirungi okwekebeza n’omanya bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kubanga bw’okola bw’otyo, ojja kutandika obujjanjabi nga bukyali singa okizuula nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate singa oba tolina Kawuka, kiyinza okwetaagisa okukola enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa okusobola okusigala bw’otyo. Omuganyulo omulala kwe kuba nti okwekebeza kijja kukulaga abakugu mu byobulamu abajja okukuyamba mu kufulumya amawulire, si nsonga ga kika ki.

input: Ng'oggyeeko kondomu, ngeri ki endala eyinza okukozesebwa okuziyiza obulwadde bwa Trichomoniasis?
output: Tuliici asobola okwewalibwa mu ngeri zino: okwewala okwegatta, okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu era buli mulundi gwe weegatta, okwewala okwegatta n'abantu abangi n'okubeera n'omubeezi omu yekka gwe weegatta naye.

input: Enkola ekozesebwa okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu yeesigika?
output: Okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okw'okweyambisa obukebera obw'okutonnyezaako omusaayi bwe kuba nga kukoleddwa bulungi era mu kugoberera ebiragiro ebyateekebwawo kusobola okukuweera ddala ebiva mu kukebera ebituufu. Obukebera buno bwakolebwa okusobozesa abantu ssekinnoomu okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kyama nga bali mu maka gaabwe. Wabula, kikulu okutegeera engeri obukebera buno gye bukolamu, obunafu bwabwo, n'okugoberera enkola esinga obulungi okusobola okufuna ebiva mu kukebera ebituufu. Kikulu okumanya nti okwekebera okw'okweyambisa obukebera bw'okutonnyezaako omusaayi kuyinza obutaba kutuufu eri buli muntu, era abantu abamu bayinza okwagala okukebererwa mu ddwaliro gye basobola okufunira okubudaabudibwa n'obuyambi. Okugatta ku ekyo, okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusalawo kwa muntu ssekinnoomu, era kikulu okulowooza ku ngeri ebivaamu gye biyinza okukosaamu omuntu mu birowoozo ne mu bwongo. Bw'oba ng'olina okweraliikirira ku mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng'olowooza ku ky'okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kiba kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo oba okugenda mu kifo ekikebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Basobola okukulungamya ku ngeri esingayo obulungi  ey'okwekebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu etuukana n'embeera era n'okukuyamba okuyita mu kiseera ky'okukebera kyonna.

input: Kituufu nti waliyo eddagala erisobola okukuyamba obutakwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu ne bw'oba nga weegatta n'omuntu akalina?
output: Wadde nga waliwo enkola z'okwetangira n’eddagala erisobola okukendeereza ddala ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obumu, omuli n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, enkola zino tezikuwa bwerinzi bwa nkomeredde, era  tewali bukakafu bwa nkalakkalira nti tojja kukwatibwa kawuka ne bw’oba weenyigira mu kwegatta n’omuntu akalina. Kikulu okutegeera nti enkola zino ez’okwetangira tezikuwa bukuumi bwa nkomeredde, era zisinga kukola bulungi nga zikozeseddwa obutayosa era mu butuufu bwazo. Zikendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde naye tezikamalirawo ddala. Mu nkomerero, engeri esinga okwesigika ey’okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, omuli n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kwe kuyita mu nkola z’okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga n’empuliziganya ey'olwatu n’abantu be weegatta nabo. Bw’oba olina ekikweraliikiriza ku bulamu bw’okwegatta oba ebibuuzo ebikwata ku bintu kinnakimu ku nkola z’okwetangira kirungi okwebuuza ku musawo oba eddwaliro ly’ebyobulamu by’okwegatta okufuna okulambikibwa n’ebikubirizibwa okukolebwa okusinziira ku bintu ebikuteeka mu katyabaga nga ggwe omuntu.

input: Mbuulira ebisingawo ku ndwadde z’ekikaba.
output: Okukwatibwa kw'obuwuka obufunibwa okuyita ku mu kwegatta. Era busobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu biseera by’okufuna olubuto, okuzaala, okuyonsa, n’okuyita mu musaayi ogulimu obuwuka.

input: Biki ebiva mu kufuuweta sigala ku bulamu bw’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okunywa sigala kulina ebizibu bingi ebikosa obulamu. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu abanywa sigala batera okusinga ku bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu abatanywa ssigala okulwala kookolo w’amawuggwe, kookolo w’omutwe n’ensingo, kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana, akwata ewava obubi, ne kookolo omulala. Okufuna lubyamira ava mu bakitiriya, ekika kya lubyamira ekya Pneumocystis jiroveciipneumonia, okuzubikira kw'amawuggwe okw'olukonvuba, n’endwadde z’omutima. Okuvaako embeera ezikosa akamwa, gamba nga kandida ow’omu kamwa n'ebipaapi by'olwoya ebikuba mu ku lulimi. Kuvaako n’obutakola bulungi obw'eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okufuna obulwadde obuteeka obulamu mu katyabaga obuvaako n'okuzuulibwamu Siriimu. Omuntu awangaala kitono.

input: Osobola okunnyonnyola emitendera egy’enjawulo egy’okuba olubuto?
output: Okuwakisa eggi: Okuzaala kubaawo ng’obutoffaali bw’enkwaso busisinkanye akatoffaali k’eggi mu emu ku nseke z’omu nnabaana. Kino kitera okubaawo mu kiseera ky'okwegatta. Enkwaso bw’eyingira mu ggi, obukole bw'endagabuzaale bwazo bwegatta ne bukola ekitonde ekiva mu kuwakisibwa kw'eggi, nga kino ke katoffaali akasooka ak’omuntu omupya. Okubeera olubuto: Oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala, eggi eriwakisiddwa litandika okwegabanyizaamu ku misinde egya waggulu nga bwe likkirira wansi mu nseke okutuuka mu nnabaana. Lifuuka omuzingo gw'obutaffaali era ne lyekwata ku bisenge bya nnabaana. Omuzingo gw'obutaffaali gumala ne guvaamu ekitonde eky'omwana oluvannyuma ekikula ne kifuuka omwana atannazaalibwa. Olubuto lugenda mu maaso okutuusa ng’omwana ali mu lubuto ng'atuuse  okuzaalibwa, ekitera okubaawo nga wayise wiiki nga 40 okuva mu lunaku lw'okugenda mu nsonga olwasembayo. Mu kiseera ky’okuba olubuto, omubiri gw’omukyala gufuna enkyukakyuka nnyingi okusobola okuwagira omwana akula, omuli enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri, omusaayi okweyongera, n’enkyukakyuka mu nnabaana okusobola okuwa omwana akula ekyanya. Enkola zino zeetaagisa nnyo mu kuzaala kw’omuntu n’okweyongerayo kw'obulamu.

input: Nategeezebwa nti nnina Kiramidiya, nkole ntya?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo ajjanjabibwa era awonyezebwa mu nnaku oba wiiki entonotono. Kiramidiya atali wa maanyi nnyo ajjanjabibwa n'empeke ezitta bbakitiiriya omuli azithromycin oba doxycycline. Okuddamu okukwatibwa Kiramidiya kusobola okubaawo singa be weegatta nabo tebajjanjabibwa, era singa abantu beegatta nga tebeetangidde n'omuntu alina Kiramidiya. Abaana abawere abalina Kiramidiya w’amaaso bajjanjabibwa ne azithromycin. Abantu balina okulindako okwegatta okumala ennaku 7 oluvannyuma lw'okumira eddagala lya Kiramidiya oba bwe kiba nga tekisoboka bakozese obupiira mu ngeri entuufu. Balina okutegeeza be beegatta nabo okukeberebwa n'okujjanjabibwa, bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

input: Wa na butya bwe nsobola okumiramu eddagala lyange ery'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga ndi ku ssomero?
output: Okumira eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'oli ku ssomero kisobola okukolebwa obulungi era mu kyama. Okuboolebwa eyinza okubeera ensonga enkulu naye waliwo emitendera gy'oyinza okukwata okukuuma ekyama kyo era n'ofuba okunywerera ku bujjanjabi. Bino bye bimu ku biroozo; noonya ekintu mw'otereka eddagala lyo, leka omusawo w'essomero avunaanyizibwe ku ky'okukuwa eddagala, buulirako mukwano gwo gwe weesiga oba gw'osula naye, tambula n'akasawo akatono mw'oteeka amakerenda go n'ebirala.

input: Endagabuzaale zifuga zitya ekiseera okuvubuka we kutandikira?
output: Ebiseera by’okutuuka mu myaka gy’obuvubuka bisobola okwawukana ennyo okusinziira ku muntu, era ensonga eziwerako zisobola okufuga ku ddi lwe gitandika: Endagabuzaale: Obuzaale bwo bukola kinene mu kuzuula ddi obuvubuka bwo lwe bunaatandika. Singa bazadde bo baatandika okuvubuka nga bukyali oba ekikeerezi, kiyinzika nnyo nti naawe ojja kukikola. Endya n’obulamu bwo: Endya ennungi n’obulamu okutwalira awamu bisobola okuyambako mu nkula y'omubiri n'okukulaakulana kw'obwongo ebirungi, omuli n’ebiseera by’okutuuka mu myaka egy’obuvubuka. Ensonga ezikwata ku butonde: Okukozesa eddagala erimu, okweraliikirira, n’ebintu ebirala ebiva mu butonde nabyo bisobola okukosa ekiseera ky’okutuukirako mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Kikulu okujjukira nti waliwo ebintu bingi ebitwalibwa ng’ebya bulijjo bwe kituuka ku myaka gy’obuvubuka. Bw’oba weeraliikirira ekiseera ky’ogenda okutuukirako mu myaka gy’obuvubuka, okwogera n’omusawo kusobola okukugumya n’okukuwa okulambikibwa.

input: Waliwo abantu ab'enjawulo abalina okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakwata bibinja bya bantu bitongole byokka. Kyetaagisa okukeberebwa oluusi n’oluusi singa weegatta nga teweetangidde oba okugabana empiso oba ebisongovu byonna.

input: Nafuna okulumizibwa omutwe okw’amaanyi nga mmaze okwegatta; kiyinza okuba nga kyekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okufuna obubonero ng’obunafu oba okulumwa omutwe oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta tekitegeeza nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu vvayiraasi eyinza okuvaako Siriimu nga wayise akaseera, naye emitendera egisooka egy’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu emirundi mingi tegitera kulaga bubonero bwa nkukunala. Kikulu okutegeera nti obubonero bwokka si ngeri eyeesigika ey’okuzuula Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kalina abantu nga bwe kabakwata tekalaga bubonero era babeera basobola okukasiiga abantu abalala?
output: Abantu abatalaga bubonero bwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu abatera okuyitibwa "Bassekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu" oba "abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu," be bantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mibiri gyabwe. Kikulu okukitegeera nti omuntu okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti buli kiseera omuntu abeera asobola asaasaanya akawuka kano oba nti bulijjo abeera akasiiga abantu abalala. Mu bufunze, wadde ng’abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okusiiga ababeezi baabwe akawuka kano, akatyabaga kano kasobola okukendeezebwa ddala era, mu mbeera ezimu ne kaggyibwawo nga bayita mu nkola zino wammanga.

input: Bika bya Kisipi ki ebiriyo?
output: Obulwadde buno obwa Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama oba Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi, era obumanyiddwa nga Kisipi buva ku bika bibiri eby'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi. Kisipi akwata ebitundu by'ekyama aleetebwa ebika bino ebibiri eby'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi afaanagana. Ekika kya 1 (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1) kisinga kusaasaana kuyita mu kukwatagana kw'akamwa k'omuntu omu n'ak'omulala era nga kareeta obuwuka obuleeta Kisipi mu kamwa oba okukeetooloola. Era kayinza okuleeta Kisipi akwata mu bitundu by’ekyama. Abantu abakulu abasinga obungi balina Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1. Ekika 2 (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2) kisaasaana okuyita mu kwegatta ne kireeta Kisipi akwata mu bitundu by’ekyama. Wabula era kisoboka Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2 okuleeta Kisipi w'akamwa. Oluusi, Kisipi (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1 ne Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2) asobola okusiigibwa okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana mu kisera ky'okuzaala, ekivaako Kisipi akwata abaakazaalibwa (omwana omuwere).

input: Abantu bakwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu kokka okuyita mu kwegatta?
output: Nedda, okwegatta si y’engeri yokka ey’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu ngeri endala eziwerako, omuli okugabana empiso, maama okukasiiga omwana, okukwatibwa mu kuweebwa omusaayi n'okusimbuliza ebitundu by'omubiri, ebeera etuukawo ku mirimu, okukabassanyizibwa n’ebirala.

input: Mpulidde abantu nga bagamba nti singa okozesa nnyo akaweke k'okumakya (P2), kayinza obutakola nga wayise ebbanga; ekyo kituufu?
output: Okukozesa enkola ya kizaalaggumba ey'obwangu entakera oba buli kiseera, nga P2, tekubirizibwa kubeera nkola ya kizaalaggumba esookerwako. P2 egendereddwamu kukozesebwa mu mbeera ez'obwangu oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta nga teweetangidde oba mu mbeera ng'enkola endala ziremereddwa. Wadde ng'okutwalira awamu terina ng'ekozeseddwa obw'olumu, okugyesigamako okwa buli kiseera oba okugiddingana kusobola okuleeta ebizibu eby'enjawulo. P2 tekola bulungi kusinga nkola ndala nnyingi za kizaalaggumba singa ebeera eddinganiddwa. Enkola yaayo egenda ekendeera buli mulundi gw'ekozesebwa, era si nnungi kwesigamako ng'enkola ya kizaalaggumba endala ezikola ku mbeera eno nga obukerenda obuziyiza okuzaala, obupiira, obuweta, oba obuti bw'omu mukono obuziyiza okufuna olubuto.

input: Ndi mu mukwano omuggya; ntegeera ntya oba munnange awulira obutenkevu ng'ali nange?
output: Faayo ku bubonero obulungi, gamba ng'okumwenya, okunyumya, n'okukkiriza okucakalirako awamu.

input: Abantu balina kutunuulira na kujjanjaba batya abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukwata abantu ssekinnoomu ab’emyaka gyonna omuli n’abaana abali wansi w’emyaka 12. Tewali muntu yenna "mulongoofu" oba atakwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku myaka gye gyokka. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasiigibwa okuyita mu nneeyisa oba embeera ez'akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, so si kuyita mu ngeri za buzaaliranwa oba obutaba na musango. Kikulu nnyo okukiggumiza nti abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebalina musango ku bulwadde bwabwe, era basaana obujjanjabi obusaanidde, obuwagizi, n’obukuumi. Enkola z'okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omuli okusomesa ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufuna okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okujjanjaba abakyala ab’embuto, n’okwegendereza okwa bulijjo mu bifo eby’ebyobulamu, bikulu nnyo mu kukendeeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu baana. input: Okugaba omusaayi tekirina bulabe singa oyo agugaba alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?

input: Lwaki abantu mu maduuka agatunda eddagala bawa abawala abatanneetuuka eddagala nga ery’okuziyiza okufuna olubuto ery'amangu?
output: Okutundira eddagala mu matundiro gaalyo, omuli ery'okuziyiza embuto okw'amangu (EC) eri abavubuka kusinziira ku mateeka n’ebiragiro ebiteekeddwawo mu eggwanga eryo oba ekitundu. Zino ze ensonga enkulu z’olina okulowoozaako: Okufuna obujjanjabi obukwata ku by'okuzaala, okufa ku budde, okusalawo okwesigamiziddwa ku bujulizi, okwekuuma n’okwetengerera, okusomesa n’okubudaabudibwa, n’okukugirwa olw'emyaka. Kikulu okujjukira nti okubeerawo kw'eddagala eritangira okufuna olubuto okw'amangu awatali biragiro bya kisawo tekitumbula kwegatta kuteeka bulamu mu katyabaga, kiwa abantu omukisa okuziyiza embuto ze bateetegekedde mu kaseera ak'akazigizigi.

input: Oyinza okumbuulira PEP kye ki?

input: Muganzi wange yeetaaga kumanya ki ku mbeera gye nnyimiriddemu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?

input: Lwaki embalabe zitera okubeerawo mu myaka gy’obuvubuka?
output: Embalabe zeeyoleka nnyo mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka olw’enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri. Butto ono asukkiridde awamu n’obutoffaali bw’olususu obufu, bisobola okuzibikira obutuli bw'olususu n’okuvaamu okubutuka omuli embalabe, obusundo ne nnamakula. Embalabe zitera kuba za kaseera buseera naye waliwo engeri ennungi ez’okuzifaako n’okuzijjanjaba.Okufa ku Mbalabe:Okulongoosa ffeesi mu ngeri ey’obwegendereza: Naaba mu maaso emirundi ebiri buli lunaku ng’okozesa eddagala erirongoosa oba ssabbuuni atakwatira ku lususu. Weewale okwesiimuula ennyo.Weewale okwekwatako: Tosuna oba okunyisa embalabe okuziyiza okuzimba n’enkovu.Ebintu ebitaliimu butto: Kozesa ebintu ebitaliimu butto oba ebitazibiira lususu, omuli ebigonza olususu n’eby'okwekolako.Eddagala eriguliddwa mu ttundiro ly'eddala: Lowooza ku bintu ebirimu benzoyl peroxide, salicylic acid oba sulphur, ng’ogoberera ebiragiro n’obwegendereza. Eddagala erisangibwa mu kitundu nga ekinzaali oba ekigaji nalyo liyinza okuyamba.Endya ennungi: Lya ebibala n’enva endiirwa, n’okunywa amazzi. Okunoonyereza okumu kulaga nti endya eyinza okuvaako embalabe.Kyusa buli kiseera obubikka ku bwo buli kiseera: Kino kiyamba okuziyiza obuwuka okukungaanyizibwa.Weebuuze ku musawo w’ensusu: Ku mbalabe ez’amaanyi oba ezitaggwaawo, omusawo w’ensusu asobola okukuwa amagezi ku bujjanjabi oba eddagala ery’amaanyi.

input: Njawulo ki mu bwesige eri wakati w’enkola za kizaalaggumba ez'ekinnansi n'enkola nga P2 oba Ppulaani B?
output: Obulungi bw'okukola kw'eddagala ly'ekinnansi oba omuddo ebikozesebwa abasawo b’ekinnansi mu kuziyiza embuto byawukana era okutwaliriza awamu tezeesigika nga enkola nga okuziyiza embuto okw'amangu okugeza Plan B oba P2, obuweke obiziyiza embuto, obuweta, obupiira oba empiso eziziyiza okufuna embuto. Basobola okukuwa amawulire amatuufu agakwata ku nkola ennungi ez’okuziyiza okufuna olubuto, omuli n’okuziyiza okufuna olubuto okw'amangu n’okukuyamba okukola okusalawo mu ngeri entuufu ku bulamu bwo obw’okuzaala. Wadde nga kikulu okussa ekitiibwa mu nkola n’ennono z’obuwangwa, kikulu era okusoosowaza obulamu bwo n'obulungi bwo bwe kituuka ku kwetangira okufuna embuto. Enkola ez’omulembe ez’okuziyiza okufuna embuto okutwalira awamu tezirina bulabe era zeesigika nnyo mu kuziyiza embuto ezitali nneetegekere.

input: Abavubuka bayinza batya okwewala okwenyigira mu bikolwa eby’okwegatta?
output: Okwewala ebikolwa by’okwegatta mu kiseera kyo ng’omuyizi kya kusalawo kya muntu nga ye, era kikulu okukulembeza empisa zo, by'okkiririzaamu, n'obutebenkevu ng’osalawo ku bikolwa byo eby’okwegatta. Buno bwe obukodyo obuyinza okukuyamba okwewala okwegatta singa kye kiba kikwatagana n’ebiruubirirwa byo n’empisa zo mu kiseera ekyo: Teekawo ensalo entegeerekeka, lambika ensalo zo, ziyiza okupikirizibwa banno, era londa emikwano egikuwagira. Weenyigire mu bikolwa ebiteekuusa ku kwegatta, weekuumire mu kumanaya, okuwagirwa banno, noonya okulambikibwa, wekkiririzeemu, weetegekere ebiseera by'omu maaso, Jjukira ebiruubirirwa byo, enkolagana ennungi, okukkiriza, n’okussaamu ekitiibwa. input: Ensibuko y'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi eri ki?

input: Okumira Panadol kulina engeri yonna gye kutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?

input: Tekirina bulabe kwegatta nga sseetangidde nga ndi ku PEP?
