PEP ddagala eriziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga erikubirizibwa okumiribwa abantu abayinza okuba nga babaddeko mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kigendereddwamu okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma kubeera mu mbeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka kano. Wabula PEP si nkola ya nkomeredde obutakwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era okwetaba mu kwegatta nga teweetangidde ng'oli ku PEP kikyayinza okwongera okukuteeka mu katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Mu bufunze, wadde nga PEP esobola okukendeeza ku katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’okubeera mu mbeera eyinza okukuviirako okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tesikira nkola za kwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga omuli n'okukozesa obupiira. Kikulu nnyo okwegendereza ebiragiro ng'oli ku nkola ya PEP ne bw'oba ogivuddeko okwetangira ggwe n'abo be weegatta nabo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo n'obweraliikirivu ku bulamu bw’okwegatta n’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, weebuuze ku musawo oba omukugu mu kubudaabuda mu by’okwegatta okufuna obuwabuzi obutuukana n'embeera mw'oli.

input: Abavubuka balina okunaaba emirundi emeka mu kiseera ky'obuvubuka?
output: Emirundi gy’okweyonja oba okunaaba ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka gisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku byayagalibwa abantu ssekinnoomu n’ebintu bye bakola. Bino bye biragiro eby’awamu: Buli lunaku: Abantu bangi bakisanga nga kya muganyulo okweyonja oba okunaaba waakiri emirundi ebiri buli lunaku (okuli ku makya n’akawungeezi), naddala ng’okola emirimu egituuyanya omubiri, ng’otuuyana nnyo oba ng’obeera mu mbeera ey’ebbugumu. Faayo ku nfunyiro z'olususu n’ebitundu entuuyo ne obuwuka we bikuŋŋaanira, gamba ng'enkwawa, mu bisambi n’ebigere, ng’onaaba. Oluvannyuma lw’okukola dduyiro: Bw’oba weetaba mu mizannyo oba okukola emirimu egituuyanya omubiri, kirungi okunaaba oluvannyuma lw’okukola dduyiro okweggyako entuuyo n'obuwuka. Nga tonnagenda kwebaka: Okunaaba nga tonnagenda kwebaka kusobola okukuyamba okweggyako obucaafu, butto n’entuuyo ezikuŋŋaanyiziddwa emisana. Okunaaba enviiri: Okusinziira ku kika ky’enviiri zo (eza butto, enkalu n’ebirala), oyinza okusalawo okunaaba enviiri zo buli lunaku oba buli luvannyuma lwa nnaku entono.

input: Singa muganzi wange alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, emikisa emeka egy'okukansiiga?
output: Akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oyita mu kwegatta kasinziira ku nsonga eziwerako omuli embeera yo n'eya muganzi wo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ekika ky’okwegatta, n’okukozesa enkola eziziyiza okukwatibwa akawuka. Kikulu okuba n’empuliziganya etaliimu kwekwekerera era ey'obwesimbu ne muganzi wo ku bikwatagana ku bulamu bw’okwegatta, embeera y'emibiri gyammwe ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n’ensonga zonna ez'okufaako oba ez'okwegendereza eri mmwe mwembi.

input: Okubeera ne Siriimu kireetera abantu okuba abennyamivu?
output: Kikulu okwewala okuzingira awamu ebikwata ku nneeyisa y'abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kubanga engeri abantu gye batwalamu ebintu n'endowooza zaabwe bisobola okwawukanira ddala si nsonga oba balina Akawuka oba nedda. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku bwako tekaleeta busungu oba nkyukakyuka mu birowoozo. Wabula waliwo ensonga nnyingi eziyinza okuvaako okusoomoozebwa mu  birowoozo ne mu bwongo mu bantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu ekiyinza okweyoleka nga enkyukakyuka mu mbeera oba mu kwetamwa. Zino ze nsonga entonotono ez'okulowoozaako: Okukabirirwa, okuboolebwa n'okusosolebwa, obweraliikirivu ku by'obujjanjabi, okweyawula ku bantu, ensonga ezitagonjoddwa ez'obwongo. Abantu engeri gye bakwatamu embeera y'okusoomoozebwa ku bwongo omuli n'okusunguwala amangu kiyinza okuba ekitundu ku bulamu bw'omuntu era tekisosola balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekirala, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuga bulungi ebirowoozo byabwe era bakuuma enkolagana ennungi. Singa ggwe oba omuntu gw'omanyi ayita mu kusoomoozebwa mu bwongo okwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu, okunoonya obuyambi okuva mu basawo ab'eby'obwongo n'ebibiina ebigaba obuyambi oba abasawo kiyinza okuba eky'omuganyulo. Obuyambi obwekuusa ku bwongo obulungi n'obukodyo obw'okwanganga embeera biyinza okuyamba abantu okukwata obulungi ebibasoomooza ku bwongo n'okutumbula omutindo gw'obulamu bwabwe okutwaliza awamu.

input: Nnyinza ntya okukuuma obuyonjo bw'akamwa nga nvubuka?
output: Yee, kikulu okukuuma akamwa nga kayonjo kiseera ky'okuvubuka, kubanga enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri eyinza okukosa ebibuno n’amannyo. Kikolebwa bwe kiti: Senya emirundi ebiri buli lunaku: Senya amannyo n’eddagala eririmu ekirungo kya fluoride waakiri emirundi ebiri olunaku (kumakya n’akawungeezi) naddala ng’omaze okulya. Enkola entuufu: Kozesa akasenya akagonvu era osenye n'obwegendereza nga weetoolooza. Longoosa amannyo n'akawuzi buli lunaku: Okukozesa akawuzi mu kulongoosa amannyo kiyamba okugaggyamu obupapajjo bw'emmere n'obuwuka wakati w'amannyo akasenya bye katasobola kutuuka. Kendeeza ku biwoomerera: Emmere n’ebyokunywa biwoomerera bisobola okukola eky'amaanyi mu kuviirako okwonooneka kw'amannyo. Bikendeeze era oyumunguzenga mu kamwa n'amazzi buli luvannyuma lw'okulya obumpwankimpwanki obuwoomerera. Okukebera amannyo buli kiseera: Laba omusawo w’amannyo yeekebejjenga amannyo go n'okugayonja, buli luvannyuma lwa myezi mukaaga. Kozesa eddagala eritta omuwuka mu kamwa: Eddagala ly'okuyumunguza mu kamwa eritaliimu kirungo kya mwenge lisobola okuyamba okuttaka bbakitiiriya n'okuvaamu akawoowo akalungi naye teririna kusikizibwa kusenya na kukozesa akawuzi okulongoosa amannyo. Weewale okunywa taaba: Okunywa oba okukozesa ebintu ebikolebwa mu taaba kiyinza kukosa akamwa ko ne kikuviirako okuvaamu omukka omubi kko n'okulwaza ebibuno. Lya emmere erimu ebiriisa ebimala kikuyambe okubeera n'akamwa akalamu obulungi. Jjukira nti ebbula ly'ebiriisa ebimu kiyinza okuvaako endwadde z’omu kamwa.

input: Ddi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu lwe kasinga okwanguyirwa okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala?
output: Omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okukasiiga ku mutendera gwonna ogw'akawuka omuli omu kiseera nga talaga bubonero, ogw'olukonvuba, n'ogw'okusajjuka. Wabula eddaala ly'okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'akatyabaga k'okukasaasaanya bisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku mitendera egy'enjawulo akawuka kwe katuuse. Eno y'ennambika ey'awamu eraga ensiiga y'akawuka gy'egenda ekyukamu buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero gumala akaseera katono oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka, nga wiiki nga ziizo ezisooka. Omutendera gw'olukonvuba: Oluvannyuma lw'omutendera ogutalaga bubonero, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kayingira omutendera gw'olukonvuba.

input: Waliwo ebikozesebwa eby’obwereere eby'okuyigirako ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Yee, waliwo emikutu gya yintaneeti n'ebifo ebijjanjabirwamu eby'omu kitundu ebisobola okukuwa ebikozesebwa mu kuyiga.

input: Mitendera ki gye nsobola okuyitamu okusobola okwanganga okwennyika n’okweraliikirira?
output: Okwaŋŋanga okwennyamira n'okweraliikirira kiyinza okuba ekizibu naye wasobola okubaawo enkola ennungamu ez'okukuyambako okuyita mu mbeera zino. Singa oba ng'oyita mu kwennyamira okw'amaanyi oba okweraliikirira kya mugaso nnyo okunoonya obuyambi obw'ekikugu okuva eri omusawo w'obwongo omutendeke. Enkola endala ezimalawo embeera eno mulimu okufuna abantu abakubudaabuda, okwefaako, obutakkiririza mu ndowooza enkyamu, n'okweteerawo enkola z'okwemalako okweraliikirira.

input: Kituufu nti okuggyamu olubuto omulundi gumu kuzibuwaza okufunaa olubuto mu biseera eby’omu maaso?
output: Nedda, si kituufu nti omuntu okuggyamu olubuto omulundi ogumu kijja kulemesa omuntu okuzaala omwana mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Okuggyamu olubuto, ka kubeere okw'okulongoosebwa oba okw'okumira eddagala (ekitera okuyitibwa empeke y’okuggyamu olubuto), nkola ya bujjanjabi ekozesebwa okukomya olubuto. Tekukosa busobozi bwa muntu kufuna lubuto oba okuzaala abaana mu bulamu obw’omu maaso. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde ng’okuggyamu olubuto omulundi ogumu tekitera kuleeta butazaala, waliwo obulabe obuyinza okuva mu nkola yonna ey’obujjanjabi, omuli n’ey'okuggyamu olubuto. Ebizibu ebiva mu kuggyamu olubuto tebitera kubaawo, naye nga bisobola okubaawo. Kikulu nnyo abantu ssekinnoomu abalowooza ku ky’okuggyamu olubuto okunoonya obujjanjabi okuva eri omusawo alina ebisaanyizo n’okugoberera ebiragiro byonna ebisemba oluvannyuma lw’okuggyamu olubuto okusobola okuwona obulungi era nga mulamu bulungi. Obutazaala buyinza okuva ku bintu ebitali bimu ebitakwatagana na kuggyamu lubuto, gamba ng’embeera z’obujjanjabi ezimu, okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde, obutatuukana bw'obusannyalaze bw'omubiri, ensonga ezikwata ku myaka, n’entambuza y’obulamu.

input: Lwaki kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo nga tonnatandika kukozesa PrEP?
output: PrEP, ekitegeeza Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis, ye nkola ey'okwetangira ekendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu  mu bantu ssekinnoomu abali mu katyabaga ak’amaanyi ak’okukwatibwa akawuka kano. PrEP ezingiramu okumira eddagala buli lunaku okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti PrEP si nkola esikira enkola ezikozesebwa mu kwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga oba okwekebeza kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okwa bulijjo.  Wabula, nnyongereza ku nkola ennyingi ezaateekebwa okutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Bw’oba olowooza okukozesa PrEP, weebuuze ku musawo asobola okukulambika oba ye nkola ekusaanidde era n’okukuyamba okukola enteekateeka enzijuvu ey’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu etuukira ddala ku byetaago byo n’embeera zo.

input: Enfumo ezikwata ku kawuka akaleeta Siriimu za bulabe eri abantu?
output: Enfumo ezikwata ku kawuka akaleeta Siriimu za bulabe nnyo kubanga zitaataaganya obujjanjabi bw'akawuka. Abantu banywerera ku nfumo zino mu kifo ky'okunoonya obujjanjabi obutuufu okuva mu basawo abakugu, banywerera ku ndowooza enkyamu eziva ku nfumo ezo ne kivaamu obujjanjabi obutali bulungi eri abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ne kiviirako akawuka okusaasaana mu bantu.

input: Omulenzi omutiini alowooza ku ky’okuganza; asobola atya okumanya nti mwetegefu?
output: Bw'oba ng'owulirira emirembe mu kubeera ky'oli era ng'oyagala okukwatagana n'omuntu omulala, oyinza okuba ng'oli mwetegefu.

input: Nnyinza ntya okwewala endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka obw’omutawaana?
output: Okumira eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ye ngeri esinga obulungi ey'okwetangiramu okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi.  Eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu lisobola okukuuma omubiri gwo nga mulamu bulungi. Bw’okwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi, yogerako n’omusawo wo ku ngeri gy’osobola okubujjanjaba. Waliwo n’ebintu ebirala by’osobola okukola okwewala obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi:Yogera n’omusawo wo ku ddagala n’eddagala erigema erisobola okukuyamba okwewala okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi obumu.Weewale okukwatibwa endwadde ezisaasaanyizibwa mu kwegatta.Togabana mpiso, ebbomba z'empiso, oba ebintu ebirala ebikozesebwa okukuba empiso (gamba ng’ebikozesebwa mu kufumba).

input: Nsobola kugenda wa okuyambibwa singa mba n’obubonero bw’Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Gendako ew'omusawo okukeberebwa n'okujjanjabibwa, tolinda!

input: Kika kya kapiira ki ekisinga obulungi mu kuwa obukuumi?
output: Bwe kituuka ku kulonda ekika ky'akapiira, okusalawo kusinziira ku muntu ssekinnoomu ky’ayagala, ebyetaago, n’ekintu ekirala kyonna nga alagye. Bw’oba olonda akapiira, kya nkizo okufa ku bintu omuntu by’ayagala, alagye yenna amanyiddwa, n’ekiruubirirwa (okugeza, okwegattira mu bukyala, awava obubi oba mu kamwa). Ekirala, bulijjo keberanga ku nnaku z'omwezi obupiira kwe buggweerako era kakasa nti kalina obulambe obukakasa okubeera ku katale olwo okimanye nti kakola bulungi.

input: Waliwo kaweefube yenna akoleddwa ekitongole ky'ensi yonna eky'Ebyobulamu (WHO) mu kwanganga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Ekitongole ky’Ebyobulamu mu Nsi yonna kikola omulimu munene mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu mu nsi yonna ng'ewa abantu okulambikibwa, okubagawo ebigobererwa ebiri ku mutindo, okutumbula kaweefube w'okumanyisa abantu mu nsi yonna ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okukeetangira. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu tekatwalibwa nga "bulwadde bwa ggwanga erimu" wabula wabula nnawookeera w'ensi yonna akosezza ebitundu n'abantu okwetoloola ensi yonna. Noolwekyo, kyetaagisa okuteekawo kaweefube omulungamu ku mutendera gw'ensi yonna wamu n'ogw'eggwanga. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kakyali kizibu kyamaanyi ku by'obulamu by'ensi yonna, era newankubadde nga waliwo ebikoleddwa okukalwanyisa mu bitundu eby'enjawulo, wakyaliwo omulimu gwa maanyi okukyetaagisa okukolebwa okusobola okutuuka ku biruubirirwa bya Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) 90-90-90, ebigendererwamu okubeera n'abantu ebitundu 90% abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bamanyi bwe bayimiridde ku kawuka kano, ebitundu 90% eby'abantu nga bali ku bujjanjabi bw'akawuka kano, era n'ebitundu 90% eby'abantu abali ku bujjanjabi ng'akawuka ke balina tekakyasobola kuzuulibwa mu musaayi gwabwe.

input: Nze n'omubeezi wange tuyinza kwetangira tutya okufuna Kiramidiya?
output: Engeri yokka ey’okwewalira ddala Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo kwe kwewala okwegattira mu bukyala, ewava obubi ne mu kamwa. Singa oba weetaba mu bikolwa eby'okwegatta, bino wammanga bisobola okukendeeza ku mikisa gyo egy'okukwatibwa Kiramidiya: Okubeera n'omubeezi omu okumala ebbanga eddene ng'omaze okumukebeza era nga talina Kiramidiya, okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu era buli lwe weegatta. Singa oba oli lubuto, yogerako n'omusawo wo ku bikwata ku kwekenneenya, okukeberwa n'okujjanjabibwa. Okujjanjaba Kiramidiya amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka kijja kukendeeza ku bizibu ebiyinza okutuuka ku bulamu bw'omwana wo.

input: Luvannyuma lwa bbanga ki omuntu mw'ayinza okulabira nti akwatiddwa Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Ekiseera ky’okwalula kw'Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba kyawukana okusinziira ku bulwadde ki. Ekiseera ky’okwalula kye kiseera wakati w’embeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba okugeza okwegatta n’omubeezi abulina n’okweyoleka kw'obubonero, bwe buba bwa kweyoleka. Kikulu okumanya nti abantu abamu abalina Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, nga Kiramidiya, Enziku n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, bayinza obutalaga bubonero bwa nkukunala, naye bakyasobola okusiiga abalala obuwuka buno. Okwekebeza Obulwadde b'Ekikaba entakera, okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga n'okwogera n'abantu be weegatta nabo mu bwesimbu kikulu mu kuziyiza n'okuzuula amangu obulwadde. Bw’oba oteebereza nti oyinza okuba nga wakwatibwa Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba ng’ofuna obubonero, kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo akukebere, okuzuula obulwadde, n’obujjanjabi obutuufu. Okuzuula amangu n’okujjanjaba bikulu nnyo okuziyiza ebizibu n’okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okusiiga abalala obulwadde.

input: Kibi bwe mbeera nga saagala kwegatta?
output: Si bwe kiri yadde n'akatono; abantu babeera beetegefu mu biseera eby’enjawulo, era ekyo kya bulijjo ddala.

input: Wa ewalala we nsobola okugenda okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'oggyeeko eddwaliro lino, kubanga wano mmanyiddwa?
output: Singa oba mweraliikirivu ku ngeri y'okukuumamu ebyama byo, era nga oyagala okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku kalwaliro gye batakumanyi, waliwo ensonga ez'okulondako eziwerako. Osobola okulyalira akalwaliro ak'enjawulo akabudaabuda n'okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Noonya bulwaliro bwa gavumenti, obulwaliro obuli mu bifo awakungaanira abantu oba obulwaliro obw'obwannannyini w'osobola okwekebereza mu kyama. Ebifo ebimu bikebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teweetaaga kuwaayo bikukwatano. Ebifo bino bikozesa obubonero obw'enjawulo mu okuzibira ebyama byo. Waliwo n'enkola eyakakasibwa ey'okwekeberera awaka esangibwa mu matundiro g'eddagala n'emitimbagano.

input: Nsobola okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba mu kidiba ekiwugirwamu eky'olukale?
output: Nedda, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba tebuyita mu mazzi, noolwekyo tobeera mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa buwuka buno ng'oli mu kidiba ekiwugirwamu.

input: Tuliici yatandika atya?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Tuliici kagwa mu kibinja kya pulotozowa ekisangibwa mu nsolo ne mu bantu. Kaava mu binyonyi ebiyitibwa amayiba n'enjiibwa era ne kagenda nga kakulaakulanira wamu n'abantu n’ensolo endala eziyonssa, nga kagumira obwebulungulule bwako okumala emyaka egisoba mu kakadde akamu. Akawuka ka Tuliici kaasooka kulabibwa mu 1836 omusawo Alfred Donne, eyakazuula mu mazzi agafaananako amasira agaavanga mu bakyala abalwadde. Wabula, akawuka kano Honh yakakwataganya n’obulwadde bwa Tuliici mu 1916.

input: Nategeezebwa nti nnina Kabootongo, nkole ntya?
output: Eddagala eritta bbakitiiriya erya Penicillin, bwe liba nga likozeseddwa bulungi era mu ddoozi entuufu, likola bulungi nnyo mu kujjanjaba Kabootongo. Tewaliiyo nzijanjaba ndala keebeere ya kinnansi oba ey'eddagala ezzungu, yaakakasiddwa nti ekola bulungi mu kujjanjaba Kabootongo. Enzijanjaba ya Kabootongo y'emu mu bantu bonna era nga teyeesigama ku kikula, emyaka, oba omutendera obulwadde kwe butuuse. Ekyawukana ze ddoozi ezigabibwa okusinziira ku myaka n'obuzito bw'omuntu. Omusawo wo y'asalawo ddoozi entuufu gy'olina okufuna.

input: Mbuulira ntya muganzi wange ku bwe nnyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri enzikakkamu era eraga okufaayo?
output: Emboozi y'okwogera ku embeera ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu eri omubeezi wo esobola okuba nga ya kwegendereza era nga esoomooza, naye yeetaagisa nnyo ku lw'obulamu n’obulungi bwamwwe mwembi, ggwe n'omubeezi wo. Gano ge gamu ku magezi agaasobola okukuyamba okwasanguza embeera yo ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri ey’okulowooza era ekendeeza ku kyekango: Londa ekiseera ekituufu n’ekifo ekituufu, teekateeka by’oyagala okwogera, kozesa olulimi olutegeerekeka obulungi era olwangu, yogera engeri gye weewuliramu mu birowoozo byo, muwe obubaka obukwata ku mbeera eyo, laga okwewaayo kwo eri okussaawo obukuumi, beera mugumiikiriza era owulirize, omubeezi wo ddamu omugumye, okussa ekitiibwa mu kusalawo kwe, era omuwagire. Weetegekere ekivaamu kyonna; noonya okulambikibwa kw’abakugu. Jjukira nti buli mukwano gwa njawulo ku mirala, era tewali nkola emu ttwalirawamu ey’okwasanguzaamu embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekikulu kwe kuba ow'amazima, omusaasizi, era assa ekitiibwa mu nneewulira y'omubeezi wo n’ebyetaago bye. Okwasanguza embeera yo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ngeri ey’okulowooza, obeera otuuse ku ddaala ery’amaanyi mu kuzimba obwesigwa n’okukuuma enkolagana ennungi, erimu obuwagizi.

input: Wakati w'omuwala n'omulenzi ani alina emikisa emingi egy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obulabe bw’okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu businziira ku nsonga eziwerako omuli ekikolwa eky'okwegatta kyennyini n'embeera y'abantu abakyetabyemu mwe bayimiridde ku Kawuka Akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti omuntu yenna, awatali kufaayo ku kikula kye, asobola okubeera mu katyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Akawuka singa yeetaba mu bikolwa by'okwegatta n'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba gw'atamanyi bw'ayimiridde ku mbeera za Siriimu nga teyeetangidde. Akatyabaga ak'okukwatibwa Siriimu kasinziira ku nneeyisa n'okwetaba mu bikolwa ebisaasaanya Akawuka sso si ku kikula. Buli muntu alina okuvunaanyizibwa ku bulamu bwe obw'okwegatta era yeegendereze nga bwe kisaanidde okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Kituufu bwe mba nfunye Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ddala mbeera wa kufa?
output: Nedda, si kituufu nti okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kitegeeza nti ddala ojja kufa. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka akalumba abaserikale b’omubiri, ne kanafuya obusobozi bwagwo okulwanyisa obuwuka obugulumba. Wadde ng’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera ya bujjanjabi ey'amaanyi, enkulaakulana mu ssaayansi w’obusawo ereetedde enkulaakulana ey’amaanyi mu ngeri y’okuddukanyaamu n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Singa abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuna obujjanjabi obutuufu n’okunywerera ku nzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okubeera n’obulamu obuwanvu era nga balamu bulungi. Enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu eyamba okufufuggaza akawuka kano, okusobozesa abaserikale b’omubiri okudda engulu n’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusuumuka okufuukamu Siriimu. Kikulu akawuka okuzuulibwa nga bukyali, okutandika okujjanjabibwa, n’okugoberera amagezi g’abakugu mu by’obulamu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakyali kibonerezo kya kufa nga bwe kyali edda. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okubeera mu bulamu obulungi, okuba n’amaka, n’okugoberera ebiruubirirwa byabwe mu bulamu. Okukeberebwa abasawo buli kiseera, entambuza y'obulamu ennungi, n’okunywerera ku bujjanjabi byetaagisa nnyo okusobola okuddukanya obulungi embeera y'okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Wabula kikulu nnyo okumanya nti awatali bujjanjabi na kulabirirwa kutuufu, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusuumuka ne kavaamu Siriimu, ekiyinza okuteeka obulamu mu matigga. Noolwekyo, okunoonya obujjanjabi n’okunywerera ku bujjanjabi mitendera mikulu nnyo eri omuntu yenna azuuliddwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okugatta ku ekyo, enkola z’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, gamba ng’okwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga n’enteekateeka z’okuwanyisiganya empiso eri abantu abatambuliza obulamu bwabwe ku ddagala, bikulu mu kukendeeza ku kusaasaana kw’akawuka kano n’okutangira okukwatibwa obuwuka obuggya. Okusomesa n’okumanyisa abantu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okumuziyiza bye bintu ebikulu mu kaweefube w’ebyobulamu by’abantu ow'okulwanyisa okusaasaana kw’akawuka kano.

input: Oli mu katyabaga ka maanyi okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa okozesa akapiira akaayitako ennaku?
output: Okukozesa akapiira akaayitako kwongera ku katyabaga k'akapiira okwabika oba okulemererwa wakati mu kwegatta ekiyinza okuviirako okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala.

input: Bubonero bwa Tuliici ki obumanyiddwa?
output: Tuliici ayinza obutalaga bubonero mu baami, naye mu bakyala, buno buyinza okubaamu amazzi agawunya obubi agava mu bukyala, okusiiyibwa mu bitundu by'ekyama, obulumi mu kufuuyisa, okubabuukirirwa mu kufuuyisa, empunya y'obukyala embi ennyo, n'okulumizibwa mu kwegatta. Obulumi bwe bunyinnyittira abakyala era basobola okufuna obulumi mu kitundu ky'olubuto ekya wansi. Mu baami, okusiiyibwa mu lupiira lw'obusajja oluleeta omusulo, okubabuukirirwa mu kufuuyisa, n'okulumizibwa mu kufuuyisa naye nga bino tebitera kubaawo.

input: Ensibuko y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu eri wa?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka akaava mu bisolo ne kasiigibwa abantu. Keefaanaanyiriza nnyo n'akawuka ka vvayiraasi aka Simian Immunodeficiency Virus, akasangibwa mu mazike mu Masekkati ga Afirika. We butuukidde kati, omuntu eyasooka okuzuulibwamu akawuka kano ng'aggyiddwako sampolo y'omusaayi mu 1959 ye munnansi w'e Kinshasa eyafa oluvannyuma. Vvayiraasi ya SIV yandiba nga yayingira mu bantu oluvannyuma y'okuyigga amazike era ng'omuyizzi bwe yafuna ekiwundu ku mubiri omusaayi ne guyingira mu mubiri gwe. Ensibuko ya vvayiraasi eno ekoleddwako nnyo okunoonyereza okw'ekinnasaayansi okuva mu myaka gya 1980 lwe yazuulwa.  Akawuka kaatuuka okumanyibwa mu nsi yonna oluvannyuma lw'abasawo okutandika okufuna amawulire g'endwadde ezitali za bulijjo nga lubyamira, kkookolo n'endala mu bavubuka abasajja abasiyazi n'abeekuba empiso z'ebiragalalagala. Emyaka gwe gizze giyita, obulwadde busaasaanidde ensi yonna.

input: Ebibinja by'Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B.
output: Akawuka akaleeta Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B kalimu ebika bisatu nga bino mulimu acute, ak'olukonvuba ne fulminant Hepatitis. Akawuka ka acute keeko akalwaza okumala akabanga akatono emyezi nga mukaaga ng'omaze okukafuna. Abantu abamu tebalaga kabonero konna oba balwalamu katono. Abalala bayinza okulwala ennyo ne beetaaga okugenda mu ddwaliro. Akawuka ak'olukonvuba: Akawuka aka acute kasobola okufuukamu obulwadde obw’olukonvuba. Singa kaba tekajjanjabiddwa, kasobola okuviirako obuzibu obw’amaanyi ku bulamu, omuli okukosebwa ekibumba, okuleeta enkovu ku kibumba, kookolo w’ekibumba, sinakindi okufa. Akawuka ka Fulminant tekatera kusangika wabula ka bulabe nnyo akakosa ekibumba amangu ddala n'okukitoniya mu nnaku oba mu ssabbiiti  mbale.  Abantu abawangaala n'Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B tebalaga bubonero bwa bulwadde bwa lukonvuba wabula basobola okusiiga abalala akawuka.

input: Singa omuntu yegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'amala n'agenda ew'omujjanjabi amuli okumpi ng'ekiseera ekituufu tekinnayitako, PEPs anattira ddala akawuka ka vvayiraasi oba anaakendeeza ku bulabe bwako?
output: PEP akolera ddala bulungi mu kuziyiza okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa abeera ng'aweereddwa omulwadde mu bwangu-ekisinga obulungi mu ssaawa 2 n’obutasukka ssaawa 72-oluvannyuma lw’okubeera mu mbeera emuteeka mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi ak'okukwatibwa akawuka.

input: Ndabirira ki esinga obulungi ey'akawuka akaleeta Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B?
output: Mu kiseera kino, Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B tegulina ddagala; obujjanjabi businziira ku ddaala ly'obulwadde kwe buli, buyinza okuba mutendera ogusooka oba ogw'olukonvuba, ate era n'obulamu bw'ekibumba kyo n'obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwo. Bw’oba ng’olina obubonero obutonotono, omusawo ajja kukuwa amagezi okuwummula, okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna, okukola dduyiro entakera, n’obutanywa mwenge. Okwongerezaako, yogerako n’omusawo wo nga tonnamira ddagala oba ebiriisa eby'emmere, weegemese Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa A, ogwa C ne D n'akawuka akaleeta siriimu, era weekebeze ekibumba kyo entekera buli luvannyuma lwa myezi esatu oba mukaaga. Obulwadde obw’amaanyi buyinza okukwetaagisa okugenda mu ddwaaliro. Waliwo eddagala eriwerako erikkirizibwa okujjanjaba abantu abalina Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B ogw'olukonvuba erikkirizibwa nga lino mulimu; tenofovir disoproxil fumarate, tenofovir alafenamide, entecavir, era n'eddagala eppya likyayongerwa okuvumbulwa. Eri abantu abamu abalina Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B, eddagala lino lisobola okutangira ekibumba obutalwala nnyo. Wabula si buli muntu alina Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B ogw'olukonvuba nti yeetaaga eddagala era eddagala lisobola okuvaako obuzibu, era liteekwa kumirwa lubeerera.

input: Lwaki obulwadde busajjuka nnyo ku bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde obwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu busobola okukwata omuntu singa obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwe bunafuyizibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obuwuka buno obuleeta obulwadde busobola okuva ku bunnakigwanyizi okutuukira ddala ku mbeera z'obulamu ezisajjuka olw'obwerinzi bw'omubiri obubeera bunafuye. Obujjanjabi bw'obuwuka obwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu buzingiramu enzijanjaba y'abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okwanganga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga ko n'obujjanjabi obw'enjawulo obw'obuwuka obulala kinnakimu.

input: Owulira otya ng'olina Kabootongo?
output: Obulwadde bwa kabootongo bulina obubonero obw’enjawulo okusinziira ku mutendera gw’obulwadde buno. Obulwadde bwa Kabootongo bulina emitendera ena: 1. Omutendera ogusooka, 2. Omutendera ogwokubiri, 3. Omutendera ogwokusatu  4. n'omutendera ogwokuna.1. Omutendera ogusooka ogw'obulwadde bwa Kabootongo gwe gwo obulwadde kwe busookera. Guyinza obutayoleka bubonero, naye akabonero akasinga okulabika kwe kufuna ekiwundu oba ebiwundu. Ekiwundu kitera okujja mu kifo akawuka we kaayingirira mu mubiri. Ekiwundu kitera okuba ekikalu era nga tekiruma era oluusi kiyinza obutamanyibwa. Ebitundu ekiwundu we kisangibwa mulimu obusajja, obukyala, ewava obubi, ekitundu eky'ekyenda ekya waggulu, emimwa, akamwa oba ebitundu ebirala byonna. Ekiwundu kitera okuwona ne bwe kiba nga tekifunye bujjanjabi.2. Obubonero ku mutendera ogwokubiri mulimu: okuyiwa obutulututtu ku lususu, ebiwundu mu bitundu by’ekyama, omusujja, okukala emimiro, okuzimba mu nnyingo, okulumwa omutwe, okukogga, okulumizibwa mu binywa, obukoowu n’obulala bingi. Obubonero bw’omutendera ogwokubiri nabwo busobola okuwona ne bwe kiba nga tebujjanjabiddwa.Omutendera ogwokusatu tegulaga bubonero bwonna era omuntu asobola okubeera n'obulwadde bwa Kabootongo okumala emyaka ne bw'aba tajjanjabiddwa. Omutendera ogwokuna; Abantu abalina obulwadde bwa Kabootongo bwe baba tebajjanjabiddwa basobola basobola okutuuka ku mutendera ogwokuna oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi. Omutendera guno ebitundu by'omubiri bingi bikosebwa obulwadde era obubonero businziira ku kitundu ky'omubiri ekikoseddwa. Omutendera guno gusobola okuvaako obuzibu ku mutima, ensigo, ekibumba, emisuwa egitambuza omusaayi n'ebitundu ebirala bingi. Obulwadde bwa Kabootongo obukwata ku bwongo, obulwadde bwa Kabootongo obukwata amaaso, n'obulwadde bwa Kabootongo obukwata amatu, bwe bulwadde bwa Kabootongo obuzingiramu obwongo n'omuyungiro gw'omubiri gwonna. Obulwadde bwa Kabootongo buno buleeta obubonero nga okulumwa omutwe, okukyankalana mu bwongo, okulumizibwa mu binywa, okukaluubirirwa mu kutambula, okusannyalala, okukyankalana mu bwongo, obuzibu mu kuwulira ne mu kulaba, n'okuviirako obwakiggala n'obwamuzibe.

input: Nsobola ntya okuyambako mu kukendeeza ku kusosolebwa olw'okuba n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Kyogereko mu lwatu, wesomese n’abalala, era kukubiriza okukubaganya ebirowoozo awatali kusala musango, kubanga okutegeera kiyamba okumenyawo okusosolebwa.

input: Lwaki kikulu okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu?
output: Okukozesa obupiira mu kwegatta kulina ebivaamu ebiwerako,  ebirungi era ebitangira, ebirina kye bigatta ku bulamu bw'okwegatta n'obw'okuzaala. Kikulu okukozesa obulungi obupiira mu butuufu bwabwo okusobola okwongera obulungi bw'enkola yaabwo n'okugobererera ebiragiro ebikuweebwa eyabukola. Okugatta ku ekyo, abantu ssekinnoomu balina okuwulira obutebenkevu mu nkozesa y'obupiira nga bali n'abantu be beegatta nabo okukakasa nti beegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga.

input: Bikolwa ki ku mutendera gw'ebitundu ebiyamba mu kuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Enkola z'embeerabantu ez'okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ziraze nti zikola bulungi ddala mu kutangira okukwatibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bantu ababadde tebakalina. Enkola ng'ezo zisobola okukendeeza ku nsimbi ezisaasaanyizibwa kubanga zisobola okutuuka ku bantu bangi abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka ku bisale ebitono ddala. Ezimu ku nkola embeerabantu z'ekozesa okutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mulimu; okwagazisa abantu okukozesa obupiira, n'enteekateeka z'okukyusa empiso ezijjanjaba.

input: Bwe mba n’Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, nnaakitegeererawo?
output: Si buli kiseera; Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obumu busobola okubeera nga tebulaga bubonero okumala ebbanga ddene.

input: Abasawo abakugu bayinza batya okuyamba ku bweraliikirivu obuli mu kugabana engoye n’obugoye bw'omunda?
output: Okugabana n'omuntu engoye ka kibeere obuwale ezoomunda oba eza bulijjo, kiyinza okukosa obulamu okusinziira ku mbeera ebeetoolodde n'embeera y’obulamu bw’abantu abakwatibwako. Zino ze zimu ku nsonga ez'okulowoozaako: Engoye, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde, embeera mwe mwambalira n'obuyonjo bw'omuntu. Okutwalira awamu, okugabana engoye n’omuntu kiyinza okuba ekya bulijjo mu mbeera ezimu, gamba nga b’omu maka oba mu mikwano egy’oku lusegere. Wabula kikulu okusoosowaza obuyonjo n’obulamu bw’omuntu okukendeeza ku bulabe bw’okukwatibwa endwadde nga bwe kisoboka. Bw’oba olina okweraliikirira ku biva mu kugabana engoye n’omuntu, kirungi okwebuuza ku mukugu mu byobulamu oba omusawo asobola okukuwa amagezi agasingawo okusinziira ku mbeera yo n’embeera y’ebyobulamu.

input: Kiramidiya asobola okukeberebwa mu musulo?
output: Okukebera Kiramidiya kuzuula bbakitiiriya ereeta Kiramidiya, Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, noolwekyo funa obujjanjabi. Omusawo wo akuggyako sampolo y’omusulo oba amazzi okuva mu bukyala bwo, mu busajja, oba mu kyenda ekinene n'agisindika mu kkeberero okwekenneenyezebwa. Ebivudde mu kukebera ebiseera ebisinga bifulumira mu lunaku lumu. Oluusi, abasawo bakozesa okwaluza obuwuka mu butaffaali bw'omubiri okuzuula Kiramidiya. Mu mbeera eno, omusawo wo akuggya amazzi mu bukyala, mu muyitiro gw'omusulo, oba awava obubi okufuna sampolo n'agisindika mu kkeberero okwekenneenyezebwa. Singa obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya busangibwamu, kitegeeza omuntu mulwadde. Abasawo bayinza okulondawo enkola eno ey'okukebera Kiramidiya okuzuula obuwuka awava obubi. Oba bayinza okukozesa enkola y'okwaluza obuwuka okulaba oba obujjanjabi bwa Kiramidiya bukola. Olw’okuba ng'emikisa giba mingi egy'okuba n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obw'enjawulo, abalwadde bonna abalina emu ku Ndwadde z'Ekikaba balina okwekenneenyezebwa okulaba oba balina akawuka ka Kiramidiya. Okukebera kuno kwonna tekuliimu bulabe bwonna. Emirundi egitali mingi, ebivudde mu kukebera biyinza obutawa kya nkomeredde oba kirambulukufu, era ng'oyinza okwetaaga okuggyibwako sampolo endala.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akatajjanjabiddwa kasobola okukoma okukukula ku lwako kokka?
output: Nedda, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekabulawo ku lwako kokka. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka ka lukonvuba era singa tekajjanjabibwa, kasigala mu mubiri obulamu bwonna. Omuntu bw’amala okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, akawuka kano kakwatagana n'endagaluse y’obutoffaali obumu obw’abaserikale b’omubiri, obuyitibwa CD4 T, ne kateekawo etterekero ly’obutoffaali obulina akawuka. Obutoffaali buno obulina akawuka bugenda mu maaso n’okukola akawuka kano, ekivaako akawuka okugenda mu maaso n'okwekubisaamu wamu n’okwonoona abaserikale b’omubiri. Awatali kuyambibwa kwa kisawo, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kakulaakulana  ne kayita mu mitendera egy'enjawulo, okuva ku nnakasooka okudda ku gw'obutalaga bubonero, n'okutuuka lwe kasuumuka okufuuka Siriimu. Mu mitendera gino, abaserikale b’omubiri banafuwa, era omuntu oyo n’akwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde olw'omubiri okunafuyizibwa akawuka n'ebika bya kookolo ebimu. Wabula okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okuddukanyizibwa obulungi n’enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, enzijanjaba  egatta eddagala eriziyiza okwekubisaamu kw’akawuka. Enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu zinga egobererwa nga yalagirwa, esobola okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka (obungi bw’akawuka mu musaayi) okutuuka ku mitendera gw'obutazuulibwa, ekisobozesa abaserikale b’omubiri okudda engulu n’okukola obulungi. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde ng'enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu esobola okulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, tewonyeza ddala bulwadde buno. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasigala mu ngeri enkweke mu butoffaali obumu, era obujjanjabi bulina okugenda mu maaso obulamu bwonna okusobola okukuuma okufufuggazibwa kw’akawuka n’okukuuma abaserikale b’omubiri.

input: Ngeri ki ze nsobola okuyitamu okuwagira mukwano gwange alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okuyamba mukwano gwo alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kiyinza okuleeta enjawulo ey’amaanyi mu bulamu bwe n’omutindo gw’obulamu bwe. Kikulu okuteekawo embeera ennungi, etaliimu  kumusalira musango, era ey’okweteeka mu bigere bye, asobole okuwulira nga mutebenkevu okukubuulira ku bimweraliikiriza ne by'ayitamu.

input: Abantu bakabirirwa nnyo ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga KKOVIDI-19?
output: Eddaala ly'okutya n'obweraliikirivu ebireetebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne KOVIDI-19 bisobola okwawukanira ddala okusinziira ku muntu ssekinnoomu by'ayiseemu, by'akkiririzaamu n'ebimwetoolodde.  Kizibu okwogera ekintu ky'otalinaako bujulizi ku kiki ekisinga okutiibwa kubanga zino ndwadde bbiri za njawulo n'ebizikwatako byawukanira ddala ssaako n'ebyo bye zireeta mu bantu. Kikulu okumanya nti okutya kintu kizibu era kwengangibwa obwongo mu ngeri ez'enjawulo okusinziira ku muntu.

input: Erinnya ki eddala eriyitibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akatalaga bubonero?
output: Okulumwa omutwe emirundi egiwerako ekiro n’okutuuyana byokka si bubonero bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obubonero bw'Akawuka akaleeta Sriimu busobola okwawukana nnyo mu bantu ssekinnoomu, era butera okweyoleka nga wayise wiiki okutuuka ku myezi oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa. Obubonero obusooka obw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obutera okuyitibwa obw'oku mutendera ogusooka ogw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba ng'omubiri gutandise okwerwanako oluvannyuma lw'okulumbibwa, muyinza okubaamu obwefaanaanyiriza obwa ssennyiga. Bw'oba olina obweraliikirivu ku Kawuka  akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu nnyo okwekebeza Akawuka kano. Okukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu y’engeri yokka ey’okuzuula obulungi bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okukebera kutera okukolebwa nga bakozesa omusaayi oba amazzi g’omu kamwa.

input: Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi kawuka ka bulwadde bwa kikaba?
output: Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama oba Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi, era amanyiddwa nga Kisipi, bulwadde obusaasaanyizibwa mu kwegatta obusobola okuleeta obutulututtu obulimu amazzi ku lususu nga buluma n’amabwa agasajjuka mu bitundu by’ekyama, naye era busobola obutalaga bubonero, ekitegeeza nti omuntu taba na bubonero. Businga kusaasaana ng'abantu bakwatagana ku lususu. Obulwadde bwa Kisipi buleetebwa obuwuka bwa Vvayiraasi bwa mirundi ebiri - Akawuka akaleeta Kisipi 1 akasaasaanyizibwa mu kukwatagana kw’emimwa, n'Akawuka akaleeta Kisipi 2 akasaasaanyizibwa mu kwegatta era nga ke kaleeta Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama. Eddagala erimu lisobola okukendeeza ku bubonero, naye ng'akawuka akaleeta Kisipi tekasobola kuwonyezebwa. Obubonero obujja nga bwe bugenda mu kamwa ne mu bitundu by’ekyama busobola okuleeta okweraliikirira. Wabula, ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo, abantu abasinga abalina ekimu ku bika bya Kisipi ebyo bamanyiira okubeera ne Kisipi oyo.

input: Lwaki kikulu okunywerera ku ART okuziyiza okukulaakulana kwa siriimu?
output: Abantu abasinga abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu beetaaga okwetooloolwa enkola esobola okubayamba mu kwanganga Akawuka. Wabula bw’oba toyagala kubuulira ku banno bw'oyimiridde ku Kawuka, funa engeri y'okugyangangamu eyinza obutakuteeka mu kukabirirwa. Bw’oba oli ku nkola ART ng’omusawo wo bw'akulungamya, olwo ojja kubeera n’omuwendo gw'Akawuka ogutasobola kuzuulibwa ekitegeeza Akawuka tekajja kufuuka Siriimu ekitegeeza ojja kuba tosobola kusiiga muntu mulala.

input: Ebyokulabirako bya Kiramidiya bye biri wa?
output: "Okukwatibwa kwa Kiramidiya mu bantu kutulubawazibwa okusinziira ku nsaasaana y'ekimuleeta, ebika bye, okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala."1. Kiramidiya ava ku buwuka bwa obumuleeta asaasaana okuyita mu kukwatagana wakati w'omuntu omulamu n'omulwadde. Muno mulimu ebika nga Kiramidiya akwata ebitundu by'ekyama n'akwata amaaso.2. Kiramidiya ava ku buwuka obumuleeta asaasaana okuyita mu mussizo/omuyitiro gw'empewo. Muno mulimu ebika nga Kiramidiya aleeta Omusujja gw'Enkusu ne Kiramidiya aleeta Lubyamira."

input: Waliwo emikisa gyonna egy'okufuna olubuto ng’omukyala ali mu nsonga?
output: Yee, kisoboka omuwala okufuna olubuto singa yeegatta ng’ali mu nsonga, wadde ng’emikisa gy’okufuna olubuto mu kiseera kino okutwalira awamu giba mitono bw’ogeraageranya n’emitendera emirala egy’omwetooloolo gw'okugenda mu nsonga. Kikulu okujjukira nti wadde ng'emikisa gy’okufuna olubuto okutwalira awamu mitono naye tegiggweerawo ddala. Okuziyiza embuto ezitali nneetegekere n'okuziyiza Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, abantu abeegatta balina okukozesa engeri ez'okutangira embuto ezeesigika n'okwegatta olutata mu ngeri ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga. Okugatta ku ekyo, okunoonya obuwabuzi okuva ew'omusawo oba akalwaliro akakola ku nkola z'ekizaalaggumba kiyinza okukuyamba okukuwa magezi ku kuziyiza embuto n'ebyokwegatta.

input: Osobola okusaba kitaawo mu lwatu okukulambika ku nnonda y'akapiira k'okukozesa mu biseera by’okwegatta?
output: Kikkirizibwa ddala era kikubirizibwa okunoonya okulambikibwa n'amagezi okuva mu bantu abakulu abeesigika, omuli abazadde, ku bulamu bw’okwegatta, enkola z'okuziyiza okufuna olubuto, n’enkola z’okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga. Okuwuliziganya mu bwerufu era mu mazima n'abazadde oba abantu abalala abakulu ab'obuvunaanyizibwa kisobola okuwa amawulire ag'omuwendo n'obuyambi bwe kituuka mu kukola okusalawo okutuufu bwe kituuka ku kusalawo okutuufu ku bikwata ku kwegatta n'okuziyiza okufuna embuto. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo ku kapiira ak'okukozesa oba weetaaga obubaka oba okumanyisibwa ku nkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, omuli n’okukozesa obulungi obupiira, okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga zino n’omuntu omukulu omumanyi era ategeera, gamba ng’omuzadde oba omusawo, kiyinza okuba eky’omuganyulo. Abazadde abamanyi obulungi ku bulamu bw'okwegatta basobola okuwa obuwabuzi ku nkozesa y'obupiira, obukulu bw'okutangira Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n'enneeyisa y'okwegatta ey'obuvunaanyizibwa. Kikulu okwogera ku bino mu ngeri ewa ekitiibwa era etasala musango, era abazadde balina okuba abeetegefu okuwa amawulire amatuufu n'okukola ku obweraliikirivu bwonna oba ebibuuzo byonna abaana baabwe bye bayinza okuba nabyo. Singa olw’ensonga yonna toli mutebenkevu mu kwogera ku nsonga zino na muzadde lowooza ku kunoonya obuwabuzi okuva ew'omusawo oba omubuziibuzi mu by'okwegatta asobola okukuwa obuwabuzi n'okuddamu ebibuuzo byo mu kyama.

input: Olowooza nti kya bulijjo oba kikkirizibwa okuba n'okwegomba okw'amaanyi okw'okwegatta n'obwongo bwange okuba nga buntuma okwegatta?
output: Okubeera n’obwagazi bw'okwegatta kya butonde era kya bulijjo mu bantu. Tewali kikyamu oba muze gwonna mu kufuna obwagazi bw'okwegatta. Kikulu okutegeera nti obwagazi bw’okwegatta kintu kikulu nnyo mu by'okwegatta kw’omuntu, era kuyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku maanyi ne ku mirundu omuntu gy'ayagaliramu okwegatta.

input: Tujjanjaba tutya Kabootongo mu bakyala?
output: Eddagala eritta bbakitiiriya erya Penicillin, bwe liba nga likozeseddwa bulungi era mu ddoozi entuufu, likola bulungi nnyo mu kujjanjaba Kabootongo. Tewaliiyo nzijanjaba ndala keebeere ya kinnansi oba ey'eddagala ezzungu, yaakakasiddwa nti ekola bulungi mu kujjanjaba Kabootongo. Enzijanjaba ya Kabootongo y'emu mu bantu bonna era nga teyeesigama ku kikula, emyaka, oba omutendera obulwadde kwe butuuse. Ekyawukana ze ddoozi ezigabibwa okusinziira ku myaka n'obuzito bw'omuntu. Omusawo wo y'asalawo ddoozi entuufu gy'olina okufuna.

input: Nninza kwekwata ntya okusobola okubuulira ku muntu ku bwe nnyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Nga tonnabuulirako balala, beera n’amawulire ag’ebuziba agakwata ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Omuntu oyo ayinza okulowooza nti tolina bbanga dddene lya buwangaazi  noolwekyo kikulu okumugumya nti kizuuliddwa kyokka so si kibonerezo kya kufa.

input: Nsobola okufuna Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama singa ngabana eby’okuzannyisa by’okwegatta n’omuntu alina akawuka akamuleeta?
output: Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama asinga kusiigibwa ng'omuntu akwataganye n'Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akamuleeta, amalusu, n'ebitundu by'omunda w'akamwa oba okwetooloola akamwa. Tekitera kubaawo, naye nga asobola okusiigibwa mu bitundu by’ekyama nga bikwataganye n’akamwa ne kireeta Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama oba Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi, era amanyiddwa nga Kisipi. Buyinza okusiigibwa okuva mu kamwa oba munda mu kamwa, oba ku ngulu ku lususu olulabika ng'olulamu; wabula akatyabaga akasinga obunene ak’okusiiga kwe kubaawo kw'ebiwundu ebisajjufu. Abantu abaakwatibwa edda Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1 tebali mu katyabaga ka kuddamu kukwatibwa kawuka mulundi mulala, naye nga bakyali mu katyabaga k’okufuna Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2. Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2 kasinga kusaasaanyizibwa kuyita mu kwegatta mu kukwatagana kw’ebitundu by’ekyama oba olususu olwetoolodde awafulumira obubi, olususu, ebiwundu oba amazzi g’omuntu alina akawuka kano. Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2 kasobola okusiigibwa ne bwe kiba nti olususu lulabika ng'olulamu era nga katera okusiigibwa nga tewali bubonero bulabirwako kawuka. Mu mbeera ezitatera kubaawo, Kisipi (Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-1 ne Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi-2) busobola okusiigibwa okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana mu kiseera ky'okuzaala, ekivaako omwana omuwere okukwatibwa Kisipi.

input: Kiki ekinaabaawo singa omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ayosa okumira eddagala lya ARV?
output: Obutakozesa nkola eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'owangaala nako kiyinza okuvaamu ebizibu eby’amaanyi era ebiyinza okuvaako okufa. ARVs kitundu kya nkizo ku bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kijja kukuviirako Akawuka okweyongera mu musaayi ekiyinza okutegeeza nti kijja kuba kyangu okuwatibwa endwadde ezisobola okukutta.

input: Pulogulaamu z'okukyusa empiso ezijjanjaba ziyamba zitya mu kukendeeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Pulogulaamu z'okukyusa empiso ezijjanjaba zibadde ziragibwa okuba nga zikola bulungi mu kukendeeza ku nneeyisa eziteeka obulamu mu katyabaga ezeekuusa ddagala (okugeza okugabana empiso) awatali kwongera ku kusaasaana kwa kukozesa ddagala okw'awamu mu bantu abakulu oba mu bavubuka.

input: Mbuulira Enziku kye ki?
output: Enziku kawuka akaleeta obulwadde bw'ekikaba ak'ekika kya bbakitiiriya ekeeyoleka ennyo era nga kaziyizika n'okuwonyezeka nga kasinga kukwata mumwa gwa nnabaana mu bakyala wamu n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo mu basajja. Ebitundu ebirala ebikosebwa mulimu ekyenda ekinene, ebitundu by'omukyala ebizaala, akamwa, omumiro oba amaaso mu baana nga bazaalibwa. Enziku era eyitibwa "Kkiraapu" oba "Dduliipu."

input: Mu kiseera ki eky'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu emikisa gy'okukasaasaanya lwe gyeyongera?
output: Omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okukasiiga ku mutendera gwonna ogw'akawuka omuli omu kiseera nga talaga bubonero, ogw'olukonvuba, n'ogw'okusajjuka. Wabula eddaala ly'okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'akatyabaga k'okukasaasaanya bisobola okwawukana okusinziira ku mitendera egy'enjawulo akawuka kwe katuuse. Eno y'ennambika ey'awamu eraga ensiiga y'akawuka gy'egenda ekyukamu buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero: Omutendera gw'obutalaga bubonero gumala akaseera katono oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka, nga wiiki nga ziizo ezisooka. Omutendera gw'olukonvuba: Oluvannyuma lw'omutendera ogutalaga bubonero, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kayingira omutendera gw'olukonvuba.

input: Muganda wange obulamu bwe bwonna abadde n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; asobola okukasiiga omuntu?
output: Abantu ssekinnoomu abazaaliddwa n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era nga bazuuliddwamu akawuka kano basobola okukasiiga abalala okuyita mu mikutu egimu singa ebirina okukolebwa okutangira kino okutuukawo biba tebigobereddwa. Kikulu okumanya nti abantu ssekinnoomu abamanyi we bayimiridde ku mbeera y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti bamulina era nga bafuna obujjanjabi obw'ekisawo, basobola okugoberera emitendera gy'okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusiiga abalala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ebiva mu kukebera Kabootongo eby’enjawulo bitegeeza ki?
output: Okukebera obutoffaali obulwanyisa endwadde nga tebukwatagana bulungi na kawuka ka bbakitiiriya kaleeta Kabootongo. Okukebera kuno kutera kukozesebwa nga enkola y'okwekebejja wadde ng'obutoffaali buno obulwanyisa endwadde butera okukolebwa ng’omuntu alina Kabootongo, era busobola okukolebwa olw'ensonga endala. Ebiseera ebisinga oyinza obutazuulwamu butoffaali bulwanyisa ndwadde ng'omaze okujjanjabibwa Kabootongo. Okukebera okulala okukakasa kusobola okukolebwa nga beeyambisa enkola ya treponemal. Enkola y'okukebera endagabutonde ya bbakitiiriya: Enkola eno enoonya ndagabutonde y'akawuka ka bbakitiriya. Wabula, oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa, obutoffaali obulwanyisa endwadde buyinza okutwala ssabbiiti eziwerako okutondebwa. Noolwekyo, oyinza okwetaaga okwekebejjebwa okulala bw'oba olowooza nti waliko mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Kabootongo. Omusawo wo asobola okukubuulira oba weetaaga okwekebejjebwa okulala.

input: Ng’oggyeeko okunywegera, abakyala basiiga batya abasajja Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kyokka nga tebafulumya mazzi ga nkwaso?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu makubo ag’enjawulo ag’okukwatagana, era tekikoma ku kuwaanyisiganya mazzi ga mubiri agalimu enkwaso. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu makubo gano wammanga: okukwatagana n’omusaayi, maama okusiiga mwana, okuteekebwako omusaayi ogulina akawuka, okufumitibwa empiso mu butanwa, n’okusimbuliza ebitundu by’omubiri. Kikulu okuggumiza nti abaami n'abakyala bombi buli omu ayinza okusiiga munne Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekisinziira ku kubaawo kwa nkwaso kwokka.

input: Nsobola okufuna Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba okuva mu kwegattira mu kamwa?
output: Yee, Obuwuka obuleeta oObulwadde bw’Ekikaba busobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu ngeri yonna ey’okwegatta omuli n’okukozesa akamwa. Emikisa gy’okusaasaanya Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba giba mingi mu bantu abeegatta nga bakozesa akamwa, oba awayita obubi, wamu n'abo abeegatta n’abantu abangi. Era busobola okusaasaanyizibwa mu kiseera ky'okuba olubuto, mu kuzaala, okuyonsa, n’okuyita mu musaayi ogulimu obuwuka.

input: Nsonga ki ekwata ku bwebulungulule ekosa ekiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Ebiseera by’okutuuka mu myaka gy’obuvubuka bisobola okwawukana ennyo okusinziira ku muntu, era ensonga eziwerako zisobola okufuga ku ddi lwe gitandika: Endagabuzaale: Obuzaale bwo bukola kinene mu kuzuula ddi obuvubuka bwo lwe bunaatandika. Singa bazadde bo baatandika okuvubuka nga bukyali oba ekikeerezi, kiyinzika nnyo nti naawe ojja kukikola. Endya n’obulamu bwo: Endya ennungi n’obulamu okutwalira awamu bisobola okuyambako mu nkula y'omubiri n'okukulaakulana kw'obwongo ebirungi, omuli n’ebiseera by’okutuuka mu myaka egy’obuvubuka. Ensonga ezikwata ku butonde: Okukozesa eddagala erimu, okweraliikirira, n’ebintu ebirala ebiva mu butonde nabyo bisobola okukosa ekiseera ky’okutuukirako mu myaka gy’obuvubuka. Kikulu okujjukira nti waliwo ebintu bingi ebitwalibwa ng’ebya bulijjo bwe kituuka ku myaka gy’obuvubuka. Bw’oba weeraliikirira ekiseera ky’ogenda okutuukirako mu myaka gy’obuvubuka, okwogera n’omusawo kusobola okukugumya n’okukuwa okulambikibwa.

input: Omuntu ayinza atya okukuuma ebyama bye nga bw'ajjanjabibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’oyagala okufuna eddagala ng’abooluganda lwo tebamanyi, waliwo emitendera egiwerako gy’osobola okuyitamu okukuuma eby’ekyama byo nga bw’ofuna n'obujjanjabi obwetaagisa: Obujjanjabi obw’ekyama, okukozesa yinsuwa ey’obwannannyini oba okwesasulira, okusaba embeera yo okukuumibwa nga ya kyama, okwetuukira ku bifo ewafunirwa eddagala, empeereza y’eddagala eriweerezebwa ku mmeyiro, enteekateeka z’okuyambibwko ku by'eddagala, ebibiina n'obuweeereza obw'oku mutimbagano ebiyamba ku bantu balina akawuka, n’obukuumi mu mateeka. Jjukira nti kyetaagisa okugenda mu maaso n’okumira eddagala lyo ery'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bwe likulagiddwa okusobola okuddukanya obulungi akawuka. Obujjanjabi obw'obutayosaamu n’okulabirirwa okw'eskisawo bikulu nnyo mu bulamu bwo n’embeera yo ennungi. Ng'okolaganira wamu n'abasawo abakulembeza okukusika ebikukwatakao n'okugoberera emitendera egimenyeddwa waggulu, osobola okufuna obujjanjabi n’eddagala eryetaagisa ate nga bw'okuuma ebikukwatako nga bya kyama.

input: Nsobola okwegattira mu kamwa ne muganzi wange singa mba nnina Kiramidiya?
output: Bwe kituuka ku by'okwegattira mu kamwa n'omubeezi wo, kisoboka:•        Okukwatibwa Kiramidiya ow'obukyala, ow'obusajja oba ow'ewava obubi bw'oba weegattidde mu kamwa n'omuntu alina Kiramidiya w'emimiro.•        Okusiiga Kiramidiya ow'obukyala, ow'obusajja oba ow'ewava obubi bwe weegattira mu kamwa ng'olina Kiramidiya w'emimiro.

input: Kirungi okuggyamu olubuto singa mbeera ndufunye?
output: Okusalawo okuggyamu embuto kisinziira ku muntu era kizibu, era kifugibwa embeera ez’enjawulo, omuli omuntu by'okkiririzaamu, empisa, embeera mw'ali n'amateeka g’ensi oba ekitundu mw’obeera. Kusalawo okulina okukolebwa oluvannyuma lw’okulowooza ennyo era, n'okwebuuza ku musawo n'omubuziibuzi abayinza okukuwa obubaka n'okukuyamba.

input: Mpeereza ki eziweebwa ku ddwaliro erikola ku bulamu bw’okwegatta?
output: Obulwaliro bw'ebyobulamu bw'okwegatta bukebera, okujjanjaba, n'okusomesa ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba n'ebyobulamu bw'okwegatta.

input: Ngeri ki esinga obulungi okukebera Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo?
output: Okukebera Kiramidiya kuzuula bbakitiiriya ereeta Kiramidiya, Akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, noolwekyo funa obujjanjabi. Omusawo wo akuggyako sampolo y’omusulo oba amazzi okuva mu bukyala bwo, mu busajja, oba mu kyenda ekinene n'agisindika mu kkeberero okwekenneenyezebwa. Ebivudde mu kukebera ebiseera ebisinga bifulumira mu lunaku lumu. Oluusi, abasawo bakozesa okwaluza obuwuka mu butaffaali bw'omubiri okuzuula Kiramidiya. Mu mbeera eno, omusawo wo akuggya amazzi mu bukyala, mu muyitiro gw'omusulo, oba awava obubi okufuna sampolo n'agisindika mu kkeberero okwekenneenyezebwa. Singa obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya busangibwamu, kitegeeza omuntu mulwadde. Abasawo bayinza okulondawo enkola eno ey'okukebera Kiramidiya okuzuula obuwuka awava obubi. Oba bayinza okukozesa enkola y'okwaluza obuwuka okulaba oba obujjanjabi bwa Kiramidiya bukola. Olw’okuba ng'emikisa giba mingi egy'okuba n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba obw'enjawulo, abalwadde bonna abalina emu ku Ndwadde z'Ekikaba balina okwekenneenyezebwa okulaba oba balina akawuka ka Kiramidiya. Okukebera kuno kwonna tekuliimu bulabe bwonna. Emirundi egitali mingi, ebivudde mu kukebera biyinza obutawa kya nkomeredde oba kirambulukufu, era ng'oyinza okwetaaga okuggyibwako sampolo endala.

input: Olufumo kye kimu n'endowooza enkyamu?
output: Nedda, olufumo n'amawulire amakyamu bifaanaganamu naye si  bye bimu. Olufumo lubeera luba n'ensibuko ku byobuwangwa, sso ng'ate amawulire amakyamu gasibuka ku muntu ne gasaasaanira abalala olw'obutamanya.

input: Kiki ekiwonya Kiramidiya?
output: Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo ajjanjabibwa era awonyezebwa mu nnaku oba wiiki entonotono. Kiramidiya atali wa maanyi nnyo ajjanjabibwa n'empeke ezitta bbakitiiriya omuli azithromycin oba doxycycline. Okuddamu okukwatibwa Kiramidiya kusobola okubaawo singa be weegatta nabo tebajjanjabibwa, era singa abantu beegatta nga tebeetangidde n'omuntu alina Kiramidiya. Abaana abawere abalina Kiramidiya w’amaaso bajjanjabibwa ne azithromycin. Abantu balina okulindako okwegatta okumala ennaku 7 oluvannyuma lw'okumira eddagala lya Kiramidiya oba bwe kiba nga tekisoboka bakozese obupiira mu ngeri entuufu. Balina okutegeeza be beegatta nabo okukeberebwa n'okujjanjabibwa, bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

input: Singa weegatta ne muganzi wo omulenzi alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era nga ku mmwe mwembi tekuli alina biwundu mu kiseera ekyo, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu kwegatta, ne bwe kiba nti tewali ku baagalana tewali alina biwundu oba amabwa ebirabika. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu mazzi g’omubiri, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g'ekiakazi, awava obubi n'amabeere. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde emikisa gy'kusaasaana kw'Akawuka gikendedde nnyo olw'ennambika eziteereddwawo gamba nga obujjanjabi obulungi n'okukozesa obupiira, wakyaliwo akatyabaga akatonotono ak'okusaasaana.

input: Mbuulira obubonero bwa Kiramidiya.
output: "Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa ng'Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo tekatera kwoleka bubonero, naye nga kasobola okuleeta obuzibu obw'amaanyi ku bulamu, wadde nga tekalaze bubonero. Singa obubonero bweyoleka, kiyinza okutwala ssabbiiti eziwera oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta n'omuntu akalina.                                                                                                                                                               1. Mu bakyala, obubonero bw'akawuka obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu eby'ekayama mulimu enkyukakyuka mu langi y'amazzi agava mu bukyala (enjeru, kyenvu, oba kitosi agayinza okuba nga gawunya), okuddingana mu nsonga oba okuvaamu omusaayi oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta, obulumi mu ndira, n'okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa.2. Mu baami, obubonero obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu by'ekyama oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka kano mulimu okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa, okuvaamu amazzi agalinga eminyira mu busajja n'obulumi mu nsigo.3. Okukwatibwa akawuka kano ewafulumira obubi mu baami n'abakyala kiyinza okuleeta obulumi, amazzi agalinga eminyira n'okuvaamu omusaayi. Singa omulwadde aba n'obulwadde bw'ensanjabavu, obubonero obusooka okweyoleka mulimu amabwa mu bitundu by’ekyama, oluvannyuma okuzimba n'okulumizibwa kw'ensanjabavu mu bitundu by’ekyama ebiruma.

input: Osobola okunnyonnyola PEP mu bimpimpi?
output: PEP kye kigambo ekitegeeza "Post-Exposure Prophylaxis." Eno y'enkola y'ekisawo etangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'omuntu okwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okukafuna. PEP etera kukozesebwa mu mbeera nga waliwo akatyabaga ak'amaanyi akamanyiddwa akayinza okuleeta omuntu okufuna Akawuka. Kikulu okumanya nti PEP tesobola kusikira nkola za kutangira Kawuka akaleeta Siriimusi ezimanyiddwa, okugeza, okukozesa obupiira ne PrEP eri abantu abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP ddagala eritangira okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'omuntu tanneetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okumuviirako okumufuna, sso nga ate PEP ekozesebwa oluvannyuma lw'akatyabaga ak'amaanyi. Bw'oba olowooza nti obadde mu katyabaga k'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, noonya omusawo amangu ddala mwogeremu ozuule oba PEP y'enkola esaana embeera gy'olimu.

input: Omuntu asobola okuteebereza emikisa mu kukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mulundi gumu ogw'okwegatta?
output: Emikisa gy’omuntu okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kiseera ky’okwegatta omulundi gumu giyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku bintu ebiwerako, omuli ekika ky’okwegatta, okubeerawo kw’ebintu ebiyinza okuteeka omuntu mu katyabaga, oba nga n'enkola ez’okuziyiza zikozesebwa. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde okusiiga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kisoboka, si tteeka nti kujja kubaawo mu kiseera ky’okwegatta kwonna okw'ekiseera ekimu. Kizibu okumanya mikisa emeka omuntu gy'aba nagyo okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu lwegatta lumu kubanga akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka kafugibwa ensonga eziwerako. Kaweefube w’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu agendererwamu okukendeeza ku katyabaga ng'ayita mu kusomesa, okukozesa obupiira, okukeberebwa entakera, n’okukozesa PrEP eri abantu ssekinnoomu abali mu katyabaga ak’amaanyi ak’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Njawulo ki eriwo wakati wa PrEPs ne PEPs?
output: PEP ne PrEP zonna nkola za nzijajnjaba za kuziyiza kukwatibwa kwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, naye nga zikozesebwa mu mbeera ez'enjawulo era ne ku lw'emigaso egy'enjawulo. PEP lye ddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu erikozesebwa okumala ekiseera ekimpi erimiribwa oluvannyuma lw'okubeera mu mbeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga k'okokwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Likozesebwa okutangira okukwatibwa kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu mbeera ng'omuntu abadde mu mbeera emuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka kano, okugeza okwegatta okutaliimu kwetangira, okugabana empiso, oba okubeera mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka olw'omulimu. input: Tunaasobola okuwangaalira awamu ne mukwano gwange singa aba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okukosa obulamu bw’omuntu singa takajjanjabwa oba singa kakwatibwa bubi. Wabula, singa kazuulibwa mu bwangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi omuli n'enkola ey'okukaweweezaako, abantu bangi abakalina basobola okuwangaala era ne babeera mu bulamu obweyagaza. Mu bufunze, wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kizibu kya maanyi eyinza okukosa obulamu singa tekajjanjabwa, si ndwadde etiisa kutuusa kutwala bulamu nga bwe gwali ekyali edda, okusiima okw'enjawulo kugende eri eby'obujjanjabi ebikuze. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaalira mu bulamu obweyagaza singa kazuulibwa mangu era ne kajjanjabibwa bulungi. Kikulu okunoonya obujjanjabi, okubunywererako, n'okusoosowaza obulamu obulungi okutwaliza awamu okusobola ekisinga obulungi. Okulondoolwa kw'obulamu entakera n'okwogera n'abasawo mu bwesimbu bikulu nnyo mu kujjanjaba obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Kya bulijjo okuba ng'ennaku ze ngenderako mu nsonga tezikyukakyuka nga nnakatandika okugenda mu nsonga?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo nnyo okubeera n'ennaku z'ogenderako mu nsonga ezikyukakyuka. Ennaku z'okugenda mu nsonga ezikyukakyuka zisobola okutegeeza ebintu eby’enjawulo: Obuwanvu bw'ebbanga ly'omala okudda mu nsonga: Omwetoloolo gw'ennaku zo kw'ogendera mu nsonga guyinza obutenkanankana buwanvu buli mwezi. Obungi bw'omusaayi: Obungi bw'omusaayi ogukuvaamu ng'oli mu nsonga busobola okwawukana okuva ku mwezi ogumu okudda ku mulala. Ebbanga: Ennaku z’omala ng'oli mu nsonga nazo zisobola okwawukana. Kisobola okutwala emyaka emitonotono omwetoloolo gw'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala okutereera. Bw’oba weeraliikirira ku kukyukakyuka kw'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala oba ng'ovaamu omusaayi mungi nnyo, mutono nnyo, oba nga zikuleetera obulumi obw’amaanyi, kirungi okwogerako n’omusawo. Basobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuyambi okuzuula oba buli kimu kiri mu mbeera nnungi. Jjukira nti okugenda mu nsonga kitundu kya butonde era kya bulijjo mu bulamu eri abantu bangi.

input: Okukebera omusaayi kuyinza kukozesebwa kutya okuzuula Akafuba?
output: Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okukeberebwa akafuba buli kaseera. Waliwo engeri nnyingi ez'okukebera akafuba:Okukebera omusaayi kye kikozesebwa ennyo, nga bakebera sampolo y'olukusense (omukka ogukolondolwa) oba ekintu ekirala eky'omubiri. Okugatta ku ekyo, akatundu katono ak'obutaffaali bw'akafuba kasobola okukubibwa wansi w'olususu okulaba oba waliwo ekikyuse. Okukuba ekifaananyi kya X-ray nakyo kikozesebwa okukebera oba akafuba kasse amawuggwe go.

input: Okugoberera endya ennungi kiyinza okuyamba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okubeera omulamu obulungi?
output: Okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna kikulu eri buli muntu, nga mw'otwalidde n'abo abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri, okukendeeza ku bubonero obuyinza okuva mu ddagala lya ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n'okutumbula obulamu obulungi. Jjukira nti endya kintu kikulu nnyo mu bulamu, era emmere erimu ebiriisa byonna esobola okuyamba obwerinzi bw'omubiri gwo n'okukuyamba okulwanyisa obulungi Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obwetaavu bw'emmere obw'enjawulo busobola okwawukana, noolwekyo kikulu okukolagana n'omusawo w'ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu byendya okukola enteekateeka y'endya ey'omuntu ey'enjawulo etunuulira ebiruubirirwa byo ebyobulamu n'ebyetaago byo.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kakosa katya obulamu bw'omuntu?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne Siriimu bisobola okukosa ennyo obulamu bw’omuntu mu ngeri ez’enjawulo mu mubiri, mu birowoozo, ne mu mbeera z’abantu. Kikulu okumanya nti enkulaakulana mu ssaayansi w’obusawo ekyusizza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu okuva ku bulwadde obwali butta edda n’efuuka embeera ey’olubeerera esobola okuddukanyizibwa. Okuzuula amangu obulwadde, okufuna obujjanjabi, n’okunywerera ku ddagala eriweweeza ku kawuka akaleeta Siriimu birongoosezza nnyo obulamu n’omutindo gw’obulamu bw’abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Obuwagizi okuva mu basawo, obuweereza bw'embeerabantu, n'omukutu gw'obuyambi ogw'amaanyi bisobola okuyamba abantu ssekinnoomu okuyita mu kusoomoozebwa okukwatagana n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu n'okubeera n'obulamu obumatiza.

input: Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bamira eddagala erikaweweeza obulamu bwabwe bwonna?
output: Obujjanjabi obuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obuzingiramu eddagala erijjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwa lubeerera kasita omuntu abutandika. Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'obujjanjabi buno kwe kusobola okukkakkanya okwekubisaamu kw'akawuka kano mu mubiri okusobozesa obwerinzi bw'omubiri okuddamu okukola obulungi nga bwe gwali. Obujjanjabi buno tebuwonya Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu naye busobola bulungi okukaweweeza n'okukaziyiza okuleeta endwadde kw'ossa okuwa omuntu obulamu obulungi.

input: Omanyi Kabootongo kye ki?
output: Obulwadde bwa Kabootongo Bulwadde bwa Kikaba obuleetebwa akawuka ka bbakitiiriya. Obulwadde bwa Kabootongo busaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu kwegattira mu kamwa mu bitundu by’ekyama, n’awava obubi ne mu kiseera eky'okuba olubuto. Busobola okukosa ebitundu by'omubiri byonna ekiviirako obuzibu obw'amaanyi ku bulamu. Wabula, busobola okutangirwa era n'okuwonyezebwa.

input: Okumira eddagala eriweweeza ku bulumi nga tonnakeberebwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu kukyusakyusa mu biva mu kukebera ne biraga nti omuntu talina kawuka?
output: Nedda, okumira eddagala eriweweeza ku bulumi oba eddagala lyonna ly'oguze okuva ku ttundiro ly'eddagala nga tonnakeberebwa Kawuka akaleeta  Siriimu tekijja kukosa bivudde mu kukeberebwa. Enkebera z'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, gamba ng’okukebera obutaffaali obulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obuli mu musaayi oba okukebera okubeerawo kw'endagaluse y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu musaayi, zikolebwa okuzuula oba waliwo kw'akawuka oba obutaffaali obulwanyisa akawuka mu musaayi gwo oba mu mazzi amalala ag’omubiri. Enkebera zino zikola nga zibaako obubonero obw'enjawulo bwe zizuula oba obutaffaali bw'endagaluse y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okugoberera ebiragiro ebitongole ebiweebwa omusawo w'ebyobulamu oba ekifo ewakebererwa mu kwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okutwalira awamu, tewali bukwakkulizo ku mmere oba ddagala by'otalina kukozesa nga tonnaba kwekebeza Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu, era teweetaaga kwewala oba okumira eddagala lyonna nga weetegekera okukeberebwa.

input: Okuzuula akawuka ka siriimu kuyinza kutya okukosa embeera y’omuntu mu nneewulira?
output: Okuzuulibwa nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kiyinza okukusoomooza mu bwongo, era kya bulijjo okwewulira mu ngeri ezitali zimu, omuli okwennyamira, okweraliikirira, okutya, n’obutali bukakafu. Wabula kikulu okumanya nti waliwo engeri ennungi ez'okukkakkanya  n'okuvvuunuka okwennyamira okwekuusa ku bivudde mu kukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Nkole ki singa mpulira nga ntya okwekebeza Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba mu ddwaliro?
output: Kya bulijjo okuwulira ng’otya, noolwekyo gezaako okuleeta mukwano gwo akuwe obuwagizi.

input: Kituufu nti okukozesa akaweke akagema okufuna olubuto (P2) kusobola okuggyamu olubuto?
output: Kikulu okunnyonnyola nti okukozesa obuweke obuziyiza okufuna olubuto obw'embeera ey'amangu, okumanyiddwa ennyo nga "Plan B" oba "empeke y'oku makya" (etera okufunzibwa nga P2 mu bitundu ebimu), tekugenderera kuyimiriza lubuto lubaddemu kukula. Enkola ya kizaalaggumba ey'obwangu yakolebwa kutangira kufuna lubuto bwe limiribwa nga wayiseewo akaseera katono oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta awatali kwetangira oba ng'enkola ya kizaalaggumba ebadde ekozesebwa egaanye okukola. Ekikulu ky'ekola kwe kulwisaawo oba okuziyiza okufulumya eggi n’okukendeeza ku mikisa gy'enkwaso okuwakisa eggi. Omuntu bw’asangibwa ng'abadde lubuto, kizaalaggumba ow'obwangu ebeera tejja kukola ku oba kuggyamu olubuto olwatonda edda. Empeke ya kizaalaggumba ey'amangu si nkola ya kuggyamu lubuto era terina kukozesebwa na kigendererewa kya kuggyamu lubuto. Bw’oba oteebereza nti oyinza okuba olubuto oba ng’olina ekikweraliikiriza ku lubuto, kyetaagisa okwebuuza ku musawo okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri gy’oyinza okukolamu n’okufuna okulambikibwa n’okulabirirwa okutuufu. Bw’oba onoonya okutangira okufuna olubuto oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta nga teweetangidde oba okulemererwa kw'enkola ya kizaalagguumba gy'obadde okozesa, eddagala eriziyiza okuzaala ery’amangu lirina okumiribwa amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka, ekisinga obulungi mu ssaawa 72 (ennaku 3) oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta, okusobola okusinga okukola obulungi.

input: Osalawo otya ddi lw’ogenda okubuulirako maama wo nti ozuuliddwamu Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okusalawo ddi n’engeri y’okutegeeza maama wo oba omuntu yenna ow’omu maka nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kusalawo kwa muntu ku bubwe nnyo era emirundi mingi kusoomooza. Tewali kya kuddamu kimu, kubanga kisinziira ku mbeera yo ssekinnoomu, enkolagana yo ne maama wo, n’obwetegefu bwo mu birowoozo. Bino bye bintu by’olina okulowoozaako ng’osalawo ddi lw’olina okubuulira maama wo: obutebenkevu bwo n’okwetegeka kwo, enkola y’okukuwagira, obudde, obwetegefu bwe mu birowoozo, ebikozeesebwa, okulambikibwa kw’ekikugu, okulowooza ku byetaago bye, emmizi n’ebyama, okulowooza ku mateeka n’empisa, n’okwenoonyeza obuyambi ku ggwe kennyini. Mu nkomerero, okusalawo okutegeeza maama wo embeera yo ey’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kya buntu nnyo, era olina okukikola ng’owulira ng’ekiseera kituufu era nti kikwatagana n’ebyetaago byo n’okwetegeka mu birowoozo. Kisobola okukuyamba okwegezaamu by’oyagala okwogera n’okusuubira ebibuuzo bye, naye kikulu okujjukira nti tosobola kufuga ngeri gy’anaakitwalamu, era kiyinza okumutwalira ekiseera obwongo bwe okumulungula amawulire ago. Beera mugumiikiriza era omusaasizi gy'ali n'eri ggwe kennyini nga mugezaako okuyita mu mboozi eno esoomooza mwembi.

input: Nkyayinza okugenda ku ssomero singa mba ndi lubuto?
output: Yee, olina eddembe okweyongerayo n'emisomo gyo ne mu kiseera ng'oli lubuto.

input: Nkubirize muganzi wange tugende twekebeze Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Yee, ddala, bw’oba obaddeko mu kwegatta okutaliimu kwetangira mazima ddala, olina okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Bitongole bya ngeri ki ebiwa okubudaabudibwa n'okuyamba abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Sisobola kuwa butereevu mikutu gya mutimbagano kusangibwa kubudaabudibwa ku by'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu wabula, nsobola okulungamya ku mikutu ki w'oyinza okusanga okubudaabudibwa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu: ebitongole by'eggwanga eby'ebyobulamu, ebitongole ebiyamba ku balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu, eby'oku mutimbagano, amalwaliro ag'oku bitundu, ennamba z'amasimu z'okubako okumanya ebikwata ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, ebitongole eby'omu bitundu, n'obuweereza obwekuusa ku bwongo.

input: Okwogera ku bulamu bw’okwegatta kuyinza kutya okuganyula buli muntu yenna akwatibwako?
output: Okwogera mu lwatu ku bulamu bw’okwegatta kiyamba abantu okufuna amawulire amatuufu, okukendeeza ku kuvumwavumwa, okusalawo mu ngeri entuufu, n’okunoonya okulabirira nga bukyali nga kyetaagisa.

input: Sirina bubonero bwonna bwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, nnina okukeberebwa?
output: Obubonero busobola okwawukana okuva ku muntu okudda ku mulala. Wadde nga tewali bubonero bulabika, kikulu okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kubanga eri abantu abamu, kitwala emyaka nga kkumi nga tebannalaba bubonero.

input: Okubeera n’ebigere ebiwunya kutegeeza nti nnina Kabootongo?
output: Kabootongo w’omutendera ogusooka n’ogwokubiri alina akakwate n’ebiwundu n’olususu okuyiwa era nga bwe bubonero obusinga okweyoleka. Buno ebiseera ebimu tebuluma ate era tebusiiwa ne bwe buba nga tebujjanjabiddwa mu ssabbiiti ntono ng'obufunye. Busobola okweyolekera ku kitundu kyonna eky’omubiri, naye ebifo ebisinga okukwatibwa mulimu ebitundu by’ekyama, obusajja, obukyala, awava obubi, ekitundu ky'awava obubi ekya waggulu, akamwa, ebibatu ne mu ntobo z'ebigere. Ebiwundu bya Kabootoongo oluusi biba bikalu era nga tebiruma era oluusi birabika nga enjatika. Bw’oba ng’olina ebiwundu ku mubiri gwo naddala mu bitundu byo eby'ekyama, laba omusawo wo akwekebejje.

input: Kisoboka omuntu okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teyeetangidde ne katamukwata?
output: Okwenyigira mu kikolwa ky'okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teweetangidde kikuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusaasaana okuyita mu mazzi  g’omubiri agamu, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g'ekikyala, amazzi agava ewava obubi, n'amabeere. Okwegatta nga teweetangidde (mu bukyala, ewava obubi oba mu kamwa) n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okuvaako akawuka kano okusaasaana.

input: Buzibu ki obuli mu kukozesa okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okwetangira naddala ng'okozesa obupiira mu kwegatta ngeri nnungi ey’okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Obupiira singa bubaba bukozeseddwa bulungi era buli mulundi gwe weegatta, busobola okukola nga ekiziyiza ekitangira okuwaanyisiganya kw'amazzi g'omubiri agalimu Akawuka ka vvayiraasi.

input: Kituufu nti abakyala bokka be basobola okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba?
output: Ekyo kya bulimba; omuntu yenna eyeegatta asobola okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, awatali kufaayo ku kikula kya muntu, kale kikulu buli muntu okwekuuma n’obutabeera mu katyabaga.

input: Ddi lwe nnyinza okuddamu okwegatta oluvannyuma lw'okujjanjabwa Enziku?
output: Ggwe n'omubeezi wo tubakubiriza okwewala okwegatta okumala waakiri ennaku musanvu nga mumazeeyo obujjanjabi. Singa mwegatta nga tewannayita nnaku musanvu, mukozese akapiira. Singa temugoberera mitendera gino gyonna, musobola okuddamu ne mukwatibwa Enziku era embeera eyinza okusajjuka.

input: Abalwadde ba Siriimu baweebwa obuwunga okukola obuugi era bwe bukola mulimu ki?
output: Okuwa obuyambi bw’emmere, omuli n’obuwunga bw’obuugi, eri abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu oba abo abalina Akawuka kano nkola eyinza okuba ekitundu ku nteekateeka nnamutaayiika ey'okuyambako abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekigendererwa ky’okuwa obuyambi bw’emmere obw’engeri eno kirimu emiganyulo mingi. Kikulu okumanya nti ekika ky'obuyambi bw’emmere obw'enjawulo obuweebwayo, gamba ng’obuwunga obw’obuugi, buyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku kitundu, ebintu ebiriwo, n’obwetaavu bw’abantu ssekinnoomu oba ebitundu ebiweebwa obuyambi.

input: Omuntu asobola okuyonsa singa abeera ng'alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okuyonsa ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nsonga nzibu esinziira ku bintu ebiwerako, omuli obujjanjabi bwo obw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, obungi bw’akawuka akali mu musaayi, n’okubeerawo kw’engeri endala ezitali za bulabe eri abaana abawere. Mu nkomerero, okusalawo okuyonsa ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kulina okukolebwa nga weebuuza ku bajjanjabi abasobola okufuna okulambikibwa okutuukana n’embeera yo ssekinnoomu n’ebikozesebwa ebiriwo mu kitundu kyo. Ekigendererwa kwe kukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okusiigibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu eri omwana omuwere nga bwe bakakasa nti bakakasa obulamu bw’omwana omuwere okutwalira awamu n’embeera ye ennungi nga bayita mu kukakasa nti endiisa y'omwana terina bulabe era ntuufu.

input: Okwegatta kwe kusalawo omuntu yenna?
output: Okumanya nti omuntu yeegasse nsonga ya kyama era eba yiye nga omuntu, era erina okwesigamizibwa ku ye okukyeyogera okusinga okuteebereza oba okuyingirira eddembe lye ery'okukuuma ebyama. Okwegatta kuba kusalawo kwa muntu, era si bantu bonna nti basalawo okwogera mu lwatu bye bayitamu mu kwegatta oba bye baagala. Kikulu okussa ekitiibwa mu byakyama by’abantu n’ensalo zaabwe bwe kituuka ku bulamu bwabwe obw’okwegatta. Kikulu nnyo okuteekawo embeera y'obwesigwa abantu mwe bawulirira nga batebenkevu okwogera ku bulamu bwabwe obw'okwegatta bwe baba basazeewo okukikola. Okussa ekitiibwa mu byakyama n’ensalo z’omuntu kikulu nnyo mu kukuuma enkolagana ennungi n’okutumbula empuliziganya ey'obwerufu mu by'okwegatta.

input: Bikolwa ki ebikulu eby'okwegatta mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa?
output: Obagazi bw'okwegatta n’engeri omuntu gy’akwatamu enneewulira z’afuna mu by’okwegatta bisobola okwawukanira ddala mu bantu ssekinnoomu, era tewali nsonga n’emu ennyonnyola lwaki abantu abamu, omuli n’abawala, bayinza okwagala ennyo oba okunyumirwa okwegatta oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Obwagazi bw’okwegatta, okusikirizibwa, n’okumatizibwa bintu bizibu era bifugibwa omugatte gw'ensonga ez’obutonde, ez’eby’obwongo, n’ez’embeerabantu. Bino bye bimu ku bintu ebirina okulowoozebwako: Ensonga za ssaayansi w'obulamu, enkwatagana mu birowoozo, eby’obwongo, ensonga z’embeerabantu n’obuwangwa, omuntu by'ayiseemu, okukkiriza n’okukola okusalawo. Kikulu okutegeera nti buli muntu by'ayitamu mu kwegatta bya njawulo, era tewali nnyinyonnyola "emu ekola ku buli omu" lwaki okwagala kw'omuntu okw'okwegatta kweyongera oluvannyuma lw'omulundi gwe ogusooka mu kwegatta. Okugatta ku ekyo, abantu abamu bayinza obutafuna nkyukakyuka za maanyi mu bwagazi bwabwe oba mu ndowooza zaabwe oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Empuliziganya ey'olwatu era ey'amazima n’abantu be weegatta nabo, okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, n’okusalawo mu ngeri ey’amagezi ku bulamu bw’omuntu mu by’okwegatta bintu bikulu nnyo mu kwegatta okw’obuvunaanyizibwa. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo oba ebikweraliikiriza ku bwagazi bwo oba obw'omubeezi wo mu kwegatta oba by’ayitamu, lowooza ku ky’okubiteesaako n’omusawo w’ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu by’obulamu bw’obwongo asobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuwagizi.

input: Mitendera ki emituufu egy’okukozesa PEP?
output: PEP kwe kujjanjaba okukolebwa mu bwangu okukendeeza ku bulabe bw’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw’okukwetaba mu katyabaga akayinza okuviirako omuntu okukwatibwa Akawuka. Okusobola okukozesa PEP obulungi, goberera emitendera gino: Funa obujjanjabi amangu ddala, yogera n’omusawo ku mbeera eyo, mukkaanye oba osaanidde okufuna PEP, tandika eddagala lya PEP, lwanisa obuzibu obuyinza okujja okuva mu kukozesa PEP, malayo obujjanjabi bwonna, era weeyongere okukeberebwa. Kozesa enkola ey’okwegatta etateeka bulamu bwo mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era weebuuze ku musawo.

input: Kitegeeza ki ebiva mu kukeberebwa okulaga nti mu musaayi mulimu obutaffaali obulwanyisa obulwadde?
output: Ebiva mu kukebera ebiroopa okubeera kw'obutaffaali obulwanyisa obulwadde mu musaayi bitegeeza nti okukebera tekwategeerekese bulungi obanga olina akawuka oba nedda. Ojja kwetaaga okuddamu okukeberwa okusobola okumanya obulungi oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nedda.

input: We bwazibidde ku lunaku ki lwe kyamanyibwa nti eddagala bbiri litera okukozesebwa ku PrEP?
output: PrEP nkola ya ddagala eritangira abantu ssekinnoomu abali mu katyabaga ak’amaanyi ak’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okukozesa PrEP kuzingiramu okumira eddagala buli kiseera okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okuva ku kumanya kwange okukyasembayo mu Gwomwenda 2021, eddagala lya mirundi ebbiri lye litera okukozesebwa mu kukozesa PrEP: tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) erigattibwa ne emtricitabine (FTC), nga litundirwa wansi w'erinnya lya Truvada, ne tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) nga ligattiddwa ne emtricitabine (FTC), eritundibwa wansi w’erinnya lya Descovy.

input: Kiki kye nsobola okukola okwewala okupikirizibwa okuva mu mikwano gyange nga baagala nneegatte?
output: Okuwulira akazito okuva mu mikwano gyo nga gukipukiriza  okwenyigira mu bikolwa by’okwegatta kusobola okubeera nga kukusoomooza, naye waliwo emitendera gy'osobola okuyitamu okukwatamu embeera eno n’okusalawo okukwatagana n’empisa zo n’omutindo gw’obutebenkevu bwo.
