Buno bwe obukodyo bw'osobola okukozesa okwewala oba okusalira amagezi akazito akakuteekebwako mikwano gyo akeekuusa ku kwegatta: Teekawo ensalo, lambika bulungi ensalo yo, londa mikwano gyo mu magezi, weemalize emikwano egyo  gyokka gye weesiga, teeka mu nkola okugamba nti "Nedda", weesomese, noonya okulambikibwa kw'abantu abakulu, kyusa emboozi, sigala ng'onyweredde ku mpisa zo, weetegekere ebijja mu maaso, okwekkiririzaamu, obuwagizi bwa banno, jjukira ebivaamu, era weesige omwoyo gwo kye gukugamba. Kikulu okujjukira nti okusalawo kwo ku by’okwegatta kwa muntu ku bubwe, era tolina kuwulira ng'olina okwenyigira mu kwegatta kwonna olw’okupikirizibwa okuva mu balala. Enneewulira zo n’ensalo zo bituufu, era kyetaagisa okukulembeza obulungi bwo n’okubutebenkevu bwo. Weekuumire mu mikwano gyo n’abantu abakulu abakuwagira abassa ekitiibwa mu by’osalawo, era tolwawo kunoonya kulambikibwa n’obuyambi nga kyetaagisizza.

input: Okwesigama ku kwetangira kulina akatyabaga konna mu kukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okwetangira naddala ng'okozesa obupiira mu kwegatta ngeri nnungi ey’okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’Endwadde endala ez’Ekikaba. Obupiira singa bubaba bukozeseddwa bulungi era buli mulundi gwe weegatta, busobola okukola nga ekiziyiza ekitangira okuwaanyisiganya kw'amazzi g'omubiri agalimu Akawuka ka vvayiraasi.

input: Omuntu asobola okwegatta n’omulwadde w'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu nga teyeetangidde n'atakwatibwa bulwadde?
output: Okwenyigira mu kikolwa ky'okwegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga teweetangidde kikuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasinga kusaasaana okuyita mu mazzi  g’omubiri agamu, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g'ekikyala, amazzi agava ewava obubi, n'amabeere. Okwegatta nga teweetangidde (mu bukyala, ewava obubi oba mu kamwa) n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kusobola okuvaako akawuka kano okusaasaana.

input: Lwaki abavubuka balina obweraliikirivu ku bikwata ku kwegatta n’omukwano mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo ddala okuba n’ebibuuzo oba ebikweraliikiriza ku by’okwegatta n’omukwano mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka. Obuvubuka kiseera kya kunoonyereza n’okutegeera omubiri gwo ogukyukakyuka, enneewulira yo n’ebintu ebikusikiriza. Eno y’ensonga lwaki oyinza okuba n’ebibuuzo: Okwegomba okumanya: Obuvubuka buleeta enneewulira empya n’ebintu ebipya, ekivaako okwagala okumanya ebikwata ku by’okwegatta, omukwano n’ebintu ebisikiriza. Emikutu gy’amawulire: Emikutu gy’amawulire omuli firimu, emizannyo gya ttivvi, n’emikutu gy’empuliziganya, gitera okulaga omukwano n’okwegatta mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, ne kireetawo ebibuuzo oba okwagala okumanya. Emboozi z'omu bibinja: Okukubaganya ebirowoozo ne banno ku bye bayitamu oba ku nneewulira zaabwe kusobola okukuleetera okwebuuza n’okwegomba okumanya ebikwata ku by’okwegatta byo. Okuzuula omuntu: mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka kiseera kya kwezuula, omuli okutegeera okwegatta kwo, ekikula ky’omuntu, n’ebyo by’onyumirwa mu mukwano. Kikulu okumanya nti olugendo lwa buli muntu olw’okuzuula obwagazi bwe n’okuzuula ebikwata ku mukwano bya njawulo. Bw’oba olina ekibuuzo oba ekikweraliikiriza, si kibi okunoonya amawulire okuva mu nsonda ezeesigika, gamba ng’abazadde, abasomesa, ababuziibuzi, nnansi w’essomero, oba emikutu gy’empuliziganya egy’ettutumu. Okuzuula ebikwata ku mukwano n’okutegeera obwagazi bwo ng’oli mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka kitundu kya bulijjo mu kukula. Jjukira nti si kibi okuba n’ebibuuzo, era okunoonya amawulire n’obuwagizi kusobola okukuyamba okuyita mu kitundu kino ekikulu eky’enkulaakulana yo.

input: Obujjanjabi bukola mulimu ki mu kukuuma omwana alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'ali bulungi?
output: Yee, kijja kusoboka, naye kakasa nti omwana wo amira bulungi eddagala lye buli lunaku. Awatali bujjanjabi, Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kajja kukosa abasirikale abalwanyisa endwadde mu mubiri, ne kimuteeka mu katyabaga k'okulwala. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu akatajjanjabiddwa kakosa nnyo abaana abawere n'abavubuka.

input: Katyabaga ki akali mu kubeera ng'omuntu tagaana kwegatta, ne bwe kiba ng'ebirowoozo byabwe babimalidde ku misomo gyabwe?
output: Okubeera n’endowooza ez’enjawulo ezeekuusa ku nkola z'okwegatta kiyinza okuba ekizibu mu mukwano. Wabula, kitera okuyambako okukolaganira awamu mu mboozi ez'okwefumiitiriza, buli omu okweteeka mu bigere bya munne, era buli omu ateeke ekitiibwa mu kusalawo n'empisa za munne nga talinnyiridde bwetwaze bwa munne.

input: Bwe mba nnina ababeezi abawera nga simanyi bwe bayimiridde ku Kawuka aka Siriimu, nnina kukola ki singa omu ku bo ayagala okwegatta awatali kwetangira?
output: Okwegatta n'abantu abangi nga teweetangidde, naddala nga waliwo akatyabaga k'okukusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, nneeyisa ya bulabe nnyo. Kikulu okukulembeza obulamu bwo n’embeera yo ennungi bwo n’okugoberera emitendera gy’okwekuuma n’abo be weegatta nabo. Kikulu nnyo okukulembeza obulamu bwo n’embeera yo ennungi mu buli kimu ky'okola mu bulamu bwo, omuli enkolagana yo ne be weegatta nabo,  n’engeri gy'oddukanyaamu eby’ensimbi zo. Singa weesanga mu mbeera ng'omuntu akuwa amagezi oba obuyambi asobole okukupikiriza okwenyigira mu kwegatta okuteeka obulamu bwo mu katyabaga, lowooza ku ky'okunoonya amagezi n'obuyambi okuva mu mikwano gye weesiga, abooluganda, oba abakugu abasobola okukuyamba okuyita mu mbeera nga tofunye bulabe era mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa.

input: Biki ebimu ku biyinza okuvaako okusiiyibwa mu bitundu by’ekyama?
output: Okwetakula (okusiiyibwa) mu bitundu by'ekyama oba ebitundu ebirala by'omubiri kayinza okuba akabonero akaleetebwa ensonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ensonga z'olususu, endwadde, alagye, oba embeera endala ez'obulamu. Kikulu okuzuula ekivaako okusiiyibwa okusobola okukwata emitendera emituufu okwanganga ekizibu. Zino ze nsonga ez'enjawulo eziviira okusiiyibwa mu bitundu by'ekyama: Alagye oba olususu okwekanga, obuwuka obukwata ensusu, olususu olukalu oba olususumbuka, okusiiyibwa, Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n’embeera endala ez’ebyobulamu. Singa ofuna okusiiyibwa okutawona oba ne kusajjuka mu bitundu by’ekyama, kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo oba omukugu mu byobulamu. Omusawo asobola okukukebera, n'akuwa by'azudde ebituufu, n’akuwa obujjanjabi obusaanira okusinziira ku kivaako okusiiyibwa. Jjukira obuteekebera oba okugezaako okwejjanjaba mu ngeri etali ya kikugu kubanga kino, kubanga kino kiyinza okuviirako ebizibu ebirala.

input: Enzijanjaba y'Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B n'ey'akawuka akaleeta siriimu y'emu?
output: Nedda, Eddagala ly'Omusujja gw'ekibumba ogwa B n'ery'akawuka akaleeta siriimu si lye limu, ebifaanana mu bika by'eddagala ebimu.

input: Bubonero ki obuyinza okulaga nti omuntu alimba ku by’ayiseemu mu by’okwegatta?
output: Kibeera kizibu okukimanya, naye empuliziganya ey'olwatu kye kikulu; buuza ebibuuzo era weesige ebirowoozo byo kye bikugamba.

input: Kiki kye nnina okukola singa nneerabira okumira akakerenda kange akaziyiza okuzaala?
output: Kisobola okukendeeza ku nkola yaako, noolwekyo gezaako okamire amangu ddala nga waakajjukira era oyongere okugoberera obwetangizi obusingako awo.

input: Osobola okwogera nange ku by’okwegatta mu ngeri etegeerekeka?
output: Mazima ddala, nsobola okuwa obubaka obusingawo ku by’okwegatta. Okwegatta kintu kikulu mu bulamu bw’omuntu ne mu kuzaala era nga kirungo kya nkizo mu nkolagana wamu n'obulamu bw'abantu abawerako.

input: Lwaki okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu entakera kikulu?
output: Kisoboka okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’ofunye akawuka kano omulundi gumu gwokka gw'obeereddemu mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, naye obusobozi bw'okusiiga akawuka kano bwesigama ku nsonga ez'enjawulo, omuli ekika ky'embeera eteeka omuntu mu katyabaga, obungi bw'obuwuka obuli mu musaayi gw'omuntu omulwadde wa Siriimu, n'okubeerawo kw'ensonga endala eziyinza okwongera oba okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde nga akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu weekali, naye embeera nnyingi ez'akatyabaga tezivaako kukwatibwa kawuka. Obusobozi bw'okusaasaanya akawuka bwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera ez'enjawulo. Wadde nga kiri kityo, n'omulundi ogumu oguteeka omuntu mu katyabaga gulina okutwalibwa ng'ensonga era abantu abateebereza nti babaddeko mu mbeera ebateega mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa akawuka balina okulaba abasawo era bakubaganye ebirowoozo ku bwetaavu bwa PEP. Enkola esinga obulungi ey'okutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kwe kuyita mu nkolwa ez’okuziyiza, omuli okukozesa obupiira buli mulundi era mu butuufu, okukozesa enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, era abantu abali mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi, okukozesa PEP mu ngeri etakyukakyuka era entuufu, okwegatta mu ngeri ey’obukuumi, era eri abantu ssekinnoomu abali mu bulabe obw’amaanyi, okukozesa PEP. Okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu entakera n’okumanya embeera y'omubeezi wo ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nagyo mitendera mikulu mu kukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya akawuka. Bw’oba olina obweraliikirivu ku nsaasaanya y'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba nga weetaaga okulambika ku ngeri y’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, weebuuze ku musawo oba omukugu mu by’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okufuna amagezi agatuukira ku mbeera mw'oli.

input: Osobola okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu singa weegatta n’omuwala omuto?
output: Okwegatta n’omuwala omuto oba omuntu omulala yenna, awatali kufaayo ku myaka, nga teweetangidde n’okwegendereza okutuufu kiyinza okwongera ku bulabe bw’okusiigibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa omu aba akalina. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu kwegatta n’omuntu akalina nga teweetangidde singa wabaawo enkwatagana ey'obutereevu n'amazzi g'omubiri, omuli omusaayi, amazzi g'ekisajja, amazzi g’ekikyala, agava awava obubi n'amabeere n’amabeere. Kikulu okutegeera nti emyaka si gye kisalawo akatyabaga k'okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; ensonga enkulu kwe kuba nti omu oba bombi abeegatta balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okumanya oba enkola ez’okwekuuma zikozeseddwa. Okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu weegatta: Kozesa obupiira, manya munno bw'ayimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okwekebeza entakera, lowooza ku PrEP, era funa amagezi g’abasawo. Kikulu okusoosowaza enkola z’okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga era ez'obuvunaanyizibwa mu kwegatta okwetangira ne bwe weegatta nabo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba.

input: Kasannyalaze ka mubiri ki akasinga okuvaako enkyukakyuka mu mubiri n’enkyukakyuka mu bitundu ebizaala n'okufulumizibwa kw'enkwaso?
output: Obuvubuka mu basajja: Obuvubuka kye kiseera ky’okukula ng’omubiri gw’omulenzi gukyuka ne gufuuka omubiri gw’omusajja omukulu ogusobola okuzaala. Kitera okumanyirwa ku nkyukakyuka mu mubiri n’enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri. Kye bukola ku bitundu by'omusajja ebizaala: Ensigo z'omusajja: Ensigo zitandika okukula ne zivaamu enkwaso, enkola emanyiddwa nga okukula kw'enkwaso. Obusajja: Obusajja bukula ne bugejja. Ensawo y'amazzi g'ekisajja: Ensawo z'amazzi g'ekisajja zigaziwa ne zitandika okukola amazzi agaliikiriza n’okukuuma ensigo. Enkyukakyuka mu mubiri gw'omusajja avubuka: Abasajja bafuna enkyukakyuka ku mibiri gyabwe ng’enviiri mu maaso, eddoboozi okugejja, ebinywa okweyongera, n’okukula kw’amalaka. Enkyukakyuka zino ziva ku nkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri naddala akasannyalaze akayitibwa testosterone akavunaanyizibwa ku kukula kw’ebitundu by’omusajja eby’okuzaala n’enkyukakyuka mu mubiri olw'okuvubuka.

input: Nsobola okwegatta nga seetangidde singa omubeezi wange abeera ng'alina Kabootongo?
output: Teweegattira mu bukyala, awava obubi oba mukamwa okutuusa ggwe n'omubeezi wo nga mumaze okujjanjabibwa era nga n'okukeberebwa kulaze nti obujjanjabi bukoze.

input: Mu bwangu ki omwana wange mw'alina okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Omwana wo alina okukeberebwa amangu ddala okumanya ekiddako okukolebwa. Okugeza nga yaakazaalibwa oba mu nnaku 2 oluvannyuma lw’okuzaalibwa.

input: Ngeri ki ze nnyinza okuyitamu okwetangira okwegatta?
output: Okugaana okwegatta kusalawo okukolebwa okusinziira ku muntu ssekinnoomu era kisinziira ku mbeera omuntu gy'abaamu, ebintu by'akulembeza ne by'ayagala. Bw’oba oluubirira okwewala okwegatta oba okulwawo okwegatta olina okufa ku nsonga eziwerako. Kikulu okujjukira nti okusalawo ku by’okwegatta kwa muntu nga ye, era tewali nkola nteeketeeke ku kino. Ekisinga obukulu kwe kuba nti by'osalawo bikwataganira ne by'okkiririzaamu, by'osoosowaza, n'eddaala ly'obukkakkamu.

input: Ndi mweeraliikirivu nti nnandiba nga mbaddeko mu mbeera enteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu; nnyinza kugyenganga ntya sitidde?
output: Bw’oba weegatta n’omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’afaayo ku mbeera yo naye ng’otya okwekebeza, kyetaagisa okukulembeza obulamu bwo n’obulungi bwo. Jjukira nti okuzuula amangu nti olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okujjanjabibwa kiyinza okuyamba ennyo mu kuziyiza ebyandivuddemu eri abantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ebitundu byange eby’ekyama bisiiwa, nnina Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama?
output: Wadde ng'abantu abamu abalina obulwadde buno obwa Kisipi akwata Ebitundu by'ekyama oba Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi, era obumanyiddwa nga Kisipi basobola obutaba na bubonero bwonna, abantu abalala basobola okufuna obubonero oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ntono nga bamaze okukwatibwa akawuka akaleeta Kisipi.  Obubonero obutera okulabika ku Kisipi w'omu kamwa mulimu obuzimba obulimu amazzi ku oba ebiwundu ebisajjufu mu kamwa oba emimwa oba okwetooloola ebitundu ebyo. Abantu abasinga balaba ekibinja ky'obuzimba ku lususu oba ebiwundu." Ebiwundu bino bibabuukirira era bisobola okuba nga biruma. Biyinza okulabikira ku butuuliro, awafulumira obubi, ebisambi; munda oba wabweru w'ebitundu by'ekyama mu bakyala;  ne ku busajja oba ku nsigo mu baami. Ebiseera ebisinga ng'ekiwundu tekinnalabika, abalwadde bannyonnyola okusiiwa oba okubabuukirirwa mu kitundu ekiwundu we kinaabeera nga kisobola okukengerwa mu kiseera ky'okufuuyisa, nga kijja n'okusiiyibwa oba obutawulira mirembe mu bitundu by'ekyama. Era osobola okubeera n'obubonero buno wammanga: obuzimba obujjudde amazzi mu kamwa oba ku mimwa, omusujja, okulumwa omutwe oba obulumi mu nnyingo, okukaluubirirwa mu kufuuyisa. Mu mbeera ya Kisipi ow'abawere, obubonero kw'olabira nti omwana wo alina Kisipi kuliko: akawuka akaleeta obulwadde ku kitundu kimu kyokka eky'olususu, obuzimba obujjudde amazzi u lususu n'okwetoloola amaaso n'akamwa obwabika, ne bukala ne buwona, okuzimba kw'obwongo, okuyinza okuleetawo obuzibu mu kukola kw'obwongo n'enkizi, omuli n'okukubwa eyaabwe. Akawuka akaleeta Kisipi akasaasaanye ennyo kye ekika ky'akawuka akaleeta Kisipi ekikyasinze okubeera eky'okubulabe. Akawuka ka Vvayiraasi akaleeta Kisipi kasaasaanidde mu mubiri gw'omwana wo gwonna era nga kasobola okukosa ebitundu by'omubiri eby'enjawulo, okuli ekibumba, obwongo, amawuggwe, n'ensigo. Omwana alina Kisipi ayinza obutaba na bubonero bwonna bwa bulwadde buno.Obubonero obusinga obungi bulaga ku nkomerero ya wiiki y’omwana esooka, so ng'ate ebizibu eby’amaanyi ennyo ebikosa obwongo tebijja kulabika okutuusa ng'omwana atuuse mu wiiki ye eyookubiri.Abantu basobola okutandika okufuna okuttuka kw'obulwadde buno emirundi egiddiringana oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera. Buno butera okuba nga bumala akaseera kampi era nga si bwa maanyi kwenkana obwasooka. Kisipi bulwadde bwa kikaba obw'obulamu bwonna era obutawona. Wabula emirundi obulwadde gye buttuka giyinza okukendeera ekiseera buli lwe kigenda kiyitawo.

input: Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba busobola okubeera mu ndagabuzaale zo?
output: Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z'Ekikaba si bwa nsikirano nga embeera endala ezisikirwa okuva ku mugigi ogumu okudda ku mulala nga ziyita mu butoffaali n'ebyafaayo bya famire.

input: Nsobola ntya okukakasa nti nze n'omubeezi wange tetuli mu bulabe nga tuli wamu?
output: Lagaana n'omusawo oba akalwaliro ku lunaku lw'okwekebeza oba okujjanjabibwa bwe kiba kyetaagisizza.

input: Mitendera ki gye nsobola okugoberera okusobola okuwangaala obulungi nga nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okuwangaala n'okuweeweeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kisobokera ddala n'obujjanjabi obutuufu, obujjanjabi n'engeri gy'osalawo okweyisa. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala nako mu bulamu obweyagaza nga balina obujjanjabi obutuufu n'okunywererako. Kikulu okukolagana obulungi n’abakugu mu byobulamu abakuguse mu kulabirira abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okugoberera enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi eziragiddwa, n’okusoosowaza obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu.

input: Lwaki nnina okwekebeza Kiramidiya?
output: Obwetaavu bwo obw'okukeberebwa businziira ku katyabaga k'oli ng'omuntu ak'okukwatibwa Kiramidiya, oba ayitibwa Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo. Olina okwekebeza entakera singa weegatta n'omubeezi omuggya nga teweetangidde oba omubeezi alina akawuka akaleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Era olina okwekebeza singa oba n'obubonero bwa Kiramidiya oba ng'oli lubuto. Abantu bangi abalina Kiramidiya tebalaga bubonero. Kya mugaso okukeberebwa kubanga Kiramidiya atajjanjabiddwa asobola okuvaako obuzibu obw'amaanyi oba obw'olubeerera ku bulamu, ne bw'oba nga tolaganga ku bubonero. Kiramidiya asobola okuwonyezebwa n'eddagala ettuufu okuva ew'omusawo wo. Kakasa nti omira eddagala lyo nga bw'olagiddwa.

input: Wabeerawo akatyabaga k'okufuna embeera z'ebyobulamu endala singa mbeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Si bwe kiri, okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekutegeeza nti ojja kufuna embeera z'obulamu endala (ebiseera ebimu obuyitibwa ‘okukwatibwa endwadde endala’). Naye oli mu katyabaga k’okubufuna singa tofaayo ku bulamu bwo. Kikulu okumira eddagala lyo eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okubeera n’obulamu obulungi. Bw’oba ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omusawo wo ajja kukebera obubonero bw’obulwadde obulala mu kukeberebwa kwo. Era asobola okukuwa obubaka obusingawo ku mbeera ezikwatagana n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obunaakuyamba okutegeera byonna.

input: Ebivudde mu kukebera Enziku eby’enjawulo bitegeeza ki?
output: Okuzuulwamu akawuka kaleeta Nziku kitegeeza nti olina Enziku era weetaaga okujjanjabibwa n'eddagala eritta obuwuka amangu ddala. Obutazuulwamu kawuka kaleeta Nziku kitegeeza tekasangiddwa mu sampolo yo wabula tekimenyawo kya kuba na Nziku. Bw'oba nga okwatiddwa akawuka akaleeta Enziku, kisobola okutwala ssabbiiti eziwera nga tekannakuzuulwamu. Kisoboka okuba nga wakeberwa mangu nnyo oluvannyuma lw'akatyabaga akakuteeka mu mbeera y'okufuna akawuka.

input: Kabootongo asobola okuleetawo okunafuwa mu maanyi g'ekisajja?
output: Kabootongo takosa butereevu busobozi bwa muntu bwa kuyima, wabula asobola okubaako engeri gy'akosaamu omusajja bwe kituuka mu kwegatta.

input: Lwaki okugenda okukyukakyuka kw'ennaku z'okugenderako kubaawo nnyo ku ntandikwa y'okugenda mu nsonga?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo nnyo okubeera n'ennaku z'ogenderako mu nsonga ezikyukakyuka. Ennaku z'okugenda mu nsonga ezikyukakyuka zisobola okutegeeza ebintu eby’enjawulo: Obuwanvu bw'ebbanga ly'omala okudda mu nsonga: Omwetoloolo gw'ennaku zo kw'ogendera mu nsonga guyinza obutenkanankana buwanvu buli mwezi. Obungi bw'omusaayi: Obungi bw'omusaayi ogukuvaamu ng'oli mu nsonga busobola okwawukana okuva ku mwezi ogumu okudda ku mulala. Ebbanga: Ennaku z’omala ng'oli mu nsonga nazo zisobola okwawukana. Kisobola okutwala emyaka emitonotono omwetoloolo gw'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala okutereera. Bw’oba weeraliikirira ku kukyukakyuka kw'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala oba ng'ovaamu omusaayi mungi nnyo, mutono nnyo, oba nga zikuleetera obulumi obw’amaanyi, kirungi okwogerako n’omusawo. Basobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuyambi okuzuula oba buli kimu kiri mu mbeera nnungi. Jjukira nti okugenda mu nsonga kitundu kya butonde era kya bulijjo mu bulamu eri abantu bangi.

input: Okwegatta kukola kinene mu kukuuma endabika oba enneewulira y'omuntu nga omuvubuka?
output: Endowooza egamba nti okwegatta kuzza omuntu obuto si ntuufu n'akamu. Okwenyigira mu kikolwa eky’okwegatta si nsulo ya magezi ey’obuvubuka nti ezza emyaka emabega.  Kyokka, okwegatta n’obulamu bw’okwegatta bisobola okuba n'emiganyulo ku mubiri ne ku bwongo egiyamba ku bulamu obulungi ekiyinza okwekuusa okukuwulira nga avubuse obuto. Kikulu okumanya nti enkolagana wakati w’okwegatta n’okukaddiwa nzibu, era emiganyulo  gy’obulamu bw’okwegatta giyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku muntu.

input: Bwe mba nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era nga njagala abawala, nnyinza ntya okukwana mu ngeri etanteeka mu atyabaga era ey'obuvunaanyizibwa?
output: Singa olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu era ng’oyagala okuganza oba okukola omukwano ogulimu okwegatta n’abawala oba omuntu omulala yenna, kikulu okukwata ensonga zino mu ngeri y'okwefumiititiza ennyo n'obuvunaanyizibwa. Bino bye bimu ku by’olina okulowoozaako n’obukodyo bw’oyinza okulowoozaako ku mukwano ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu: Okwogera w'oyimiridde ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, somesa ababeezi bo, kozesa enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, funa obujjanjabi entakera, noonya obuyambi, kozesa empenduzo z'abanoonya ababeezi ku mitimbagano,  wuliziganya mu mazima, kkiriza okugaanibwa, weefeeko era lowooza ku nsonga z'amateeka. Jjukira nti okubeera n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekitegeeza nti tosobola kuba na mukwano ogweyagaza era ogw’amakulu. Abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina enkolagana ennungi era ejjudde omukwano. Bwe weeyisa mu ngeri ey'obuvunaanyizibwa era etateeka bulamu mukatyabaga, okubeera ow'amazima ku mbeera yo ey'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n'okunoonya abakuyamba osobola okwanganga ensonga z'okuganza n'omukwano bulungi.

input: Obupiira butangira butya okukwatagana kw'amazzi mu kwegatta?
output: Obupiira bw'abaami n'abakyala busobola okukola obulungi mu kutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bukozesebwa mu butuufu era entakera. Okusalawo ku kukozesa akapiira k'abaami oba ak'abakyala kisinziira ku muntu ssekinnoomu by’ayagala n’embeera gy’alimu. Obupiira bw'abaami bwe businga okukozesebwa era n'okusangibwa buli wamu.  Zikolebwa nga zirina amazzi agaseerera, era zitondawo omuziziko ogutangira okuwaanyisiganya kw'amazzi mu kwegatta. Obupiira bw'abakazi tebutera kulabika nga bwe kiri ku bw'abasajja wadde nga nabwo buteekawo obukuumi obuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Singa omukyala yeegatta n’omwami aliko obulemu ng’alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kinaakyusa ku mikisa gy’okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Kirabika okuba nga weebuuza oba ng'okwenyigira mu kwegatta n’omuntu alina obulemu kusobola okumalawo akatyabaga k’okusaasaanya akawuka, gamba nga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw’Ekikaba. Kikulu okutangaaza nti obulemu bw’omuntu tebulina kye bukola ku kusaasaanya kwa buwuka bwa vvayiraasi oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba mu kiseera ky'okwegatta. Akatyabaga k’okusiiga okusinga kasinziira ku bintu ng’okubeerawo kwa vvayiraasi mu muntu omu oba bombi, ekika ky’okwegatta, n’okuba ng'enkola z'okwetangira ng'obupiira zikozeseddwa. Ka kibeere nti omuntu aliko obulemu, bw’aba ng’awangaala n'akawuka ka vvayiraasi oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba (nga Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, Kisipi, oba obulala), okwenyigira mu kwegatta awatali kwetangira n’omuntu atalina akawuka kikysobola okuvaamu okusiigibwa akawuka. Kikulu nnyo abantu bonna ssekinnoomu okugoberera emitendera gy’okwegendereza emituufu okwekuuma n’abo be beegatta nabo, awatali kulowooza ku mbeera ya bulemu.

input: Lwaki endwadde zinnakigwanyizi ensangi zino tezitera nnyo kukwata bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi bwe bulwadde obusinga okubalukawo era nga businga kuba bwa bulabe mu bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kino kiri bwe kityo kubanga emibiri gyabwe giba ginafuye. Leero, endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka bunnakigwanyizi tezikyali nnyo mu bantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu olw’okuba waliwo eddagala erikola obulungi ku kawuka ka kano. Naye abantu abamu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bakyafuna endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka bunnakigwanyizi  kubanga basobola okuba nga tebamanyi nti balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, bayinza okuba nga tebali ku ddagala lya Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, oba eddagala lyabwe eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu liyinza okuba nga terikola bulungi.

input: Enkola z'ebyobulamu n'ebibiina by'obwannakyewa biyamba bitya okusobola okufuna okubudaabuda kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Empeereza z'okubudaabuda abantu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ziyinza okubaawo ku bwereere oba ku ssente entono mu bitundu bingi, okusinziira ku nkola y'ebyobulamu, enteekateeka za gavumenti, ebitongole by'obwa nnakyewa, n'ebibiina ebikola ku bantu mu bitundu. Okubeerawo kw'okubudaabudibwa wamu n'ebisale byakwo byawukana okusinziira ku ggwanga, esssaza, oba ekyalo. Kikulu okumanya nti empeereza y'okubudaabudibwa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kitundu kikulu nnyo mu kuziyiza, okujjanjaba, n'okuwagira abakoseddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ebitongole n'abasawo bakola butaweera okufuula empeereza zino okuba nga zituukikako abantu bonna, nga tebafuddeeyo ku busobozi bwabwe obw'okuzisasulira. Jjukira nti okubudaabudibwa kusobola okuba ekitundu ekikulu mu kutegeera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okulondoola  obulamu bw’omuntu, n’okukola okusalawo okw'ekitegeevu ku kuziyizan'okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Tolonzalonza kunoonya buyambi na bubaka okuva mu babudaabuda abantu abakugu n'abasawo, ne bw'oba nga weeraliikiridde ku ky'ebisale.

input: Bulabe ki Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe kalina ku maama ali olubuto oba omwana we ali mu lubuto?
output: Okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oli lubuto kyeraliikiriza nnyo eri omwana ali mu lubuto ne maama we. Wabula, akatyabaga ka maama okusiiga omwana kasobola okukendeezebwa singa afuna enkola z'obujjanjabi entuufu. Kikulu okuggumiza nti singa tufuna obujjanjabi obutuufu n'okunywerera ku nkola eziragirwa, akatyabaga ka maama okusiiga omwana ali mu lubuto kasobola okukendeezebwa okutuuka ku kitundu 1%. Okulondoola n'okugoberera endabirira ya maama n'omwana bikulu nnyo okulaba nga bali bulungi.

input: Enkyukakyuka mu birowoozo zitera okubaawo mu kiseera ky’okugenda mu nsonga?
output: Yee, kya bulijjo okufuna enkyukakyuka mu mbeera zo oba okukyuka mu birowoozo mu kiseera ky'okubeera mu nsonga z'ekikyala. Kino kitera okuyitibwa "PMS" oba Obubonero Obukulembera ensonga z'Ekikyala. Enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri mu kiseera ky'okubeera mu nsonga z'ekikyala zisobola okukosa embeera zo, ne kikuleetera okuwulira obusunguwavu, ennaku, oba okukulungutana. Enkyukakyuka zino zitera kubaawo mu nnaku ezisembayo ng'onaatera okugenda mu nsonga zo ez'ekikyala era zisobola okutereera ng'ensonga zo ez'ekikyala zitandise. Kijjukire nti enkyukakyuka zino mu mbeera zo za bulijjo, naye bwe ziba nga zikusukkiriddeko era nga zikosa obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo, kiba kirungi okwogerako n'omusawo.

input: Enkola ya PrEP esobola okusangibwa mu malwaliro ga gavumenti oba mu bulwaliro?
output: Okufuna obujjanjabi obw’okukendeeza ku kukatyaga k’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga tonneetaba mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka mu Uganda kitera okuzingiramu okunoonya obujjanjabi n’obubaka okuva mu malwaliro, obulwaliro oba ebitongole ebikola ku kuziyiza n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. PrEP ddagala erikozesebwa abantu abali mu katyabaga ak'amaanyi obw’okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okukendeeza emikisa gyabwe egy’okukwatibwa Akawuka. Jjukira nti PrEP ekola bulungi nnyo singa omuntu agikozesa buli kiseera nga bwe bamulagidde. Kikulu okubeera n’empuliziganya ennungi n’omusawo wo era n’ofuna obuyambi singa osanga obuzibu bwonna ng’okozesa PrEP. Okufuna obubaka obusinga obulungi n’ebifo ebiri okumpi gy’osobola okufuna PrEP mu Uganda, lowooza ku kubuuza Minisitule y’Ebyobulamu eya Uganda oba ebitongole ebimanyiddwa ebikola ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu ggwanga. Bisobola okukuwa obubaka obutuufu era ne bikulagirira mu malwaliro agali okumpi agawa obujjanjabi bwa PrEP.

input: Waliwo engeri endala ez’okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko okwewala okwegatta n'okukozesa empeke?
output: Yee, waliwo enkola eziwerako ezikola obulungi mu kuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko okwewala okwegatta n’okumira empeke. Wano waliwo enkola enkulu z'okwetangira: okukozesa obupiira, PrEP, PEP, okwekebeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu buli kiseera, n’okujjanjabibwa ng’enkola z'okwetangira (Obutazuulibwa = Obutasiigibwa).

input: Mitendera ki gye nsobola okuyitamu okwanganga embeera ya mikwano gyange egimpikiriza okwenyigira mu kwegatta nga seesiimidde?
output: Okuwulira akazito okuva mu mikwano gyo nga gukipukiriza  okwenyigira mu bikolwa by’okwegatta kusobola okubeera nga kukusoomooza, naye waliwo emitendera gy'osobola okuyitamu okukwatamu embeera eno n’okusalawo okukwatagana n’empisa zo n’omutindo gw’obutebenkevu bwo. Buno bwe obukodyo bw'osobola okukozesa okwewala oba okusalira amagezi akazito akakuteekebwako mikwano gyo akeekuusa ku kwegatta: Teekawo ensalo, lambika bulungi ensalo yo, londa mikwano gyo mu magezi, weemalize emikwano egyo  gyokka gye weesiga, teeka mu nkola okugamba nti "Nedda", weesomese, noonya okulambikibwa kw'abantu abakulu, kyusa emboozi, sigala ng'onyweredde ku mpisa zo, weetegekere ebijja mu maaso, okwekkiririzaamu, obuwagizi bwa banno, jjukira ebivaamu, era weesige omwoyo gwo kye gukugamba. Kikulu okujjukira nti okusalawo kwo ku by’okwegatta kwa muntu ku bubwe, era tolina kuwulira ng'olina okwenyigira mu kwegatta kwonna olw’okupikirizibwa okuva mu balala. Enneewulira zo n’ensalo zo bituufu, era kyetaagisa okukulembeza obulungi bwo n’okubutebenkevu bwo. Weekuumire mu mikwano gyo n’abantu abakulu abakuwagira abassa ekitiibwa mu by’osalawo, era tolwawo kunoonya kulambikibwa n’obuyambi nga kyetaagisizza.

input: Kiki ekiyinza okuvaako obulumi mu nnyingo mu kiseera ky'okwegatta?
output: Okulumizibwa mu binywa kwakati mu kwegatta oba oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta si kabonero aka bulijjo mu mbeera y'okwegatta. Okulumizibwa mu binywa kisobola okuleetebwa ensonga z'obulamu ez'enjawulo, obuvune, ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwo, naye tekwekuusa ku kwegatta butereevu.  Mukwano gwo bw’aba alumizibwa mu binywa nga kwekuusa ku kwegatta kikulu nnyo okwebuuza ku musawo okuzuula ekiviirako obulumi.

input: Endwadde eziggyawo olw'omubiri okunafuyizibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu zisobola okunafuya obwerinzi bw'omubiri gw'omuntu singa abeera ku mutendera ogusooka ogw'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Obulwadde obujjawo olw'omubiri okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu zireetebwa obuwuka obw'enjawulo (vvayiraasi, bbakitiiriya, entiko, n'obunyuunyunsi). Obuwuka buno busaasaanira mu ngeri ez'enjawulo, okugeza nga mu mpewo, mu mazzi g'omu mubiri, oba mu mmere eyonoonese oba amazzi. Busobola okuleeta ebizibu ku bulamu bw'omuntu alina obwerinzi bwe obw'omubiri nga bwanafuyizibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Mitendera ki egiri mu kuwa omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obujjanjabi?
output: Okuyamba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu by’obujjanjabi kuzingiramu okulaba ng’afuna endabirira y'ekisawo entuufu, obujjanjabi, n’obuwagizi okusobola okuyita mu mbeera ye obulungi. Gino gye mitendera emikulu egy’okuyamba omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu by’obujjanjabi: okuba ng'asobola okutuuka w'afunira obujjanjabi, okwebuuza n’okwekebejjebwa, okutandika obujjanjabi, okunywerera ku ddagala, okwekebrebwa abasawo entakera,  emitendera gy'okwetangira, eby'endya n'embeera y'obulamu ennungi, engeri y'okufa ku bizibu ebiva mu kukozesa eddagala, n’okuyambibwa kw'obwongo n'ebirowoozo.

input: Ntegeera ntya oba omubiri gwange gwetegekera okugenda mu nsonga?
output: Waliwo obubonero obuwerako obulaga nti okugenda mu nsonga kwo kuyinza okuba nga kuli mu kkubo: Amabeere okulumirira oba okuzimba, embeera z'omuntu okukyukakyuka oba okuwulira ng’olowoolereza nnyo okusinga bulijjo, okugulumba olubuto oba okulumwa ekitundu ky'olubuto ekya wansi, okuyoya emmere, okulumwa omutwe, obukoowu, okuziyira oba ekiddukano, enkyukakyuka mu mazzi agava mu bukyala (gayinza okweyongera obukwafu oba okukwatira), embalabe oba okubutuka, n’okuwulira ng’olubuto lukuzimbye oba ng’amazzi geesibidde mu mubiri gwo ne guzimba. Obubonero buno buyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku muntu, era oyinza obutabufuna bwonna. Kirungi okulondoola ebbanga mw'ogendera mu nsonga osobole okumanya ddi lw’osuubira okugenda mu nsonga.

input: Kiki ekifuula eddembe ly’abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ekikulu?
output: Abalwadde b'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufaananako abantu bonna, balina eddembe ly’obwebange n’obukuumi bw’amateeka. Eddembe lino lyetaagisa nnyo okulaba nga bafuna ekitiibwa, okufuna obujjanjabi, n’obukuumi okubataasa okusosolebwa. Kikulu okumanya nti eddembe lino liyinza okwawukana okusinziira ku nsi, noolwekyo kirungi okwebuuza ku mateeka ag'enjawulo n'ebigobererwa mu kitundu kyo.

input: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kennyini kaleeta akasunguyira oba ebirowoozo okukyuka?
output: Kikulu okwewala okuzingira awamu ebikwata ku nneeyisa y'abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kubanga engeri abantu gye batwalamu ebintu n'endowooza zaabwe bisobola okwawukanira ddala si nsonga oba balina Akawuka oba nedda. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ku bwako tekaleeta busungu oba nkyukakyuka mu birowoozo. Wabula waliwo ensonga nnyingi eziyinza okuvaako okusoomoozebwa mu  birowoozo ne mu bwongo mu bantu abawangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu ekiyinza okweyoleka nga enkyukakyuka mu mbeera oba mu kwetamwa. Zino ze nsonga entonotono ez'okulowoozaako: Okukabirirwa, okuboolebwa n'okusosolebwa, obweraliikirivu ku by'obujjanjabi, okweyawula ku bantu, ensonga ezitagonjoddwa ez'obwongo. Abantu engeri gye bakwatamu embeera y'okusoomoozebwa ku bwongo omuli n'okusunguwala amangu kiyinza okuba ekitundu ku bulamu bw'omuntu era tekisosola balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Ekirala, abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bafuga bulungi ebirowoozo byabwe era bakuuma enkolagana ennungi. Singa ggwe oba omuntu gw'omanyi ayita mu kusoomoozebwa mu bwongo okwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu, okunoonya obuyambi okuva mu basawo ab'eby'obwongo n'ebibiina ebigaba obuyambi oba abasawo kiyinza okuba eky'omuganyulo. Obuyambi obwekuusa ku bwongo obulungi n'obukodyo obw'okwanganga embeera biyinza okuyamba abantu okukwata obulungi ebibasoomooza ku bwongo n'okutumbula omutindo gw'obulamu bwabwe okutwaliza awamu.

input: Lwaki okukozesa akapiira kikulu mu kwegatta?
output: Yee, okukozesa obupiira kukubirizibwa nnyo mu kwegatta, naddala mu bantu abalina  ababeezi abasukka mu omu era n'eri abo abali mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba embuto ezitali nneetegekere. Obupiira muziziko gwa maanyi mu kutangira okufuna olubuto n'okubeera n'emiganyulo egiwerako.

input: Waliyo ebika bya Kiramidiya?
output: "Okukwatibwa kwa Kiramidiya mu bantu kutulubawazibwa okusinziira ku nsaasaana y'ekimuleeta, ebika bye, okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala."1. Kiramidiya ava ku buwuka bwa obumuleeta asaasaana okuyita mu kukwatagana wakati w'omuntu omulamu n'omulwadde. Muno mulimu ebika nga Kiramidiya akwata ebitundu by'ekyama n'akwata amaaso.2. Kiramidiya ava ku buwuka obumuleeta asaasaana okuyita mu mussizo/omuyitiro gw'empewo. Muno mulimu ebika nga Kiramidiya aleeta Omusujja gw'Enkusu ne Kiramidiya aleeta Lubyamira."

input: Nsobola ntya okuwangaala n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Okuwangaala n'okuweeweeza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kisobokera ddala n'obujjanjabi obutuufu, obujjanjabi n'engeri gy'osalawo okweyisa. Abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okuwangaala nako mu bulamu obweyagaza nga balina obujjanjabi obutuufu n'okunywererako. Kikulu okukolagana obulungi n’abakugu mu byobulamu abakuguse mu kulabirira abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okugoberera enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi eziragiddwa, n’okusoosowaza obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu.

input: Nkola ki abantu ze bayinza okukozesa okutumbula obusaasizi n'okukendeeza ku kuboola abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okukendeeza ku kuboolebwa okwekuusa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kikulu okulumirirwa, okwenyigiramu kw'abantu bonna, n'ebiva mu bulamu obulungi eri abo ababa bakoseddwa. Zino ze zimu ku nkola ez'okuyambamu ekitundu okw'ongera okutegeera ebikwata ku Kawuka n'okuyambagana: Somesa banno era obunyise amawulire, tumbula obusaasizi n'okulumirirwa, yogerako n'abakulembeze b'ebitundu, lwanirira enkola enkola z’okulwanyisa obusosoze, yamba ku mirimu gy'ebibiina, wakanya ebigereesebwa ku kikula ky'abantu , tumbula enkuuma y'ebyama, sosowaza ensoga y'abantu okukolera awamu, tendeka abasawo era somesa ab'amawulire.

input: Omusaayi oguva mu muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gusobola okuteekebwa ku muntu omulala?
output: Nedda, abantu ssekinnoomu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebalina kugaba musaayi. Okugaba omusaayi ng’olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekiba kya bulabe kyokka eri oyo gwe baguwa wabula kimenya amateeka g'ekisawo. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kasobola okusaasaanyizibwa okuyita mu musaayi, era okugaba omusaayi ogulimu Akawuka kiyinza okuviirako omuntu gwe bagutaddeko okukwatibwa Akawuka.

input: Omwana azaaliddwa maama alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu alina emikisa emeka okubeera omulamu obulungi?
output: Yee, omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okuzaala omwana atalina kawuka singa aba alina obujjanjabi obutuufu. Kino kimanyiddwa nga okutangira okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana. Enkola nnyingi zikozesebwa okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuva ku maama okudda ku mwana mu kiseera kya maama ng'ali lubuto, okuzaala, n'okuyonsa. Kikulu okussa essira ku kuba nti emikisa gya maama ali olubuto okusiiga omwana we Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gisobola okukendeezebwa okutuuka ku kitundu 1% singa afuna obujjanjabi obutuufu era n'anywerera ku nkola eziragirwa. Abantu abali embuto abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu balina okukolagana n'abasawo baabwe okuteekawo enteekateeka y'obujjanjabi etuukana n'embeera mwe bali n'okugoberera ebiragiro byonna ebiweebwa okukuuma obulamu bw'omukyala n'omwana.

input: Nnyinza okwetangira okufuna Kiramidiya singa nfuna omubeezi omuggya?
output: Engeri yokka ey’okwewalira ddala Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa nga Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo kwe kwewala okwegattira mu bukyala, ewava obubi ne mu kamwa. Singa oba weetaba mu bikolwa eby'okwegatta, bino wammanga bisobola okukendeeza ku mikisa gyo egy'okukwatibwa Kiramidiya: Okubeera n'omubeezi omu okumala ebbanga eddene ng'omaze okumukebeza era nga talina Kiramidiya, okukozesa obupiira mu ngeri entuufu era buli lwe weegatta. Singa oba oli lubuto, yogerako n'omusawo wo ku bikwata ku kwekenneenya, okukeberwa n'okujjanjabibwa. Okujjanjaba Kiramidiya amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka kijja kukendeeza ku bizibu ebiyinza okutuuka ku bulamu bw'omwana wo.

input: Singa nzijanjabwa Enziku n'ewona, waliwo emikisa gy'okuddamu okunkwata?
output: Bw’oba walina ku Nziku n'ogijjanjaba, ekyasobola okuddamu okukukwata. Kino kibaawo singa weegatta n'omuntu agirina nga tokozesezza kapiira. Singa obubonero bwo tebukyukako ng'omaze okujjanjabibwa oba ng'olowooza nti ezzeemu n'ekukwata, laba omusawo. Wandyetaaga okuddamu okujjanjabibwa oba okukeberebwa okuzuula ebizibu ebirala.

input: Nnina mikisa gyenkana ki okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba singa nneegasse n'omuntu gwe simanyi mbeera ye ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu ne nneeyambisa PEP?
output: Emikisa gy'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Endwadde z'Ekikaba oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta n’omuntu gw'otamanyi bikwata ku mbeera ye ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu oba Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba gikendeera ng'okozesezza PEP naye tekisoboka kumanya mikisa emeka kubanga kisinziira ku nsonga nnyingi. Kikulu okutegeera nti wadde nga PEP nkola eyeesigika okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'okwetaba mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga k'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye tekola kikumi ku kikumi. Noolwekyo, kikulu okwegendereza okusobola okutangira ebinaddirira mu maaso omuli okwegatta okutateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, okukozesa obupiira n'okwogera ku bikwata ku kwegatta mu bwesimbu n'ababeezi bo. Singa oba olina obweraliikirivu nti waliko mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okubirizibwa okunoonya amagezi n'obujjanjabi embagirawo. Noonya omusawo oba akalwaliro ku kitundu weekenneenyezebwe era okeberebwe bulungi, obudaabudibwe era olondoole ebinaddirira. Basobola okukuwabula okusinziira ku mbeera yo n'obulabe obugyetooloolerako.

input: PrEP esobola okutangira Obuwuka obuleeta Endwadde z’Ekikaba?
output: PrEP ekola bulungi mu kuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye tekuwa bukuumi ku Buwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba okukendeeza ku katyabaga akaleeta obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. PrEP egenderera kuziyiza Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu era terina kakwate ka butereevu ku Bulwadde bw'Ekikaba obulala. Kikulu okumanya nti nga okozesa PrEP okuziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, wakyaliwo akatyabaga ak’okukwatibwa Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba nga Kiramidiya, Enziku, Kabootongo ne Kisipi. Okusobola okwetangira Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba oba Obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, kikulu nnyo okugoberera enkola ezisaanidde ez’okuziyiza Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, omuli: Okukozesa obupiira, okwekebeza obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba, okwogera n'abantu be weegatta nabo, okuyiga ebikwata ku bulwadde bw'Ekikaba, n'okweyambisa eddagala ery'okuziyiza obulwadde bw'Ekikaba. Mu bufunze, PrEP ekola bulungi mu kuziyiza okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu naye tewa bukuumi ku Bulwadde bwa Kikaba. Noolwekyo, kikulu okwongerezaako enkola z'okuziyiza obuwuka obuleeta Obulwadde bw'Ekikaba mu kwegatta.

input: Waliwo okusobozi bw'okufuna Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa nnalamusa omuntu akalina?
output: Tewaliiwo katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu kayita mu kulamusa oba kukwatagana na muntu alina kawuka kano. Okulamusiganya okwa bulijjo, gamba nga okukwatagana mu ngalo, okunywegerangana mu kyenyi, oba okukwatagana mu ngalo tebireetawo katyabaga ka kukwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekasobola kusaasaanyizibwa kuyita mu nkwatagana y'abantu mu mbeera eza bulijjo oba okukolagana n'abantu abalina akawuka ka vvayiraasi.

input: Endwadde zinnakigwanyizi zikyusa zitya engeri Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gye kayisaamu omubiri gwo?
output: Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu katwalibwa ng’embeera ey'olukonvuba era eyinza okutta omuntu kubanga kanafuya abaserikale b’omubiri, ekifuula omubiri okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta endwadde ez’enjawulo n'ebika bya kookolo ebimu. Wadde ng'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ko kennyini tekatta, kasobola okuvaako obuzibu obuyinza okutta omuntu, omuli obuwuka obuleeta endwadde ezirumbagana omubiri olw'okuba nti gunafuyiziddwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okutegeera nti Akawuka akaleeata Siriimu/Siriimu kasobola okuyita mu mitendera egyawukana, era nga si buli muntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nti ajja kukwatibwa obuwuka buno obuleeta obulwadde olw'okuba nti omubiri gunafuyiziddwa akawuka kano.

input: Abavubuka basobola batya okuzimba emikwano eminywevu era egibayamba mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Okukulaakulanya enkolagana ennungi n’emikwano mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka kyetaagisa nnyo ku lw'obulungi bw'abantu b'obeeramu n'ebirowoozo byo. Gano ge magezi g'osobola okusala: Beera ekyo ky'oli: Obutuufu kye kisumuluzo ky’okukola enkolagana eya nnamaddala. Beera mwesimbu eri ky’oli era okkirize abalala balabe ggwe omutuufu. Empuliziganya: Weenyigire mu mpuliziganya ey'olwatu era entuufu ne mikwano gyo. Wuliriza ng'ossaayo omwoyo era olage okusaasira. Ebintu by’oyagala: Weetabe mu mirimu oba kiraabu mw’osobola okusisinkana abantu abalina ebintu bye bafaanaganya naawe. Okuwa ekitiibwa: Ssa mu balala ekitiibwa era mu ngeri ey’ekisa. Wa ekitiibwa endowooza zaabwe, ensalo zaabwe, n’enjawulo zaabwe. Faayo ku mutindo okusinga obungi: Essira lisse ku kuzimba emikwano mitono egy’oku lusegere okusinga okugezaako okubeera mukwano gwa buli muntu. Okugonjoola obutakkaanya: Yiga engeri ennungi ez’okugonjoolamu enkaayana n’obutakkaanya. Empuliziganya ey’ekitiibwa kikulu nnyo. Okusaasira: Weeteeke mu mbeera z’abalala era fuba okutegeera endowooza zaabwe n’enneewulira zaabwe. Enkolagana ennungi etwala obudde okuzimba, noolwekyo beera mugumiikiriza era okkirize okufuna enkolagana empya. Jjukira nti emikwano emirungi gitumbula obulamu bwo era giwagira okukula kwo.

input: Lwaki kya mugaso okumanya ebisingawo ku myaka gy’obuvubuka n’obusannyalaze bw'omubiri?
output: Bw’oba ozibuwalirwa okumalako n'enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri, wano waliwo emitendera gy’osobola okuyitamu: Yogerako n’Omuntu: Okubuulirako omuzadde, omukuza, omubuziibuzi ku ssomero, oba omuntu omukulu gwe weesiga bw'owulira kusobola okukuyamba ennyo. Basobola okuwa obuwagizi, okutegeera, n’okulambikibwa. Wesomese: Okuyiga ebisingawo ku myaka gy’obuvubuka, obusannyalaze bw'omubiri, n’enkyukakyuka ezigenda mu maaso mu mubiri gwo kusobola okukuyamba okuwulira nga weetegese era nga tofaayo nnyo. Okulowooza n’okuwummulamu: Enkola nga okulowooza, dduyiro w’okussa ennyo, n’obukodyo bw’okuwummulamu bisobola okuyamba okukkakkanya ebirowoozo byo n’omubiri gwo mu biseera by'obweraliikirivu. Empisa ennungi: Essira lisse ku mpisa ennungi nga okukola dduyiro buli kiseera, okulya emmere erimu ebiriisa n’otulo otumala. Empisa zino zisobola okukyusa embeera yo mu ngeri ennungi n’obulamu bwo okutwalira awamu. Jjukira nti si kibi okusaba obuyambi ng’obwetaaga. Okugumira enkyukakyuka mu busannyalaze bw'omubiri kitundu kya bulijjo mu kukula, era waliwo ebikozesebwa n’abantu abasobola okukuwagira okuyita mu kiseera kino.

input: Omwami omukomole asobola okufuna Enziku?
output: Enziku bulwadde bwa kikaba obusaasaanyizibwa mu kwegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba ewava obubi nga tokozesezza kapiira. Era eyinza okusaasaana okuva ku maama agirina okudda ku mwana we omuwere ng'azaalibwa. Era eyinza okusaasaanira ebitundu by'omubiri ebirala, okugeza, omuntu ayinza okugifuna ng'akutte ku bitundu by'ekyama, amaaso, omumwa, oba ewava obubi olwo ne yeekwata ku bitundu bye eby'ekyama, omumwa, amaaso oba ewava obubi.

input: Kaba kabagulizo ka kubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu singa muganzi wange omuwala abeera akoogerako nnyo?
output: Singa muganzi wo atera okulaga okweraliikirira oba obutali butebenkevu ku ngeri gy’ayinza okuba n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, kikulu okusemberera embeera eyo ng’osaasira, ng’otegeera bulungi, era ng’owuliziganya mu lwatu. Wadde nga kiyinza obutaba "okweyoleka kw'obuzibu," kiraga nti alina okukulungutana oba okweraliikirira okukwatagana n'obulamu bwe obw'okwegatta.

input: Biki ebikozesebwa mu kukola obupiira ebitangira amazzi okukwatagana mu kwegatta?
output: Obupiira bw'abaami n'abakyala busobola okukola obulungi mu kutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bukozesebwa mu butuufu era entakera. Okusalawo ku kukozesa akapiira k'abaami oba ak'abakyala kisinziira ku muntu ssekinnoomu by’ayagala n’embeera gy’alimu. Obupiira bw'abaami bwe businga okukozesebwa era n'okusangibwa buli wamu.  Zikolebwa nga zirina amazzi agaseerera, era zitondawo omuziziko ogutangira okuwaanyisiganya kw'amazzi mu kwegatta. Obupiira bw'abakazi tebutera kulabika nga bwe kiri ku bw'abasajja wadde nga nabwo buteekawo obukuumi obuziyiza okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Osobola okunnyonnyola obukulu bw’okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng’oli lubuto?
output: Abakyala bangi abakeberebwa nga balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu nga bali embuto tebamanyi nti balina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Bayinza obutaba na bubonero oba nga tebakeberebwanga. Kikulu okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu omanye oba okalina, osobole okukwata emitendera: okwekuuma nga oli mulamu bulungi okuziyiza okusiiga omwana wo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Okunywerera ku nkola ya ART okusobola okuziyiza maama okusiiga omwana ali mu lubuto Akawuka. Kisobozesa bamaama okufuna embuto ezitali za bulabe era nga balamu bulungi n’okuzaala abaana abalamu era abatalina Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Kyetaagisa okubuulirako omusawo wange ku byafaayo byange eby’okwegatta?
output: Yee, kibayamba okukulabirira obulungi, era buli kimu bakikuuma nga kyama!

input: Mitendera ki omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu gy’ayinza okuyitamu okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'endwadde zinnakigwanyizi?
output: Okumira eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ye ngeri esinga obulungi ey'okwetangiramu okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi.  Eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu lisobola okukuuma omubiri gwo nga mulamu bulungi. Bw’okwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi, yogerako n’omusawo wo ku ngeri gy’osobola okubujjanjaba. Waliwo n’ebintu ebirala by’osobola okukola okwewala obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi:Yogera n’omusawo wo ku ddagala n’eddagala erigema erisobola okukuyamba okwewala okukwatibwa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bunnakigwanyizi obumu.Weewale okukwatibwa endwadde ezisaasaanyizibwa mu kwegatta.Togabana mpiso, ebbomba z'empiso, oba ebintu ebirala ebikozesebwa okukuba empiso (gamba ng’ebikozesebwa mu kufumba).

input: Lwaki kya bulabe okwesigama ku ddagala ly'ekinnansi lyokka mu kujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Tewali bujulizi bwa ssaayansi buwagira kigambibwa nti omuddo oba eddagala ly’ebimera lisobola okuwonya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu kawuka kazibu akalumba abaserikale b’omubiri, era tekasobola kuwonyezebwa bulungi oba okuggyibwawo na bujjanjabi bwa ddagala lya bimera oba enzijanjaba ez'ebika ebirala. Obujjanjabi obusookerwako obw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bwe bujjanjabi obuweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, nga buno buzingiramu okumira omugatte gw'eddagala ly'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu erigabibwa abakugu mu by’obulamu.  Eddagala eriweweeza ku Kawuka aaleeta Siriimu liyamba okufufuggaza akawuka, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka mu musaayi okutuuka ku mutendera kwe katasobola kuzuulirwa, n’okukuuma obulamu bw’abaserikale b’omubiri. Wadde ng'enzijanjaba eweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu esobola bulungi okukendeeza amaanyi g'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, teggyirawo ddala kawuka mu mubiri, era omuntu abeera yeetaaga okunywerera ku bujjanjabi bw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obulamu bwe bwonna. Kikulu nnyo okwanganga obujjanjabi n’enzirukanya y'embeera ey'okubeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’obujjanjabi obwesigama ku bujulizi bw'ekisawo. Okwesigama ku bujjanjabi bw'eddagala ly’ebimera lyokka oba obujjanjabi obulala nga tolina bulagirizi butuufu mu basawo kiyinza okuba eky’akabi era kiyinza okuvaako Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu k'olina obutajjanjabibwa mu budde, ekiyinza okuvaamu ebizibu eby’amaanyi mu bulamu.

input: Obusannyalaze bw'omu mubiri bukola mulimu ki mu kiseera ky'okuvubuka?
output: Obusannyalaze bw'omubiri bulinga babaka mu mubiri gwo. Mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka, bukola emirimu emikulu egiwerako: bukuleetera okukula, ekikuyamba okuwanvuwa, era buleeta enkyukakyuka mu ddoboozi lyo, gamba ng’okudoodooma mu abalenzi. Ziviirako okufuna enkyukakyuka mu bitundu by'ekyama mu bawala n'abalenzi, gamba ng’amabeere g’abawala n’enviiri mu ffeesi eri abalenzi. Zikosa ebirowoozo byo n’embeera gy’owuliramu, ne zikuleetera okuwulira ng’olowooza nnyo oba ng’okyukakyuka mu mbeera ng’oli mu myaka gy’obuvubuka.

input: Kirungi okugenda mu maaso n'enkolagana erimu okwegatta singa omubeezi wo abeera n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate nga ggwe tokalina?
output: Okusalawo oba okukuuma oba okugenda mu maaso n’enkolagana n’omwagalwa alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate nga ggwe tokalina si kya kusalawo kikyo ng'omuntu era kyesigamizibwa ku nsonga ezy’enjawulo, omuli eddaala ly’okutegeera kwo, empuliziganya, n’okwewaayo kwo eri omukwano n’obulamu bwo. Kikulu okumanya nti enkolagana n'abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esobola okuba ennungi, ey'okwagala, era ematiza.

input: Nkola ntya singa nteebereza muganzi wange omuwala okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ate nga neegasse naye nga sseetangidde ekiro kya jjo?
output: Singa oba weekengedde nti muganzi wo omuwala ayinza okuba n'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu ng'ate weegasse naye ekiro kya jjo nga teweetangidde, kikulu okwetangira embagirawo. Jjukira nti wadde nga waliwo akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu kwegatta nga teweetangidde si kya tteeka. Okwekebeza amangu, okutangira okumira PEP bwe kiba kiragiddwa, n’okutandika okwetangira biyinza okuyambako okukendeeza ku katyabaga. Nga tofudde ku bivudde mu kwekebeza, kikulu okusoosowaza enkola z'okwegatta ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga era n'okwogera mu bwesimbu n'omubeezi wo ebikwata ku mbeera y'okwegatta n'okutangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Lwaki kikulu okukuuma obuyonjo mu kwemazisa?
output: Okwemazisa kwo kwennyini tekuleeta bulwadde mu mubiri. Mu butuufu, okwemazisa kikolwa kya kwegatta kya bulijjo era ekirungi abantu bangi kye beenyigiramu obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Kirina emiganyulo egiwerako, omuli okumalawo okukabirirwa, okulongoosa embeera y’omuntu, n’okukola obulungi mu by’okwegatta. Wabula, kikulu okukuuma obuyonjo ng’ogenda okwemazisa okukendeeza ku katyabaga k’okuyingiza obuwuka bwa bbakitiiriya oba obuwuka obulala obuleeta endwadde mu bitundu by’ekyama.

input: Bintu ki ebireetera omuntu okusalawo okwewala okwegatta?
output: Okwewala okwenyigira mu bikolwa by'okwegatta kya kyeyagalire, era engeri gy'oyinza okwewalamu okwegatta zijja kusinziira ku mbeera yo, empisa zo, n'ebikusikiriza. Kikulu okujjukira nti okusalawo okwewala okwegatta kya kyeyagalire, era bulijjo kusaanidde okusinziira ku mpisa zo n'ebyo by'oyagala.

input: Ng’oggyeeko eddagala lya ARVs, waliwo engeri endala ez'ekisawo ezisobola okumalawo Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Tewali ddagala liwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeeta Siriimu ng’oggyeeko eddagala erikaweweezaako. Enkola y'okuweweeza ku kawuka bwe bujjanjabi obw’omutindo obusinga okukola ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Eyamba okukkakkanya vvayiraasi, okukendeeza ku bungi bw’akawuka mu mubiri, okuzzaamu abaserikale b’omu mubiri, n’okukendeeza ku kukula kw’obulwadde. Kyokka tekiwonyeza ddala Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti wadde enkola zino ziwa essuubi, tewali n’emu ku zo ekakasiddwa nti ddagala erijjuvu era erituukiridde okuwonyeza ddala Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku bye nnakasembayo okumanya. Enkola enkulu era esinga okusembebwa okukkakkanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu esigala nga ya kukaweweezaako, ekiyamba abantu abalina akawuka okuwangaalira mu balamu obweyagaza ate nga bwe bakendeeza ku bungi bw'akawuka mu musaayi okutuuka ku ssa ly'obutazuulibwa n'okukendeeza ku katyabaga k'okukasaasaanya. Okunoonyereza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu kukyagenda mu maaso, noolwekyo kirungi okubeera ng’omanyi ebigenda mu maaso nga weebuuza ku nsonda ezeesigika ez'abakugu mu byobulamu.

input: Obuwangaazi bw'omuntu ali ku ddagala lya ARV busuubirwa kwenkana wa?
output: Abantu bangi abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu basobola okusuubira okuwangaala nga bannaabwe abatakalina. Okunoonyereza kulaga nti obuwangaazi bw'omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu bufaananako n’obw’omuntu atakalina kasita azuulibwa mu budde obulungi, ng’afuna obujjanjabi obulungi, era ng’asobola okunywerera ku bujjanjabi bwe obw’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Bbanga ki erikubirizibwa okukozesa PEP?
output: Ekiseera ky'okumira eddagala eriziyiza Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu oluvannyuma lw'okwetaba mu mbeera ekuteeka mu katyabaga kitera kuba nnaku 28 (ssabbiiti 4). PEP kika kya bujjanjabi obuziyiza okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu obuweebwa abantu ababa bamaze okwetaba mu mbeera eyinza okubateeka mu Katyabaga k'okukwatibwa nga bayita mu bikolwa nga okwegatta n'omuntu atamanyiddwa oba alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufuna ebisago eby'empiso, oba embeera endala ez'akatyabaga k'okusaasaanya Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Ababeezi bange be nneegatta nabo balina engeri yonna gye bayambibwamu singa nkeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Okumanya embeera yo kikakasa okukuumibwa kw'obulamu bw'omubeezi wo. Bw’oba n’obulwadde buno osobola okugoberera emitendera gy'okulaba ng’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tekakwata mubeezi wo.

input: Nkola ki eziyinza okuyamba omuntu okunywerera ku ky'okwewala okwegatta nga tannagenda mu bufumbo?
output: Okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa kikusalawo wa muntu ssekinnoomu okusinziira ku by'oyagala, by'okkiririzaamu n’ebiruubirirwa byo. Bw’oba nga weewaddeyo okwewala okwegatta nga tonnafumbirwa, zino ze zimu ku nkola eziyinza okukuyambako okutuukiriza okusalawo kwo: Teekawo ekkomo ku bintu by'otalina kukola, funa ababeezi bwe mufaananya endowooza, era oteekewo empuliziganya ennungi.

input: Nkola ki ezeetaagisa okulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu?
output: Omutindo gw'okumanyisa abantu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okusomesa, ne kampeyini bisobola okwawukanira ddala okuva mu kitundu oba ensi emu okudda ku ndala era n'ekiseera nga bwe kigenda kiyitawo. Wabula waliwo ensonga eziwerako lwaki ebitundu oba abantu abamu bayinza obutaba na kampeyini nnyingi ez’okusomesa n’okumanyisa abantu ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Kikulu okumanya nti ebitongole bingi, gavumenti, n’ebibiina by’obwannakyewa bikyagenda mu maaso n’okukola obutakoowa ku kaweefube w’okusomesa, okuziyiza, n’okujjanjaba Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu kakyali kya kusoomooza mu by’obulamu mu nsi yonna, era waliwo kampeyini n’enteekateeka ezigenda mu maaso yaezigendereddwamu okumanyisa abantu, okukendeeza ku kuboola abakalina, okutumbula okufuna obujjanjabi, n’okutumbula enneeyisa ezitateeka bulamu mu katyabaga okusobola okutangira okusaasaana kw’akawuka kano. Kaweefube w’okulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu yeetaaga omugatte gw'enkola ez’enjawulo omuli okusomesa, okukebera, okuziyiza, n’okujjanjaba, era kaweefube ono asobola okwawukana okusinziira ku mbeera ez’enjawulo n’okusoomoozebwa okusangibwa mu buli kitundu. Okumanyisa abantu n’okubasomesa bintu bikulu nnyo mu kulwanyisa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, era okugenda mu maaso n’okubunyisa amawulire kyetaagisa okusobola okukola ku nsonga eziyinza okubeera omuziziko eri kaweefube ono mu bitundu ebimu.

input: Nsobola okuzaala omwana mu ngeri ey'obutonde nga nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Ebiseera ebisinga kikubirizibwa abakyala abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okuzaala mu ngeri ey'obutonde (okuzaalira mu bukyala). Singa okuzaalira mu bukyala kubeera nga kujja kuzibuwala, kiyinza okuba ekirngiko okulongoosebwamu omwana. Kuno kwe kulongoosa okw'okuggya omwana mu nnabaana yo. Bw’oba olina akawuka kangi mu musaayi, oyinza n’okuweebwa amagezi okulongoosebwa. Omusawo wo ajja kukuwa amagezi ku ngeri esinga obulungi ey’okuzaalamu omwana wo. Bw’oba ogenda kuzaalira waka, genda ew’omusawo amangu ddala ng’omaze okuzaala asobole okukebera obulamu bwo n’obulamu bw’omwana wo, okumukebera Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, n’okubatandisa ku bujjanjabi obw'ekiseera ekitono okusobola okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu.

input: Okwagala okwegatta n'engeri omuntu gye yengangamu embeera y'okwegatta byawukana okusinziira ku bantu?
output: Obagazi bw'okwegatta n’engeri omuntu gy’akwatamu enneewulira z’afuna mu by’okwegatta bisobola okwawukanira ddala mu bantu ssekinnoomu, era tewali nsonga n’emu ennyonnyola lwaki abantu abamu, omuli n’abawala, bayinza okwagala ennyo oba okunyumirwa okwegatta oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Obwagazi bw’okwegatta, okusikirizibwa, n’okumatizibwa bintu bizibu era bifugibwa omugatte gw'ensonga ez’obutonde, ez’eby’obwongo, n’ez’embeerabantu. Bino bye bimu ku bintu ebirina okulowoozebwako: Ensonga za ssaayansi w'obulamu, enkwatagana mu birowoozo, eby’obwongo, ensonga z’embeerabantu n’obuwangwa, omuntu by'ayiseemu, okukkiriza n’okukola okusalawo. Kikulu okutegeera nti buli muntu by'ayitamu mu kwegatta bya njawulo, era tewali nnyinyonnyola "emu ekola ku buli omu" lwaki okwagala kw'omuntu okw'okwegatta kweyongera oluvannyuma lw'omulundi gwe ogusooka mu kwegatta. Okugatta ku ekyo, abantu abamu bayinza obutafuna nkyukakyuka za maanyi mu bwagazi bwabwe oba mu ndowooza zaabwe oluvannyuma lw’omulundi gwabwe ogusooka okwegatta. Empuliziganya ey'olwatu era ey'amazima n’abantu be weegatta nabo, okwegatta mu ngeri etateeka bulamu mu katyabaga, n’okusalawo mu ngeri ey’amagezi ku bulamu bw’omuntu mu by’okwegatta bintu bikulu nnyo mu kwegatta okw’obuvunaanyizibwa. Bw’oba olina ebibuuzo oba ebikweraliikiriza ku bwagazi bwo oba obw'omubeezi wo mu kwegatta oba by’ayitamu, lowooza ku ky’okubiteesaako n’omusawo w’ebyobulamu oba omukugu mu by’obulamu bw’obwongo asobola okukuwa okulambikibwa n’obuwagizi.

input: Bubonero ki obwoleka Kiramidiya mu baami n'abakyala?
output: "Kiramidiya era amanyiddwa ng'Akawuka ka Kiramidiya akalwaza Ebitundu by'ekyama n'omuyitiro gw'omusulo tekatera kwoleka bubonero, naye nga kasobola okuleeta obuzibu obw'amaanyi ku bulamu, wadde nga tekalaze bubonero. Singa obubonero bweyoleka, kiyinza okutwala ssabbiiti eziwera oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta n'omuntu akalina.                                                                                                                                                               1. Mu bakyala, obubonero bw'akawuka obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu eby'ekayama mulimu enkyukakyuka mu langi y'amazzi agava mu bukyala (enjeru, kyenvu, oba kitosi agayinza okuba nga gawunya), okuddingana mu nsonga oba okuvaamu omusaayi oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta, obulumi mu ndira, n'okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa.2. Mu baami, obubonero obutera okweyolekera mu bitundu by'ekyama oluvannyuma lw'okukwatibwa akawuka kano mulimu okubabuukirirwa nga bafuuyisa, okuvaamu amazzi agalinga eminyira mu busajja n'obulumi mu nsigo.3. Okukwatibwa akawuka kano ewafulumira obubi mu baami n'abakyala kiyinza okuleeta obulumi, amazzi agalinga eminyira n'okuvaamu omusaayi. Singa omulwadde aba n'obulwadde bw'ensanjabavu, obubonero obusooka okweyoleka mulimu amabwa mu bitundu by’ekyama, oluvannyuma okuzimba n'okulumizibwa kw'ensanjabavu mu bitundu by’ekyama ebiruma.

input: Plan B oba P2, era emanyiddwa nga akaweke k'okumakya egendereddwamu ki?
output: Ppulaani B oba P2, era emanyiddwa nga "empeke y'oku makya," egendererwamu okukozesebwa obw'olumu ne mu mbeera ey'obwangu oluvannyuma lw'okwegatta nga teweetangidde oba ng'enkola za kizaalaggumba endala ziremereddwa.  Teyakolebwa kukozesebwa ntakera oba emirundi emingi ng’enkola enkulu ey’okuziyiza okuzaala. Emirundi gy’okukozesa P2 girina okukendeezebwa, era erina kukozesebwa mu kaseera ka bwangu kokka.  Okukozesa ennyo P2 kuyinza okuvaako okukendeeza ku nkola yaayo, okwongera ku bulabe bw’ebizibu ebiva mu kugikozesa, n’okwongera ku kukaluubirirwa n’okusaasaanya ssente. Kikulu okutegeera nti wadde nga P2 nkola ya muwendo nnyo mu kuziyiza embuto z'oteetegekedde mu mbeera ez’amangu, tekola bulungi oba teyeesigika kwenkana nkola za kizaalaggumba endala ezimanyiddwa, obuweke obuziyiza okufuna olubuto, obupiira, n'obuti bw'omu mukono obuziyiza okufuna olubuto.

input: Enziku bulwadde bwa kikaba?
output: Enziku bulwadde bwa kikaba obusaasaanyizibwa mu kwegattira mu bukyala, mu kamwa oba ewava obubi nga tokozesezza kapiira. Era eyinza okusaasaana okuva ku maama agirina okudda ku mwana we omuwere ng'azaalibwa. Era eyinza okusaasaanira ebitundu by'omubiri ebirala, okugeza, omuntu ayinza okugifuna ng'akutte ku bitundu by'ekyama, amaaso, omumwa, oba ewava obubi olwo ne yeekwata ku bitundu bye eby'ekyama, omumwa, amaaso oba ewava obubi.

input: Abatiini okufuna embuto kizibu kya maanyi gye bali?
output: Yee, kisobola okukosa obulamu bwo n'okusoma kwo, noolwekyo kiba kirungi okwetegeka n'okubeera mu mbeera etali ya katyabaga.

input: Nkola ki ez'okwetangira ze nsobola okukozesa okwewala okukwatibwa endwadde endala, naddala nga nnina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu?
output: Bw’oba olina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu waliwo emitendera mingi gy’oyinza okuyitamu okukuuma obulamu bwo: mira eddagala lyo eriweweeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu buli lunaku nga bwe likulagiddwa (oluusi liyitibwa ‘okunywerera ku ddagala’) lya bulungi kola dduyiro buli kiseera tonywa mwenge mungi tonywa ssigala.

input: Waliyo eddagala ly'Enziku ery'ekinnansi?
output: Tosobola kujjanjaba Nziku nga weegulira eddagala oba okwejjanjabira awaka. Singa olowooza nti olina Enziku oba nga omubeezi wo azuuliddwamu akawuka akaleeta Enziku, ojja kwetaaga okukeberebwa n'okujjanjabibwa omusawo omutendeke.

input: Kituufu nti omuntu alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu asobola okuba n'obuwangaazi n'asigala ng'asiiga abalala akawuka?

input: Lwaki kikulu okwebuuza ku musawo singa wabaawo obweraliikirivu oba ebibuuzo ku nkozesa ya kizaalaggumba?

Wabula, kikulu okufa ku bintu ebimu: ebiyinza okubaawo mu kaseera akatono, emiganyulo, emiganyulo egyekuusa ku butakozesa nkola ziziyiza kufuna lubuto, okwawukana mu bantu, eby'okulondako ku nkola z'okutangira okufuna embuto, n’okukeberebwa mu ddwaliro okwa buli kiseera. Enkola eziziyiza okufuna olubuto zirina emiganyulo egisukka ku kutangira olubuto, enkola z'obeera osazeewo okukozesa okusinziira ku bulamu bwo ne by'oyagala. Singa wabeerawo obweraliikirivu bwonna oba ebibuuzo ebyekuusa ku kukozesa enkola eziziyiza okuzaala, kikubirizibwa okwebuuza ku musawo asobola okukulambika n'okukuwa obuyambi.

input: Nsobola ntya okwogera ne bazadde bange oba abakuza bange ku nsonga z’okugenda mu nsonga singa mbeera mpulira nga sitebenkedde?

input: Luvannyuma lwa bbanga ki akaweke k'okumakya (P2) lwe kayinza okukozesebwa ne kasigala nga kakola bulungi?

input: Kisoboka omukyala alina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu/Siriimu okuzaala omwana?

input: Kisoboka abaana abali wansi w’emyaka 12 okuba n’Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, oba bulijjo bo tekabakwata?

Tewali muntu yenna "mulongoofu" oba atakwatibwa Kawuka kaleeta Siriimu okusinziira ku myaka gye gyokka. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okusinga kasiigibwa okuyita mu nneeyisa oba embeera ez'akatyabaga k'okukwatibwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, so si kuyita mu ngeri za buzaaliranwa oba obutaba na musango. Kikulu nnyo okukiggumiza nti abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu tebalina musango ku bulwadde bwabwe, era basaana obujjanjabi obusaanidde, obuwagizi, n’obukuumi. Enkola z'okwetangira Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, omuli okusomesa ku Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okufuna okukeberebwa Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu n’okujjanjaba abakyala ab’embuto, n’okwegendereza okwa bulijjo mu bifo eby’ebyobulamu, bikulu nnyo mu kukendeeza ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu baana. Okusomesa ku Kawuka akaleeta Siriimu, okumanyisa abantu, n'okufuna empeereza z'ebyobulamu bikola kinene mu kutangira okusaasaana kw'Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mu bibinja by'emyaka gyonna, omuli n'abaana. Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu mbeera esobola okuziyizibwa era esobola okuddukanyizibwa, era okuzuulibwa amangu n’okujjanjabibwa kisobola okuyamba abaana abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okubeera n’obulamu obulungi.

input: Kiseera ki ekitera okukozesebwamu  eddagala eritta obuwuka okujjanjaba Akafuba akakwata amawuggwe?
output: Akafuba akoolese obubonero kumpi bulijjo kasobola okuwonyezebwa n’eddagala eritta bbakitiiriya. Ku Kafuba k’amawuggwe, eddagala eritta bbakitiiriya litera okumiribwa buli lunaku okumala emyezi mukaaga. Ku bantu abalina Akafuba mu bitundu by’omubiri ebirala, obujjanjabi bujja kumala ebbanga ddeneko, oboolyawo okutuuka ku myezi 24. Akafuba akatalaga bubonero kasobola okujjanjabibwa n’obujjanjabi obw’okukatangira okusuumuka okufuuka Akafuba akalaga obubonero. Kino bulijjo kyetaagisa abantu abalina Akawuka akaleeta Siriimu okwetangira obulwadde obuvaako Akafuba n'okukawonya. Emitendera gy'obujjanjabi gijja kuba gye gimu n’egy’Akafuba akalaze obubonero. Kikulu okumira empeke zonna ze bakuwadde kuba bw’otokikola, Akafuba katuuka nga tekakyawulira ddagala, era nga kazibu nnyo okujjanjaba.

input: Nneekebeza ntya Kabootongo?
